def CerberusHeapLang.Frag.casesOn :
∀ {motive : (a : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr) → CerberusHeapLang.Frag a → Prop}
  {a : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} (t : CerberusHeapLang.Frag a),
  (∀ (v : value), motive (generic_expr.Expr [] (Epure (Pexpr [] () (PEval v)))) ⋯) →
    (∀ {loc : CerbLocation.Loc} {ann : core_run_annotation} {lk : Bool} {ty : ctype}
        {pv : CerbMem.PointerValue} {cv : value} {mo : memory_order},
        motive (CerberusHeapLang.storeRedex loc ann lk ty pv cv mo) ⋯) →
      (∀ {loc : CerbLocation.Loc} {ann : core_run_annotation} {ty : ctype}
          {pv : CerbMem.PointerValue} {mo : memory_order},
          motive (CerberusHeapLang.loadRedex loc ann ty pv mo) ⋯) →
        (∀ {loc : CerbLocation.Loc} {ann : core_run_annotation} {align : CerbMem.IntegerValue}
            {ty : ctype} {pref : prefix0},
            motive (CerberusHeapLang.createRedex loc ann align ty pref) ⋯) →
          (∀ {loc : CerbLocation.Loc} {ann : core_run_annotation} {kind : kill_kind}
              {pv : CerbMem.PointerValue}, motive (CerberusHeapLang.killRedex loc ann kind pv) ⋯) →
            (∀ {loc : CerbLocation.Loc} {ann : core_run_annotation} {kind : kill_kind}
                {pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym} (hnv : valueFromPexpr pe = none)
                (hp : CerberusHeapLang.PePure pe)
                (hdp : CerberusHeapLang.peDepth pe ≤ lemDefaultFuel),
                motive (CerberusHeapLang.killOpRedex loc ann kind pe) ⋯) →
              (∀ {loc : CerbLocation.Loc} {ann : core_run_annotation}
                  {align size : CerbMem.IntegerValue} {pref : prefix0},
                  motive (CerberusHeapLang.allocRedex loc ann align size pref) ⋯) →
                (∀ {loc : CerbLocation.Loc} {ann : core_run_annotation}
                    {pe1 pe2 : generic_pexpr Unit sym} {pref : prefix0}
                    (hnv : valueFromPexprs [pe1, pe2] = none) (hp1 : CerberusHeapLang.PePure pe1)
                    (hp2 : CerberusHeapLang.PePure pe2)
                    (hd1 : CerberusHeapLang.peDepth pe1 ≤ lemDefaultFuel)
                    (hd2 : CerberusHeapLang.peDepth pe2 ≤ lemDefaultFuel),
                    motive (CerberusHeapLang.allocOpRedex loc ann pe1 pe2 pref) ⋯) →
                  (∀ {pa : List annot} {bty : core_base_type} {e1 e2 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr}
                      (a : CerberusHeapLang.Frag e1) (a_1 : CerberusHeapLang.Frag e2),
                      motive
                        (generic_expr.Expr [] (Esseq (Pattern pa (CaseBase (none, bty))) e1 e2))
                        ⋯) →
                    (∀ {ds : List dyn_annotation} {b : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr}
                        (a : CerberusHeapLang.Frag b),
                        motive (generic_expr.Expr [] (Eannot ds b)) ⋯) →
                      (∀ {sb : sym × core_base_type}
                          {ps :
                            List
                              (sym ×
                                (core_base_type × Option (ctype × pass_by_value_or_pointer)) ×
                                  generic_pexpr Unit sym)}
                          {body : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr}
                          (hp :
                            ∀ (pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym),
                              pe ∈ CerberusHeapLang.saveParamPexprs ps → CerberusHeapLang.PePure pe)
                          (hd :
                            ∀ (pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym),
                              pe ∈ CerberusHeapLang.saveParamPexprs ps →
                                CerberusHeapLang.peDepth pe ≤ lemDefaultFuel)
                          (a : CerberusHeapLang.Frag body),
                          motive (CerberusHeapLang.saveRedex sb ps body) ⋯) →
                        (∀ {g : generic_pexpr Unit sym} {e2 e3 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr}
                            (hpg : CerberusHeapLang.PePure g)
                            (hdg : CerberusHeapLang.peDepth g ≤ lemDefaultFuel)
                            (a : CerberusHeapLang.Frag e2) (a_1 : CerberusHeapLang.Frag e3),
                            motive (CerberusHeapLang.ifRedex g e2 e3) ⋯) →
                          (∀ {ra : core_run_annotation} {l : sym}
                              {pes : List (generic_pexpr Unit sym)}
                              (hpes :
                                ∀ (pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym),
                                  pe ∈ pes → CerberusHeapLang.PePure pe)
                              (hdep :
                                ∀ (pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym),
                                  pe ∈ pes → CerberusHeapLang.peDepth pe ≤ lemDefaultFuel),
                              motive (CerberusHeapLang.runRedex ra l pes) ⋯) →
                            (∀ {pa pb : List _root_.annot} {x : sym} {bty : core_base_type}
                                {e1 e2 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} (a : CerberusHeapLang.Frag e1)
                                (a_1 : CerberusHeapLang.Frag e2),
                                motive
                                  (generic_expr.Expr []
                                    (Esseq (CerberusHeapLang.specPat pa pb x bty) e1 e2))
                                  ⋯) →
                              (∀ {pb : List _root_.annot} {x : sym},
                                  motive (CerberusHeapLang.pureRedex (Pexpr pb () (PEsym x))) ⋯) →
                                (∀ {loc : CerbLocation.Loc} {ann : core_run_annotation} {ty : ctype}
                                    {pe2 : generic_pexpr Unit sym} {mo : memory_order}
                                    (hnv2 : valueFromPexpr pe2 = none)
                                    (hp2 : CerberusHeapLang.PePure pe2)
                                    (hd2 : CerberusHeapLang.peDepth pe2 ≤ lemDefaultFuel),
                                    motive (CerberusHeapLang.loadOpRedex loc ann ty pe2 mo) ⋯) →
                                  (∀ {pa : List _root_.annot} {x : sym} {bty : core_base_type}
                                      {e1 e2 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr}
                                      (hb : CerberusHeapLang.BareHead e1)
                                      (a : CerberusHeapLang.Frag e1)
                                      (a_1 : CerberusHeapLang.Frag e2),
                                      motive
                                        (generic_expr.Expr []
                                          (Esseq (CerberusHeapLang.symPat pa x bty) e1 e2))
                                        ⋯) →
                                    (∀ (v1 v2 : value),
                                        motive (CerberusHeapLang.memopPtrEqVals v1 v2) ⋯) →
                                      (∀ {pe1 pe2 : generic_pexpr Unit sym}
                                          (hnv : valueFromPexprs [pe1, pe2] = none)
                                          (hp1 : CerberusHeapLang.PePure pe1)
                                          (hp2 : CerberusHeapLang.PePure pe2)
                                          (hd1 : CerberusHeapLang.peDepth pe1 ≤ lemDefaultFuel)
                                          (hd2 : CerberusHeapLang.peDepth pe2 ≤ lemDefaultFuel),
                                          motive (CerberusHeapLang.memopRedex PtrEq [pe1, pe2]) ⋯) →
                                        (∀ {loc : CerbLocation.Loc} {ann : core_run_annotation}
                                            {ty : ctype} {pe2 pe3 : generic_pexpr Unit sym}
                                            {mo : memory_order}
                                            (hnv : valueFromPexprs [pe2, pe3] = none)
                                            (hp2 : CerberusHeapLang.PePure pe2)
                                            (hp3 : CerberusHeapLang.PePure pe3)
                                            (hd2 : CerberusHeapLang.peDepth pe2 ≤ lemDefaultFuel)
                                            (hd3 : CerberusHeapLang.peDepth pe3 ≤ lemDefaultFuel),
                                            motive
                                              (CerberusHeapLang.storeOpRedex loc ann ty pe2 pe3 mo)
                                              ⋯) →
                                          (∀ {b : List _root_.annot} {cval : value}
                                              {pats : List (pattern × CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr)}
                                              (hbr :
                                                ∀ (e' : expr core_run_annotation),
                                                  select_case subst_sym_expr cval pats = some e' →
                                                    CerberusHeapLang.Frag e')
                                              (hbsz :
                                                ∀ (e' : expr core_run_annotation),
                                                  select_case subst_sym_expr cval pats = some e' →
                                                    CerberusHeapLang.esize e' ≤
                                                      CerberusHeapLang.esize
                                                        (CerberusHeapLang.caseRedex
                                                          (Pexpr b () (PEval cval)) pats)),
                                              motive
                                                (CerberusHeapLang.caseRedex
                                                  (Pexpr b () (PEval cval)) pats)
                                                ⋯) →
                                            (∀ {pa : List _root_.annot} {bty : core_base_type}
                                                {e1 e2 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr}
                                                (a : CerberusHeapLang.Frag e1)
                                                (a_1 : CerberusHeapLang.Frag e2),
                                                motive
                                                  (generic_expr.Expr []
                                                    (Ewseq (Pattern pa (CaseBase (none, bty))) e1
                                                      e2))
                                                  ⋯) →
                                              (∀ {ra : core_run_annotation} {f : sym}
                                                  {pes : List (generic_pexpr Unit sym)}
                                                  (hpes :
                                                    ∀ (pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym),
                                                      pe ∈ pes → CerberusHeapLang.PePure pe)
                                                  (hdep :
                                                    ∀ (pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym),
                                                      pe ∈ pes →
                                                        CerberusHeapLang.peDepth pe ≤
                                                          lemDefaultFuel),
                                                  motive (CerberusHeapLang.callRedex ra f pes) ⋯) →
                                                motive a t
----
ctor CerberusHeapLang.Frag.create :
∀ {loc : CerbLocation.Loc} {ann : core_run_annotation} {align : CerbMem.IntegerValue} {ty : ctype}
  {pref : prefix0}, CerberusHeapLang.Frag (CerberusHeapLang.createRedex loc ann align ty pref)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.Frag.decomp :
∀ {e : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr},
  CerberusHeapLang.Frag e →
    CerberusHeapLang.toVal e = none →
      ∃ ctx r, CerberusHeapLang.Decomp e ctx r ∧ CerberusHeapLang.Frag r
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.Frag.esize_le_pot :
∀ {e : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr},
  CerberusHeapLang.Frag e → CerberusHeapLang.esize e ≤ CerberusHeapLang.pot e
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.Frag.esize_step_bound :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {e : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack}
  {ctl : CerberusHeapLang.Ctl} {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem} {e' : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr}
  {ρ' : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack} {σ' : CerberusHeapLang.Mem},
  CerberusHeapLang.Frag e →
    CerberusHeapLang.Step M (e, ρ, ctl, σ) (e', ρ', ctl, σ') →
      CerberusHeapLang.esize e' ≤ CerberusHeapLang.esize e + 1 ∨
        ∃ l pes params cont,
          CerberusHeapLang.jumpRedex? e = some (l, pes) ∧
            CerberusHeapLang.lookupLabel (M.labelsAt ctl.proc) l = some (params, cont) ∧ e' = cont
----
ctor CerberusHeapLang.Frag.if_ :
∀ {g : generic_pexpr Unit sym} {e2 e3 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr},
  CerberusHeapLang.PePure g →
    CerberusHeapLang.peDepth g ≤ lemDefaultFuel →
      CerberusHeapLang.Frag e2 →
        CerberusHeapLang.Frag e3 → CerberusHeapLang.Frag (CerberusHeapLang.ifRedex g e2 e3)
----
ctor CerberusHeapLang.Frag.kill :
∀ {loc : CerbLocation.Loc} {ann : core_run_annotation} {kind : kill_kind}
  {pv : CerbMem.PointerValue}, CerberusHeapLang.Frag (CerberusHeapLang.killRedex loc ann kind pv)
----
ctor CerberusHeapLang.Frag.kill_op :
∀ {loc : CerbLocation.Loc} {ann : core_run_annotation} {kind : kill_kind}
  {pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym},
  valueFromPexpr pe = none →
    CerberusHeapLang.PePure pe →
      CerberusHeapLang.peDepth pe ≤ lemDefaultFuel →
        CerberusHeapLang.Frag (CerberusHeapLang.killOpRedex loc ann kind pe)
----
ctor CerberusHeapLang.Frag.load :
∀ {loc : CerbLocation.Loc} {ann : core_run_annotation} {ty : ctype} {pv : CerbMem.PointerValue}
  {mo : memory_order}, CerberusHeapLang.Frag (CerberusHeapLang.loadRedex loc ann ty pv mo)
----
ctor CerberusHeapLang.Frag.load_op :
∀ {loc : CerbLocation.Loc} {ann : core_run_annotation} {ty : ctype} {pe2 : generic_pexpr Unit sym}
  {mo : memory_order},
  valueFromPexpr pe2 = none →
    CerberusHeapLang.PePure pe2 →
      CerberusHeapLang.peDepth pe2 ≤ lemDefaultFuel →
        CerberusHeapLang.Frag (CerberusHeapLang.loadOpRedex loc ann ty pe2 mo)
----
ctor CerberusHeapLang.Frag.memop_op :
∀ {pe1 pe2 : generic_pexpr Unit sym},
  valueFromPexprs [pe1, pe2] = none →
    CerberusHeapLang.PePure pe1 →
      CerberusHeapLang.PePure pe2 →
        CerberusHeapLang.peDepth pe1 ≤ lemDefaultFuel →
          CerberusHeapLang.peDepth pe2 ≤ lemDefaultFuel →
            CerberusHeapLang.Frag (CerberusHeapLang.memopRedex PtrEq [pe1, pe2])
----
ctor CerberusHeapLang.Frag.memop_vals :
∀ (v1 v2 : value), CerberusHeapLang.Frag (CerberusHeapLang.memopPtrEqVals v1 v2)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.Frag.pot_le_two :
∀ {e : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr},
  CerberusHeapLang.Frag e → CerberusHeapLang.pot e ≤ 2 * CerberusHeapLang.esize e
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.Frag.pot_step_bound :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {e : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack}
  {ctl : CerberusHeapLang.Ctl} {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem} {e' : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr}
  {ρ' : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack} {σ' : CerberusHeapLang.Mem},
  CerberusHeapLang.Frag e →
    CerberusHeapLang.Step M (e, ρ, ctl, σ) (e', ρ', ctl, σ') →
      CerberusHeapLang.pot e' ≤ CerberusHeapLang.pot e ∨
        ∃ l pes params cont,
          CerberusHeapLang.jumpRedex? e = some (l, pes) ∧
            CerberusHeapLang.lookupLabel (M.labelsAt ctl.proc) l = some (params, cont) ∧ e' = cont
----
ctor CerberusHeapLang.Frag.pure_sym :
∀ {pb : List annot} {x : sym},
  CerberusHeapLang.Frag (CerberusHeapLang.pureRedex (Pexpr pb () (PEsym x)))
----
rec CerberusHeapLang.Frag.rec :
∀ {motive : (a : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr) → CerberusHeapLang.Frag a → Prop},
  (∀ (v : value), motive (generic_expr.Expr [] (Epure (Pexpr [] () (PEval v)))) ⋯) →
    (∀ {loc : CerbLocation.Loc} {ann : core_run_annotation} {lk : Bool} {ty : ctype}
        {pv : CerbMem.PointerValue} {cv : value} {mo : memory_order},
        motive (CerberusHeapLang.storeRedex loc ann lk ty pv cv mo) ⋯) →
      (∀ {loc : CerbLocation.Loc} {ann : core_run_annotation} {ty : ctype}
          {pv : CerbMem.PointerValue} {mo : memory_order},
          motive (CerberusHeapLang.loadRedex loc ann ty pv mo) ⋯) →
        (∀ {loc : CerbLocation.Loc} {ann : core_run_annotation} {align : CerbMem.IntegerValue}
            {ty : ctype} {pref : prefix0},
            motive (CerberusHeapLang.createRedex loc ann align ty pref) ⋯) →
          (∀ {loc : CerbLocation.Loc} {ann : core_run_annotation} {kind : kill_kind}
              {pv : CerbMem.PointerValue}, motive (CerberusHeapLang.killRedex loc ann kind pv) ⋯) →
            (∀ {loc : CerbLocation.Loc} {ann : core_run_annotation} {kind : kill_kind}
                {pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym} (hnv : valueFromPexpr pe = none)
                (hp : CerberusHeapLang.PePure pe)
                (hdp : CerberusHeapLang.peDepth pe ≤ lemDefaultFuel),
                motive (CerberusHeapLang.killOpRedex loc ann kind pe) ⋯) →
              (∀ {loc : CerbLocation.Loc} {ann : core_run_annotation}
                  {align size : CerbMem.IntegerValue} {pref : prefix0},
                  motive (CerberusHeapLang.allocRedex loc ann align size pref) ⋯) →
                (∀ {loc : CerbLocation.Loc} {ann : core_run_annotation}
                    {pe1 pe2 : generic_pexpr Unit sym} {pref : prefix0}
                    (hnv : valueFromPexprs [pe1, pe2] = none) (hp1 : CerberusHeapLang.PePure pe1)
                    (hp2 : CerberusHeapLang.PePure pe2)
                    (hd1 : CerberusHeapLang.peDepth pe1 ≤ lemDefaultFuel)
                    (hd2 : CerberusHeapLang.peDepth pe2 ≤ lemDefaultFuel),
                    motive (CerberusHeapLang.allocOpRedex loc ann pe1 pe2 pref) ⋯) →
                  (∀ {pa : List annot} {bty : core_base_type} {e1 e2 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr}
                      (a : CerberusHeapLang.Frag e1) (a_1 : CerberusHeapLang.Frag e2),
                      motive e1 a →
                        motive e2 a_1 →
                          motive
                            (generic_expr.Expr [] (Esseq (Pattern pa (CaseBase (none, bty))) e1 e2))
                            ⋯) →
                    (∀ {ds : List dyn_annotation} {b : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr}
                        (a : CerberusHeapLang.Frag b),
                        motive b a → motive (generic_expr.Expr [] (Eannot ds b)) ⋯) →
                      (∀ {sb : sym × core_base_type}
                          {ps :
                            List
                              (sym ×
                                (core_base_type × Option (ctype × pass_by_value_or_pointer)) ×
                                  generic_pexpr Unit sym)}
                          {body : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr}
                          (hp :
                            ∀ (pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym),
                              pe ∈ CerberusHeapLang.saveParamPexprs ps → CerberusHeapLang.PePure pe)
                          (hd :
                            ∀ (pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym),
                              pe ∈ CerberusHeapLang.saveParamPexprs ps →
                                CerberusHeapLang.peDepth pe ≤ lemDefaultFuel)
                          (a : CerberusHeapLang.Frag body),
                          motive body a → motive (CerberusHeapLang.saveRedex sb ps body) ⋯) →
                        (∀ {g : generic_pexpr Unit sym} {e2 e3 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr}
                            (hpg : CerberusHeapLang.PePure g)
                            (hdg : CerberusHeapLang.peDepth g ≤ lemDefaultFuel)
                            (a : CerberusHeapLang.Frag e2) (a_1 : CerberusHeapLang.Frag e3),
                            motive e2 a →
                              motive e3 a_1 → motive (CerberusHeapLang.ifRedex g e2 e3) ⋯) →
                          (∀ {ra : core_run_annotation} {l : sym}
                              {pes : List (generic_pexpr Unit sym)}
                              (hpes :
                                ∀ (pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym),
                                  pe ∈ pes → CerberusHeapLang.PePure pe)
                              (hdep :
                                ∀ (pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym),
                                  pe ∈ pes → CerberusHeapLang.peDepth pe ≤ lemDefaultFuel),
                              motive (CerberusHeapLang.runRedex ra l pes) ⋯) →
                            (∀ {pa pb : List _root_.annot} {x : sym} {bty : core_base_type}
                                {e1 e2 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} (a : CerberusHeapLang.Frag e1)
                                (a_1 : CerberusHeapLang.Frag e2),
                                motive e1 a →
                                  motive e2 a_1 →
                                    motive
                                      (generic_expr.Expr []
                                        (Esseq (CerberusHeapLang.specPat pa pb x bty) e1 e2))
                                      ⋯) →
                              (∀ {pb : List _root_.annot} {x : sym},
                                  motive (CerberusHeapLang.pureRedex (Pexpr pb () (PEsym x))) ⋯) →
                                (∀ {loc : CerbLocation.Loc} {ann : core_run_annotation} {ty : ctype}
                                    {pe2 : generic_pexpr Unit sym} {mo : memory_order}
                                    (hnv2 : valueFromPexpr pe2 = none)
                                    (hp2 : CerberusHeapLang.PePure pe2)
                                    (hd2 : CerberusHeapLang.peDepth pe2 ≤ lemDefaultFuel),
                                    motive (CerberusHeapLang.loadOpRedex loc ann ty pe2 mo) ⋯) →
                                  (∀ {pa : List _root_.annot} {x : sym} {bty : core_base_type}
                                      {e1 e2 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr}
                                      (hb : CerberusHeapLang.BareHead e1)
                                      (a : CerberusHeapLang.Frag e1)
                                      (a_1 : CerberusHeapLang.Frag e2),
                                      motive e1 a →
                                        motive e2 a_1 →
                                          motive
                                            (generic_expr.Expr []
                                              (Esseq (CerberusHeapLang.symPat pa x bty) e1 e2))
                                            ⋯) →
                                    (∀ (v1 v2 : value),
                                        motive (CerberusHeapLang.memopPtrEqVals v1 v2) ⋯) →
                                      (∀ {pe1 pe2 : generic_pexpr Unit sym}
                                          (hnv : valueFromPexprs [pe1, pe2] = none)
                                          (hp1 : CerberusHeapLang.PePure pe1)
                                          (hp2 : CerberusHeapLang.PePure pe2)
                                          (hd1 : CerberusHeapLang.peDepth pe1 ≤ lemDefaultFuel)
                                          (hd2 : CerberusHeapLang.peDepth pe2 ≤ lemDefaultFuel),
                                          motive (CerberusHeapLang.memopRedex PtrEq [pe1, pe2]) ⋯) →
                                        (∀ {loc : CerbLocation.Loc} {ann : core_run_annotation}
                                            {ty : ctype} {pe2 pe3 : generic_pexpr Unit sym}
                                            {mo : memory_order}
                                            (hnv : valueFromPexprs [pe2, pe3] = none)
                                            (hp2 : CerberusHeapLang.PePure pe2)
                                            (hp3 : CerberusHeapLang.PePure pe3)
                                            (hd2 : CerberusHeapLang.peDepth pe2 ≤ lemDefaultFuel)
                                            (hd3 : CerberusHeapLang.peDepth pe3 ≤ lemDefaultFuel),
                                            motive
                                              (CerberusHeapLang.storeOpRedex loc ann ty pe2 pe3 mo)
                                              ⋯) →
                                          (∀ {b : List _root_.annot} {cval : value}
                                              {pats : List (pattern × CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr)}
                                              (hbr :
                                                ∀ (e' : expr core_run_annotation),
                                                  select_case subst_sym_expr cval pats = some e' →
                                                    CerberusHeapLang.Frag e')
                                              (hbsz :
                                                ∀ (e' : expr core_run_annotation),
                                                  select_case subst_sym_expr cval pats = some e' →
                                                    CerberusHeapLang.esize e' ≤
                                                      CerberusHeapLang.esize
                                                        (CerberusHeapLang.caseRedex
                                                          (Pexpr b () (PEval cval)) pats)),
                                              (∀ (e' : expr core_run_annotation)
                                                  (a :
                                                    select_case subst_sym_expr cval pats = some e'),
                                                  motive e' ⋯) →
                                                motive
                                                  (CerberusHeapLang.caseRedex
                                                    (Pexpr b () (PEval cval)) pats)
                                                  ⋯) →
                                            (∀ {pa : List _root_.annot} {bty : core_base_type}
                                                {e1 e2 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr}
                                                (a : CerberusHeapLang.Frag e1)
                                                (a_1 : CerberusHeapLang.Frag e2),
                                                motive e1 a →
                                                  motive e2 a_1 →
                                                    motive
                                                      (generic_expr.Expr []
                                                        (Ewseq (Pattern pa (CaseBase (none, bty)))
                                                          e1 e2))
                                                      ⋯) →
                                              (∀ {ra : core_run_annotation} {f : sym}
                                                  {pes : List (generic_pexpr Unit sym)}
                                                  (hpes :
                                                    ∀ (pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym),
                                                      pe ∈ pes → CerberusHeapLang.PePure pe)
                                                  (hdep :
                                                    ∀ (pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym),
                                                      pe ∈ pes →
                                                        CerberusHeapLang.peDepth pe ≤
                                                          lemDefaultFuel),
                                                  motive (CerberusHeapLang.callRedex ra f pes) ⋯) →
                                                ∀ {a : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr}
                                                  (t : CerberusHeapLang.Frag a), motive a t
----
def CerberusHeapLang.Frag.recOn :
∀ {motive : (a : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr) → CerberusHeapLang.Frag a → Prop}
  {a : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} (t : CerberusHeapLang.Frag a),
  (∀ (v : value), motive (generic_expr.Expr [] (Epure (Pexpr [] () (PEval v)))) ⋯) →
    (∀ {loc : CerbLocation.Loc} {ann : core_run_annotation} {lk : Bool} {ty : ctype}
        {pv : CerbMem.PointerValue} {cv : value} {mo : memory_order},
        motive (CerberusHeapLang.storeRedex loc ann lk ty pv cv mo) ⋯) →
      (∀ {loc : CerbLocation.Loc} {ann : core_run_annotation} {ty : ctype}
          {pv : CerbMem.PointerValue} {mo : memory_order},
          motive (CerberusHeapLang.loadRedex loc ann ty pv mo) ⋯) →
        (∀ {loc : CerbLocation.Loc} {ann : core_run_annotation} {align : CerbMem.IntegerValue}
            {ty : ctype} {pref : prefix0},
            motive (CerberusHeapLang.createRedex loc ann align ty pref) ⋯) →
          (∀ {loc : CerbLocation.Loc} {ann : core_run_annotation} {kind : kill_kind}
              {pv : CerbMem.PointerValue}, motive (CerberusHeapLang.killRedex loc ann kind pv) ⋯) →
            (∀ {loc : CerbLocation.Loc} {ann : core_run_annotation} {kind : kill_kind}
                {pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym} (hnv : valueFromPexpr pe = none)
                (hp : CerberusHeapLang.PePure pe)
                (hdp : CerberusHeapLang.peDepth pe ≤ lemDefaultFuel),
                motive (CerberusHeapLang.killOpRedex loc ann kind pe) ⋯) →
              (∀ {loc : CerbLocation.Loc} {ann : core_run_annotation}
                  {align size : CerbMem.IntegerValue} {pref : prefix0},
                  motive (CerberusHeapLang.allocRedex loc ann align size pref) ⋯) →
                (∀ {loc : CerbLocation.Loc} {ann : core_run_annotation}
                    {pe1 pe2 : generic_pexpr Unit sym} {pref : prefix0}
                    (hnv : valueFromPexprs [pe1, pe2] = none) (hp1 : CerberusHeapLang.PePure pe1)
                    (hp2 : CerberusHeapLang.PePure pe2)
                    (hd1 : CerberusHeapLang.peDepth pe1 ≤ lemDefaultFuel)
                    (hd2 : CerberusHeapLang.peDepth pe2 ≤ lemDefaultFuel),
                    motive (CerberusHeapLang.allocOpRedex loc ann pe1 pe2 pref) ⋯) →
                  (∀ {pa : List annot} {bty : core_base_type} {e1 e2 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr}
                      (a : CerberusHeapLang.Frag e1) (a_1 : CerberusHeapLang.Frag e2),
                      motive e1 a →
                        motive e2 a_1 →
                          motive
                            (generic_expr.Expr [] (Esseq (Pattern pa (CaseBase (none, bty))) e1 e2))
                            ⋯) →
                    (∀ {ds : List dyn_annotation} {b : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr}
                        (a : CerberusHeapLang.Frag b),
                        motive b a → motive (generic_expr.Expr [] (Eannot ds b)) ⋯) →
                      (∀ {sb : sym × core_base_type}
                          {ps :
                            List
                              (sym ×
                                (core_base_type × Option (ctype × pass_by_value_or_pointer)) ×
                                  generic_pexpr Unit sym)}
                          {body : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr}
                          (hp :
                            ∀ (pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym),
                              pe ∈ CerberusHeapLang.saveParamPexprs ps → CerberusHeapLang.PePure pe)
                          (hd :
                            ∀ (pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym),
                              pe ∈ CerberusHeapLang.saveParamPexprs ps →
                                CerberusHeapLang.peDepth pe ≤ lemDefaultFuel)
                          (a : CerberusHeapLang.Frag body),
                          motive body a → motive (CerberusHeapLang.saveRedex sb ps body) ⋯) →
                        (∀ {g : generic_pexpr Unit sym} {e2 e3 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr}
                            (hpg : CerberusHeapLang.PePure g)
                            (hdg : CerberusHeapLang.peDepth g ≤ lemDefaultFuel)
                            (a : CerberusHeapLang.Frag e2) (a_1 : CerberusHeapLang.Frag e3),
                            motive e2 a →
                              motive e3 a_1 → motive (CerberusHeapLang.ifRedex g e2 e3) ⋯) →
                          (∀ {ra : core_run_annotation} {l : sym}
                              {pes : List (generic_pexpr Unit sym)}
                              (hpes :
                                ∀ (pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym),
                                  pe ∈ pes → CerberusHeapLang.PePure pe)
                              (hdep :
                                ∀ (pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym),
                                  pe ∈ pes → CerberusHeapLang.peDepth pe ≤ lemDefaultFuel),
                              motive (CerberusHeapLang.runRedex ra l pes) ⋯) →
                            (∀ {pa pb : List _root_.annot} {x : sym} {bty : core_base_type}
                                {e1 e2 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} (a : CerberusHeapLang.Frag e1)
                                (a_1 : CerberusHeapLang.Frag e2),
                                motive e1 a →
                                  motive e2 a_1 →
                                    motive
                                      (generic_expr.Expr []
                                        (Esseq (CerberusHeapLang.specPat pa pb x bty) e1 e2))
                                      ⋯) →
                              (∀ {pb : List _root_.annot} {x : sym},
                                  motive (CerberusHeapLang.pureRedex (Pexpr pb () (PEsym x))) ⋯) →
                                (∀ {loc : CerbLocation.Loc} {ann : core_run_annotation} {ty : ctype}
                                    {pe2 : generic_pexpr Unit sym} {mo : memory_order}
                                    (hnv2 : valueFromPexpr pe2 = none)
                                    (hp2 : CerberusHeapLang.PePure pe2)
                                    (hd2 : CerberusHeapLang.peDepth pe2 ≤ lemDefaultFuel),
                                    motive (CerberusHeapLang.loadOpRedex loc ann ty pe2 mo) ⋯) →
                                  (∀ {pa : List _root_.annot} {x : sym} {bty : core_base_type}
                                      {e1 e2 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr}
                                      (hb : CerberusHeapLang.BareHead e1)
                                      (a : CerberusHeapLang.Frag e1)
                                      (a_1 : CerberusHeapLang.Frag e2),
                                      motive e1 a →
                                        motive e2 a_1 →
                                          motive
                                            (generic_expr.Expr []
                                              (Esseq (CerberusHeapLang.symPat pa x bty) e1 e2))
                                            ⋯) →
                                    (∀ (v1 v2 : value),
                                        motive (CerberusHeapLang.memopPtrEqVals v1 v2) ⋯) →
                                      (∀ {pe1 pe2 : generic_pexpr Unit sym}
                                          (hnv : valueFromPexprs [pe1, pe2] = none)
                                          (hp1 : CerberusHeapLang.PePure pe1)
                                          (hp2 : CerberusHeapLang.PePure pe2)
                                          (hd1 : CerberusHeapLang.peDepth pe1 ≤ lemDefaultFuel)
                                          (hd2 : CerberusHeapLang.peDepth pe2 ≤ lemDefaultFuel),
                                          motive (CerberusHeapLang.memopRedex PtrEq [pe1, pe2]) ⋯) →
                                        (∀ {loc : CerbLocation.Loc} {ann : core_run_annotation}
                                            {ty : ctype} {pe2 pe3 : generic_pexpr Unit sym}
                                            {mo : memory_order}
                                            (hnv : valueFromPexprs [pe2, pe3] = none)
                                            (hp2 : CerberusHeapLang.PePure pe2)
                                            (hp3 : CerberusHeapLang.PePure pe3)
                                            (hd2 : CerberusHeapLang.peDepth pe2 ≤ lemDefaultFuel)
                                            (hd3 : CerberusHeapLang.peDepth pe3 ≤ lemDefaultFuel),
                                            motive
                                              (CerberusHeapLang.storeOpRedex loc ann ty pe2 pe3 mo)
                                              ⋯) →
                                          (∀ {b : List _root_.annot} {cval : value}
                                              {pats : List (pattern × CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr)}
                                              (hbr :
                                                ∀ (e' : expr core_run_annotation),
                                                  select_case subst_sym_expr cval pats = some e' →
                                                    CerberusHeapLang.Frag e')
                                              (hbsz :
                                                ∀ (e' : expr core_run_annotation),
                                                  select_case subst_sym_expr cval pats = some e' →
                                                    CerberusHeapLang.esize e' ≤
                                                      CerberusHeapLang.esize
                                                        (CerberusHeapLang.caseRedex
                                                          (Pexpr b () (PEval cval)) pats)),
                                              (∀ (e' : expr core_run_annotation)
                                                  (a :
                                                    select_case subst_sym_expr cval pats = some e'),
                                                  motive e' ⋯) →
                                                motive
                                                  (CerberusHeapLang.caseRedex
                                                    (Pexpr b () (PEval cval)) pats)
                                                  ⋯) →
                                            (∀ {pa : List _root_.annot} {bty : core_base_type}
                                                {e1 e2 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr}
                                                (a : CerberusHeapLang.Frag e1)
                                                (a_1 : CerberusHeapLang.Frag e2),
                                                motive e1 a →
                                                  motive e2 a_1 →
                                                    motive
                                                      (generic_expr.Expr []
                                                        (Ewseq (Pattern pa (CaseBase (none, bty)))
                                                          e1 e2))
                                                      ⋯) →
                                              (∀ {ra : core_run_annotation} {f : sym}
                                                  {pes : List (generic_pexpr Unit sym)}
                                                  (hpes :
                                                    ∀ (pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym),
                                                      pe ∈ pes → CerberusHeapLang.PePure pe)
                                                  (hdep :
                                                    ∀ (pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym),
                                                      pe ∈ pes →
                                                        CerberusHeapLang.peDepth pe ≤
                                                          lemDefaultFuel),
                                                  motive (CerberusHeapLang.callRedex ra f pes) ⋯) →
                                                motive a t
----
ctor CerberusHeapLang.Frag.run :
∀ {ra : core_run_annotation} {l : sym} {pes : List (generic_pexpr Unit sym)},
  (∀ (pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym), pe ∈ pes → CerberusHeapLang.PePure pe) →
    (∀ (pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym), pe ∈ pes → CerberusHeapLang.peDepth pe ≤ lemDefaultFuel) →
      CerberusHeapLang.Frag (CerberusHeapLang.runRedex ra l pes)
----
ctor CerberusHeapLang.Frag.save :
∀ {sb : sym × core_base_type}
  {ps :
    List
      (sym × (core_base_type × Option (ctype × pass_by_value_or_pointer)) × generic_pexpr Unit sym)}
  {body : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr},
  (∀ (pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym),
      pe ∈ CerberusHeapLang.saveParamPexprs ps → CerberusHeapLang.PePure pe) →
    (∀ (pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym),
        pe ∈ CerberusHeapLang.saveParamPexprs ps → CerberusHeapLang.peDepth pe ≤ lemDefaultFuel) →
      CerberusHeapLang.Frag body → CerberusHeapLang.Frag (CerberusHeapLang.saveRedex sb ps body)
----
ctor CerberusHeapLang.Frag.sseq :
∀ {pa : List annot} {bty : core_base_type} {e1 e2 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr},
  CerberusHeapLang.Frag e1 →
    CerberusHeapLang.Frag e2 →
      CerberusHeapLang.Frag (generic_expr.Expr [] (Esseq (Pattern pa (CaseBase (none, bty))) e1 e2))
----
ctor CerberusHeapLang.Frag.sseq_spec :
∀ {pa pb : List annot} {x : sym} {bty : core_base_type} {e1 e2 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr},
  CerberusHeapLang.Frag e1 →
    CerberusHeapLang.Frag e2 →
      CerberusHeapLang.Frag
        (generic_expr.Expr [] (Esseq (CerberusHeapLang.specPat pa pb x bty) e1 e2))
----
ctor CerberusHeapLang.Frag.sseq_sym :

    CerberusHeapLang.Frag e1 →
      CerberusHeapLang.Frag e2 →
        CerberusHeapLang.Frag
          (generic_expr.Expr [] (Esseq (CerberusHeapLang.symPat pa x bty) e1 e2))

theorem CerberusHeapLang.Frag.step :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {ctl : CerberusHeapLang.Ctl},
  (∀ (l : sym) (params : List (sym × core_base_type)) (cont : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr),
      CerberusHeapLang.lookupLabel (M.labelsAt ctl.proc) l = some (params, cont) →
        CerberusHeapLang.Frag cont) →
    ∀ {e : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack} {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem}
      {e' : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {ρ' : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack} {σ' : CerberusHeapLang.Mem},
      CerberusHeapLang.Frag e →
        CerberusHeapLang.Step M (e, ρ, ctl, σ) (e', ρ', ctl, σ') → CerberusHeapLang.Frag e'
----
ctor CerberusHeapLang.Frag.store :
∀ {loc : CerbLocation.Loc} {ann : core_run_annotation} {lk : Bool} {ty : ctype}
  {pv : CerbMem.PointerValue} {cv : value} {mo : memory_order},
  CerberusHeapLang.Frag (CerberusHeapLang.storeRedex loc ann lk ty pv cv mo)
----
ctor CerberusHeapLang.Frag.store_op :
∀ {loc : CerbLocation.Loc} {ann : core_run_annotation} {ty : ctype}
  {pe2 pe3 : generic_pexpr Unit sym} {mo : memory_order},
  valueFromPexprs [pe2, pe3] = none →
    CerberusHeapLang.PePure pe2 →
      CerberusHeapLang.PePure pe3 →
        CerberusHeapLang.peDepth pe2 ≤ lemDefaultFuel →
          CerberusHeapLang.peDepth pe3 ≤ lemDefaultFuel →
            CerberusHeapLang.Frag (CerberusHeapLang.storeOpRedex loc ann ty pe2 pe3 mo)

∀ {tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap} {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem}

inductive CerberusHeapLang.LiveCoh :
CerberusHeapLang.Mem → Int → CerberusHeapLang.MetaCell → Prop
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.LiveCoh.alloc :
∀ {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem} {id : Int} {mc : CerberusHeapLang.MetaCell},
  CerberusHeapLang.LiveCoh σ id mc →
    ∃ al,
      σ.allocations.get? id = some al ∧
        al.base = mc.addr ∧
          al.size = ↑mc.size ∧
            al.ty = mc.ty ∧
              (al.isReadonly = CerbMem.ReadonlyStatus.IsWritable ↔ mc.readonly = false)
----
def CerberusHeapLang.LiveCoh.casesOn :
{σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem} →
  {id : Int} →
    {mc : CerberusHeapLang.MetaCell} →
      {motive : CerberusHeapLang.LiveCoh σ id mc → Sort u} →
        (t : CerberusHeapLang.LiveCoh σ id mc) →
          ((dead : σ.deadAllocations.contains id = false) →
              (alloc :
                  ∃ al,
                    σ.allocations.get? id = some al ∧
                      al.base = mc.addr ∧
                        al.size = ↑mc.size ∧
                          al.ty = mc.ty ∧
                            (al.isReadonly = CerbMem.ReadonlyStatus.IsWritable ↔
                              mc.readonly = false)) →
                motive ⋯) →
            motive t
----

∀ {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem} {id : Int} {mc : CerberusHeapLang.MetaCell},
  CerberusHeapLang.LiveCoh σ id mc → σ.deadAllocations.contains id = false

  σ.deadAllocations.contains id = false →
    (∃ al,
        σ.allocations.get? id = some al ∧
          al.base = mc.addr ∧
            al.size = ↑mc.size ∧
              al.ty = mc.ty ∧
                (al.isReadonly = CerbMem.ReadonlyStatus.IsWritable ↔ mc.readonly = false)) →
      CerberusHeapLang.LiveCoh σ id mc
----

        ((dead : σ.deadAllocations.contains id = false) →

                ∃ al,
                  σ.allocations.get? id = some al ∧

        (file : generic_file Unit core_run_annotation) →
          (extern : Fmap sym sym) →
            (tid : Nat) →
              (parent : Option Nat) →
                (errno : CerbMem.PointerValue) →
                  (currentLoc : CerbLocation.Loc) →
                    (runState : core_run_state) →
                      motive
                        { tagDefs := tagDefs, file := file, extern := extern, tid := tid,
                          parent := parent, errno := errno, currentLoc := currentLoc,
                          runState := runState }) →
      motive t

theorem CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx.labelsAt_eq_of_proc :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {c : CerberusHeapLang.Ctl} {p : sym},
  c.proc = some p →
    M.labelsAt c.proc =
      match
        fmapLookupBy (fun s1 s2 => Lem_Basic_classes.ordCompare s1 s2) (M.resolveProc p)
          M.runState.labeled with
      | some Q => Q
      | none => fmapEmpty
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx.labelsAt_none :
∀ (M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx), M.labelsAt none = fmapEmpty
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx.labelsAt_some :
∀ (M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx) (p : sym),
  M.labelsAt (some p) =
    match
      fmapLookupBy (fun s1 s2 => Lem_Basic_classes.ordCompare s1 s2) (M.resolveProc p)
        M.runState.labeled with
    | some Q => Q
    | none => fmapEmpty
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx.labels_lookup_some :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {ctl : CerberusHeapLang.Ctl} {l : sym}
  {pc : List (sym × core_base_type) × CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr},
  CerberusHeapLang.lookupLabel (M.labelsAt ctl.proc) l = some pc →
    ∃ p,
      ctl.proc = some p ∧
        CerberusHeapLang.LabeledAt M.runState (M.resolveProc p) (M.labelsAt ctl.proc)

Fmap sym (CerbLocation.Loc × tag_definition) →
  generic_file Unit core_run_annotation →
    Fmap sym sym →
      Nat →
        Option Nat →
          CerbMem.PointerValue → CerbLocation.Loc → core_run_state → CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx

theorem CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx.mk.inj :
∀ {tagDefs : Fmap sym (CerbLocation.Loc × tag_definition)}
  {file : generic_file Unit core_run_annotation} {extern : Fmap sym sym} {tid : Nat}
  {parent : Option Nat} {errno : CerbMem.PointerValue} {currentLoc : CerbLocation.Loc}
  {runState : core_run_state} {tagDefs_1 : Fmap sym (CerbLocation.Loc × tag_definition)}
  {file_1 : generic_file Unit core_run_annotation} {extern_1 : Fmap sym sym} {tid_1 : Nat}
  {parent_1 : Option Nat} {errno_1 : CerbMem.PointerValue} {currentLoc_1 : CerbLocation.Loc}
  {runState_1 : core_run_state},
  { tagDefs := tagDefs, file := file, extern := extern, tid := tid, parent := parent,
        errno := errno, currentLoc := currentLoc, runState := runState } =
      { tagDefs := tagDefs_1, file := file_1, extern := extern_1, tid := tid_1, parent := parent_1,
        errno := errno_1, currentLoc := currentLoc_1, runState := runState_1 } →
    tagDefs = tagDefs_1 ∧
      file = file_1 ∧
        extern = extern_1 ∧
          tid = tid_1 ∧
            parent = parent_1 ∧ errno = errno_1 ∧ currentLoc = currentLoc_1 ∧ runState = runState_1
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx.mk.injEq :
∀ (tagDefs : Fmap sym (CerbLocation.Loc × tag_definition))
  (file : generic_file Unit core_run_annotation) (extern : Fmap sym sym) (tid : Nat)
  (parent : Option Nat) (errno : CerbMem.PointerValue) (currentLoc : CerbLocation.Loc)
  (runState : core_run_state) (tagDefs_1 : Fmap sym (CerbLocation.Loc × tag_definition))
  (file_1 : generic_file Unit core_run_annotation) (extern_1 : Fmap sym sym) (tid_1 : Nat)
  (parent_1 : Option Nat) (errno_1 : CerbMem.PointerValue) (currentLoc_1 : CerbLocation.Loc)
  (runState_1 : core_run_state),
  ({ tagDefs := tagDefs, file := file, extern := extern, tid := tid, parent := parent,
        errno := errno, currentLoc := currentLoc, runState := runState } =
      { tagDefs := tagDefs_1, file := file_1, extern := extern_1, tid := tid_1, parent := parent_1,
        errno := errno_1, currentLoc := currentLoc_1, runState := runState_1 }) =
    (tagDefs = tagDefs_1 ∧
      file = file_1 ∧
        extern = extern_1 ∧
          tid = tid_1 ∧
            parent = parent_1 ∧ errno = errno_1 ∧ currentLoc = currentLoc_1 ∧ runState = runState_1)
----
def CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx.mk.noConfusion :
{P : Sort u} →
  {tagDefs : Fmap sym (CerbLocation.Loc × tag_definition)} →
    {file : generic_file Unit core_run_annotation} →
      {extern : Fmap sym sym} →
        {tid : Nat} →
          {parent : Option Nat} →
            {errno : CerbMem.PointerValue} →
              {currentLoc : CerbLocation.Loc} →
                {runState : core_run_state} →
                  {tagDefs' : Fmap sym (CerbLocation.Loc × tag_definition)} →
                    {file' : generic_file Unit core_run_annotation} →
                      {extern' : Fmap sym sym} →
                        {tid' : Nat} →
                          {parent' : Option Nat} →
                            {errno' : CerbMem.PointerValue} →
                              {currentLoc' : CerbLocation.Loc} →
                                {runState' : core_run_state} →
                                  { tagDefs := tagDefs, file := file, extern := extern, tid := tid,
                                        parent := parent, errno := errno, currentLoc := currentLoc,
                                        runState := runState } =
                                      { tagDefs := tagDefs', file := file', extern := extern',
                                        tid := tid', parent := parent', errno := errno',
                                        currentLoc := currentLoc', runState := runState' } →
                                    (tagDefs = tagDefs' →
                                        file = file' →
                                          extern = extern' →
                                            tid = tid' →
                                              parent = parent' →
                                                errno = errno' →
                                                  currentLoc = currentLoc' →
                                                    runState = runState' → P) →
                                      P
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx.mk.sizeOf_spec :
∀ (tagDefs : Fmap sym (CerbLocation.Loc × tag_definition))
  (file : generic_file Unit core_run_annotation) (extern : Fmap sym sym) (tid : Nat)
  (parent : Option Nat) (errno : CerbMem.PointerValue) (currentLoc : CerbLocation.Loc)
  (runState : core_run_state),
  sizeOf
      { tagDefs := tagDefs, file := file, extern := extern, tid := tid, parent := parent,
        errno := errno, currentLoc := currentLoc, runState := runState } =
    1 + sizeOf tagDefs + sizeOf file + sizeOf extern + sizeOf tid + sizeOf parent + sizeOf errno +
        sizeOf currentLoc +
      sizeOf runState

theorem CerberusHeapLang.MemWF.alloc :
∀ {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem},
  CerberusHeapLang.MemWF σ →
    ∀ (al : CerbMem.Allocation) (dyn : List CerbMem.Address),
      0 ≤ al.size →
        al.base + al.size ≤ σ.lastAddress →
          0 < al.base →
            (∀ (a : CerbMem.Address), a ∈ dyn → a = al.base ∨ a ∈ σ.dynamicAddrs) →
              CerberusHeapLang.MemWF
                { nextAllocId := σ.nextAllocId + 1, nextIota := σ.nextIota, lastAddress := al.base,
                  allocations := σ.allocations.insert σ.nextAllocId al, iotaMap := σ.iotaMap,
                  funptrmap := σ.funptrmap, varargs := σ.varargs, nextVarargsId := σ.nextVarargsId,
                  bytemap := σ.bytemap, lastUsedUnionMembers := σ.lastUsedUnionMembers,
                  deadAllocations := σ.deadAllocations, dynamicAddrs := dyn, lastUsed := σ.lastUsed,
                  requested := σ.requested }
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.MemWF.allocateObject :
∀ (tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap) (tid : Nat) (pref : prefix0) (align : CerbMem.IntegerValue)
  (ty : ctype) (reqAddr : Option Int) (initOpt : Option CerbMem.MemValue)
  {σ σ' : CerberusHeapLang.Mem} {pv : CerbMem.PointerValue},
  CerberusHeapLang.MemWF σ →
    CerberusHeapLang.applyMemM (CerbMem.allocateObject tds tid pref align ty reqAddr initOpt) σ =
        some (pv, σ') →
      CerberusHeapLang.MemWF σ'
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.MemWF.allocateRegion :
∀ (tid : Nat) (pref : prefix0) (align size : CerbMem.IntegerValue) {σ σ' : CerberusHeapLang.Mem}
  {pv : CerbMem.PointerValue},
  CerberusHeapLang.MemWF σ →
    CerberusHeapLang.applyMemM (CerbMem.allocateRegion tid pref align size) σ = some (pv, σ') →
      CerberusHeapLang.MemWF σ'
----
def CerberusHeapLang.MemWF.casesOn :
{σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem} →
  {motive : CerberusHeapLang.MemWF σ → Sort u} →
    (t : CerberusHeapLang.MemWF σ) →
      ((live_lt :
            ∀ (id : Int) (al : CerbMem.Allocation),
              σ.allocations.get? id = some al → id < σ.nextAllocId) →
          (dead_lt :
              ∀ (id : CerbMem.StorageInstanceId),
                σ.deadAllocations.contains id = true → id < σ.nextAllocId) →
            (live_dead :
                ∀ (id : Int) (al : CerbMem.Allocation),
                  σ.allocations.get? id = some al → σ.deadAllocations.contains id = false) →
              (disj :
                  ∀ (i j : Int) (ai aj : CerbMem.Allocation),
                    i ≠ j →
                      σ.allocations.get? i = some ai →
                        σ.allocations.get? j = some aj → CerberusHeapLang.allocDisjoint ai aj) →
                (cursor_lo :
                    ∀ (id : Int) (al : CerbMem.Allocation),
                      σ.allocations.get? id = some al → σ.lastAddress ≤ al.base) →
                  (size_nonneg :
                      ∀ (id : Int) (al : CerbMem.Allocation),
                        σ.allocations.get? id = some al → 0 ≤ al.size) →
                    (la_wf : σ.lastAddress ≤ 2 ^ 64) →
                      (la_pos : 0 < σ.lastAddress) →
                        (dyn_lo : ∀ (a : CerbMem.Address), a ∈ σ.dynamicAddrs → σ.lastAddress ≤ a) →
                          (dyn_disj :
                              ∀ (a : CerbMem.Address),
                                a ∈ σ.dynamicAddrs →
                                  ∀ (id : Int) (al : CerbMem.Allocation),
                                    σ.allocations.get? id = some al →
                                      a ≤ al.base ∨ al.base + al.size ≤ a) →
                            motive ⋯) →
        motive t
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.MemWF.create :
∀ (tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap) {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem},
  CerberusHeapLang.MemWF σ →
    ∀ (pref : prefix0) (alignN : Int) (ty : ctype),
      0 < CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds ty →
        CerberusHeapLang.freshBase σ.lastAddress alignN (CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds ty) ≠ 0 →
          CerberusHeapLang.MemWF
            (CerbMem.writeBytesTo
              { nextAllocId := σ.nextAllocId + 1, nextIota := σ.nextIota,
                lastAddress :=
                  CerberusHeapLang.freshBase σ.lastAddress alignN (CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds ty),
                allocations :=
                  σ.allocations.insert σ.nextAllocId
                    {
                      base :=
                        CerberusHeapLang.freshBase σ.lastAddress alignN
                          (CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds ty),
                      size := ↑(CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds ty), ty := some ty, prefix_ := pref },
                iotaMap := σ.iotaMap, funptrmap := σ.funptrmap, varargs := σ.varargs,
                nextVarargsId := σ.nextVarargsId, bytemap := σ.bytemap,
                lastUsedUnionMembers := σ.lastUsedUnionMembers,
                deadAllocations := σ.deadAllocations, dynamicAddrs := σ.dynamicAddrs,
                lastUsed := σ.lastUsed, requested := σ.requested }
              (CerberusHeapLang.freshBase σ.lastAddress alignN (CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds ty))
              (List.replicate (CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds ty) CerberusHeapLang.undefByte))
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.MemWF.cursor_lo :
∀ {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem},
  CerberusHeapLang.MemWF σ →
    ∀ (id : Int) (al : CerbMem.Allocation),
      σ.allocations.get? id = some al → σ.lastAddress ≤ al.base
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.MemWF.dead_lt :
∀ {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem},
  CerberusHeapLang.MemWF σ →
    ∀ (id : CerbMem.StorageInstanceId), σ.deadAllocations.contains id = true → id < σ.nextAllocId
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.MemWF.disj :
∀ {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem},
  CerberusHeapLang.MemWF σ →
    ∀ (i j : Int) (ai aj : CerbMem.Allocation),
      i ≠ j →
        σ.allocations.get? i = some ai →
          σ.allocations.get? j = some aj → CerberusHeapLang.allocDisjoint ai aj
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.MemWF.dyn_disj :
∀ {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem},
  CerberusHeapLang.MemWF σ →
    ∀ (a : CerbMem.Address),
      a ∈ σ.dynamicAddrs →
        ∀ (id : Int) (al : CerbMem.Allocation),
          σ.allocations.get? id = some al → a ≤ al.base ∨ al.base + al.size ≤ a
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.MemWF.dyn_lo :
∀ {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem},
  CerberusHeapLang.MemWF σ → ∀ (a : CerbMem.Address), a ∈ σ.dynamicAddrs → σ.lastAddress ≤ a
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.MemWF.fresh_alloc :
∀ {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem},
  CerberusHeapLang.MemWF σ → ∀ (id : Int), σ.nextAllocId ≤ id → σ.allocations.get? id = none
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.MemWF.fresh_dead :
∀ {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem},
  CerberusHeapLang.MemWF σ →
    ∀ (id : Int), σ.nextAllocId ≤ id → σ.deadAllocations.contains id = false

theorem CerberusHeapLang.MemWF.kill :
∀ {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem},
  CerberusHeapLang.MemWF σ →
    ∀ (id : Int) (al : CerbMem.Allocation),
      σ.allocations.get? id = some al →
        CerberusHeapLang.MemWF
          { nextAllocId := σ.nextAllocId, nextIota := σ.nextIota, lastAddress := σ.lastAddress,
            allocations := σ.allocations.erase id, iotaMap := σ.iotaMap, funptrmap := σ.funptrmap,
            varargs := σ.varargs, nextVarargsId := σ.nextVarargsId, bytemap := σ.bytemap,
            lastUsedUnionMembers := σ.lastUsedUnionMembers,
            deadAllocations := id :: σ.deadAllocations, dynamicAddrs := σ.dynamicAddrs,
            lastUsed := σ.lastUsed, requested := σ.requested }
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.MemWF.killM :
∀ (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (isDyn : Bool) (pv : CerbMem.PointerValue) {σ σ' : CerberusHeapLang.Mem},
  CerberusHeapLang.MemWF σ →
    CerberusHeapLang.applyMemM (CerbMem.killM loc isDyn pv) σ = some ((), σ') →
      CerberusHeapLang.MemWF σ'

theorem CerberusHeapLang.MemWF.loadM :

  {σ σ' : CerberusHeapLang.Mem} {r : CerbMem.Footprint × CerbMem.MemValue},

theorem CerberusHeapLang.MemWF.map_allocs :
∀ {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem},
  CerberusHeapLang.MemWF σ →
    ∀ (f : Int → CerbMem.Allocation → CerbMem.Allocation),
      (∀ (k : Int) (a : CerbMem.Allocation), (f k a).base = a.base ∧ (f k a).size = a.size) →
        CerberusHeapLang.MemWF
          { nextAllocId := σ.nextAllocId, nextIota := σ.nextIota, lastAddress := σ.lastAddress,
            allocations := Std.TreeMap.map f σ.allocations, iotaMap := σ.iotaMap,
            funptrmap := σ.funptrmap, varargs := σ.varargs, nextVarargsId := σ.nextVarargsId,
            bytemap := σ.bytemap, lastUsedUnionMembers := σ.lastUsedUnionMembers,
            deadAllocations := σ.deadAllocations, dynamicAddrs := σ.dynamicAddrs,
            lastUsed := σ.lastUsed, requested := σ.requested }
----
ctor CerberusHeapLang.MemWF.mk :
∀ {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem},
  (∀ (id : Int) (al : CerbMem.Allocation), σ.allocations.get? id = some al → id < σ.nextAllocId) →
    (∀ (id : CerbMem.StorageInstanceId),
        σ.deadAllocations.contains id = true → id < σ.nextAllocId) →
      (∀ (id : Int) (al : CerbMem.Allocation),
          σ.allocations.get? id = some al → σ.deadAllocations.contains id = false) →
        (∀ (i j : Int) (ai aj : CerbMem.Allocation),
            i ≠ j →
              σ.allocations.get? i = some ai →
                σ.allocations.get? j = some aj → CerberusHeapLang.allocDisjoint ai aj) →
          (∀ (id : Int) (al : CerbMem.Allocation),
              σ.allocations.get? id = some al → σ.lastAddress ≤ al.base) →
            (∀ (id : Int) (al : CerbMem.Allocation),
                σ.allocations.get? id = some al → 0 ≤ al.size) →
              σ.lastAddress ≤ 2 ^ 64 →
                0 < σ.lastAddress →
                  (∀ (a : CerbMem.Address), a ∈ σ.dynamicAddrs → σ.lastAddress ≤ a) →
                    (∀ (a : CerbMem.Address),
                        a ∈ σ.dynamicAddrs →
                          ∀ (id : Int) (al : CerbMem.Allocation),
                            σ.allocations.get? id = some al → a ≤ al.base ∨ al.base + al.size ≤ a) →
                      CerberusHeapLang.MemWF σ
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.MemWF.of_fields :
∀ {σ σ' : CerberusHeapLang.Mem},
  CerberusHeapLang.MemWF σ →
    σ'.nextAllocId = σ.nextAllocId →
      σ'.lastAddress = σ.lastAddress →
        σ'.allocations = σ.allocations →
          σ'.deadAllocations = σ.deadAllocations →
            σ'.dynamicAddrs = σ.dynamicAddrs → CerberusHeapLang.MemWF σ'

rec CerberusHeapLang.MemWF.rec :
{σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem} →
  {motive : CerberusHeapLang.MemWF σ → Sort u} →
    ((live_lt :
          ∀ (id : Int) (al : CerbMem.Allocation),
            σ.allocations.get? id = some al → id < σ.nextAllocId) →
        (dead_lt :
            ∀ (id : CerbMem.StorageInstanceId),
              σ.deadAllocations.contains id = true → id < σ.nextAllocId) →
          (live_dead :
              ∀ (id : Int) (al : CerbMem.Allocation),
                σ.allocations.get? id = some al → σ.deadAllocations.contains id = false) →
            (disj :
                ∀ (i j : Int) (ai aj : CerbMem.Allocation),
                  i ≠ j →
                    σ.allocations.get? i = some ai →
                      σ.allocations.get? j = some aj → CerberusHeapLang.allocDisjoint ai aj) →
              (cursor_lo :
                  ∀ (id : Int) (al : CerbMem.Allocation),
                    σ.allocations.get? id = some al → σ.lastAddress ≤ al.base) →
                (size_nonneg :
                    ∀ (id : Int) (al : CerbMem.Allocation),
                      σ.allocations.get? id = some al → 0 ≤ al.size) →
                  (la_wf : σ.lastAddress ≤ 2 ^ 64) →
                    (la_pos : 0 < σ.lastAddress) →
                      (dyn_lo : ∀ (a : CerbMem.Address), a ∈ σ.dynamicAddrs → σ.lastAddress ≤ a) →
                        (dyn_disj :
                            ∀ (a : CerbMem.Address),
                              a ∈ σ.dynamicAddrs →
                                ∀ (id : Int) (al : CerbMem.Allocation),
                                  σ.allocations.get? id = some al →
                                    a ≤ al.base ∨ al.base + al.size ≤ a) →
                          motive ⋯) →
      (t : CerberusHeapLang.MemWF σ) → motive t

inductive CerberusHeapLang.MetaByteOf :
CerbTags.TagDefsMap →
  CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerberusHeapLang.SpikeCell →
    CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerberusHeapLang.MetaCell →
      CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerbMem.AbsByte → Prop
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.MetaByteOf.byte_all :
∀ {tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap} {m : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerberusHeapLang.SpikeCell}
  {mm : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerberusHeapLang.MetaCell}
  {mb : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerbMem.AbsByte},
  CerberusHeapLang.MetaByteOf tds m mm mb →
    ∀ (i : Int) (c : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeCell),
      Iris.Std.get? m i = some c →
        ∀ (j : Nat), j < c.bytes.length → Iris.Std.get? mb (c.addr + ↑j) = c.bytes[j]?
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.MetaByteOf.byte_cov :
∀ {tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap} {m : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerberusHeapLang.SpikeCell}
  {mm : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerberusHeapLang.MetaCell}
  {mb : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerbMem.AbsByte},
  CerberusHeapLang.MetaByteOf tds m mm mb →
    ∀ (k : Int) (b : CerbMem.AbsByte),
      Iris.Std.get? mb k = some b →
        ∃ i c,
          Iris.Std.get? m i = some c ∧
            c.addr ≤ k ∧
              k < c.addr + ↑c.bytes.length ∧
                b = c.bytes[(k - c.addr).toNat]?.getD CerberusHeapLang.undefByte
----
def CerberusHeapLang.MetaByteOf.casesOn :
{tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap} →
  {m : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerberusHeapLang.SpikeCell} →
    {mm : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerberusHeapLang.MetaCell} →
      {mb : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerbMem.AbsByte} →
        {motive : CerberusHeapLang.MetaByteOf tds m mm mb → Sort u} →
          (t : CerberusHeapLang.MetaByteOf tds m mm mb) →
            ((meta_sub :
                  ∀ (i : Int) (mc : CerberusHeapLang.MetaCell),
                    Iris.Std.get? mm i = some mc →
                      ∃ c, Iris.Std.get? m i = some c ∧ mc = CerberusHeapLang.metaOf tds c) →
                (meta_all :
                    ∀ (i : Int) (c : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeCell),
                      Iris.Std.get? m i = some c →
                        Iris.Std.get? mm i = some (CerberusHeapLang.metaOf tds c)) →
                  (byte_cov :
                      ∀ (k : Int) (b : CerbMem.AbsByte),
                        Iris.Std.get? mb k = some b →
                          ∃ i c,
                            Iris.Std.get? m i = some c ∧
                              c.addr ≤ k ∧
                                k < c.addr + ↑c.bytes.length ∧
                                  b =
                                    c.bytes[(k - c.addr).toNat]?.getD CerberusHeapLang.undefByte) →
                    (byte_all :
                        ∀ (i : Int) (c : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeCell),
                          Iris.Std.get? m i = some c →
                            ∀ (j : Nat),
                              j < c.bytes.length → Iris.Std.get? mb (c.addr + ↑j) = c.bytes[j]?) →
                      motive ⋯) →
              motive t

theorem CerberusHeapLang.MetaCell.mk.inj :
∀ {addr : Int} {ty : Option ctype} {size : Nat} {alive readonly dynamic : Bool} {addr_1 : Int}
  {ty_1 : Option ctype} {size_1 : Nat} {alive_1 readonly_1 dynamic_1 : Bool},
  { addr := addr, ty := ty, size := size, alive := alive, readonly := readonly,
        dynamic := dynamic } =
      { addr := addr_1, ty := ty_1, size := size_1, alive := alive_1, readonly := readonly_1,
        dynamic := dynamic_1 } →
    addr = addr_1 ∧
      ty = ty_1 ∧ size = size_1 ∧ alive = alive_1 ∧ readonly = readonly_1 ∧ dynamic = dynamic_1
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.MetaCell.mk.injEq :
∀ (addr : Int) (ty : Option ctype) (size : Nat) (alive readonly dynamic : Bool) (addr_1 : Int)
  (ty_1 : Option ctype) (size_1 : Nat) (alive_1 readonly_1 dynamic_1 : Bool),
  ({ addr := addr, ty := ty, size := size, alive := alive, readonly := readonly,
        dynamic := dynamic } =
      { addr := addr_1, ty := ty_1, size := size_1, alive := alive_1, readonly := readonly_1,
        dynamic := dynamic_1 }) =
    (addr = addr_1 ∧
      ty = ty_1 ∧ size = size_1 ∧ alive = alive_1 ∧ readonly = readonly_1 ∧ dynamic = dynamic_1)

def CerberusHeapLang.MetaCell.mk.noConfusion :
{P : Sort u} →
  {addr : Int} →
    {ty : Option ctype} →
      {size : Nat} →
        {alive readonly dynamic : Bool} →
          {addr' : Int} →
            {ty' : Option ctype} →
              {size' : Nat} →
                {alive' readonly' dynamic' : Bool} →
                  { addr := addr, ty := ty, size := size, alive := alive, readonly := readonly,
                        dynamic := dynamic } =
                      { addr := addr', ty := ty', size := size', alive := alive',
                        readonly := readonly', dynamic := dynamic' } →
                    (addr = addr' →
                        ty = ty' →
                          size = size' →
                            alive = alive' → readonly = readonly' → dynamic = dynamic' → P) →
                      P
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.MetaCell.mk.sizeOf_spec :
∀ (addr : Int) (ty : Option ctype) (size : Nat) (alive readonly dynamic : Bool),
  sizeOf
      { addr := addr, ty := ty, size := size, alive := alive, readonly := readonly,
        dynamic := dynamic } =
    1 + sizeOf addr + sizeOf ty + sizeOf size + sizeOf alive + sizeOf readonly + sizeOf dynamic

def CerberusHeapLang.MetaCoh.casesOn :
{σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem} →
  {id : Int} →
    {mc : CerberusHeapLang.MetaCell} →
      {motive : CerberusHeapLang.MetaCoh σ id mc → Sort u} →
        (t : CerberusHeapLang.MetaCoh σ id mc) →
          ((live : mc.alive = true → CerberusHeapLang.LiveCoh σ id mc) →
              (dead :
                  mc.alive = false →
                    σ.deadAllocations.contains id = true ∧ σ.allocations.get? id = none) →
                (nonAtomic : CerberusHeapLang.atomicTyOpt mc.ty = false) →
                  (dynamic : mc.dynamic = true → mc.addr ∈ σ.dynamicAddrs) → motive ⋯) →
            motive t
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.MetaCoh.dead :
∀ {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem} {id : Int} {mc : CerberusHeapLang.MetaCell},
  CerberusHeapLang.MetaCoh σ id mc →
    mc.alive = false → σ.deadAllocations.contains id = true ∧ σ.allocations.get? id = none
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.MetaCoh.dynamic :
∀ {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem} {id : Int} {mc : CerberusHeapLang.MetaCell},
  CerberusHeapLang.MetaCoh σ id mc → mc.dynamic = true → mc.addr ∈ σ.dynamicAddrs
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.MetaCoh.kill_other :
∀ {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem} {id id' : Int} {mc : CerberusHeapLang.MetaCell},
  CerberusHeapLang.MetaCoh σ id' mc →
    id' ≠ id →
      CerberusHeapLang.MetaCoh
        { nextAllocId := σ.nextAllocId, nextIota := σ.nextIota, lastAddress := σ.lastAddress,
          allocations := σ.allocations.erase id, iotaMap := σ.iotaMap, funptrmap := σ.funptrmap,
          varargs := σ.varargs, nextVarargsId := σ.nextVarargsId, bytemap := σ.bytemap,
          lastUsedUnionMembers := σ.lastUsedUnionMembers,
          deadAllocations := id :: σ.deadAllocations, dynamicAddrs := σ.dynamicAddrs,
          lastUsed := σ.lastUsed, requested := σ.requested }
        id' mc
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.MetaCoh.live :
∀ {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem} {id : Int} {mc : CerberusHeapLang.MetaCell},
  CerberusHeapLang.MetaCoh σ id mc → mc.alive = true → CerberusHeapLang.LiveCoh σ id mc
----
ctor CerberusHeapLang.MetaCoh.mk :
∀ {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem} {id : Int} {mc : CerberusHeapLang.MetaCell},
  (mc.alive = true → CerberusHeapLang.LiveCoh σ id mc) →
    (mc.alive = false → σ.deadAllocations.contains id = true ∧ σ.allocations.get? id = none) →
      CerberusHeapLang.atomicTyOpt mc.ty = false →
        (mc.dynamic = true → mc.addr ∈ σ.dynamicAddrs) → CerberusHeapLang.MetaCoh σ id mc
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.MetaCoh.nonAtomic :
∀ {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem} {id : Int} {mc : CerberusHeapLang.MetaCell},
  CerberusHeapLang.MetaCoh σ id mc → CerberusHeapLang.atomicTyOpt mc.ty = false
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.MetaCoh.of_fields :
∀ {σ σ' : CerberusHeapLang.Mem} {id : Int} {mc : CerberusHeapLang.MetaCell},
  CerberusHeapLang.MetaCoh σ id mc →
    σ'.deadAllocations = σ.deadAllocations →
      σ'.allocations.get? id = σ.allocations.get? id →
        σ'.dynamicAddrs = σ.dynamicAddrs → CerberusHeapLang.MetaCoh σ' id mc
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.MetaCoh.of_fields_dyn :
∀ {σ σ' : CerberusHeapLang.Mem} {id : Int} {mc : CerberusHeapLang.MetaCell},
  CerberusHeapLang.MetaCoh σ id mc →
    σ'.deadAllocations = σ.deadAllocations →
      σ'.allocations.get? id = σ.allocations.get? id →
        (∀ (a : CerbMem.Address), a ∈ σ.dynamicAddrs → a ∈ σ'.dynamicAddrs) →
          CerberusHeapLang.MetaCoh σ' id mc
----
rec CerberusHeapLang.MetaCoh.rec :
{σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem} →
  {id : Int} →
    {mc : CerberusHeapLang.MetaCell} →
      {motive : CerberusHeapLang.MetaCoh σ id mc → Sort u} →
        ((live : mc.alive = true → CerberusHeapLang.LiveCoh σ id mc) →
            (dead :
                mc.alive = false →
                  σ.deadAllocations.contains id = true ∧ σ.allocations.get? id = none) →
              (nonAtomic : CerberusHeapLang.atomicTyOpt mc.ty = false) →
                (dynamic : mc.dynamic = true → mc.addr ∈ σ.dynamicAddrs) → motive ⋯) →
          (t : CerberusHeapLang.MetaCoh σ id mc) → motive t
----
def CerberusHeapLang.MetaCoh.recOn :
{σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem} →
  {id : Int} →
    {mc : CerberusHeapLang.MetaCell} →

        (t : CerberusHeapLang.MetaCoh σ id mc) →

                    σ.deadAllocations.contains id = true ∧ σ.allocations.get? id = none) →

            motive t

theorem CerberusHeapLang.NodeTree.node.inj :
∀ {id v : Int} {l r : CerberusHeapLang.NodeTree} {id_1 v_1 : Int}
  {l_1 r_1 : CerberusHeapLang.NodeTree},
  CerberusHeapLang.NodeTree.node id v l r = CerberusHeapLang.NodeTree.node id_1 v_1 l_1 r_1 →
    id = id_1 ∧ v = v_1 ∧ l = l_1 ∧ r = r_1
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.NodeTree.node.injEq :
∀ (id v : Int) (l r : CerberusHeapLang.NodeTree) (id_1 v_1 : Int)
  (l_1 r_1 : CerberusHeapLang.NodeTree),
  (CerberusHeapLang.NodeTree.node id v l r = CerberusHeapLang.NodeTree.node id_1 v_1 l_1 r_1) =
    (id = id_1 ∧ v = v_1 ∧ l = l_1 ∧ r = r_1)
----
def CerberusHeapLang.NodeTree.node.noConfusion :
{P : Sort u} →
  {id v : Int} →
    {l r : CerberusHeapLang.NodeTree} →
      {id' v' : Int} →
        {l' r' : CerberusHeapLang.NodeTree} →
          CerberusHeapLang.NodeTree.node id v l r = CerberusHeapLang.NodeTree.node id' v' l' r' →
            (id = id' → v = v' → l = l' → r = r' → P) → P
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.NodeTree.node.sizeOf_spec :
∀ (id v : Int) (l r : CerberusHeapLang.NodeTree),
  sizeOf (CerberusHeapLang.NodeTree.node id v l r) = 1 + sizeOf id + sizeOf v + sizeOf l + sizeOf r

def CerberusHeapLang.OpenRound.casesOn :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {c : CerberusHeapLang.Config}
  {motive : CerberusHeapLang.OpenRound M c → Prop} (t : CerberusHeapLang.OpenRound M c),
  (∀ (pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym)
      (a : ∀ (c'' : CerberusHeapLang.Config), ¬CerberusHeapLang.Step M c c'')
      (a_1 : pe ∈ CerberusHeapLang.operandsOf c.fst) (a_2 : CerberusHeapLang.PePure pe)
      (a_3 :
        CerberusHeapLang.evalClass M.tagDefs M.currentLoc M.extern M.file c.snd.fst pe =
          CerberusHeapLang.EvalOut.uncovered)
      (a_4 :
        ∀ (dst : driver_state),
          M.Embeds dst c →
            ∃ rsk m,
              step_ctx M.tagDefs dst.layout_state dst.core_file dst.core_extern M.tid
                  (M.parent, M.thread c.fst c.snd.fst c.snd.snd.fst) =
                [Step_with_runstate2 rsk m]),
      motive ⋯) →
    (∀ (l : sym) (pes : List (generic_pexpr Unit sym)) (p : sym)
        (params : List (sym × core_base_type)) (cont : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr)
        (a : ∀ (c'' : CerberusHeapLang.Config), ¬CerberusHeapLang.Step M c c'')
        (a_1 : CerberusHeapLang.jumpRedex? c.fst = some (l, pes))
        (a_2 : c.snd.snd.fst.proc = some p)
        (a_3 : CerberusHeapLang.lookupLabel (M.labelsAt c.snd.snd.fst.proc) l = some (params, cont))
        (a_4 :
          ∃ vs,
            CerberusHeapLang.evalPexprs M.tagDefs M.extern c.snd.fst
                (CerberusHeapLang.zipArgs params pes) =
              some vs)
        (a_5 : CerberusHeapLang.evalPexprs M.tagDefs M.extern c.snd.fst pes = none)
        (a_6 :
          ∀ (dst : driver_state),
            M.Embeds dst c →
              ∃ rsk m,
                step_ctx M.tagDefs dst.layout_state dst.core_file dst.core_extern M.tid
                    (M.parent, M.thread c.fst c.snd.fst c.snd.snd.fst) =
                  [Step_with_runstate2 rsk m]),
        motive ⋯) →
      motive t

  (∀ (c'' : CerberusHeapLang.Config), ¬CerberusHeapLang.Step M c c'') →
    pe ∈ CerberusHeapLang.operandsOf c.fst →

        CerberusHeapLang.evalClass M.tagDefs M.currentLoc M.extern M.file c.snd.fst pe =
            CerberusHeapLang.EvalOut.uncovered →

                ∃ rsk m,
                  step_ctx M.tagDefs dst.layout_state dst.core_file dst.core_extern M.tid
                      (M.parent, M.thread c.fst c.snd.fst c.snd.snd.fst) =
                    [Step_with_runstate2 rsk m]) →
            CerberusHeapLang.OpenRound M c

ctor CerberusHeapLang.OpenRound.run_surplus :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {c : CerberusHeapLang.Config} (l : sym)
  (pes : List (generic_pexpr Unit sym)) (p : sym) (params : List (sym × core_base_type))
  (cont : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr),
  (∀ (c'' : CerberusHeapLang.Config), ¬CerberusHeapLang.Step M c c'') →
    CerberusHeapLang.jumpRedex? c.fst = some (l, pes) →
      c.snd.snd.fst.proc = some p →
        CerberusHeapLang.lookupLabel (M.labelsAt c.snd.snd.fst.proc) l = some (params, cont) →
          (∃ vs,
              CerberusHeapLang.evalPexprs M.tagDefs M.extern c.snd.fst
                  (CerberusHeapLang.zipArgs params pes) =
                some vs) →
            CerberusHeapLang.evalPexprs M.tagDefs M.extern c.snd.fst pes = none →
              (∀ (dst : driver_state),
                  M.Embeds dst c →
                    ∃ rsk m,
                      step_ctx M.tagDefs dst.layout_state dst.core_file dst.core_extern M.tid
                          (M.parent, M.thread c.fst c.snd.fst c.snd.snd.fst) =
                        [Step_with_runstate2 rsk m]) →
                CerberusHeapLang.OpenRound M c

theorem CerberusHeapLang.PMunion_get? :
∀ {V : Type} (m₁ m₂ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF V) (k : Int),
  Iris.Std.get? (Iris.Std.PartialMap.union m₁ m₂) k =
    (Iris.Std.get? m₁ k).orElse fun x => Iris.Std.get? m₂ k

def CerberusHeapLang.PePure.below.casesOn :
∀ {motive : (a : generic_pexpr Unit sym) → CerberusHeapLang.PePure a → Prop}
  {motive_1 :
    {a : generic_pexpr Unit sym} →
      (t : CerberusHeapLang.PePure a) → CerberusHeapLang.PePure.below t → Prop}

    (∀ (a : List annot) (x : sym), motive_1 ⋯ ⋯) →
      (∀ (a : List annot) (op : binop) (hop : CerberusHeapLang.isMirroredOp op = true)
          {pe1 pe2 : generic_pexpr Unit _root_.sym} (a_1 : CerberusHeapLang.PePure pe1)
          (a_2 : CerberusHeapLang.PePure pe2) (ih : CerberusHeapLang.PePure.below a_1)
          (a_ih : motive pe1 a_1) (ih_1 : CerberusHeapLang.PePure.below a_2)
          (a_ih_1 : motive pe2 a_2), motive_1 ⋯ ⋯) →
        (∀ (a : List annot) (ty : ctype) {pe1 pe2 : generic_pexpr Unit _root_.sym}
            (a_1 : CerberusHeapLang.PePure pe1) (a_2 : CerberusHeapLang.PePure pe2)
            (ih : CerberusHeapLang.PePure.below a_1) (a_ih : motive pe1 a_1)
            (ih_1 : CerberusHeapLang.PePure.below a_2) (a_ih_1 : motive pe2 a_2), motive_1 ⋯ ⋯) →
          motive_1 t t_1

rec CerberusHeapLang.PePure.below.rec :
∀ {motive : (a : generic_pexpr Unit sym) → CerberusHeapLang.PePure a → Prop}
  {motive_1 :
    {a : generic_pexpr Unit sym} →
      (t : CerberusHeapLang.PePure a) → CerberusHeapLang.PePure.below t → Prop},
  (∀ (a : List annot) (v : value), motive_1 ⋯ ⋯) →
    (∀ (a : List annot) (x : sym), motive_1 ⋯ ⋯) →
      (∀ (a : List annot) (op : binop) (hop : CerberusHeapLang.isMirroredOp op = true)
          {pe1 pe2 : generic_pexpr Unit _root_.sym} (a_1 : CerberusHeapLang.PePure pe1)
          (a_2 : CerberusHeapLang.PePure pe2) (ih : CerberusHeapLang.PePure.below a_1)
          (a_ih : motive pe1 a_1) (ih_1 : CerberusHeapLang.PePure.below a_2)
          (a_ih_1 : motive pe2 a_2), motive_1 a_1 ih → motive_1 a_2 ih_1 → motive_1 ⋯ ⋯) →
        (∀ (a : List annot) (ty : ctype) {pe1 pe2 : generic_pexpr Unit _root_.sym}
            (a_1 : CerberusHeapLang.PePure pe1) (a_2 : CerberusHeapLang.PePure pe2)
            (ih : CerberusHeapLang.PePure.below a_1) (a_ih : motive pe1 a_1)
            (ih_1 : CerberusHeapLang.PePure.below a_2) (a_ih_1 : motive pe2 a_2),
            motive_1 a_1 ih → motive_1 a_2 ih_1 → motive_1 ⋯ ⋯) →
          ∀ {a : generic_pexpr Unit _root_.sym} {t : CerberusHeapLang.PePure a}
            (t_1 : CerberusHeapLang.PePure.below t), motive_1 t t_1
----
