def CerberusHeapLang.ReadinessSmoke.twoField :
{hlc : Iris.HasLC} →
  {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} →
    [CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF] →
      CerbTags.TagDefsMap →
        CerbMem.PointerValue → List CerbMem.AbsByte → List CerbMem.AbsByte → Iris.IProp GF
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.ReadinessSmoke.twoField_create :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {pr : Option sym} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpec GF}
  {Θ : CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpec GF}
  {Ψ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF}
  (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ann : core_run_annotation) (aprov : CerbMem.Provenance) (alignN : Int)
  (pref : prefix0) (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack),
  (CerberusHeapLang.allocBudget
        (CerberusHeapLang.allocCost M.tagDefs CerberusHeapLang.ReadinessSmoke.objTy alignN) ∗
      ∀ p,
        CerberusHeapLang.ReadinessSmoke.twoField M.tagDefs p
              CerberusHeapLang.ReadinessSmoke.undefField
              CerberusHeapLang.ReadinessSmoke.undefField ∗
            ⌜0 < CerberusHeapLang.addrOf p ∧ CerberusHeapLang.addrOf p < 2 ^ 64⌝ -∗
          Ψ (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.pure (Vobject (OVpointer p))) ρ) ⊢
    CerberusHeapLang.wps M pr Ls Θ Ψ
      (CerberusHeapLang.createExpr loc ann (CerbMem.IntegerValue.IV aprov alignN)
        CerberusHeapLang.ReadinessSmoke.objTy pref)
      ρ
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.ReadinessSmoke.twoField_iff :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap) (p : CerbMem.PointerValue) (xb yb : List CerbMem.AbsByte),
  CerberusHeapLang.ReadinessSmoke.twoField tds p xb yb ⊣⊢
    ∃ id a,
      ⌜p = CerberusHeapLang.cellPtr id a⌝ ∗
        CerberusHeapLang.pointsToView tds id a CerberusHeapLang.ReadinessSmoke.objTy 0
            (Iris.DFrac.own (Iris.Qp.half 1)) (Iris.DFrac.own 1)
            CerberusHeapLang.ReadinessSmoke.fieldTy xb ∗
          CerberusHeapLang.pointsToView tds id a CerberusHeapLang.ReadinessSmoke.objTy 8
            (Iris.DFrac.own (Iris.Qp.half 1)) (Iris.DFrac.own 1)
            CerberusHeapLang.ReadinessSmoke.fieldTy yb
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.ReadinessSmoke.twoField_load_x :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {pr : Option sym} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpec GF}
  {Θ : CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpec GF}
  {Ψ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF}
  (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ann : core_run_annotation) (p : CerbMem.PointerValue)
  (mo : memory_order) (xb yb : List CerbMem.AbsByte) (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack)
  {mv : CerbMem.MemValue},
  (∀ (lum : List (Int × identifier)) (fpm : CerbMem.Funptrmap) (ad : Int),
      CerbMem.reconstructValue M.tagDefs lum fpm ad CerberusHeapLang.ReadinessSmoke.fieldTy xb =
        mv) →
    CerberusHeapLang.loadTrapV CerberusHeapLang.ReadinessSmoke.fieldTy mv = false →
      (CerberusHeapLang.ReadinessSmoke.twoField M.tagDefs p xb yb ∗
          ∀ fp,
            CerberusHeapLang.ReadinessSmoke.twoField M.tagDefs p xb yb -∗
              Ψ (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.annot [DA_pos [] fp] (valueFromMemValue mv).snd) ρ) ⊢
        CerberusHeapLang.wps M pr Ls Θ Ψ
          (CerberusHeapLang.loadExpr loc ann CerberusHeapLang.ReadinessSmoke.fieldTy p mo) ρ
----

theorem CerberusHeapLang.ReadinessSmoke.twoField_of_cell :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]

theorem CerberusHeapLang.ReadinessSmoke.twoField_store_x :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]

def CerberusHeapLang.Redex.casesOn :
∀ {motive : (a : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr) → CerberusHeapLang.Redex a → Prop}
  {a : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} (t : CerberusHeapLang.Redex a),
  (∀ {loc : CerbLocation.Loc} {ann : core_run_annotation} {lk : Bool} {ty : ctype}
      {pv : CerbMem.PointerValue} {cv : value} {mo : memory_order},
      motive (CerberusHeapLang.storeRedex loc ann lk ty pv cv mo) ⋯) →
    (∀ {loc : CerbLocation.Loc} {ann : core_run_annotation} {ty : ctype} {pv : CerbMem.PointerValue}
        {mo : memory_order}, motive (CerberusHeapLang.loadRedex loc ann ty pv mo) ⋯) →
      (∀ {loc : CerbLocation.Loc} {ann : core_run_annotation} {align : CerbMem.IntegerValue}
          {ty : ctype} {pref : prefix0},
          motive (CerberusHeapLang.createRedex loc ann align ty pref) ⋯) →
        (∀ {loc : CerbLocation.Loc} {ann : core_run_annotation} {kind : kill_kind}
            {pv : CerbMem.PointerValue}, motive (CerberusHeapLang.killRedex loc ann kind pv) ⋯) →
          (∀ (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ann : core_run_annotation) (kind : kill_kind)
              {pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym} (hnv : valueFromPexpr pe = none),
              motive (CerberusHeapLang.killOpRedex loc ann kind pe) ⋯) →
            (∀ {loc : CerbLocation.Loc} {ann : core_run_annotation}
                {align size : CerbMem.IntegerValue} {pref : prefix0},
                motive (CerberusHeapLang.allocRedex loc ann align size pref) ⋯) →
              (∀ (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ann : core_run_annotation) (pref : prefix0)
                  {pe1 pe2 : generic_pexpr Unit sym} (hnv : valueFromPexprs [pe1, pe2] = none),
                  motive (CerberusHeapLang.allocOpRedex loc ann pe1 pe2 pref) ⋯) →
                (∀ {pa : List annot} {bty : core_base_type} {v : value}
                    {e2 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr},
                    motive
                      (generic_expr.Expr []
                        (Esseq (Pattern pa (CaseBase (none, bty)))
                          (CerberusHeapLang.ofVal (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.pure v)) e2))
                      ⋯) →
                  (∀ {pa : List annot} {bty : core_base_type} {ds : List dyn_annotation} {v : value}
                      {e2 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr},
                      motive
                        (generic_expr.Expr []
                          (Esseq (Pattern pa (CaseBase (none, bty)))
                            (CerberusHeapLang.ofVal (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.annot ds v)) e2))
                        ⋯) →
                    (∀ {ds1 ds2 : List dyn_annotation} {b : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr}
                        (hirr :
                          is_irreducible
                              (generic_expr.Expr []
                                (Eannot ds1 (generic_expr.Expr [] (Eannot ds2 b)))) =
                            false),
                        motive
                          (generic_expr.Expr [] (Eannot ds1 (generic_expr.Expr [] (Eannot ds2 b))))
                          ⋯) →
                      (∀ (sb : sym × core_base_type)
                          (ps :
                            List
                              (sym ×
                                (core_base_type × Option (ctype × pass_by_value_or_pointer)) ×
                                  generic_pexpr Unit sym))
                          (body : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr),
                          motive (CerberusHeapLang.saveRedex sb ps body) ⋯) →
                        (∀ (g : generic_pexpr Unit sym) (e2 e3 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr),
                            motive (CerberusHeapLang.ifRedex g e2 e3) ⋯) →
                          (∀ (pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym)
                              (pats : List (pattern × CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr)),
                              motive (CerberusHeapLang.caseRedex pe pats) ⋯) →
                            (∀ (ra : core_run_annotation) (l : sym)
                                (pes : List (generic_pexpr Unit sym)),
                                motive (CerberusHeapLang.runRedex ra l pes) ⋯) →
                              (∀ {pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym} (hnv : valueFromPexpr pe = none),
                                  motive (CerberusHeapLang.pureRedex pe) ⋯) →
                                (∀ (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ann : core_run_annotation) (ty : ctype)
                                    {pe2 : generic_pexpr Unit sym} (mo : memory_order)
                                    (hnv2 : valueFromPexpr pe2 = none),
                                    motive (CerberusHeapLang.loadOpRedex loc ann ty pe2 mo) ⋯) →
                                  (∀ {pa pb : List annot} {x : sym} {bty : core_base_type}
                                      {w : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal}
                                      {e2 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr},
                                      motive
                                        (generic_expr.Expr []
                                          (Esseq (CerberusHeapLang.specPat pa pb x bty)
                                            (CerberusHeapLang.ofVal w) e2))
                                        ⋯) →
                                    (∀ (mop : memop) (pes : List (generic_pexpr Unit sym)),
                                        motive (CerberusHeapLang.memopRedex mop pes) ⋯) →
                                      (∀ (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ann : core_run_annotation)
                                          (ty : ctype) {pe2 pe3 : generic_pexpr Unit sym}
                                          (mo : memory_order)
                                          (hnv : valueFromPexprs [pe2, pe3] = none),
                                          motive
                                            (CerberusHeapLang.storeOpRedex loc ann ty pe2 pe3 mo)
                                            ⋯) →
                                        (∀ {pa : List annot} {x : sym} {bty : core_base_type}
                                            {w : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal}
                                            {e2 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr},
                                            motive
                                              (generic_expr.Expr []
                                                (Esseq (CerberusHeapLang.symPat pa x bty)
                                                  (CerberusHeapLang.ofVal w) e2))
                                              ⋯) →
                                          (∀ {pa : List annot} {bty : core_base_type} {v : value}
                                              {e2 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr},
                                              motive
                                                (generic_expr.Expr []
                                                  (Ewseq (Pattern pa (CaseBase (none, bty)))
                                                    (CerberusHeapLang.ofVal
                                                      (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.pure v))
                                                    e2))
                                                ⋯) →
                                            (∀ {pa : List annot} {bty : core_base_type}
                                                {ds : List dyn_annotation} {v : value}
                                                {e2 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr},
                                                motive
                                                  (generic_expr.Expr []
                                                    (Ewseq (Pattern pa (CaseBase (none, bty)))
                                                      (CerberusHeapLang.ofVal
                                                        (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.annot ds v))
                                                      e2))
                                                  ⋯) →
                                              (∀ (ra : core_run_annotation) (f : sym)
                                                  (pes : List (generic_pexpr Unit sym)),
                                                  motive (CerberusHeapLang.callRedex ra f pes) ⋯) →
                                                motive a t

  CerberusHeapLang.Redex r →

rec CerberusHeapLang.Redex.rec :
∀ {motive : (a : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr) → CerberusHeapLang.Redex a → Prop},
  (∀ {loc : CerbLocation.Loc} {ann : core_run_annotation} {lk : Bool} {ty : ctype}
      {pv : CerbMem.PointerValue} {cv : value} {mo : memory_order},
      motive (CerberusHeapLang.storeRedex loc ann lk ty pv cv mo) ⋯) →
    (∀ {loc : CerbLocation.Loc} {ann : core_run_annotation} {ty : ctype} {pv : CerbMem.PointerValue}
        {mo : memory_order}, motive (CerberusHeapLang.loadRedex loc ann ty pv mo) ⋯) →
      (∀ {loc : CerbLocation.Loc} {ann : core_run_annotation} {align : CerbMem.IntegerValue}
          {ty : ctype} {pref : prefix0},
          motive (CerberusHeapLang.createRedex loc ann align ty pref) ⋯) →
        (∀ {loc : CerbLocation.Loc} {ann : core_run_annotation} {kind : kill_kind}
            {pv : CerbMem.PointerValue}, motive (CerberusHeapLang.killRedex loc ann kind pv) ⋯) →
          (∀ (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ann : core_run_annotation) (kind : kill_kind)
              {pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym} (hnv : valueFromPexpr pe = none),
              motive (CerberusHeapLang.killOpRedex loc ann kind pe) ⋯) →
            (∀ {loc : CerbLocation.Loc} {ann : core_run_annotation}
                {align size : CerbMem.IntegerValue} {pref : prefix0},
                motive (CerberusHeapLang.allocRedex loc ann align size pref) ⋯) →
              (∀ (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ann : core_run_annotation) (pref : prefix0)
                  {pe1 pe2 : generic_pexpr Unit sym} (hnv : valueFromPexprs [pe1, pe2] = none),
                  motive (CerberusHeapLang.allocOpRedex loc ann pe1 pe2 pref) ⋯) →
                (∀ {pa : List annot} {bty : core_base_type} {v : value}
                    {e2 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr},
                    motive
                      (generic_expr.Expr []
                        (Esseq (Pattern pa (CaseBase (none, bty)))
                          (CerberusHeapLang.ofVal (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.pure v)) e2))
                      ⋯) →
                  (∀ {pa : List annot} {bty : core_base_type} {ds : List dyn_annotation} {v : value}
                      {e2 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr},
                      motive
                        (generic_expr.Expr []
                          (Esseq (Pattern pa (CaseBase (none, bty)))
                            (CerberusHeapLang.ofVal (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.annot ds v)) e2))
                        ⋯) →
                    (∀ {ds1 ds2 : List dyn_annotation} {b : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr}
                        (hirr :
                          is_irreducible
                              (generic_expr.Expr []
                                (Eannot ds1 (generic_expr.Expr [] (Eannot ds2 b)))) =
                            false),
                        motive
                          (generic_expr.Expr [] (Eannot ds1 (generic_expr.Expr [] (Eannot ds2 b))))
                          ⋯) →
                      (∀ (sb : sym × core_base_type)
                          (ps :
                            List
                              (sym ×
                                (core_base_type × Option (ctype × pass_by_value_or_pointer)) ×
                                  generic_pexpr Unit sym))
                          (body : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr),
                          motive (CerberusHeapLang.saveRedex sb ps body) ⋯) →
                        (∀ (g : generic_pexpr Unit sym) (e2 e3 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr),
                            motive (CerberusHeapLang.ifRedex g e2 e3) ⋯) →
                          (∀ (pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym)
                              (pats : List (pattern × CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr)),
                              motive (CerberusHeapLang.caseRedex pe pats) ⋯) →
                            (∀ (ra : core_run_annotation) (l : sym)
                                (pes : List (generic_pexpr Unit sym)),
                                motive (CerberusHeapLang.runRedex ra l pes) ⋯) →
                              (∀ {pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym} (hnv : valueFromPexpr pe = none),
                                  motive (CerberusHeapLang.pureRedex pe) ⋯) →
                                (∀ (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ann : core_run_annotation) (ty : ctype)
                                    {pe2 : generic_pexpr Unit sym} (mo : memory_order)
                                    (hnv2 : valueFromPexpr pe2 = none),
                                    motive (CerberusHeapLang.loadOpRedex loc ann ty pe2 mo) ⋯) →
                                  (∀ {pa pb : List annot} {x : sym} {bty : core_base_type}
                                      {w : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal}
                                      {e2 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr},
                                      motive
                                        (generic_expr.Expr []
                                          (Esseq (CerberusHeapLang.specPat pa pb x bty)
                                            (CerberusHeapLang.ofVal w) e2))
                                        ⋯) →
                                    (∀ (mop : memop) (pes : List (generic_pexpr Unit sym)),
                                        motive (CerberusHeapLang.memopRedex mop pes) ⋯) →
                                      (∀ (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ann : core_run_annotation)
                                          (ty : ctype) {pe2 pe3 : generic_pexpr Unit sym}
                                          (mo : memory_order)
                                          (hnv : valueFromPexprs [pe2, pe3] = none),
                                          motive
                                            (CerberusHeapLang.storeOpRedex loc ann ty pe2 pe3 mo)
                                            ⋯) →
                                        (∀ {pa : List annot} {x : sym} {bty : core_base_type}
                                            {w : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal}
                                            {e2 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr},
                                            motive
                                              (generic_expr.Expr []
                                                (Esseq (CerberusHeapLang.symPat pa x bty)
                                                  (CerberusHeapLang.ofVal w) e2))
                                              ⋯) →
                                          (∀ {pa : List annot} {bty : core_base_type} {v : value}
                                              {e2 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr},
                                              motive
                                                (generic_expr.Expr []
                                                  (Ewseq (Pattern pa (CaseBase (none, bty)))
                                                    (CerberusHeapLang.ofVal
                                                      (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.pure v))
                                                    e2))
                                                ⋯) →
                                            (∀ {pa : List annot} {bty : core_base_type}
                                                {ds : List dyn_annotation} {v : value}
                                                {e2 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr},
                                                motive
                                                  (generic_expr.Expr []
                                                    (Ewseq (Pattern pa (CaseBase (none, bty)))
                                                      (CerberusHeapLang.ofVal
                                                        (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.annot ds v))
                                                      e2))
                                                  ⋯) →
                                              (∀ (ra : core_run_annotation) (f : sym)
                                                  (pes : List (generic_pexpr Unit sym)),
                                                  motive (CerberusHeapLang.callRedex ra f pes) ⋯) →
                                                ∀ {a : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr}
                                                  (t : CerberusHeapLang.Redex a), motive a t

def CerberusHeapLang.Redex.recOn :
∀ {motive : (a : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr) → CerberusHeapLang.Redex a → Prop}
  {a : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} (t : CerberusHeapLang.Redex a),
  (∀ {loc : CerbLocation.Loc} {ann : core_run_annotation} {lk : Bool} {ty : ctype}
      {pv : CerbMem.PointerValue} {cv : value} {mo : memory_order},
      motive (CerberusHeapLang.storeRedex loc ann lk ty pv cv mo) ⋯) →

        {mo : memory_order}, motive (CerberusHeapLang.loadRedex loc ann ty pv mo) ⋯) →
      (∀ {loc : CerbLocation.Loc} {ann : core_run_annotation} {align : CerbMem.IntegerValue}

            {pv : CerbMem.PointerValue}, motive (CerberusHeapLang.killRedex loc ann kind pv) ⋯) →
          (∀ (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ann : core_run_annotation) (kind : kill_kind)

              motive (CerberusHeapLang.killOpRedex loc ann kind pe) ⋯) →

              (∀ (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ann : core_run_annotation) (pref : prefix0)
                  {pe1 pe2 : generic_pexpr Unit sym} (hnv : valueFromPexprs [pe1, pe2] = none),
                  motive (CerberusHeapLang.allocOpRedex loc ann pe1 pe2 pref) ⋯) →
                (∀ {pa : List annot} {bty : core_base_type} {v : value}

                      (generic_expr.Expr []
                        (Esseq (Pattern pa (CaseBase (none, bty)))
                          (CerberusHeapLang.ofVal (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.pure v)) e2))
                      ⋯) →
                  (∀ {pa : List annot} {bty : core_base_type} {ds : List dyn_annotation} {v : value}
                      {e2 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr},
                      motive
                        (generic_expr.Expr []
                          (Esseq (Pattern pa (CaseBase (none, bty)))
                            (CerberusHeapLang.ofVal (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.annot ds v)) e2))
                        ⋯) →
                    (∀ {ds1 ds2 : List dyn_annotation} {b : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr}

                            false),
                        motive
                          (generic_expr.Expr [] (Eannot ds1 (generic_expr.Expr [] (Eannot ds2 b))))
                          ⋯) →
                      (∀ (sb : sym × core_base_type)
                          (ps :
                            List
                              (sym ×
                                (core_base_type × Option (ctype × pass_by_value_or_pointer)) ×
                                  generic_pexpr Unit sym))
                          (body : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr),
                          motive (CerberusHeapLang.saveRedex sb ps body) ⋯) →
                        (∀ (g : generic_pexpr Unit sym) (e2 e3 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr),
                            motive (CerberusHeapLang.ifRedex g e2 e3) ⋯) →
                          (∀ (pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym)
                              (pats : List (pattern × CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr)),
                              motive (CerberusHeapLang.caseRedex pe pats) ⋯) →
                            (∀ (ra : core_run_annotation) (l : sym)
                                (pes : List (generic_pexpr Unit sym)),
                                motive (CerberusHeapLang.runRedex ra l pes) ⋯) →
                              (∀ {pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym} (hnv : valueFromPexpr pe = none),
                                  motive (CerberusHeapLang.pureRedex pe) ⋯) →
                                (∀ (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ann : core_run_annotation) (ty : ctype)
                                    {pe2 : generic_pexpr Unit sym} (mo : memory_order)

                                  (∀ {pa pb : List annot} {x : sym} {bty : core_base_type}

                                          motive
                                            (CerberusHeapLang.storeOpRedex loc ann ty pe2 pe3 mo)
                                            ⋯) →

                                            {w : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal}
                                            {e2 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr},
                                            motive
                                              (generic_expr.Expr []
                                                (Esseq (CerberusHeapLang.symPat pa x bty)
                                                  (CerberusHeapLang.ofVal w) e2))
                                              ⋯) →
                                          (∀ {pa : List annot} {bty : core_base_type} {v : value}
                                              {e2 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr},
                                              motive
                                                (generic_expr.Expr []
                                                  (Ewseq (Pattern pa (CaseBase (none, bty)))
                                                    (CerberusHeapLang.ofVal
                                                      (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.pure v))
                                                    e2))
                                                ⋯) →
                                            (∀ {pa : List annot} {bty : core_base_type}
                                                {ds : List dyn_annotation} {v : value}

                                                  ⋯) →

                                                motive a t

def CerberusHeapLang.RoundClass.casesOn :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {c : CerberusHeapLang.Config}
  {motive : CerberusHeapLang.RoundClass M c → Prop} (t : CerberusHeapLang.RoundClass M c),
  (∀ (v : value) (a : c.fst = CerberusHeapLang.ofVal (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.pure v))
      (a_1 :
        ∀ (dst : driver_state),
          M.Embeds dst c →
            step_ctx M.tagDefs dst.layout_state dst.core_file dst.core_extern M.tid
                (M.parent, M.thread c.fst c.snd.fst c.snd.snd.fst) =
              [Step_done2 v]),
      motive ⋯) →
    (∀ (ds : List dyn_annotation) (v : value)
        (a : c.fst = CerberusHeapLang.ofVal (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.annot ds v))
        (a_1 :
          CerberusHeapLang.CerberusRound M c
            (CerberusHeapLang.ofVal (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.pure v), c.snd.fst, c.snd.snd.fst,
              c.snd.snd.snd)),
        motive ⋯) →
      (∀ (c' : CerberusHeapLang.Config) (a : CerberusHeapLang.Step M c c')
          (a_1 :
            ∀ (c'' : CerberusHeapLang.Config),
              CerberusHeapLang.Step M c c'' ↔ CerberusHeapLang.CerberusRound M c c''),
          motive ⋯) →
        (∀ (a : CerberusHeapLang.toVal c.fst = none)
            (a_1 : ∀ (c' : CerberusHeapLang.Config), ¬CerberusHeapLang.Step M c c')
            (a_2 : CerberusHeapLang.ShippedRefusal M c), motive ⋯) →
          (∀ (a : CerberusHeapLang.toVal c.fst = none)
              (a_1 : ∀ (c' : CerberusHeapLang.Config), ¬CerberusHeapLang.Step M c c')
              (a_2 : CerberusHeapLang.OpenRound M c), motive ⋯) →
            motive t
----

  CerberusHeapLang.toVal c.fst = none →
    (∀ (c' : CerberusHeapLang.Config), ¬CerberusHeapLang.Step M c c') →
      CerberusHeapLang.OpenRound M c → CerberusHeapLang.RoundClass M c

def CerberusHeapLang.SameTail :
CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Prop
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.SameTail.cons_inv :
∀ {ev0 : Fmap sym value} {evs ρ' : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack},
  CerberusHeapLang.SameTail (ev0 :: evs) ρ' → ∃ ev0', ρ' = ev0' :: evs
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.SameTail.refl :
∀ (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack), CerberusHeapLang.SameTail ρ ρ
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.SameTail.trans :
∀ {ρ₁ ρ₂ ρ₃ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack},
  CerberusHeapLang.SameTail ρ₁ ρ₂ →
    CerberusHeapLang.SameTail ρ₂ ρ₃ → CerberusHeapLang.SameTail ρ₁ ρ₃

def CerberusHeapLang.Sat :
CerbTags.TagDefsMap → CerberusHeapLang.Mem → CerberusHeapLang.CellMap → Prop
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.Sat.mono :
∀ {tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap} {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem} {m m' : CerberusHeapLang.CellMap},
  CerberusHeapLang.Sat tds σ m → m' ⊆ m → CerberusHeapLang.Sat tds σ m'
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.Sat.union_left :
∀ {tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap} {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem} {Q R : CerberusHeapLang.CellMap},
  CerberusHeapLang.Sat tds σ (Iris.Std.PartialMap.union Q R) → CerberusHeapLang.Sat tds σ Q

def CerberusHeapLang.SeedChain :
CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerberusHeapLang.SpikeCell →
  CerbMem.PointerValue → List (Int × Int) → Prop
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.SeedChain.footprint :
∀ (ns : List (Int × Int)) (m : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerberusHeapLang.SpikeCell)
  (p : CerbMem.PointerValue),
  CerberusHeapLang.SeedChain m p ns →
    ∀ (k : Int), (Iris.Std.get? m k).isSome = true ↔ k ∈ List.map Prod.fst ns

CerberusHeapLang.CellMap → CerbMem.PointerValue → CerberusHeapLang.NodeTree → Prop
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.SeedTree.footprint :
∀ (t : CerberusHeapLang.NodeTree) (m : CerberusHeapLang.CellMap) (p : CerbMem.PointerValue),
  CerberusHeapLang.SeedTree m p t → ∀ (k : Int), (Iris.Std.get? m k).isSome = true ↔ k ∈ t.ids

def CerberusHeapLang.SemTriple :
CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx →
  CerberusHeapLang.Ctl →
    CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack →
      CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr →
        CerberusHeapLang.CellMap → (value → CerberusHeapLang.CellMap → Prop) → Prop
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.SemTriple_iff_Mem :
∀ (M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx) (ctl : CerberusHeapLang.Ctl) (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack)
  (e : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr) (P : CerberusHeapLang.CellMap)
  (post : value → CerberusHeapLang.CellMap → Prop),
  CerberusHeapLang.SemTriple M ctl ρ e P post ↔
    CerberusHeapLang.MemTriple M ctl ρ e P fun R v σ' =>
      ∃ Q,
        post v Q ∧
          Iris.Std.PartialMap.disjoint Q R ∧
            CerberusHeapLang.Sat M.tagDefs σ' (Iris.Std.PartialMap.union Q R)
----
inductive CerberusHeapLang.ShippedRefusal :
CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx → CerberusHeapLang.Config → Prop
----
def CerberusHeapLang.ShippedRefusal.casesOn :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {c : CerberusHeapLang.Config}
  {motive : CerberusHeapLang.ShippedRefusal M c → Prop} (t : CerberusHeapLang.ShippedRefusal M c),
  (∀ (msg : String)
      (a :
        ∀ (dst : driver_state),
          M.Embeds dst c →
            step_ctx M.tagDefs dst.layout_state dst.core_file dst.core_extern M.tid
                (M.parent, M.thread c.fst c.snd.fst c.snd.snd.fst) =
              [Step_error2 msg]),
      motive ⋯) →
    (∀ (r : kill_reason driver_error)
        (a :
          ∀ (dst : driver_state),
            M.Embeds dst c →
              ∃ s dst',
                step_ctx M.tagDefs dst.layout_state dst.core_file dst.core_extern M.tid
                      (M.parent, M.thread c.fst c.snd.fst c.snd.snd.fst) =
                    [s] ∧
                  can_advance s = true ∧
                    CerberusHeapLang.runOne (advance_step M.tagDefs M.tid s) dst =
                      (NDkilled r, dst')),
        motive ⋯) →
      (∀
          (a :
            ∀ (dst : driver_state),
              M.Embeds dst c →
                ∃ s,
                  step_ctx M.tagDefs dst.layout_state dst.core_file dst.core_extern M.tid
                        (M.parent, M.thread c.fst c.snd.fst c.snd.snd.fst) =
                      [s] ∧
                    can_advance s = true ∧
                      2 ≤ (CerbND.runND (advance_step M.tagDefs M.tid s) dst).length),
          motive ⋯) →
        (∀
            (a :
              ∀ (dst : driver_state),
                M.Embeds dst c →
                  ∃ rsk m d inst step_m k msg,
                    step_ctx M.tagDefs dst.layout_state dst.core_file dst.core_extern M.tid
                          (M.parent, M.thread c.fst c.snd.fst c.snd.snd.fst) =
                        [Step_with_runstate2 rsk m] ∧
                      m = stExceptUndef_bind step_m k ∧
                        step_m dst.core_run_state0 = failwithI msg dst.core_run_state0),
            motive ⋯) →
          (∀ (msg : String)
              (a :
                ∀ (dst : driver_state),
                  M.Embeds dst c →
                    ∃ s th' evs,
                      step_ctx M.tagDefs dst.layout_state dst.core_file dst.core_extern M.tid
                            (M.parent, M.thread c.fst c.snd.fst c.snd.snd.fst) =
                          [Step_tau2 s TSK_Misc th'] ∧
                        th'.env = failwithI msg :: evs),
              motive ⋯) →
            (∀ (msg : String)
                (a :
                  ∀ (dst : driver_state),
                    M.Embeds dst c →
                      ∃ loc mop cvals uw k g,
                        step_ctx M.tagDefs dst.layout_state dst.core_file dst.core_extern M.tid
                              (M.parent, M.thread c.fst c.snd.fst c.snd.snd.fst) =
                            [Step_memop_request2 loc mop cvals M.tid uw k] ∧
                          perform_memop_request2 M.tagDefs loc mop cvals M.tid k =
                            nd_bind (failwithI msg) g),
                motive ⋯) →
              (∀ (c' : CerberusHeapLang.Config) (msg : String)
                  (a : CerberusHeapLang.CerberusRound M c c')
                  (a_1 :
                    ∀ (dst : driver_state),
                      M.Embeds dst c' →
                        step_ctx M.tagDefs dst.layout_state dst.core_file dst.core_extern M.tid
                            (M.parent, M.thread c'.fst c'.snd.fst c'.snd.snd.fst) =
                          [Step_error2 msg]),
                  motive ⋯) →
                (∀ (msg : String) (a : c.snd.snd.fst.proc = none)
                    (a_1 :
                      ∀ (dst : driver_state),
                        M.Embeds dst c →
                          ∃ s l inst k,
                            step_ctx M.tagDefs dst.layout_state dst.core_file dst.core_extern M.tid
                                (M.parent, M.thread c.fst c.snd.fst c.snd.snd.fst) =
                              [Step_with_runstate2 (RSK_eval s)
                                  (stExceptUndef_bind
                                    (runSE
                                      (state_except_read fun rs =>
                                        Lem_Maybe.bind0
                                          (fmapLookupBy
                                            (fun s1 s2 => Lem_Basic_classes.ordCompare s1 s2)
                                            (CerberusHeapLang.resolveExtern dst.core_extern
                                              (failwithI msg))
                                            rs.labeled)
                                          (fmapLookupBy
                                            (fun s1 s2 => Lem_Basic_classes.ordCompare s1 s2) l)))
                                    k)]),
                    motive ⋯) →
                  motive t
----
ctor CerberusHeapLang.ShippedRefusal.error :

  (∀ (dst : driver_state),
      M.Embeds dst c →

ctor CerberusHeapLang.ShippedRefusal.panic_noproc :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {c : CerberusHeapLang.Config} (msg : String),
  c.snd.snd.fst.proc = none →
    (∀ (dst : driver_state),
        M.Embeds dst c →
          ∃ s l inst k,
            step_ctx M.tagDefs dst.layout_state dst.core_file dst.core_extern M.tid
                (M.parent, M.thread c.fst c.snd.fst c.snd.snd.fst) =
              [Step_with_runstate2 (RSK_eval s)
                  (stExceptUndef_bind
                    (runSE
                      (state_except_read fun rs =>
                        Lem_Maybe.bind0
                          (fmapLookupBy (fun s1 s2 => Lem_Basic_classes.ordCompare s1 s2)
                            (CerberusHeapLang.resolveExtern dst.core_extern (failwithI msg))
                            rs.labeled)
                          (fmapLookupBy (fun s1 s2 => Lem_Basic_classes.ordCompare s1 s2) l)))
                    k)]) →
      CerberusHeapLang.ShippedRefusal M c

rec CerberusHeapLang.ShippedRefusal.rec :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {c : CerberusHeapLang.Config}
  {motive : CerberusHeapLang.ShippedRefusal M c → Prop},
  (∀ (msg : String)
      (a :
        ∀ (dst : driver_state),
          M.Embeds dst c →
            step_ctx M.tagDefs dst.layout_state dst.core_file dst.core_extern M.tid
                (M.parent, M.thread c.fst c.snd.fst c.snd.snd.fst) =
              [Step_error2 msg]),
      motive ⋯) →
    (∀ (r : kill_reason driver_error)
        (a :
          ∀ (dst : driver_state),
            M.Embeds dst c →
              ∃ s dst',
                step_ctx M.tagDefs dst.layout_state dst.core_file dst.core_extern M.tid
                      (M.parent, M.thread c.fst c.snd.fst c.snd.snd.fst) =
                    [s] ∧
                  can_advance s = true ∧
                    CerberusHeapLang.runOne (advance_step M.tagDefs M.tid s) dst =
                      (NDkilled r, dst')),
        motive ⋯) →
      (∀
          (a :
            ∀ (dst : driver_state),
              M.Embeds dst c →
                ∃ s,
                  step_ctx M.tagDefs dst.layout_state dst.core_file dst.core_extern M.tid
                        (M.parent, M.thread c.fst c.snd.fst c.snd.snd.fst) =
                      [s] ∧
                    can_advance s = true ∧
                      2 ≤ (CerbND.runND (advance_step M.tagDefs M.tid s) dst).length),
          motive ⋯) →
        (∀
            (a :
              ∀ (dst : driver_state),
                M.Embeds dst c →
                  ∃ rsk m d inst step_m k msg,
                    step_ctx M.tagDefs dst.layout_state dst.core_file dst.core_extern M.tid
                          (M.parent, M.thread c.fst c.snd.fst c.snd.snd.fst) =
                        [Step_with_runstate2 rsk m] ∧
                      m = stExceptUndef_bind step_m k ∧
                        step_m dst.core_run_state0 = failwithI msg dst.core_run_state0),
            motive ⋯) →
          (∀ (msg : String)
              (a :
                ∀ (dst : driver_state),
                  M.Embeds dst c →
                    ∃ s th' evs,
                      step_ctx M.tagDefs dst.layout_state dst.core_file dst.core_extern M.tid
                            (M.parent, M.thread c.fst c.snd.fst c.snd.snd.fst) =
                          [Step_tau2 s TSK_Misc th'] ∧
                        th'.env = failwithI msg :: evs),
              motive ⋯) →
            (∀ (msg : String)
                (a :
                  ∀ (dst : driver_state),
                    M.Embeds dst c →
                      ∃ loc mop cvals uw k g,
                        step_ctx M.tagDefs dst.layout_state dst.core_file dst.core_extern M.tid
                              (M.parent, M.thread c.fst c.snd.fst c.snd.snd.fst) =
                            [Step_memop_request2 loc mop cvals M.tid uw k] ∧
                          perform_memop_request2 M.tagDefs loc mop cvals M.tid k =
                            nd_bind (failwithI msg) g),
                motive ⋯) →
              (∀ (c' : CerberusHeapLang.Config) (msg : String)
                  (a : CerberusHeapLang.CerberusRound M c c')
                  (a_1 :
                    ∀ (dst : driver_state),
                      M.Embeds dst c' →
                        step_ctx M.tagDefs dst.layout_state dst.core_file dst.core_extern M.tid
                            (M.parent, M.thread c'.fst c'.snd.fst c'.snd.snd.fst) =
                          [Step_error2 msg]),
                  motive ⋯) →
                (∀ (msg : String) (a : c.snd.snd.fst.proc = none)
                    (a_1 :
                      ∀ (dst : driver_state),
                        M.Embeds dst c →
                          ∃ s l inst k,
                            step_ctx M.tagDefs dst.layout_state dst.core_file dst.core_extern M.tid
                                (M.parent, M.thread c.fst c.snd.fst c.snd.snd.fst) =
                              [Step_with_runstate2 (RSK_eval s)
                                  (stExceptUndef_bind
                                    (runSE
                                      (state_except_read fun rs =>
                                        Lem_Maybe.bind0
                                          (fmapLookupBy
                                            (fun s1 s2 => Lem_Basic_classes.ordCompare s1 s2)
                                            (CerberusHeapLang.resolveExtern dst.core_extern
                                              (failwithI msg))
                                            rs.labeled)
                                          (fmapLookupBy
                                            (fun s1 s2 => Lem_Basic_classes.ordCompare s1 s2) l)))
                                    k)]),
                    motive ⋯) →
                  ∀ (t : CerberusHeapLang.ShippedRefusal M c), motive t
----
def CerberusHeapLang.ShippedRefusal.recOn :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {c : CerberusHeapLang.Config}
  {motive : CerberusHeapLang.ShippedRefusal M c → Prop} (t : CerberusHeapLang.ShippedRefusal M c),
  (∀ (msg : String)
      (a :
        ∀ (dst : driver_state),
          M.Embeds dst c →
            step_ctx M.tagDefs dst.layout_state dst.core_file dst.core_extern M.tid
                (M.parent, M.thread c.fst c.snd.fst c.snd.snd.fst) =
              [Step_error2 msg]),
      motive ⋯) →
    (∀ (r : kill_reason driver_error)
        (a :
          ∀ (dst : driver_state),
            M.Embeds dst c →
              ∃ s dst',
                step_ctx M.tagDefs dst.layout_state dst.core_file dst.core_extern M.tid
                      (M.parent, M.thread c.fst c.snd.fst c.snd.snd.fst) =
                    [s] ∧
                  can_advance s = true ∧
                    CerberusHeapLang.runOne (advance_step M.tagDefs M.tid s) dst =
                      (NDkilled r, dst')),
        motive ⋯) →
      (∀
          (a :
            ∀ (dst : driver_state),
              M.Embeds dst c →
                ∃ s,
                  step_ctx M.tagDefs dst.layout_state dst.core_file dst.core_extern M.tid
                        (M.parent, M.thread c.fst c.snd.fst c.snd.snd.fst) =
                      [s] ∧
                    can_advance s = true ∧
                      2 ≤ (CerbND.runND (advance_step M.tagDefs M.tid s) dst).length),
          motive ⋯) →
        (∀
            (a :
              ∀ (dst : driver_state),
                M.Embeds dst c →
                  ∃ rsk m d inst step_m k msg,
                    step_ctx M.tagDefs dst.layout_state dst.core_file dst.core_extern M.tid
                          (M.parent, M.thread c.fst c.snd.fst c.snd.snd.fst) =
                        [Step_with_runstate2 rsk m] ∧
                      m = stExceptUndef_bind step_m k ∧
                        step_m dst.core_run_state0 = failwithI msg dst.core_run_state0),
            motive ⋯) →
          (∀ (msg : String)
              (a :
                ∀ (dst : driver_state),
                  M.Embeds dst c →
                    ∃ s th' evs,
                      step_ctx M.tagDefs dst.layout_state dst.core_file dst.core_extern M.tid
                            (M.parent, M.thread c.fst c.snd.fst c.snd.snd.fst) =
                          [Step_tau2 s TSK_Misc th'] ∧
                        th'.env = failwithI msg :: evs),
              motive ⋯) →
            (∀ (msg : String)
                (a :
                  ∀ (dst : driver_state),
                    M.Embeds dst c →
                      ∃ loc mop cvals uw k g,
                        step_ctx M.tagDefs dst.layout_state dst.core_file dst.core_extern M.tid
                              (M.parent, M.thread c.fst c.snd.fst c.snd.snd.fst) =
                            [Step_memop_request2 loc mop cvals M.tid uw k] ∧
                          perform_memop_request2 M.tagDefs loc mop cvals M.tid k =
                            nd_bind (failwithI msg) g),
                motive ⋯) →
              (∀ (c' : CerberusHeapLang.Config) (msg : String)
                  (a : CerberusHeapLang.CerberusRound M c c')
                  (a_1 :
                    ∀ (dst : driver_state),
                      M.Embeds dst c' →
                        step_ctx M.tagDefs dst.layout_state dst.core_file dst.core_extern M.tid
                            (M.parent, M.thread c'.fst c'.snd.fst c'.snd.snd.fst) =
                          [Step_error2 msg]),
                  motive ⋯) →
                (∀ (msg : String) (a : c.snd.snd.fst.proc = none)
                    (a_1 :
                      ∀ (dst : driver_state),
                        M.Embeds dst c →
                          ∃ s l inst k,
                            step_ctx M.tagDefs dst.layout_state dst.core_file dst.core_extern M.tid
                                (M.parent, M.thread c.fst c.snd.fst c.snd.snd.fst) =
                              [Step_with_runstate2 (RSK_eval s)
                                  (stExceptUndef_bind
                                    (runSE
                                      (state_except_read fun rs =>
                                        Lem_Maybe.bind0
                                          (fmapLookupBy
                                            (fun s1 s2 => Lem_Basic_classes.ordCompare s1 s2)
                                            (CerberusHeapLang.resolveExtern dst.core_extern
                                              (failwithI msg))
                                            rs.labeled)
                                          (fmapLookupBy
                                            (fun s1 s2 => Lem_Basic_classes.ordCompare s1 s2) l)))
                                    k)]),
                    motive ⋯) →
                  motive t
----

  {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} →

      {invGS : Iris.InvGS_gen hlc GF} →

            {cursorGS :
                Iris.genHeapGS Int CerberusHeapLang.AllocCursor GF CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF} →
              {budgetGS : CerberusHeapLang.BudgetGS GF} →
                {invGS' : Iris.InvGS_gen hlc GF} →
                  {byteGS' : Iris.genHeapGS Int CerbMem.AbsByte GF CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF} →

                        Iris.genHeapGS Int CerberusHeapLang.MetaCell GF
                          CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF} →
                      {cursorGS' :
                          Iris.genHeapGS Int CerberusHeapLang.AllocCursor GF
                            CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF} →
                        {budgetGS' : CerberusHeapLang.BudgetGS GF} →
                          { invGS := invGS, byteGS := byteGS, metaGS := metaGS,
                                cursorGS := cursorGS, budgetGS := budgetGS } =
                              { invGS := invGS', byteGS := byteGS', metaGS := metaGS',
                                cursorGS := cursorGS', budgetGS := budgetGS' } →
                            (invGS ≍ invGS' →
                                byteGS ≍ byteGS' →
                                  metaGS ≍ metaGS' →
                                    cursorGS ≍ cursorGS' → budgetGS ≍ budgetGS' → P) →
                              P

                  cursor_pre := cursor_pre }) →
      (t : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGpreS GF) → motive t

  {ctl : CerberusHeapLang.Ctl} {σ σ' : CerberusHeapLang.Mem},
  valueFromPexpr pe1 = some (Vobject (OVinteger align)) →
    valueFromPexpr pe2 = some (Vobject (OVinteger size)) →
      CerberusHeapLang.applyMemM (CerbMem.allocateRegion 0 pref align size) σ = some (pv, σ') →
        CerberusHeapLang.Step M
          (generic_expr.Expr a
              (Eaction (Paction polarity.Pos (Action loc ann (Alloc0 pe1 pe2 pref)))),
            ρ, ctl, σ)
          (generic_expr.Expr [] (Epure (Pexpr [] () (PEval (Vobject (OVpointer pv))))), ρ, ctl, σ')

theorem CerberusHeapLang.Step.alloc_inv :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {a : List annot} {loc : CerbLocation.Loc}
  {ann : core_run_annotation} {align size : CerbMem.IntegerValue} {pref : prefix0}
  {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack} {ctl : CerberusHeapLang.Ctl} {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem}
  {out : CerberusHeapLang.Config},
  CerberusHeapLang.Step M
      (generic_expr.Expr a
          (Eaction
            (Paction polarity.Pos
              (Action loc ann
                (Alloc0 (Pexpr [] () (PEval (Vobject (OVinteger align))))
                  (Pexpr [] () (PEval (Vobject (OVinteger size)))) pref)))),
        ρ, ctl, σ)
      out →
    ∃ pv σ',
      CerberusHeapLang.applyMemM (CerbMem.allocateRegion 0 pref align size) σ = some (pv, σ') ∧
        out =
          (generic_expr.Expr [] (Epure (Pexpr [] () (PEval (Vobject (OVpointer pv))))), ρ, ctl, σ')
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.Step.alloc_op_inv :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {a : List annot} {loc : CerbLocation.Loc}
  {ann : core_run_annotation} {pe1 pe2 : generic_pexpr Unit sym} {pref : prefix0}
  {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack} {ctl : CerberusHeapLang.Ctl} {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem}
  {out : CerberusHeapLang.Config},
  valueFromPexprs [pe1, pe2] = none →
    CerberusHeapLang.Step M
        (generic_expr.Expr a
            (Eaction (Paction polarity.Pos (Action loc ann (Alloc0 pe1 pe2 pref)))),
          ρ, ctl, σ)
        out →
      ∃ align size,
        CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr M.tagDefs M.extern ρ pe1 = some (Vobject (OVinteger align)) ∧
          CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr M.tagDefs M.extern ρ pe2 = some (Vobject (OVinteger size)) ∧
            out =
              (generic_expr.Expr a
                  (Eaction
                    (Paction polarity.Pos
                      (Action loc ann
                        (Alloc0 (Pexpr [] () (PEval (Vobject (OVinteger align))))
                          (Pexpr [] () (PEval (Vobject (OVinteger size)))) pref)))),
                ρ, ctl, σ)

ctor CerberusHeapLang.Step.annot_ctx :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {a : List annot} {ds : List dyn_annotation}
  {b b' : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {ρ ρ' : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack} {ctl : CerberusHeapLang.Ctl}
  {σ σ' : CerberusHeapLang.Mem},
  CerberusHeapLang.jumpRedex? b = none →
    CerberusHeapLang.annotRooted b = false →
      CerberusHeapLang.Step M (b, ρ, ctl, σ) (b', ρ', ctl, σ') →
        CerberusHeapLang.Step M (generic_expr.Expr a (Eannot ds b), ρ, ctl, σ)
          (generic_expr.Expr a (Eannot ds b'), ρ', ctl, σ')
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.Step.annot_inv :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {a : List annot} {ds : List dyn_annotation}
  {b : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack} {ctl : CerberusHeapLang.Ctl}
  {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem} {out : CerberusHeapLang.Config},
  CerberusHeapLang.Step M (generic_expr.Expr a (Eannot ds b), ρ, ctl, σ) out →
    (CerberusHeapLang.annotRooted b = false ∧
        CerberusHeapLang.jumpRedex? b = none ∧
          ∃ b' ρ' σ',
            CerberusHeapLang.Step M (b, ρ, ctl, σ) (b', ρ', ctl, σ') ∧
              out = (generic_expr.Expr a (Eannot ds b'), ρ', ctl, σ')) ∨
      (∃ a2 ds2 c,
          b = generic_expr.Expr a2 (Eannot ds2 c) ∧
            out = (generic_expr.Expr (a ++ a2) (Eannot (ds ++ ds2) c), ρ, ctl, σ)) ∨
        (∃ l pes params cont vs ev0 evs,
            CerberusHeapLang.annotRooted b = false ∧
              CerberusHeapLang.jumpRedex? b = some (l, pes) ∧
                ρ = ev0 :: evs ∧
                  CerberusHeapLang.lookupLabel (M.labelsAt ctl.proc) l = some (params, cont) ∧
                    CerberusHeapLang.evalPexprs M.tagDefs M.extern ρ pes = some vs ∧
                      out = (cont, CerberusHeapLang.bindArgs params vs ρ, ctl, σ)) ∨
          CerberusHeapLang.annotRooted b = false ∧
              CerberusHeapLang.Step.CallOf M b (fun c => Cannot a ds c) ρ ctl σ out ∨
            ∃ v pc κ,
              a = [] ∧
                b = generic_expr.Expr [] (Epure (Pexpr [] () (PEval v))) ∧
                  ctl.κ = pc :: κ ∧
                    out = (generic_expr.Expr [] (Epure (Pexpr [] () (PEval v))), ρ, ctl, σ)
----
ctor CerberusHeapLang.Step.annot_merge :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {a1 a2 : List annot} {ds1 ds2 : List dyn_annotation}
  {b : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack} {ctl : CerberusHeapLang.Ctl}
  {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem},
  CerberusHeapLang.Step M
    (generic_expr.Expr a1 (Eannot ds1 (generic_expr.Expr a2 (Eannot ds2 b))), ρ, ctl, σ)
    (generic_expr.Expr (a1 ++ a2) (Eannot (ds1 ++ ds2) b), ρ, ctl, σ)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.Step.annot_val_inv :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {ds : List dyn_annotation} {v : value}
  {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack} {ctl ctl' : CerberusHeapLang.Ctl} {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem}
  {e' : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {ρ' : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack} {σ' : CerberusHeapLang.Mem},
  CerberusHeapLang.Step M
      (generic_expr.Expr [] (Eannot ds (generic_expr.Expr [] (Epure (Pexpr [] () (PEval v))))), ρ,
        ctl, σ)
      (e', ρ', ctl', σ') →
    ctl' = ctl →
      e' = generic_expr.Expr [] (Epure (Pexpr [] () (PEval v))) ∧
        ρ' = ρ ∧ σ' = σ ∧ ∃ pc κ, ctl.κ = pc :: κ

def CerberusHeapLang.Step.below.casesOn :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx}
  {motive : (a a_1 : CerberusHeapLang.Config) → CerberusHeapLang.Step M a a_1 → Prop}
  {motive_1 :
    {a a_1 : CerberusHeapLang.Config} →
      (t : CerberusHeapLang.Step M a a_1) → CerberusHeapLang.Step.below t → Prop}
  {a a_1 : CerberusHeapLang.Config} {t : CerberusHeapLang.Step M a a_1}
  (t_1 : CerberusHeapLang.Step.below t),

  {ev0 : Fmap sym value} {evs : List (Fmap sym value)} {ctl : CerberusHeapLang.Ctl}
  {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem} (hj : CerberusHeapLang.jumpRedex? e = some (l, pes))
  (hl : CerberusHeapLang.lookupLabel (M.labelsAt ctl.proc) l = some (params, cont))
  (hvs : CerberusHeapLang.evalPexprs M.tagDefs M.extern (ev0 :: evs) pes = some vs),
  CerberusHeapLang.Step.below ⋯
----

ctor CerberusHeapLang.Step.call :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {e : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {ctx : context} {f : sym}
  {pes : List (generic_pexpr Unit sym)} {params : List (sym × core_base_type)}
  {body : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {vs : List value} {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack}
  {ctl : CerberusHeapLang.Ctl} {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem},
  CerberusHeapLang.callRedex? e = some (ctx, f, pes) →
    CerberusHeapLang.evalPexprs M.tagDefs M.extern ρ pes = some vs →
      CerberusHeapLang.lookupProc M.file M.extern f = some (params, body) →
        params.length = vs.length →
          CerberusHeapLang.Step M (e, ρ, ctl, σ)
            (body, CerberusHeapLang.procEnv params vs :: ρ,
              { κ := (ctl.proc, ctx) :: ctl.κ, proc := some f,
                execLoc := push_exec_loc f M.currentLoc ctl.execLoc },
              σ)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.Step.call_inv :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {e : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack}
  {ctl : CerberusHeapLang.Ctl} {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem} {out : CerberusHeapLang.Config},
  CerberusHeapLang.Step M (e, ρ, ctl, σ) out →
    ∀ {ctx : context} {f : sym} {pes : List (generic_pexpr Unit sym)},
      CerberusHeapLang.callRedex? e = some (ctx, f, pes) →
        ∃ params body vs,
          CerberusHeapLang.evalPexprs M.tagDefs M.extern ρ pes = some vs ∧
            CerberusHeapLang.lookupProc M.file M.extern f = some (params, body) ∧
              params.length = vs.length ∧
                out =
                  (body, CerberusHeapLang.procEnv params vs :: ρ,
                    { κ := (ctl.proc, ctx) :: ctl.κ, proc := some f,
                      execLoc := push_exec_loc f M.currentLoc ctl.execLoc },
                    σ)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.Step.call_inv' :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {c out : CerberusHeapLang.Config},
  CerberusHeapLang.Step M c out →
    ∀ {ctx : context} {f : sym} {pes : List (generic_pexpr Unit sym)},
      CerberusHeapLang.callRedex? c.fst = some (ctx, f, pes) →
        ∃ params body vs,
          CerberusHeapLang.evalPexprs M.tagDefs M.extern c.snd.fst pes = some vs ∧
            CerberusHeapLang.lookupProc M.file M.extern f = some (params, body) ∧
              params.length = vs.length ∧
                out =
                  (body, CerberusHeapLang.procEnv params vs :: c.snd.fst,
                    { κ := (c.snd.snd.fst.proc, ctx) :: c.snd.snd.fst.κ, proc := some f,
                      execLoc := push_exec_loc f M.currentLoc c.snd.snd.fst.execLoc },
                    c.snd.snd.snd)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.Step.call_ne_same_ctl :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {e e' : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr}
  {ρ ρ' : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack} {ctl : CerberusHeapLang.Ctl} {σ σ' : CerberusHeapLang.Mem}
  {ctx : context} {f : sym} {pes : List (generic_pexpr Unit sym)},
  CerberusHeapLang.callRedex? e = some (ctx, f, pes) →
    CerberusHeapLang.Step M (e, ρ, ctl, σ) (e', ρ', ctl, σ') → False
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.Step.call_of_callRedex :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {e : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {ctx : context} {f : sym}
  {pes : List (generic_pexpr Unit sym)} {params : List (sym × core_base_type)}
  {body : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {vs : List value} {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack}
  {ctl : CerberusHeapLang.Ctl} {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem},
  CerberusHeapLang.callRedex? e = some (ctx, f, pes) →
    CerberusHeapLang.evalPexprs M.tagDefs M.extern ρ pes = some vs →
      CerberusHeapLang.lookupProc M.file M.extern f = some (params, body) →
        params.length = vs.length →
          CerberusHeapLang.Step M (e, ρ, ctl, σ)
            (body, CerberusHeapLang.procEnv params vs :: ρ,
              { κ := (ctl.proc, ctx) :: ctl.κ, proc := some f,
                execLoc := push_exec_loc f M.currentLoc ctl.execLoc },
              σ)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.Step.case_inv :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {a : List annot} {pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym}
  {pats : List (pattern × CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr)} {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack}
  {ctl : CerberusHeapLang.Ctl} {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem} {out : CerberusHeapLang.Config},
  CerberusHeapLang.Step M (generic_expr.Expr a (Ecase pe pats), ρ, ctl, σ) out →
    ∃ cval e',
      valueFromPexpr pe = some cval ∧
        select_case subst_sym_expr cval pats = some e' ∧ out = (e', ρ, ctl, σ)
----
ctor CerberusHeapLang.Step.case_value :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {a : List annot} {pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym}
  {pats : List (pattern × CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr)} {cval : value}
  {e' : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack} {ctl : CerberusHeapLang.Ctl}
  {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem},
  valueFromPexpr pe = some cval →
    select_case subst_sym_expr cval pats = some e' →
      CerberusHeapLang.Step M (generic_expr.Expr a (Ecase pe pats), ρ, ctl, σ) (e', ρ, ctl, σ)
----
def CerberusHeapLang.Step.casesOn :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx}
  {motive : (a a_1 : CerberusHeapLang.Config) → CerberusHeapLang.Step M a a_1 → Prop}
  {a a_1 : CerberusHeapLang.Config} (t : CerberusHeapLang.Step M a a_1),
  (∀ {a : List annot} {loc : CerbLocation.Loc} {ann : core_run_annotation} {lk : Bool}
      {pe1 pe2 pe3 : generic_pexpr Unit sym} {ty : ctype} {pv : CerbMem.PointerValue} {cv : value}
      {mo : memory_order} {mv : CerbMem.MemValue} {fp : CerbMem.Footprint}
      {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack} {ctl : CerberusHeapLang.Ctl} {σ σ' : CerberusHeapLang.Mem}
      (h1 : valueFromPexpr pe1 = some (Vctype ty))
      (h2 : valueFromPexpr pe2 = some (Vobject (OVpointer pv))) (h3 : valueFromPexpr pe3 = some cv)
      (hmv : memValueFromValue M.tagDefs (Ctype [] (unatomic_ ty)) cv = some mv)
      (hmem :
        CerberusHeapLang.applyMemM (CerbMem.storeM M.tagDefs loc ty lk pv mv) σ = some (fp, σ')),
      motive
        (generic_expr.Expr a
            (Eaction (Paction polarity.Pos (Action loc ann (Store0 lk pe1 pe2 pe3 mo)))),
          ρ, ctl, σ)
        (generic_expr.Expr []
            (Eannot [DA_pos [] fp] (generic_expr.Expr [] (Epure (Pexpr [] () (PEval Vunit))))),
          ρ, ctl, σ')
        ⋯) →
    (∀ {a : List annot} {loc : CerbLocation.Loc} {ann : core_run_annotation}
        {pe1 pe2 : generic_pexpr Unit sym} {ty : ctype} {pv : CerbMem.PointerValue}
        {mo : memory_order} {mval : CerbMem.MemValue} {fp : CerbMem.Footprint}
        {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack} {ctl : CerberusHeapLang.Ctl} {σ σ' : CerberusHeapLang.Mem}
        (h1 : valueFromPexpr pe1 = some (Vctype ty))
        (h2 : valueFromPexpr pe2 = some (Vobject (OVpointer pv)))
        (hmem :
          CerberusHeapLang.applyMemM (CerbMem.loadM M.tagDefs loc ty pv) σ = some ((fp, mval), σ')),
        motive
          (generic_expr.Expr a (Eaction (Paction polarity.Pos (Action loc ann (Load0 pe1 pe2 mo)))),
            ρ, ctl, σ)
          (generic_expr.Expr []
              (Eannot [DA_pos [] fp]
                (generic_expr.Expr [] (Epure (Pexpr [] () (PEval (valueFromMemValue mval).snd))))),
            ρ, ctl, σ')
          ⋯) →
      (∀ {a : List annot} {loc : CerbLocation.Loc} {ann : core_run_annotation}
          {pe1 pe2 : generic_pexpr Unit sym} {align : CerbMem.IntegerValue} {ty : ctype}
          {pref : prefix0} {pv : CerbMem.PointerValue} {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack}
          {ctl : CerberusHeapLang.Ctl} {σ σ' : CerberusHeapLang.Mem}
          (h1 : valueFromPexpr pe1 = some (Vobject (OVinteger align)))
          (h2 : valueFromPexpr pe2 = some (Vctype ty))
          (hmem :
            CerberusHeapLang.applyMemM (CerbMem.allocateObject M.tagDefs 0 pref align ty none none)
                σ =
              some (pv, σ')),
          motive
            (generic_expr.Expr a
                (Eaction (Paction polarity.Pos (Action loc ann (Create pe1 pe2 pref)))),
              ρ, ctl, σ)
            (generic_expr.Expr [] (Epure (Pexpr [] () (PEval (Vobject (OVpointer pv))))), ρ, ctl,
              σ')
            ⋯) →
        (∀ {a : List annot} {loc : CerbLocation.Loc} {ann : core_run_annotation}
            {pe1 pe2 : generic_pexpr Unit sym} {align size : CerbMem.IntegerValue} {pref : prefix0}
            {pv : CerbMem.PointerValue} {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack} {ctl : CerberusHeapLang.Ctl}
            {σ σ' : CerberusHeapLang.Mem}
            (h1 : valueFromPexpr pe1 = some (Vobject (OVinteger align)))
            (h2 : valueFromPexpr pe2 = some (Vobject (OVinteger size)))
            (hmem :
              CerberusHeapLang.applyMemM (CerbMem.allocateRegion 0 pref align size) σ =
                some (pv, σ')),
            motive
              (generic_expr.Expr a
                  (Eaction (Paction polarity.Pos (Action loc ann (Alloc0 pe1 pe2 pref)))),
                ρ, ctl, σ)
              (generic_expr.Expr [] (Epure (Pexpr [] () (PEval (Vobject (OVpointer pv))))), ρ, ctl,
                σ')
              ⋯) →
          (∀ {a : List annot} {loc : CerbLocation.Loc} {ann : core_run_annotation}
              {kind : kill_kind} {pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym} {pv : CerbMem.PointerValue}
              {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack} {ctl : CerberusHeapLang.Ctl}
              {σ σ' : CerberusHeapLang.Mem} (h1 : valueFromPexpr pe = some (Vobject (OVpointer pv)))
              (hmem :
                CerberusHeapLang.applyMemM (CerbMem.killM loc (is_dynamic kind) pv) σ =
                  some ((), σ')),
              motive
                (generic_expr.Expr a
                    (Eaction (Paction polarity.Pos (Action loc ann (Kill kind pe)))),
                  ρ, ctl, σ)
                (generic_expr.Expr [] (Epure (Pexpr [] () (PEval Vunit))), ρ, ctl, σ') ⋯) →
            (∀ {a pa : List annot} {bty : core_base_type} {v : value}
                {e2 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {ev0 : Fmap sym value}
                {evs : List (Fmap sym value)} {ctl : CerberusHeapLang.Ctl}
                {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem},
                motive
                  (generic_expr.Expr a
                      (Esseq (Pattern pa (CaseBase (none, bty)))
                        (CerberusHeapLang.ofVal (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.pure v)) e2),
                    ev0 :: evs, ctl, σ)
                  (e2, ev0 :: evs, ctl, σ) ⋯) →
              (∀ {a pa : List annot} {bty : core_base_type} {ds : List dyn_annotation} {v : value}
                  {e2 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {ev0 : Fmap sym value}
                  {evs : List (Fmap sym value)} {ctl : CerberusHeapLang.Ctl}
                  {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem},
                  motive
                    (generic_expr.Expr a
                        (Esseq (Pattern pa (CaseBase (none, bty)))
                          (CerberusHeapLang.ofVal (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.annot ds v)) e2),
                      ev0 :: evs, ctl, σ)
                    (generic_expr.Expr [] (Eannot ds e2), ev0 :: evs, ctl, σ) ⋯) →
                (∀ {a pa : List annot} {bty : core_base_type} {v : value}
                    {e2 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {ev0 : Fmap sym value}
                    {evs : List (Fmap sym value)} {ctl : CerberusHeapLang.Ctl}
                    {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem},
                    motive
                      (generic_expr.Expr a
                          (Ewseq (Pattern pa (CaseBase (none, bty)))
                            (CerberusHeapLang.ofVal (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.pure v)) e2),
                        ev0 :: evs, ctl, σ)
                      (e2, ev0 :: evs, ctl, σ) ⋯) →
                  (∀ {a pa : List annot} {bty : core_base_type} {ds : List dyn_annotation}
                      {v : value} {e2 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {ev0 : Fmap sym value}
                      {evs : List (Fmap sym value)} {ctl : CerberusHeapLang.Ctl}
                      {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem},
                      motive
                        (generic_expr.Expr a
                            (Ewseq (Pattern pa (CaseBase (none, bty)))
                              (CerberusHeapLang.ofVal (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.annot ds v)) e2),
                          ev0 :: evs, ctl, σ)
                        (generic_expr.Expr [] (Eannot ds e2), ev0 :: evs, ctl, σ) ⋯) →
                    (∀ {a pa pb : List annot} {x : sym} {bty : core_base_type} {ov : object_value}
                        {e2 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {ev0 : Fmap sym value}

ctor CerberusHeapLang.Step.create :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {a : List annot} {loc : CerbLocation.Loc}
  {ann : core_run_annotation} {pe1 pe2 : generic_pexpr Unit sym} {align : CerbMem.IntegerValue}
  {ty : ctype} {pref : prefix0} {pv : CerbMem.PointerValue} {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack}
  {ctl : CerberusHeapLang.Ctl} {σ σ' : CerberusHeapLang.Mem},
  valueFromPexpr pe1 = some (Vobject (OVinteger align)) →
    valueFromPexpr pe2 = some (Vctype ty) →
      CerberusHeapLang.applyMemM (CerbMem.allocateObject M.tagDefs 0 pref align ty none none) σ =
          some (pv, σ') →
        CerberusHeapLang.Step M
          (generic_expr.Expr a
              (Eaction (Paction polarity.Pos (Action loc ann (Create pe1 pe2 pref)))),
            ρ, ctl, σ)
          (generic_expr.Expr [] (Epure (Pexpr [] () (PEval (Vobject (OVpointer pv))))), ρ, ctl, σ')
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.Step.create_canonical :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {a : List annot} {loc : CerbLocation.Loc}
  {ann : core_run_annotation} {align : CerbMem.IntegerValue} {ty : ctype} {pref : prefix0}
  {pv : CerbMem.PointerValue} {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack} {ctl : CerberusHeapLang.Ctl}
  {σ σ' : CerberusHeapLang.Mem},
  CerberusHeapLang.applyMemM (CerbMem.allocateObject M.tagDefs 0 pref align ty none none) σ =
      some (pv, σ') →
    CerberusHeapLang.Step M
      (generic_expr.Expr a
          (Eaction
            (Paction polarity.Pos
              (Action loc ann
                (Create (Pexpr [] () (PEval (Vobject (OVinteger align))))
                  (Pexpr [] () (PEval (Vctype ty))) pref)))),
        ρ, ctl, σ)
      (generic_expr.Expr [] (Epure (Pexpr [] () (PEval (Vobject (OVpointer pv))))), ρ, ctl, σ')
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.Step.create_inv :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {a : List annot} {loc : CerbLocation.Loc}
  {ann : core_run_annotation} {align : CerbMem.IntegerValue} {ty : ctype} {pref : prefix0}
  {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack} {ctl : CerberusHeapLang.Ctl} {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem}
  {out : CerberusHeapLang.Config},
  CerberusHeapLang.Step M
      (generic_expr.Expr a
          (Eaction
            (Paction polarity.Pos
              (Action loc ann
                (Create (Pexpr [] () (PEval (Vobject (OVinteger align))))
                  (Pexpr [] () (PEval (Vctype ty))) pref)))),
        ρ, ctl, σ)
      out →
    ∃ pv σ',
      CerberusHeapLang.applyMemM (CerbMem.allocateObject M.tagDefs 0 pref align ty none none) σ =
          some (pv, σ') ∧
        out =
          (generic_expr.Expr [] (Epure (Pexpr [] () (PEval (Vobject (OVpointer pv))))), ρ, ctl, σ')
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.Step.ctl_cases :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {e e' : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr}
  {ρ ρ' : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack} {ctl ctl' : CerberusHeapLang.Ctl}
  {σ σ' : CerberusHeapLang.Mem},
  CerberusHeapLang.Step M (e, ρ, ctl, σ) (e', ρ', ctl', σ') →
    ctl' = ctl ∨
      (∃ ctx f pes params body vs,
          CerberusHeapLang.callRedex? e = some (ctx, f, pes) ∧
            CerberusHeapLang.evalPexprs M.tagDefs M.extern ρ pes = some vs ∧
              CerberusHeapLang.lookupProc M.file M.extern f = some (params, body) ∧
                params.length = vs.length ∧
                  e' = body ∧
                    ρ' = CerberusHeapLang.procEnv params vs :: ρ ∧
                      ctl' =
                          { κ := (ctl.proc, ctx) :: ctl.κ, proc := some f,
                            execLoc := push_exec_loc f M.currentLoc ctl.execLoc } ∧
                        σ' = σ) ∨
        ∃ v ev0 evs p ctx κ q ℓ,
          e = generic_expr.Expr [] (Epure (Pexpr [] () (PEval v))) ∧
            ρ = ev0 :: evs ∧
              ctl = { κ := (p, ctx) :: κ, proc := q, execLoc := ℓ } ∧
                e' = apply_ctx ctx (generic_expr.Expr [] (Epure (Pexpr [] () (PEval v)))) ∧
                  ρ' = evs ∧ ctl' = { κ := κ, proc := p, execLoc := ℓ } ∧ σ' = σ
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.Step.ctl_eq :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {e e' : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr}
  {ρ ρ' : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack} {ctl ctl' : CerberusHeapLang.Ctl}
  {σ σ' : CerberusHeapLang.Mem},
  CerberusHeapLang.Step M (e, ρ, ctl, σ) (e', ρ', ctl', σ') →
    CerberusHeapLang.callRedex? e = none → CerberusHeapLang.toVal e = none → ctl' = ctl
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.Step.ctl_eq' :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {c c' : CerberusHeapLang.Config},
  CerberusHeapLang.Step M c c' →
    CerberusHeapLang.callRedex? c.fst = none →
      CerberusHeapLang.toVal c.fst = none → c'.snd.snd.fst = c.snd.snd.fst
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.Step.env_cons :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {e : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {ev0 : Fmap sym value}
  {evs : List (Fmap sym value)} {ctl : CerberusHeapLang.Ctl} {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem}
  {e' : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {ρ' : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack} {σ' : CerberusHeapLang.Mem},
  CerberusHeapLang.Step M (e, ev0 :: evs, ctl, σ) (e', ρ', ctl, σ') → ∃ ev0', ρ' = ev0' :: evs
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.Step.env_cons' :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {c c' : CerberusHeapLang.Config},
  CerberusHeapLang.Step M c c' →
    c'.snd.snd.fst = c.snd.snd.fst →
      ∀ (ev0 : Fmap sym value) (evs : List (Fmap sym value)),
        c.snd.fst = ev0 :: evs → ∃ ev0', c'.snd.fst = ev0' :: evs
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.Step.env_depth :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {e e' : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr}
  {ρ ρ' : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack} {ctl ctl' : CerberusHeapLang.Ctl}
  {σ σ' : CerberusHeapLang.Mem},
  CerberusHeapLang.Step M (e, ρ, ctl, σ) (e', ρ', ctl', σ') →
    ctl.κ.length < List.length ρ → ctl'.κ.length < List.length ρ'

theorem CerberusHeapLang.Step.jump_inv :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {e : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack}
  {ctl : CerberusHeapLang.Ctl} {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem} {out : CerberusHeapLang.Config} {l : sym}

          CerberusHeapLang.lookupLabel (M.labelsAt ctl.proc) l = some (params, cont) ∧
            CerberusHeapLang.evalPexprs M.tagDefs M.extern ρ pes = some vs ∧
              out = (cont, CerberusHeapLang.bindArgs params vs ρ, ctl, σ)

rec CerberusHeapLang.Step.rec :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx}
  {motive : (a a_1 : CerberusHeapLang.Config) → CerberusHeapLang.Step M a a_1 → Prop},
  (∀ {a : List annot} {loc : CerbLocation.Loc} {ann : core_run_annotation} {lk : Bool}
      {pe1 pe2 pe3 : generic_pexpr Unit sym} {ty : ctype} {pv : CerbMem.PointerValue} {cv : value}
      {mo : memory_order} {mv : CerbMem.MemValue} {fp : CerbMem.Footprint}
      {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack} {ctl : CerberusHeapLang.Ctl} {σ σ' : CerberusHeapLang.Mem}
      (h1 : valueFromPexpr pe1 = some (Vctype ty))
      (h2 : valueFromPexpr pe2 = some (Vobject (OVpointer pv))) (h3 : valueFromPexpr pe3 = some cv)
      (hmv : memValueFromValue M.tagDefs (Ctype [] (unatomic_ ty)) cv = some mv)
      (hmem :
        CerberusHeapLang.applyMemM (CerbMem.storeM M.tagDefs loc ty lk pv mv) σ = some (fp, σ')),
      motive
        (generic_expr.Expr a
            (Eaction (Paction polarity.Pos (Action loc ann (Store0 lk pe1 pe2 pe3 mo)))),
          ρ, ctl, σ)

def CerberusHeapLang.Step.recOn :
