                                                      {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack}
                                                      {ctl : CerberusHeapLang.Ctl}
                                                      {σ σ' : CerberusHeapLang.Mem}
                                                      (h1 :
                                                        valueFromPexpr pe1 =
                                                          some (Vobject (OVpointer pv1)))
                                                      (h2 :
                                                        valueFromPexpr pe2 =
                                                          some (Vobject (OVpointer pv2)))
                                                      (hmem :
                                                        CerberusHeapLang.applyMemM
                                                            (CerbMem.eqPtrval default pv1 pv2) σ =
                                                          some (b, σ')),
                                                      motive
                                                        (generic_expr.Expr a
                                                            (Ememop PtrEq [pe1, pe2]),
                                                          ρ, ctl, σ)
                                                        (generic_expr.Expr []
                                                            (Epure
                                                              (Pexpr [] ()
                                                                (PEval
                                                                  (CerberusHeapLang.boolValue b)))),
                                                          ρ, ctl, σ')
                                                        ⋯) →
                                                    (∀ {a : List annot} {mop : memop}
                                                        {pe1 pe2 : generic_pexpr Unit sym}
                                                        {v1 v2 : value}
                                                        {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack}
                                                        {ctl : CerberusHeapLang.Ctl}
                                                        {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem}
                                                        (hnv : valueFromPexprs [pe1, pe2] = none)
                                                        (hv1 :
                                                          CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr M.tagDefs
                                                              M.extern ρ pe1 =
                                                            some v1)
                                                        (hv2 :
                                                          CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr M.tagDefs
                                                              M.extern ρ pe2 =
                                                            some v2),
                                                        motive
                                                          (generic_expr.Expr a
                                                              (Ememop mop [pe1, pe2]),
                                                            ρ, ctl, σ)
                                                          (generic_expr.Expr a
                                                              (Ememop mop
                                                                [Pexpr [] () (PEval v1),
                                                                  Pexpr [] () (PEval v2)]),
                                                            ρ, ctl, σ)
                                                          ⋯) →
                                                      (∀ {a : List annot} {loc : CerbLocation.Loc}
                                                          {ann : core_run_annotation} {lk : Bool}
                                                          {ty : ctype}
                                                          {pe2 pe3 : generic_pexpr Unit sym}
                                                          {pv : CerbMem.PointerValue} {cv : value}
                                                          {mo : memory_order}
                                                          {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack}
                                                          {ctl : CerberusHeapLang.Ctl}
                                                          {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem}
                                                          (hnv : valueFromPexprs [pe2, pe3] = none)
                                                          (hv2 :
                                                            CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr M.tagDefs
                                                                M.extern ρ pe2 =
                                                              some (Vobject (OVpointer pv)))
                                                          (hv3 :
                                                            CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr M.tagDefs
                                                                M.extern ρ pe3 =
                                                              some cv),
                                                          motive
                                                            (generic_expr.Expr a
                                                                (Eaction
                                                                  (Paction polarity.Pos
                                                                    (Action loc ann
                                                                      (Store0 lk
                                                                        (Pexpr [] ()
                                                                          (PEval (Vctype ty)))
                                                                        pe2 pe3 mo)))),
                                                              ρ, ctl, σ)
                                                            (generic_expr.Expr a
                                                                (Eaction
                                                                  (Paction polarity.Pos
                                                                    (Action loc ann
                                                                      (Store0 lk
                                                                        (Pexpr [] ()
                                                                          (PEval (Vctype ty)))
                                                                        (Pexpr [] ()
                                                                          (PEval
                                                                            (Vobject
                                                                              (OVpointer pv))))
                                                                        (Pexpr [] () (PEval cv))
                                                                        mo)))),
                                                              ρ, ctl, σ)
                                                            ⋯) →
                                                        (∀ {a : List annot} {loc : CerbLocation.Loc}
                                                            {ann : core_run_annotation}
                                                            {kind : kill_kind}
                                                            {pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym}
                                                            {pv : CerbMem.PointerValue}
                                                            {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack}
                                                            {ctl : CerberusHeapLang.Ctl}
                                                            {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem}
                                                            (hnv : valueFromPexpr pe = none)
                                                            (hv :
                                                              CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr M.tagDefs
                                                                  M.extern ρ pe =
                                                                some (Vobject (OVpointer pv))),
                                                            motive
                                                              (generic_expr.Expr a
                                                                  (Eaction
                                                                    (Paction polarity.Pos
                                                                      (Action loc ann
                                                                        (Kill kind pe)))),
                                                                ρ, ctl, σ)
                                                              (generic_expr.Expr a
                                                                  (Eaction
                                                                    (Paction polarity.Pos
                                                                      (Action loc ann
                                                                        (Kill kind
                                                                          (Pexpr [] ()
                                                                            (PEval
                                                                              (Vobject
                                                                                (OVpointer
                                                                                  pv)))))))),
                                                                ρ, ctl, σ)
                                                              ⋯) →
                                                          (∀ {a : List annot}
                                                              {loc : CerbLocation.Loc}
                                                              {ann : core_run_annotation}
                                                              {pe1 pe2 : generic_pexpr Unit sym}
                                                              {align size : CerbMem.IntegerValue}
                                                              {pref : prefix0}
                                                              {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack}
                                                              {ctl : CerberusHeapLang.Ctl}
                                                              {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem}
                                                              (hnv :
                                                                valueFromPexprs [pe1, pe2] = none)
                                                              (hv1 :
                                                                CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr M.tagDefs
                                                                    M.extern ρ pe1 =
                                                                  some (Vobject (OVinteger align)))
                                                              (hv2 :
                                                                CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr M.tagDefs
                                                                    M.extern ρ pe2 =
                                                                  some (Vobject (OVinteger size))),
                                                              motive
                                                                (generic_expr.Expr a
                                                                    (Eaction
                                                                      (Paction polarity.Pos
                                                                        (Action loc ann
                                                                          (Alloc0 pe1 pe2 pref)))),
                                                                  ρ, ctl, σ)
                                                                (generic_expr.Expr a
                                                                    (Eaction
                                                                      (Paction polarity.Pos
                                                                        (Action loc ann
                                                                          (Alloc0
                                                                            (Pexpr [] ()
                                                                              (PEval
                                                                                (Vobject
                                                                                  (OVinteger
                                                                                    align))))
                                                                            (Pexpr [] ()
                                                                              (PEval
                                                                                (Vobject
                                                                                  (OVinteger
                                                                                    size))))
                                                                            pref)))),
                                                                  ρ, ctl, σ)
                                                                ⋯) →
                                                            (∀ {e : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr}
                                                                {ctx : context} {f : sym}
                                                                {pes :
                                                                  List (generic_pexpr Unit sym)}
                                                                {params :
                                                                  List (sym × core_base_type)}
                                                                {body : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr}
                                                                {vs : List value}
                                                                {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack}
                                                                {ctl : CerberusHeapLang.Ctl}
                                                                {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem}
                                                                (hc :
                                                                  CerberusHeapLang.callRedex? e =
                                                                    some (ctx, f, pes))
                                                                (hvs :
                                                                  CerberusHeapLang.evalPexprs
                                                                      M.tagDefs M.extern ρ pes =
                                                                    some vs)
                                                                (hf :
                                                                  CerberusHeapLang.lookupProc M.file
                                                                      M.extern f =
                                                                    some (params, body))
                                                                (hlen : params.length = vs.length),
                                                                motive (e, ρ, ctl, σ)
                                                                  (body,
                                                                    CerberusHeapLang.procEnv params
                                                                        vs ::
                                                                      ρ,
                                                                    ⋯)
                                                                  ⋯) →
                                                              (∀ {v : value} {ev0 : Fmap sym value}
                                                                  {evs : List (Fmap sym value)}
                                                                  {p : Option sym} {ctx : context}
                                                                  {κ : List (Option sym × context)}
                                                                  {q : Option sym}
                                                                  {ℓ : exec_location}
                                                                  {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem},
                                                                  motive
                                                                    (generic_expr.Expr []
                                                                        (Epure
                                                                          (Pexpr [] () (PEval v))),
                                                                      ev0 :: evs,
                                                                      { κ := (p, ctx) :: κ,
                                                                        proc := q, execLoc := ℓ },
                                                                      σ)
                                                                    (apply_ctx ctx
                                                                        (generic_expr.Expr []
                                                                          (Epure
                                                                            (Pexpr [] ()
                                                                              (PEval v)))),
                                                                      evs,
                                                                      { κ := κ, proc := p,
                                                                        execLoc := ℓ },
                                                                      σ)
                                                                    ⋯) →
                                                                (∀ {ds : List dyn_annotation}
                                                                    {v : value}
                                                                    {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack}
                                                                    {pc : Option sym × context}
                                                                    {κ :
                                                                      List (Option sym × context)}
                                                                    {q : Option sym}
                                                                    {ℓ : exec_location}
                                                                    {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem},
                                                                    motive
                                                                      (generic_expr.Expr []
                                                                          (Eannot ds
                                                                            (generic_expr.Expr []
                                                                              (Epure
                                                                                (Pexpr [] ()
                                                                                  (PEval v))))),
                                                                        ρ,
                                                                        { κ := pc :: κ, proc := q,
                                                                          execLoc := ℓ },
                                                                        σ)
                                                                      (generic_expr.Expr []
                                                                          (Epure
                                                                            (Pexpr [] ()
                                                                              (PEval v))),
                                                                        ρ,
                                                                        { κ := pc :: κ, proc := q,
                                                                          execLoc := ℓ },
                                                                        σ)
                                                                      ⋯) →
                                                                  motive a a_1 t
----
ctor CerberusHeapLang.Step.ret :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {v : value} {ev0 : Fmap sym value} {evs : List (Fmap sym value)}
  {p : Option sym} {ctx : context} {κ : List (Option sym × context)} {q : Option sym}
  {ℓ : exec_location} {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem},
  CerberusHeapLang.Step M
    (generic_expr.Expr [] (Epure (Pexpr [] () (PEval v))), ev0 :: evs,
      { κ := (p, ctx) :: κ, proc := q, execLoc := ℓ }, σ)
    (apply_ctx ctx (generic_expr.Expr [] (Epure (Pexpr [] () (PEval v)))), evs,
      { κ := κ, proc := p, execLoc := ℓ }, σ)
----
ctor CerberusHeapLang.Step.ret_annot :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {ds : List dyn_annotation} {v : value}
  {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack} {pc : Option sym × context} {κ : List (Option sym × context)}
  {q : Option sym} {ℓ : exec_location} {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem},
  CerberusHeapLang.Step M
    (generic_expr.Expr [] (Eannot ds (generic_expr.Expr [] (Epure (Pexpr [] () (PEval v))))), ρ,
      { κ := pc :: κ, proc := q, execLoc := ℓ }, σ)
    (generic_expr.Expr [] (Epure (Pexpr [] () (PEval v))), ρ,
      { κ := pc :: κ, proc := q, execLoc := ℓ }, σ)

theorem CerberusHeapLang.Step.ret_annot_inv :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {ds : List dyn_annotation} {v : value}
  {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack} {ctl : CerberusHeapLang.Ctl} {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem}
  {out : CerberusHeapLang.Config},

        ctl, σ)
      out →
    out = (generic_expr.Expr [] (Epure (Pexpr [] () (PEval v))), ρ, ctl, σ)

theorem CerberusHeapLang.Step.ret_inv :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {v : value} {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack}
  {pc : Option sym × context} {κ : List (Option sym × context)} {q : Option sym} {ℓ : exec_location}
  {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem} {out : CerberusHeapLang.Config},
  CerberusHeapLang.Step M
      (generic_expr.Expr [] (Epure (Pexpr [] () (PEval v))), ρ,
        { κ := pc :: κ, proc := q, execLoc := ℓ }, σ)
      out →
    ∃ ev0 evs,
      ρ = ev0 :: evs ∧
        out =
          (apply_ctx pc.snd (generic_expr.Expr [] (Epure (Pexpr [] () (PEval v)))), evs,
            { κ := κ, proc := pc.fst, execLoc := ℓ }, σ)

ctor CerberusHeapLang.Step.run :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {e : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {l : sym}
  {pes : List (generic_pexpr Unit sym)} {params : List (sym × core_base_type)}
  {cont : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {vs : List value} {ev0 : Fmap sym value}
  {evs : List (Fmap sym value)} {ctl : CerberusHeapLang.Ctl} {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem},
  CerberusHeapLang.jumpRedex? e = some (l, pes) →
    CerberusHeapLang.lookupLabel (M.labelsAt ctl.proc) l = some (params, cont) →
      CerberusHeapLang.evalPexprs M.tagDefs M.extern (ev0 :: evs) pes = some vs →
        CerberusHeapLang.Step M (e, ev0 :: evs, ctl, σ)
          (cont, CerberusHeapLang.bindArgs params vs (ev0 :: evs), ctl, σ)

        CerberusHeapLang.Step M (e, ev0 :: evs, ctl, σ)
          (cont, CerberusHeapLang.bindArgs params vs (ev0 :: evs), ctl, σ)

ctor CerberusHeapLang.Step.save :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {a : List annot} {sb : sym × core_base_type}
  {ps :
    List
      (sym × (core_base_type × Option (ctype × pass_by_value_or_pointer)) × generic_pexpr Unit sym)}
  {body : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {cvals : List value} {ev0 : Fmap sym value}
  {evs : List (Fmap sym value)} {ctl : CerberusHeapLang.Ctl} {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem},
  valueFromPexprs (CerberusHeapLang.saveParamPexprs ps) = some cvals →
    CerberusHeapLang.Step M (generic_expr.Expr a (Esave sb ps body), ev0 :: evs, ctl, σ)
      (body, CerberusHeapLang.bindSaveParams ps cvals (ev0 :: evs), ctl, σ)

ctor CerberusHeapLang.Step.save_eval :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {a : List annot} {sb : sym × core_base_type}
  {ps :
    List
      (sym × (core_base_type × Option (ctype × pass_by_value_or_pointer)) × generic_pexpr Unit sym)}
  {body : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {cvals : List value} {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack}
  {ctl : CerberusHeapLang.Ctl} {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem},
  valueFromPexprs (CerberusHeapLang.saveParamPexprs ps) = none →
    CerberusHeapLang.evalPexprs M.tagDefs M.extern ρ (CerberusHeapLang.saveParamPexprs ps) =
        some cvals →
      CerberusHeapLang.Step M (generic_expr.Expr a (Esave sb ps body), ρ, ctl, σ)
        (generic_expr.Expr a (Esave sb (CerberusHeapLang.saveParamsWithValues ps cvals) body), ρ,
          ctl, σ)

theorem CerberusHeapLang.Step.save_inv :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {a : List annot} {sb : sym × core_base_type}
  {ps :
    List
      (sym × (core_base_type × Option (ctype × pass_by_value_or_pointer)) × generic_pexpr Unit sym)}
  {body : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack} {ctl : CerberusHeapLang.Ctl}
  {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem} {out : CerberusHeapLang.Config},
  CerberusHeapLang.Step M (generic_expr.Expr a (Esave sb ps body), ρ, ctl, σ) out →
    (∃ cvals ev0 evs,
        ρ = ev0 :: evs ∧
          valueFromPexprs (CerberusHeapLang.saveParamPexprs ps) = some cvals ∧
            out = (body, CerberusHeapLang.bindSaveParams ps cvals ρ, ctl, σ)) ∨
      ∃ cvals,
        valueFromPexprs (CerberusHeapLang.saveParamPexprs ps) = none ∧
          CerberusHeapLang.evalPexprs M.tagDefs M.extern ρ (CerberusHeapLang.saveParamPexprs ps) =
              some cvals ∧
            out =
              (generic_expr.Expr a (Esave sb (CerberusHeapLang.saveParamsWithValues ps cvals) body),
                ρ, ctl, σ)

ctor CerberusHeapLang.Step.sseq_annot :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {a pa : List annot} {bty : core_base_type}
  {ds : List dyn_annotation} {v : value} {e2 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {ev0 : Fmap sym value}
  {evs : List (Fmap sym value)} {ctl : CerberusHeapLang.Ctl} {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem},
  CerberusHeapLang.Step M
    (generic_expr.Expr a
        (Esseq (Pattern pa (CaseBase (none, bty)))
          (CerberusHeapLang.ofVal (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.annot ds v)) e2),
      ev0 :: evs, ctl, σ)
    (generic_expr.Expr [] (Eannot ds e2), ev0 :: evs, ctl, σ)

ctor CerberusHeapLang.Step.sseq_ctx :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {a : List annot} {pat : pattern}
  {e1 e1' e2 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {ρ ρ' : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack}
  {ctl : CerberusHeapLang.Ctl} {σ σ' : CerberusHeapLang.Mem},
  CerberusHeapLang.jumpRedex? e1 = none →
    CerberusHeapLang.toVal e1 = none →
      CerberusHeapLang.Step M (e1, ρ, ctl, σ) (e1', ρ', ctl, σ') →
        CerberusHeapLang.Step M (generic_expr.Expr a (Esseq pat e1 e2), ρ, ctl, σ)
          (generic_expr.Expr a (Esseq pat e1' e2), ρ', ctl, σ')
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.Step.sseq_inv :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {a : List annot} {pat : pattern}
  {e1 e2 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack} {ctl : CerberusHeapLang.Ctl}
  {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem} {out : CerberusHeapLang.Config},
  CerberusHeapLang.Step M (generic_expr.Expr a (Esseq pat e1 e2), ρ, ctl, σ) out →
    (∃ e1' ρ' σ',
        CerberusHeapLang.jumpRedex? e1 = none ∧
          CerberusHeapLang.toVal e1 = none ∧
            CerberusHeapLang.Step M (e1, ρ, ctl, σ) (e1', ρ', ctl, σ') ∧
              out = (generic_expr.Expr a (Esseq pat e1' e2), ρ', ctl, σ')) ∨
      (∃ pa bty v ev0 evs,
          pat = Pattern pa (CaseBase (none, bty)) ∧
            e1 = CerberusHeapLang.ofVal (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.pure v) ∧
              ρ = ev0 :: evs ∧ out = (e2, ρ, ctl, σ)) ∨
        (∃ pa bty ds v ev0 evs,
            pat = Pattern pa (CaseBase (none, bty)) ∧
              e1 = CerberusHeapLang.ofVal (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.annot ds v) ∧
                ρ = ev0 :: evs ∧ out = (generic_expr.Expr [] (Eannot ds e2), ρ, ctl, σ)) ∨
          (∃ l pes params cont vs ev0 evs,
              CerberusHeapLang.jumpRedex? e1 = some (l, pes) ∧
                ρ = ev0 :: evs ∧
                  CerberusHeapLang.lookupLabel (M.labelsAt ctl.proc) l = some (params, cont) ∧
                    CerberusHeapLang.evalPexprs M.tagDefs M.extern ρ pes = some vs ∧
                      out = (cont, CerberusHeapLang.bindArgs params vs ρ, ctl, σ)) ∨
            (∃ pa' pb' x bty' ov ev0 evs,
                pat = CerberusHeapLang.specPat pa' pb' x bty' ∧
                  e1 =
                      CerberusHeapLang.ofVal
                        (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.pure (Vloaded (LVspecified ov))) ∧
                    ρ = ev0 :: evs ∧
                      out =
                        (e2,
                          update_env (CerberusHeapLang.specPat pa' pb' x bty')
                            (Vloaded (LVspecified ov)) ρ,
                          ctl, σ)) ∨
              (∃ pa' pb' x bty' ds ov ev0 evs,
                  pat = CerberusHeapLang.specPat pa' pb' x bty' ∧
                    e1 =
                        CerberusHeapLang.ofVal
                          (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.annot ds (Vloaded (LVspecified ov))) ∧
                      ρ = ev0 :: evs ∧
                        out =
                          (generic_expr.Expr [] (Eannot ds e2),
                            update_env (CerberusHeapLang.specPat pa' pb' x bty')
                              (Vloaded (LVspecified ov)) ρ,
                            ctl, σ)) ∨
                (∃ pa' x bty' v ev0 evs,
                    pat = CerberusHeapLang.symPat pa' x bty' ∧
                      e1 = CerberusHeapLang.ofVal (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.pure v) ∧
                        ρ = ev0 :: evs ∧
                          out = (e2, update_env (CerberusHeapLang.symPat pa' x bty') v ρ, ctl, σ)) ∨
                  CerberusHeapLang.Step.CallOf M e1 (fun c => Csseq a pat c e2) ρ ctl σ out
----
ctor CerberusHeapLang.Step.sseq_pure :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {a pa : List annot} {bty : core_base_type} {v : value}
  {e2 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {ev0 : Fmap sym value} {evs : List (Fmap sym value)}
  {ctl : CerberusHeapLang.Ctl} {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem},
  CerberusHeapLang.Step M
    (generic_expr.Expr a
        (Esseq (Pattern pa (CaseBase (none, bty)))
          (CerberusHeapLang.ofVal (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.pure v)) e2),
      ev0 :: evs, ctl, σ)
    (e2, ev0 :: evs, ctl, σ)
----

ctor CerberusHeapLang.Step.store :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {a : List annot} {loc : CerbLocation.Loc}
  {ann : core_run_annotation} {lk : Bool} {pe1 pe2 pe3 : generic_pexpr Unit sym} {ty : ctype}
  {pv : CerbMem.PointerValue} {cv : value} {mo : memory_order} {mv : CerbMem.MemValue}
  {fp : CerbMem.Footprint} {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack} {ctl : CerberusHeapLang.Ctl}
  {σ σ' : CerberusHeapLang.Mem},
  valueFromPexpr pe1 = some (Vctype ty) →
    valueFromPexpr pe2 = some (Vobject (OVpointer pv)) →
      valueFromPexpr pe3 = some cv →
        memValueFromValue M.tagDefs (Ctype [] (unatomic_ ty)) cv = some mv →
          CerberusHeapLang.applyMemM (CerbMem.storeM M.tagDefs loc ty lk pv mv) σ = some (fp, σ') →
            CerberusHeapLang.Step M
              (generic_expr.Expr a
                  (Eaction (Paction polarity.Pos (Action loc ann (Store0 lk pe1 pe2 pe3 mo)))),
                ρ, ctl, σ)
              (generic_expr.Expr []
                  (Eannot [DA_pos [] fp]
                    (generic_expr.Expr [] (Epure (Pexpr [] () (PEval Vunit))))),
                ρ, ctl, σ')
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.Step.store_canonical :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {a : List annot} {loc : CerbLocation.Loc}
  {ann : core_run_annotation} {lk : Bool} {ty : ctype} {pv : CerbMem.PointerValue} {cv : value}
  {mo : memory_order} {mv : CerbMem.MemValue} {fp : CerbMem.Footprint}
  {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack} {ctl : CerberusHeapLang.Ctl} {σ σ' : CerberusHeapLang.Mem},
  memValueFromValue M.tagDefs (Ctype [] (unatomic_ ty)) cv = some mv →
    CerberusHeapLang.applyMemM (CerbMem.storeM M.tagDefs loc ty lk pv mv) σ = some (fp, σ') →
      CerberusHeapLang.Step M
        (generic_expr.Expr a
            (Eaction
              (Paction polarity.Pos
                (Action loc ann
                  (Store0 lk (Pexpr [] () (PEval (Vctype ty)))
                    (Pexpr [] () (PEval (Vobject (OVpointer pv)))) (Pexpr [] () (PEval cv)) mo)))),
          ρ, ctl, σ)
        (generic_expr.Expr []
            (Eannot [DA_pos [] fp] (generic_expr.Expr [] (Epure (Pexpr [] () (PEval Vunit))))),
          ρ, ctl, σ')
----
ctor CerberusHeapLang.Step.store_eval :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {a : List annot} {loc : CerbLocation.Loc}
  {ann : core_run_annotation} {lk : Bool} {ty : ctype} {pe2 pe3 : generic_pexpr Unit sym}
  {pv : CerbMem.PointerValue} {cv : value} {mo : memory_order} {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack}
  {ctl : CerberusHeapLang.Ctl} {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem},
  valueFromPexprs [pe2, pe3] = none →
    CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr M.tagDefs M.extern ρ pe2 = some (Vobject (OVpointer pv)) →
      CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr M.tagDefs M.extern ρ pe3 = some cv →
        CerberusHeapLang.Step M
          (generic_expr.Expr a
              (Eaction
                (Paction polarity.Pos
                  (Action loc ann (Store0 lk (Pexpr [] () (PEval (Vctype ty))) pe2 pe3 mo)))),
            ρ, ctl, σ)
          (generic_expr.Expr a
              (Eaction
                (Paction polarity.Pos
                  (Action loc ann
                    (Store0 lk (Pexpr [] () (PEval (Vctype ty)))
                      (Pexpr [] () (PEval (Vobject (OVpointer pv)))) (Pexpr [] () (PEval cv))
                      mo)))),
            ρ, ctl, σ)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.Step.store_inv :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {a : List annot} {loc : CerbLocation.Loc}
  {ann : core_run_annotation} {lk : Bool} {ty : ctype} {pv : CerbMem.PointerValue} {cv : value}
  {mo : memory_order} {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack} {ctl : CerberusHeapLang.Ctl}
  {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem} {out : CerberusHeapLang.Config},
  CerberusHeapLang.Step M
      (generic_expr.Expr a
          (Eaction
            (Paction polarity.Pos
              (Action loc ann
                (Store0 lk (Pexpr [] () (PEval (Vctype ty)))
                  (Pexpr [] () (PEval (Vobject (OVpointer pv)))) (Pexpr [] () (PEval cv)) mo)))),
        ρ, ctl, σ)
      out →
    ∃ mv fp σ',
      memValueFromValue M.tagDefs (Ctype [] (unatomic_ ty)) cv = some mv ∧
        CerberusHeapLang.applyMemM (CerbMem.storeM M.tagDefs loc ty lk pv mv) σ = some (fp, σ') ∧
          out =
            (generic_expr.Expr []
                (Eannot [DA_pos [] fp] (generic_expr.Expr [] (Epure (Pexpr [] () (PEval Vunit))))),
              ρ, ctl, σ')
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.Step.store_op_inv :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {a : List annot} {loc : CerbLocation.Loc}
  {ann : core_run_annotation} {lk : Bool} {ty : ctype} {pe2 pe3 : generic_pexpr Unit sym}
  {mo : memory_order} {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack} {ctl : CerberusHeapLang.Ctl}
  {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem} {out : CerberusHeapLang.Config},
  valueFromPexprs [pe2, pe3] = none →
    CerberusHeapLang.Step M
        (generic_expr.Expr a
            (Eaction
              (Paction polarity.Pos
                (Action loc ann (Store0 lk (Pexpr [] () (PEval (Vctype ty))) pe2 pe3 mo)))),
          ρ, ctl, σ)
        out →
      ∃ pv cv,
        CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr M.tagDefs M.extern ρ pe2 = some (Vobject (OVpointer pv)) ∧
          CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr M.tagDefs M.extern ρ pe3 = some cv ∧
            out =
              (generic_expr.Expr a
                  (Eaction
                    (Paction polarity.Pos
                      (Action loc ann
                        (Store0 lk (Pexpr [] () (PEval (Vctype ty)))
                          (Pexpr [] () (PEval (Vobject (OVpointer pv)))) (Pexpr [] () (PEval cv))
                          mo)))),
                ρ, ctl, σ)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.Step.toCerberusRound :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {e : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {ev0 : Fmap sym value}
  {evs : List (Fmap sym value)} {ctl : CerberusHeapLang.Ctl} {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem}
  {c' : CerberusHeapLang.Config},
  CerberusHeapLang.Frag e →
    CerberusHeapLang.esize e ≤ lemDefaultFuel →
      CerberusHeapLang.Step M (e, ev0 :: evs, ctl, σ) c' →
        CerberusHeapLang.CerberusRound M (e, ev0 :: evs, ctl, σ) c'

ctor CerberusHeapLang.Step.wseq_annot :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {a pa : List annot} {bty : core_base_type}
  {ds : List dyn_annotation} {v : value} {e2 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {ev0 : Fmap sym value}
  {evs : List (Fmap sym value)} {ctl : CerberusHeapLang.Ctl} {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem},
  CerberusHeapLang.Step M
    (generic_expr.Expr a
        (Ewseq (Pattern pa (CaseBase (none, bty)))
          (CerberusHeapLang.ofVal (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.annot ds v)) e2),
      ev0 :: evs, ctl, σ)
    (generic_expr.Expr [] (Eannot ds e2), ev0 :: evs, ctl, σ)
----
ctor CerberusHeapLang.Step.wseq_ctx :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {a : List annot} {pat : pattern}
  {e1 e1' e2 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {ρ ρ' : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack}
  {ctl : CerberusHeapLang.Ctl} {σ σ' : CerberusHeapLang.Mem},
  CerberusHeapLang.jumpRedex? e1 = none →
    CerberusHeapLang.toVal e1 = none →
      CerberusHeapLang.Step M (e1, ρ, ctl, σ) (e1', ρ', ctl, σ') →
        CerberusHeapLang.Step M (generic_expr.Expr a (Ewseq pat e1 e2), ρ, ctl, σ)
          (generic_expr.Expr a (Ewseq pat e1' e2), ρ', ctl, σ')
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.Step.wseq_inv :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {a : List annot} {pat : pattern}
  {e1 e2 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack} {ctl : CerberusHeapLang.Ctl}
  {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem} {out : CerberusHeapLang.Config},
  CerberusHeapLang.Step M (generic_expr.Expr a (Ewseq pat e1 e2), ρ, ctl, σ) out →
    (∃ e1' ρ' σ',
        CerberusHeapLang.jumpRedex? e1 = none ∧
          CerberusHeapLang.toVal e1 = none ∧
            CerberusHeapLang.Step M (e1, ρ, ctl, σ) (e1', ρ', ctl, σ') ∧
              out = (generic_expr.Expr a (Ewseq pat e1' e2), ρ', ctl, σ')) ∨
      (∃ pa bty v ev0 evs,
          pat = Pattern pa (CaseBase (none, bty)) ∧
            e1 = CerberusHeapLang.ofVal (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.pure v) ∧
              ρ = ev0 :: evs ∧ out = (e2, ρ, ctl, σ)) ∨
        (∃ pa bty ds v ev0 evs,
            pat = Pattern pa (CaseBase (none, bty)) ∧
              e1 = CerberusHeapLang.ofVal (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.annot ds v) ∧
                ρ = ev0 :: evs ∧ out = (generic_expr.Expr [] (Eannot ds e2), ρ, ctl, σ)) ∨
          (∃ l pes params cont vs ev0 evs,
              CerberusHeapLang.jumpRedex? e1 = some (l, pes) ∧
                ρ = ev0 :: evs ∧
                  CerberusHeapLang.lookupLabel (M.labelsAt ctl.proc) l = some (params, cont) ∧
                    CerberusHeapLang.evalPexprs M.tagDefs M.extern ρ pes = some vs ∧
                      out = (cont, CerberusHeapLang.bindArgs params vs ρ, ctl, σ)) ∨
            CerberusHeapLang.Step.CallOf M e1 (fun c => Cwseq a pat c e2) ρ ctl σ out
----
ctor CerberusHeapLang.Step.wseq_pure :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {a pa : List annot} {bty : core_base_type} {v : value}
  {e2 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {ev0 : Fmap sym value} {evs : List (Fmap sym value)}
  {ctl : CerberusHeapLang.Ctl} {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem},
  CerberusHeapLang.Step M
    (generic_expr.Expr a
        (Ewseq (Pattern pa (CaseBase (none, bty)))
          (CerberusHeapLang.ofVal (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.pure v)) e2),
      ev0 :: evs, ctl, σ)
    (e2, ev0 :: evs, ctl, σ)

inductive CerberusHeapLang.StorableAt :
CerbTags.TagDefsMap → ctype → CerbMem.MemValue → Prop
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.StorableAt.bytes_fpm :
∀ {tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap} {ty : ctype} {mv : CerbMem.MemValue},
  CerberusHeapLang.StorableAt tds ty mv →
    ∀ (fpm : CerbMem.Funptrmap),
      (CerbMem.memValueToBytes tds fpm mv).snd = (CerbMem.memValueToBytes tds [] mv).snd
----
def CerberusHeapLang.StorableAt.casesOn :
{tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap} →
  {ty : ctype} →
    {mv : CerbMem.MemValue} →
      {motive : CerberusHeapLang.StorableAt tds ty mv → Sort u} →
        (t : CerberusHeapLang.StorableAt tds ty mv) →
          ((compat : CerbMem.ctypeMemCompatible ty (CerbMem.typeofMval mv) = true) →
              (fpm : ∀ (fpm : CerbMem.Funptrmap), (CerbMem.memValueToBytes tds fpm mv).fst = fpm) →
                (len :
                    ∀ (fpm : CerbMem.Funptrmap),
                      (CerbMem.memValueToBytes tds fpm mv).snd.length =
                        CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds ty) →
                  (bytes_fpm :
                      ∀ (fpm : CerbMem.Funptrmap),
                        (CerbMem.memValueToBytes tds fpm mv).snd =
                          (CerbMem.memValueToBytes tds [] mv).snd) →
                    (stored_dec :
                        ∀ (lum : List (Int × identifier)) (fpm : CerbMem.Funptrmap) (addr : Int),
                          CerbMem.reconstructValue tds lum fpm addr ty
                              (CerbMem.memValueToBytes tds [] mv).snd =
                            CerbMem.reconstructValue tds [] [] addr ty
                              (CerbMem.memValueToBytes tds [] mv).snd) →
                      motive ⋯) →
            motive t
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.StorableAt.compat :
∀ {tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap} {ty : ctype} {mv : CerbMem.MemValue},
  CerberusHeapLang.StorableAt tds ty mv →
    CerbMem.ctypeMemCompatible ty (CerbMem.typeofMval mv) = true
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.StorableAt.fpm :
∀ {tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap} {ty : ctype} {mv : CerbMem.MemValue},
  CerberusHeapLang.StorableAt tds ty mv →
    ∀ (fpm : CerbMem.Funptrmap), (CerbMem.memValueToBytes tds fpm mv).fst = fpm
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.StorableAt.len :
∀ {tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap} {ty : ctype} {mv : CerbMem.MemValue},
  CerberusHeapLang.StorableAt tds ty mv →
    ∀ (fpm : CerbMem.Funptrmap),
      (CerbMem.memValueToBytes tds fpm mv).snd.length = CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds ty
----
ctor CerberusHeapLang.StorableAt.mk :
∀ {tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap} {ty : ctype} {mv : CerbMem.MemValue},
  CerbMem.ctypeMemCompatible ty (CerbMem.typeofMval mv) = true →
    (∀ (fpm : CerbMem.Funptrmap), (CerbMem.memValueToBytes tds fpm mv).fst = fpm) →
      (∀ (fpm : CerbMem.Funptrmap),
          (CerbMem.memValueToBytes tds fpm mv).snd.length = CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds ty) →
        (∀ (fpm : CerbMem.Funptrmap),
            (CerbMem.memValueToBytes tds fpm mv).snd = (CerbMem.memValueToBytes tds [] mv).snd) →
          (∀ (lum : List (Int × identifier)) (fpm : CerbMem.Funptrmap) (addr : Int),
              CerbMem.reconstructValue tds lum fpm addr ty (CerbMem.memValueToBytes tds [] mv).snd =
                CerbMem.reconstructValue tds [] [] addr ty
                  (CerbMem.memValueToBytes tds [] mv).snd) →
            CerberusHeapLang.StorableAt tds ty mv
----
rec CerberusHeapLang.StorableAt.rec :
{tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap} →
  {ty : ctype} →
    {mv : CerbMem.MemValue} →
      {motive : CerberusHeapLang.StorableAt tds ty mv → Sort u} →
        ((compat : CerbMem.ctypeMemCompatible ty (CerbMem.typeofMval mv) = true) →
            (fpm : ∀ (fpm : CerbMem.Funptrmap), (CerbMem.memValueToBytes tds fpm mv).fst = fpm) →
              (len :
                  ∀ (fpm : CerbMem.Funptrmap),
                    (CerbMem.memValueToBytes tds fpm mv).snd.length = CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds ty) →
                (bytes_fpm :
                    ∀ (fpm : CerbMem.Funptrmap),
                      (CerbMem.memValueToBytes tds fpm mv).snd =
                        (CerbMem.memValueToBytes tds [] mv).snd) →
                  (stored_dec :
                      ∀ (lum : List (Int × identifier)) (fpm : CerbMem.Funptrmap) (addr : Int),
                        CerbMem.reconstructValue tds lum fpm addr ty
                            (CerbMem.memValueToBytes tds [] mv).snd =
                          CerbMem.reconstructValue tds [] [] addr ty
                            (CerbMem.memValueToBytes tds [] mv).snd) →
                    motive ⋯) →
          (t : CerberusHeapLang.StorableAt tds ty mv) → motive t
----

                            CerbMem.reconstructValue tds [] [] addr ty

theorem CerberusHeapLang.StorableAt.stored_dec :

theorem CerberusHeapLang.StorableView.bytes_fpm :
∀ {tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap} {ty : ctype} {mv : CerbMem.MemValue},
  CerberusHeapLang.StorableView tds ty mv →
    ∀ (fpm : CerbMem.Funptrmap),
      (CerbMem.memValueToBytes tds fpm mv).snd = (CerbMem.memValueToBytes tds [] mv).snd
----
def CerberusHeapLang.StorableView.casesOn :
{tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap} →
  {ty : ctype} →
    {mv : CerbMem.MemValue} →
      {motive : CerberusHeapLang.StorableView tds ty mv → Sort u} →
        (t : CerberusHeapLang.StorableView tds ty mv) →
          ((compat : CerbMem.ctypeMemCompatible ty (CerbMem.typeofMval mv) = true) →
              (fpm : ∀ (fpm : CerbMem.Funptrmap), (CerbMem.memValueToBytes tds fpm mv).fst = fpm) →
                (bytes_fpm :
                    ∀ (fpm : CerbMem.Funptrmap),
                      (CerbMem.memValueToBytes tds fpm mv).snd =
                        (CerbMem.memValueToBytes tds [] mv).snd) →
                  (len :
                      (CerbMem.memValueToBytes tds [] mv).snd.length = CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds ty) →
                    motive ⋯) →
            motive t
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.StorableView.compat :
∀ {tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap} {ty : ctype} {mv : CerbMem.MemValue},
  CerberusHeapLang.StorableView tds ty mv →
    CerbMem.ctypeMemCompatible ty (CerbMem.typeofMval mv) = true
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.StorableView.fpm :
∀ {tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap} {ty : ctype} {mv : CerbMem.MemValue},
  CerberusHeapLang.StorableView tds ty mv →
    ∀ (fpm : CerbMem.Funptrmap), (CerbMem.memValueToBytes tds fpm mv).fst = fpm
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.StorableView.len :
∀ {tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap} {ty : ctype} {mv : CerbMem.MemValue},
  CerberusHeapLang.StorableView tds ty mv →
    (CerbMem.memValueToBytes tds [] mv).snd.length = CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds ty
----
ctor CerberusHeapLang.StorableView.mk :
∀ {tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap} {ty : ctype} {mv : CerbMem.MemValue},
  CerbMem.ctypeMemCompatible ty (CerbMem.typeofMval mv) = true →
    (∀ (fpm : CerbMem.Funptrmap), (CerbMem.memValueToBytes tds fpm mv).fst = fpm) →
      (∀ (fpm : CerbMem.Funptrmap),
          (CerbMem.memValueToBytes tds fpm mv).snd = (CerbMem.memValueToBytes tds [] mv).snd) →
        (CerbMem.memValueToBytes tds [] mv).snd.length = CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds ty →
          CerberusHeapLang.StorableView tds ty mv

theorem CerberusHeapLang.advance_action :
∀ {tds : Fmap sym (CerbLocation.Loc × tag_definition)} {tid : Nat} {s : String}
  {loc : CerbLocation.Loc} {req : action_request2 thread_state} {dst dst' : driver_state},
  CerberusHeapLang.runOne
        (action_request_sequential2 tds loc tid dst.core_run_state0.aid_supply req)
        { core_file := dst.core_file, core_extern := dst.core_extern,
          core_state0 := dst.core_state0,
          core_run_state0 :=
            have __src := dst.core_run_state0;
            { tid_supply := __src.tid_supply, aid_supply := dst.core_run_state0.aid_supply + 1,
              excluded_supply := __src.excluded_supply, sym_supply := __src.sym_supply,
              labeled := __src.labeled },
          layout_state := dst.layout_state, concurrency_state := dst.concurrency_state,
          fs_state0 := dst.fs_state0, trace := dst.trace, symbolic_assoc := dst.symbolic_assoc,
          blocked := dst.blocked, dr_step_counter := dst.dr_step_counter } =
      (NDactive (), dst') →
    CerberusHeapLang.runOne
        (advance_step tds tid (Step_action_request2 s loc tid false (stExceptUndef_return req)))
        dst =
      (NDactive NOWAKEUP, dst')
----

  {r : kill_reason driver_error},

        (action_request_sequential2 tds loc tid dst.core_run_state0.aid_supply req)

            have __src := dst.core_run_state0;

              excluded_supply := __src.excluded_supply, sym_supply := __src.sym_supply,
              labeled := __src.labeled },
          layout_state := dst.layout_state, concurrency_state := dst.concurrency_state,
          fs_state0 := dst.fs_state0, trace := dst.trace, symbolic_assoc := dst.symbolic_assoc,
          blocked := dst.blocked, dr_step_counter := dst.dr_step_counter } =

theorem CerberusHeapLang.alloc_atomic :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {ctl : CerberusHeapLang.Ctl} (loc : CerbLocation.Loc)
  (ann : core_run_annotation) (aprov sprov : CerbMem.Provenance) (alignN sizeN : Int)
  (pref : prefix0) (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack),
  0 < CerberusHeapLang.regionCost alignN sizeN →
    CerberusHeapLang.AtomicStep M ctl
      (CerberusHeapLang.allocExpr loc ann (CerbMem.IntegerValue.IV aprov alignN)
        (CerbMem.IntegerValue.IV sprov sizeN) pref)
      ρ 1 (CerberusHeapLang.allocBudget (CerberusHeapLang.regionCost alignN sizeN)) fun w =>
      iprop(∃ id a,
          ⌜w =
                CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.pure
                  (Vobject (OVpointer (CerberusHeapLang.cellPtr id a)))⌝ ∗
            CerberusHeapLang.regionOwn id a sizeN.toNat (Iris.DFrac.own 1)
                (List.replicate sizeN.toNat CerberusHeapLang.undefByte) ∗
              ⌜0 < a ∧ a + ↑sizeN.toNat ≤ 2 ^ 64⌝)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.alloc_create_kill_wps :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p : Option sym} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpec GF}
  {Θ : CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpec GF},
  (∀ (x : sym), CerberusHeapLang.resolveExtern M.extern x = x) →
    ∀ (al : Int) (pref : prefix0) (ev0 : Fmap sym value) (evs : List (Fmap sym value)),
      CerberusHeapLang.SymFrame ev0 →
        CerberusHeapLang.allocBudget
            (CerberusHeapLang.allocCost M.tagDefs CerberusHeapLang.intTy al) ⊢
          CerberusHeapLang.wps M p Ls Θ
            (fun w x =>
              iprop(⌜w = CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.pure Vunit⌝ ∗
                  ∃ id a, CerberusHeapLang.deadObj M.tagDefs id a CerberusHeapLang.intTy))
            (CerberusHeapLang.createKillProg al pref) (ev0 :: evs)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.alloc_create_wpt :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p : Option sym} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpecT GF}
  {Θ : CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpecT GF} (al : Int) (pref : prefix0) (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack),
  CerberusHeapLang.allocBudget (CerberusHeapLang.allocCost M.tagDefs CerberusHeapLang.intTy al) ⊢
    CerberusHeapLang.wpt M p Ls Θ 2
      (fun x x_1 =>
        iprop(∃ p,
            p ↦c[M.tagDefs]{Iris.DFrac.own 1} CerberusHeapLang.intTy ;
              CerberusHeapLang.intUndefBytes M.tagDefs))
      (CerberusHeapLang.createExpr CerberusHeapLang.loc0 empty_annotation
        (CerbMem.IntegerValue.IV CerbMem.Provenance.Prov_none al) CerberusHeapLang.intTy pref)
      ρ
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.alloc_free_wps :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p : Option sym} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpec GF}
  {Θ : CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpec GF},
  (∀ (x : sym), CerberusHeapLang.resolveExtern M.extern x = x) →
    ∀ (al n : Int) (pref : prefix0),
      0 < CerberusHeapLang.regionCost al n →
        ∀ (ev0 : Fmap sym value) (evs : List (Fmap sym value)),
          CerberusHeapLang.SymFrame ev0 →
            CerberusHeapLang.allocBudget (CerberusHeapLang.regionCost al n) ⊢
              CerberusHeapLang.wps M p Ls Θ
                (fun w x =>
                  iprop(⌜w = CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.pure Vunit⌝ ∗
                      ∃ id a, CerberusHeapLang.deadRegion id a n.toNat))
                (CerberusHeapLang.allocFreeProg al n pref) (ev0 :: evs)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.alloc_get_x :
CerberusHeapLang.σ₀.allocations.get? 0 = some CerberusHeapLang.allocX
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.alloc_get_y :
CerberusHeapLang.σ₀.allocations.get? 1 = some CerberusHeapLang.allocY
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.alloc_lit_sym_step :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {loc : CerbLocation.Loc} {ann : core_run_annotation}
  {align size : CerbMem.IntegerValue} {n : sym} {pref : prefix0} {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack}
  {ctl : CerberusHeapLang.Ctl} {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem},
  CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr M.tagDefs M.extern ρ (Pexpr [] () (PEsym n)) =
      some (Vobject (OVinteger size)) →
    CerberusHeapLang.Step M
      (CerberusHeapLang.allocOpRedex loc ann (Pexpr [] () (PEval (Vobject (OVinteger align))))
          (Pexpr [] () (PEsym n)) pref,
        ρ, ctl, σ)
      (CerberusHeapLang.allocRedex loc ann align size pref, ρ, ctl, σ)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.alloc_two_creates_wps :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p : Option sym} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpec GF}
  {Θ : CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpec GF} (al₁ al₂ : Int) (pref₁ pref₂ : prefix0) (bty : core_base_type)
  (ev0 : Fmap sym value) (evs : List (Fmap sym value)),
  CerberusHeapLang.allocBudget
      (CerberusHeapLang.allocCost M.tagDefs CerberusHeapLang.intTy al₁ +
        CerberusHeapLang.allocCost M.tagDefs CerberusHeapLang.intTy al₂) ⊢
    CerberusHeapLang.wps M p Ls Θ
      (fun x x_1 =>
        iprop(∃ p₁ p₂,
            p₁ ↦c[M.tagDefs]{Iris.DFrac.own 1} CerberusHeapLang.intTy ;
                CerberusHeapLang.intUndefBytes M.tagDefs ∗
              p₂ ↦c[M.tagDefs]{Iris.DFrac.own 1} CerberusHeapLang.intTy ;
                CerberusHeapLang.intUndefBytes M.tagDefs))
      (CerberusHeapLang.sseqExpr bty
        (CerberusHeapLang.createExpr CerberusHeapLang.loc0 empty_annotation
          (CerbMem.IntegerValue.IV CerbMem.Provenance.Prov_none al₁) CerberusHeapLang.intTy pref₁)
        (CerberusHeapLang.createExpr CerberusHeapLang.loc0 empty_annotation
          (CerbMem.IntegerValue.IV CerbMem.Provenance.Prov_none al₂) CerberusHeapLang.intTy pref₂))
      (ev0 :: evs)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.allocateObject_arg_irrel :
∀ (tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap) (tid tid' : Nat) (pref : prefix0) (align : CerbMem.IntegerValue)
  (ty : ctype) (r r' : Option Int) (init : Option CerbMem.MemValue),
  CerbMem.allocateObject tds tid pref align ty r init =
    CerbMem.allocateObject tds tid' pref align ty r' init
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.allocateObject_layer :
∀ (tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap) (tid : Nat) (pref : prefix0) (align : CerbMem.IntegerValue)
  (ty : ctype) (reqAddr : Option Int) (initOpt : Option CerbMem.MemValue)
  (σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem),
  (∃ pv σ',
      CerberusHeapLang.runOne (CerbMem.allocateObject tds tid pref align ty reqAddr initOpt) σ =
        (NDactive pv, σ')) ∨
    ∃ r σ',
      CerberusHeapLang.runOne (CerbMem.allocateObject tds tid pref align ty reqAddr initOpt) σ =
        (NDkilled r, σ')
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.allocateObject_success :
∀ (tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap) (σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem) (pref : prefix0)
  (aprov : CerbMem.Provenance) (alignN : Int) (ty : ctype),
  0 < CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds ty →
    CerberusHeapLang.freshBase σ.lastAddress alignN (CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds ty) ≠ 0 →
      CerberusHeapLang.applyMemM
          (CerbMem.allocateObject tds 0 pref (CerbMem.IntegerValue.IV aprov alignN) ty none none)
          σ =
        some
          (CerberusHeapLang.cellPtr σ.nextAllocId
              (CerberusHeapLang.freshBase σ.lastAddress alignN (CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds ty)),
            CerbMem.writeBytesTo
              { nextAllocId := σ.nextAllocId + 1, nextIota := σ.nextIota,
                lastAddress :=
                  CerberusHeapLang.freshBase σ.lastAddress alignN (CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds ty),
                allocations :=
                  σ.allocations.insert σ.nextAllocId
                    {
                      base :=
                        CerberusHeapLang.freshBase σ.lastAddress alignN
                          (CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds ty),
                      size := ↑(CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds ty), ty := some ty, prefix_ := pref },
                iotaMap := σ.iotaMap, funptrmap := σ.funptrmap, varargs := σ.varargs,
                nextVarargsId := σ.nextVarargsId, bytemap := σ.bytemap,
                lastUsedUnionMembers := σ.lastUsedUnionMembers,
                deadAllocations := σ.deadAllocations, dynamicAddrs := σ.dynamicAddrs,
                lastUsed := σ.lastUsed, requested := σ.requested }
              (CerberusHeapLang.freshBase σ.lastAddress alignN (CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds ty))
              (List.replicate (CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds ty) CerberusHeapLang.undefByte))
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.allocateRegion_arg_irrel :
∀ (tid tid' : Nat) (pref : prefix0) (align size : CerbMem.IntegerValue),
  CerbMem.allocateRegion tid pref align size = CerbMem.allocateRegion tid' pref align size
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.allocateRegion_killed_inv :
∀ (tid : Nat) (pref : prefix0) (align size : CerbMem.IntegerValue) (σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem)
  {r : kill_reason mem_error} {σ' : CerberusHeapLang.Mem},
  CerberusHeapLang.runOne (CerbMem.allocateRegion tid pref align size) σ = (NDkilled r, σ') →
    σ' = σ ∧ r = Other (MerrOther "out of memory")
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.allocateRegion_layer :
∀ (tid : Nat) (pref : prefix0) (align size : CerbMem.IntegerValue) (σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem),
  (∃ pv σ',
      CerberusHeapLang.runOne (CerbMem.allocateRegion tid pref align size) σ = (NDactive pv, σ')) ∨
    ∃ r σ',
      CerberusHeapLang.runOne (CerbMem.allocateRegion tid pref align size) σ = (NDkilled r, σ')
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.allocateRegion_success :
∀ (σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem) (pref : prefix0) (aprov sprov : CerbMem.Provenance)
  (alignN sizeN : Int),
  CerberusHeapLang.freshBase σ.lastAddress alignN sizeN.toNat ≠ 0 →
    CerberusHeapLang.applyMemM
        (CerbMem.allocateRegion 0 pref (CerbMem.IntegerValue.IV aprov alignN)
          (CerbMem.IntegerValue.IV sprov sizeN))
        σ =
      some
        (CerberusHeapLang.cellPtr σ.nextAllocId
            (CerberusHeapLang.freshBase σ.lastAddress alignN sizeN.toNat),
          CerbMem.writeBytesTo
            { nextAllocId := σ.nextAllocId + 1, nextIota := σ.nextIota,
              lastAddress := CerberusHeapLang.freshBase σ.lastAddress alignN sizeN.toNat,
              allocations :=
                σ.allocations.insert σ.nextAllocId
                  { base := CerberusHeapLang.freshBase σ.lastAddress alignN sizeN.toNat,
                    size := ↑sizeN.toNat, prefix_ := pref },
              iotaMap := σ.iotaMap, funptrmap := σ.funptrmap, varargs := σ.varargs,
              nextVarargsId := σ.nextVarargsId, bytemap := σ.bytemap,
              lastUsedUnionMembers := σ.lastUsedUnionMembers, deadAllocations := σ.deadAllocations,
              dynamicAddrs :=
                CerberusHeapLang.freshBase σ.lastAddress alignN sizeN.toNat :: σ.dynamicAddrs,
              lastUsed := σ.lastUsed, requested := σ.requested }
            (CerberusHeapLang.freshBase σ.lastAddress alignN sizeN.toNat)
            (List.replicate sizeN.toNat CerberusHeapLang.undefByte))
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.allocations_erase_get? :
∀ (σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem) (id id' : Int),
  (σ.allocations.erase id).get? id' = if id = id' then none else σ.allocations.get? id'

∀ {α : Type}
  (f :
    CerberusHeapLang.Mem →
      nd_action α String mem_error (mem_constraint CerbMem.IntegerValue) CerbMem.MemState ×
        CerberusHeapLang.Mem)

theorem CerberusHeapLang.applyMemM_none_killed :
∀ {α : Type} {m : CerbMem.memM α} {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem},
  ((∃ z σ', CerberusHeapLang.runOne m σ = (NDactive z, σ')) ∨
      ∃ r σ', CerberusHeapLang.runOne m σ = (NDkilled r, σ')) →
    CerberusHeapLang.applyMemM m σ = none → ∃ r σ', CerberusHeapLang.runOne m σ = (NDkilled r, σ')

theorem CerberusHeapLang.arrQ_inv :
∀ (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ann ra : core_run_annotation) (mo : memory_order)
  (ibty accbty pbty xbty : core_base_type) (n : Int) {l : sym}
  {params : List (sym × core_base_type)} {cont : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr},
  CerberusHeapLang.lookupLabel (CerberusHeapLang.arrQ loc ann ra mo ibty accbty pbty xbty n) l =
      some (params, cont) →
    params =
        [(CerberusHeapLang.arrISym, ibty), (CerberusHeapLang.arrAccSym, accbty),
          (CerberusHeapLang.arrPSym, pbty)] ∧
      cont = CerberusHeapLang.arrBody loc ann ra mo xbty n

  CerberusHeapLang.lookupLabel (CerberusHeapLang.arrQ loc ann ra mo ibty accbty pbty xbty n)
      CerberusHeapLang.arrLoopSym =
    some
      ([(CerberusHeapLang.arrISym, ibty), (CerberusHeapLang.arrAccSym, accbty),
          (CerberusHeapLang.arrPSym, pbty)],
        CerberusHeapLang.arrBody loc ann ra mo xbty n)

theorem CerberusHeapLang.arr_args_eval :
∀ {f : Fmap sym value},
  CerberusHeapLang.SymFrame f →
    ∀ (i : Nat) (acc : Int) (rest : List (Fmap sym value)) (x id a : Int),
      CerberusHeapLang.evalPexprs fmapEmpty fmapEmpty
          (CerberusHeapLang.arrFrameX (CerberusHeapLang.ivVal x) (CerberusHeapLang.ivVal ↑i)
              (CerberusHeapLang.ivVal acc) (Vobject (OVpointer (CerberusHeapLang.cellPtr id a)))
              f ::
            rest)
          [CerberusHeapLang.arrIncPe, CerberusHeapLang.arrAccXPe, CerberusHeapLang.arrShiftPe] =
        some
          [CerberusHeapLang.ivVal (↑i + 1), CerberusHeapLang.ivVal (acc + x),
            Vobject (OVpointer (CerberusHeapLang.cellPtr id (a + 4)))]
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.arr_blockSpecs :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ann ra : core_run_annotation) (mo : memory_order)
  (ibty accbty pbty xbty : core_base_type) (vs : List Int) (id a : Int) (aty : ctype)
  (bs : List CerbMem.AbsByte) (p : sym) (rs : core_run_state),
  CerberusHeapLang.LabeledAt rs p
      (CerberusHeapLang.arrQ loc ann ra mo ibty accbty pbty xbty ↑vs.length) →
    vs.length * 4 ≤ CerbMem.sizeofCtype fmapEmpty aty →
      ∀ (ety : integerType),
        (∀ (i : Nat) (hi : i < vs.length) (lum : List (Int × identifier)) (fpm : CerbMem.Funptrmap),
            CerbMem.reconstructValue fmapEmpty lum fpm (a + ↑(4 * i)) CerberusHeapLang.intTy
                (List.take (CerbMem.sizeofCtype fmapEmpty CerberusHeapLang.intTy)
                  (List.drop (4 * i) bs)) =
              CerbMem.MemValue.MVinteger ety (CerbMem.integerIval vs[i])) →
          ⊢
            CerberusHeapLang.blockSpecs (CerberusHeapLang.procCtx rs) (some p)
              (CerberusHeapLang.arrLs vs id a aty bs) CerberusHeapLang.emptyProcSpec
              (CerberusHeapLang.arrPost vs id a aty bs)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.arr_body_wps :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ann ra : core_run_annotation) (mo : memory_order)
  (ibty accbty pbty xbty : core_base_type) (vs : List Int) (id a : Int) (aty : ctype)
  (bs : List CerbMem.AbsByte) (p : sym) (rs : core_run_state),
  CerberusHeapLang.LabeledAt rs p
      (CerberusHeapLang.arrQ loc ann ra mo ibty accbty pbty xbty ↑vs.length) →
    vs.length * 4 ≤ CerbMem.sizeofCtype fmapEmpty aty →
      ∀ (ety : integerType),
        (∀ (i : Nat) (hi : i < vs.length) (lum : List (Int × identifier)) (fpm : CerbMem.Funptrmap),
            CerbMem.reconstructValue fmapEmpty lum fpm (a + ↑(4 * i)) CerberusHeapLang.intTy
                (List.take (CerbMem.sizeofCtype fmapEmpty CerberusHeapLang.intTy)
                  (List.drop (4 * i) bs)) =
              CerbMem.MemValue.MVinteger ety (CerbMem.integerIval vs[i])) →
          ∀ (i : Nat) (f : Fmap sym value) (rest : List (Fmap sym value)),
            CerberusHeapLang.SymFrame f →
              i ≤ vs.length →
                CerberusHeapLang.cellOwn (CerberusHeapLang.procCtx rs).tagDefs id (Iris.DFrac.own 1)
                    { addr := a, ty := aty, bytes := bs } ⊢
                  CerberusHeapLang.wps (CerberusHeapLang.procCtx rs) (some p)
                    (CerberusHeapLang.arrLs vs id a aty bs) CerberusHeapLang.emptyProcSpec
                    (CerberusHeapLang.arrPost vs id a aty bs)
                    (CerberusHeapLang.arrBody loc ann ra mo xbty ↑vs.length)
                    (CerberusHeapLang.arrFrame (CerberusHeapLang.ivVal ↑i)
                        (CerberusHeapLang.ivVal (List.take i vs).sum)
                        (Vobject (OVpointer (CerberusHeapLang.cellPtr id (a + ↑(4 * i))))) f ::
                      rest)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.arr_exit_eval :
∀ {f : Fmap sym value},
  CerberusHeapLang.SymFrame f →
    ∀ (i : Nat) (acc : Int) (vp : value) (rest : List (Fmap sym value)),
      CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr fmapEmpty fmapEmpty
          (CerberusHeapLang.arrFrame (CerberusHeapLang.ivVal ↑i) (CerberusHeapLang.ivVal acc) vp
              f ::
            rest)
          CerberusHeapLang.arrExitPe =
        some (CerberusHeapLang.ivVal acc)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.arr_guard_eval :
∀ {f : Fmap sym value},
  CerberusHeapLang.SymFrame f →
    ∀ (i : Nat) (acc : Int) (vp : value) (rest : List (Fmap sym value)) (n : Int),
      CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr fmapEmpty fmapEmpty
          (CerberusHeapLang.arrFrame (CerberusHeapLang.ivVal ↑i) (CerberusHeapLang.ivVal acc) vp
              f ::
            rest)
          (CerberusHeapLang.arrGuard n) =
        some (CerberusHeapLang.boolValue (decide (↑i < n)))
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.arr_p_eval :
∀ {f : Fmap sym value},
  CerberusHeapLang.SymFrame f →
    ∀ (i : Nat) (acc : Int) (vp : value) (rest : List (Fmap sym value)),
      CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr fmapEmpty fmapEmpty
          (CerberusHeapLang.arrFrame (CerberusHeapLang.ivVal ↑i) (CerberusHeapLang.ivVal acc) vp
              f ::
            rest)
          (Pexpr [] () (PEsym CerberusHeapLang.arrPSym)) =
        some vp

theorem CerberusHeapLang.arr_wp_readout :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ann ra : core_run_annotation) (mo : memory_order)
  (ibty accbty pbty xbty : core_base_type) (vs : List Int) (id a : Int) (aty : ctype)
  (bs : List CerbMem.AbsByte) (p : sym) (rs : core_run_state),
  CerberusHeapLang.LabeledAt rs p
      (CerberusHeapLang.arrQ loc ann ra mo ibty accbty pbty xbty ↑vs.length) →
    vs.length * 4 ≤ CerbMem.sizeofCtype fmapEmpty aty →
      ∀ (ety : integerType),
        (∀ (i : Nat) (hi : i < vs.length) (lum : List (Int × identifier)) (fpm : CerbMem.Funptrmap),
            CerbMem.reconstructValue fmapEmpty lum fpm (a + ↑(4 * i)) CerberusHeapLang.intTy
                (List.take (CerbMem.sizeofCtype fmapEmpty CerberusHeapLang.intTy)
                  (List.drop (4 * i) bs)) =
              CerbMem.MemValue.MVinteger ety (CerbMem.integerIval vs[i])) →
          ∀ (sbty : core_base_type),
            CerberusHeapLang.cellOwn (CerberusHeapLang.procCtx rs).tagDefs id (Iris.DFrac.own 1)
                { addr := a, ty := aty, bytes := bs } ⊢
              WP
                {
                  e :=
                    CerberusHeapLang.arrProg loc ann ra mo sbty ibty accbty pbty xbty
                      (CerberusHeapLang.cellPtr id a) ↑vs.length,
                  ρ := [fmapEmpty], ctl := CerberusHeapLang.procCtl p,
                  M := CerberusHeapLang.procCtx rs } @
                Iris.Stuckness.NotStuck ;
                ⊤ {{
                  w,
                    ∀ σ' ns κs nt,
                      Iris.stateInterp σ' ns κs nt ={⊤,∅}=∗
                        ⌜w.val = CerberusHeapLang.ivVal vs.sum ∧
                            CerberusHeapLang.CellCoh (CerberusHeapLang.procCtx rs).tagDefs σ' id
                              { addr := a, ty := aty, bytes := bs }⌝ }}
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.arr_wps :

theorem CerberusHeapLang.array_sum_certified :
∀ (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ann ra : core_run_annotation) (mo : memory_order)
  (ibty accbty pbty xbty sbty : core_base_type) (vs : List Int) (id a : Int) (aty : ctype)
  (bs : List CerbMem.AbsByte),
  vs.length * 4 ≤ CerbMem.sizeofCtype fmapEmpty aty →
    ∀ (ety : integerType),
      (∀ (i : Nat) (hi : i < vs.length) (lum : List (Int × identifier)) (fpm : CerbMem.Funptrmap),
          CerbMem.reconstructValue fmapEmpty lum fpm (a + ↑(4 * i)) CerberusHeapLang.intTy
              (List.take (CerbMem.sizeofCtype fmapEmpty CerberusHeapLang.intTy)
                (List.drop (4 * i) bs)) =
            CerbMem.MemValue.MVinteger ety (CerbMem.integerIval vs[i])) →
        ∀ (σ₀ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem),
          CerberusHeapLang.Coh fmapEmpty σ₀
              (Iris.Std.PartialMap.singleton id { addr := a, ty := aty, bytes := bs }) →
            have prog :=
              CerberusHeapLang.arrProg loc ann ra mo sbty ibty accbty pbty xbty
                (CerberusHeapLang.cellPtr id a) ↑vs.length;
            have rs := CerberusHeapLang.arrRS loc ann ra mo ibty accbty pbty xbty ↑vs.length;
            CerberusHeapLang.DriverSafeCtl (CerberusHeapLang.procCtx rs)
              (CerberusHeapLang.procThread CerberusHeapLang.arrProcSym prog [fmapEmpty]) prog
              [fmapEmpty] (CerberusHeapLang.procCtl CerberusHeapLang.arrProcSym) σ₀ fun v σ' =>
              v = CerberusHeapLang.ivVal vs.sum ∧
                CerberusHeapLang.CellCoh fmapEmpty σ' id { addr := a, ty := aty, bytes := bs }
----

theorem CerberusHeapLang.aux2_bridge :
∀ {tds : Fmap sym (CerbLocation.Loc × tag_definition)} {ext : Fmap sym sym}
  {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack} {pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym} {v : value},
  CerberusHeapLang.PePure pe →
    CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr tds ext ρ pe = some v →
      CerberusHeapLang.peDepth pe ≤ lemDefaultFuel →
        ∀ (fuel : Nat) (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (cloc : Option CerbLocation.Loc)
          (mem : Option CerbMem.MemState) (file : generic_file Unit core_run_annotation),
          eval_pexpr_aux2_lemFuel (fuel + 1) tds loc cloc ext ρ mem file pe =
            exception_undef_return (Sum.inr v)

theorem CerberusHeapLang.aux2_bridge_kill :
∀ {tds : Fmap sym (CerbLocation.Loc × tag_definition)} {ext : Fmap sym sym}
  {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack} {loc : CerbLocation.Loc}
  {file : generic_file Unit core_run_annotation} {pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym}
  {err : core_run_cause},
  CerberusHeapLang.PePure pe →
    CerberusHeapLang.evalClass tds loc ext file ρ pe = CerberusHeapLang.EvalOut.kill err →
      CerberusHeapLang.peDepth pe ≤ lemDefaultFuel →
        ∀ (fuel : Nat) (cloc : Option CerbLocation.Loc) (mem : Option CerbMem.MemState),
          eval_pexpr_aux2_lemFuel (fuel + 1) tds loc cloc ext ρ mem file pe = exceptM.Exception err
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.bigSepA_ptx :
∀ {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS Iris.HasLC.hasLC GF],
  ([∗map] i ↦ c ∈ CerberusHeapLang.mA, CerberusHeapLang.cellOwn fmapEmpty i (Iris.DFrac.own 1) c) ⊢
    CerberusHeapLang.xPtr ↦c[fmapEmpty]{Iris.DFrac.own 1} CerberusHeapLang.intTy ;
      CerberusHeapLang.bytesX
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.bigSepB_pts :
∀ {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS Iris.HasLC.hasLC GF],
  ([∗map] i ↦ c ∈ CerberusHeapLang.mB, CerberusHeapLang.cellOwn fmapEmpty i (Iris.DFrac.own 1) c) ⊢
    CerberusHeapLang.xPtr ↦c[fmapEmpty]{Iris.DFrac.own 1} CerberusHeapLang.intTy ;
        CerberusHeapLang.bytesX ∗
      CerberusHeapLang.yPtr ↦c[fmapEmpty]{Iris.DFrac.own 1} CerberusHeapLang.intTy ;
        CerberusHeapLang.bytesY
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.bigSepL_consequence :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {mm : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerberusHeapLang.MetaCell}
  {mb : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerbMem.AbsByte} {α : Type u_1} {Φ : α → Iris.IProp GF}
  {ψ : α → Prop},
  (∀ (x : α), Φ x ∗ CerberusHeapLang.metaInterp mm ∗ CerberusHeapLang.byteInterp mb ⊢ ⌜ψ x⌝) →
    ∀ (xs : List α),
      ([∗list] x ∈ xs, Φ x) ∗ CerberusHeapLang.metaInterp mm ∗ CerberusHeapLang.byteInterp mb ⊢
        ⌜∀ (x : α), x ∈ xs → ψ x⌝
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.bigSepM_own_disjoint :
∀ (tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap) {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors}
  [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS Iris.HasLC.hasLC GF] (Q R : CerberusHeapLang.CellMap),
  (([∗map] i ↦ c ∈ Q, CerberusHeapLang.cellOwn tds i (Iris.DFrac.own 1) c) ∗
      [∗map] i ↦ c ∈ R, CerberusHeapLang.cellOwn tds i (Iris.DFrac.own 1) c) ⊢
    ⌜Iris.Std.PartialMap.disjoint Q R⌝
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.bigSepM_rangeMap :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF] (a : Int)
  (bs : List CerbMem.AbsByte),
  ([∗map] k ↦ b ∈ CerberusHeapLang.rangeMap a bs, CerberusHeapLang.byteOwn k (Iris.DFrac.own 1) b) ⊢
    CerberusHeapLang.bytesOwn a (Iris.DFrac.own 1) bs

∀ {a b : Type} (x : a) (f : a → Option b), Lem_Maybe.bind0 (some x) f = f x

theorem CerberusHeapLang.bind_branch_active :
∀ {a b cs err info st : Type} (n : Nat) {m : ndM a info err cs st} {f : a → ndM b info err cs st}
  {s : st},
  (∃ z s', CerberusHeapLang.runOne m s = (NDactive z, s')) →
    (∀ (z : a) (s' : st), ∃ z' s'', CerberusHeapLang.runOne (f z) s' = (NDactive z', s'')) →
      ∃ z' s'', CerberusHeapLang.runOne (nd_bind_lemFuel n.succ m f) s = (NDactive z', s'')

def CerberusHeapLang.blockSpecs :
{hlc : Iris.HasLC} →
  {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} →
    [CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF] →
      CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx →
        Option sym →
          CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpec GF →
            CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpec GF →
              (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF) →
                Iris.IProp GF
----
def CerberusHeapLang.blockSpecsT :
{hlc : Iris.HasLC} →
  {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} →
    [CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF] →
      CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx →
        Option sym →
          CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpecT GF →
            CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpecT GF →
              (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF) →
                Iris.IProp GF
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.blockSpecsT_frame :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p : Option sym} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpecT GF}
  {Θ : CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpecT GF}
  {Ψ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF} (R : Iris.IProp GF),
  CerberusHeapLang.blockSpecsT M p Ls Θ Ψ ⊢
    CerberusHeapLang.blockSpecsT M p (CerberusHeapLang.frameLsT R Ls) Θ fun w ρ' =>
      iprop(Ψ w ρ' ∗ R)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.blockSpecsT_intro :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p : Option sym} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpecT GF}
  {Θ : CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpecT GF}
  {Ψ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF},
  (∀ (l : sym) (params : List (sym × core_base_type)) (cont : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr)
      (vs : List value) (ev0 : Fmap sym value) (evs : List (Fmap sym value)) (m : Nat),
      CerberusHeapLang.lookupLabel (M.labelsAt p) l = some (params, cont) →
        Ls l m vs (ev0 :: evs) ⊢
          CerberusHeapLang.wpt M p Ls Θ m Ψ cont
            (CerberusHeapLang.bindArgs params vs (ev0 :: evs))) →
    ⊢ CerberusHeapLang.blockSpecsT M p Ls Θ Ψ
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.blockSpecsT_mono :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p : Option sym} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpecT GF}
  {Θ : CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpecT GF}
  {Ψ₁ Ψ₂ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF},
  (∀ (w : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal) (ρ' : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack), Ψ₁ w ρ' ⊢ Ψ₂ w ρ') →
    CerberusHeapLang.blockSpecsT M p Ls Θ Ψ₁ ⊢ CerberusHeapLang.blockSpecsT M p Ls Θ Ψ₂
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.blockSpecs_frame :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p : Option sym} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpec GF}
  {Θ : CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpec GF}
  {Ψ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF} (R : Iris.IProp GF),
  CerberusHeapLang.blockSpecs M p Ls Θ Ψ ⊢
    CerberusHeapLang.blockSpecs M p (CerberusHeapLang.frameLs R Ls) Θ fun w ρ' => iprop(Ψ w ρ' ∗ R)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.blockSpecs_intro :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p : Option sym} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpec GF}
  {Θ : CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpec GF}
  {Ψ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF},
  (∀ (l : sym) (params : List (sym × core_base_type)) (cont : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr)
      (vs : List value) (ev0 : Fmap sym value) (evs : List (Fmap sym value)),
      CerberusHeapLang.lookupLabel (M.labelsAt p) l = some (params, cont) →
        Ls l vs (ev0 :: evs) ⊢
          CerberusHeapLang.wps M p Ls Θ Ψ cont (CerberusHeapLang.bindArgs params vs (ev0 :: evs))) →
    ⊢ CerberusHeapLang.blockSpecs M p Ls Θ Ψ
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.blockSpecs_mono :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p : Option sym} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpec GF}
  {Θ : CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpec GF}
  {Ψ₁ Ψ₂ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF},
  (∀ (w : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal) (ρ' : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack), Ψ₁ w ρ' ⊢ Ψ₂ w ρ') →
    CerberusHeapLang.blockSpecs M p Ls Θ Ψ₁ ⊢ CerberusHeapLang.blockSpecs M p Ls Θ Ψ₂

def CerberusHeapLang.budgetAuth :

theorem CerberusHeapLang.budgetAuth_bound :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (B n : Nat), CerberusHeapLang.budgetAuth B ∗ CerberusHeapLang.allocBudget n ⊢ ⌜n ≤ B⌝
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.budgetAuth_consume :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (n m : Nat),
  ⊢
    CerberusHeapLang.budgetAuth (n + m) ∗ CerberusHeapLang.allocBudget n ==∗
      CerberusHeapLang.budgetAuth m
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.budgetAuth_grant :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (B : Nat),
  ⊢ CerberusHeapLang.budgetAuth 0 ==∗ CerberusHeapLang.budgetAuth B ∗ CerberusHeapLang.allocBudget B

  Iris.iOwn CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS.budgetGS.name (●{Iris.DFrac.own 1} 0) ⊢
    CerberusHeapLang.budgetAuth 0

theorem CerberusHeapLang.budgetInit :
∀ {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [E : Iris.ElemG GF (Auth.AuthURF (Iris.constOF Iris.Credit))],
  ⊢ |==> ∃ G, Iris.iOwn G.name (●{Iris.DFrac.own 1} 0)
