def CerberusHeapLang.budgetInterp :
{hlc : Iris.HasLC} →
  {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} →
    [CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF] →
      CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerberusHeapLang.AllocCursor → Iris.IProp GF
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.budgetInterp_iff :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (mk : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerberusHeapLang.AllocCursor),
  CerberusHeapLang.budgetInterp mk ⊣⊢
    ∃ B,
      CerberusHeapLang.budgetAuth B ∗
        (⌜B = 0⌝ ∨
          ∃ c,
            ⌜Iris.Std.get? mk 0 = some c ∧ B ≤ CerberusHeapLang.headroom c.lastAddr⌝ ∗
              CerberusHeapLang.cursorOwn c)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.budgetInterp_intro :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (mk : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerberusHeapLang.AllocCursor) (c : CerberusHeapLang.AllocCursor)
  (B : Nat),
  Iris.Std.get? mk 0 = some c →
    B ≤ CerberusHeapLang.headroom c.lastAddr →
      CerberusHeapLang.budgetAuth B ∗ CerberusHeapLang.cursorOwn c ⊢
        CerberusHeapLang.budgetInterp mk
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.budgetInterp_zero :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (mk : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerberusHeapLang.AllocCursor),
  CerberusHeapLang.budgetAuth 0 ⊢ CerberusHeapLang.budgetInterp mk
----
def CerberusHeapLang.byteAt :
CerberusHeapLang.Mem → Int → CerbMem.AbsByte
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.byteAt_of_readBytesFrom :
∀ (σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem) (a : Int) (n : Nat) (bs : List CerbMem.AbsByte),
  CerbMem.readBytesFrom σ a n = bs →
    ∀ (j : Nat), j < n → CerberusHeapLang.byteAt σ (a + ↑j) = bs[j]?.getD CerberusHeapLang.undefByte
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.byteAt_writeBytesTo_in :
∀ (σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem) (a : Int) (bs : List CerbMem.AbsByte) (k : Int) (h1 : a ≤ k)
  (h2 : k < a + ↑bs.length),
  CerberusHeapLang.byteAt (CerbMem.writeBytesTo σ a bs) k = bs[(k - a).toNat]
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.byteAt_writeBytesTo_out :
∀ (σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem) (a : Int) (bs : List CerbMem.AbsByte) (k : Int),
  ¬(a ≤ k ∧ k < a + ↑bs.length) →
    CerberusHeapLang.byteAt (CerbMem.writeBytesTo σ a bs) k = CerberusHeapLang.byteAt σ k
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.byteHeap_alloc_big :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {mb : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerbMem.AbsByte}
  (mbnew : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerbMem.AbsByte),
  Iris.Std.PartialMap.disjoint mbnew mb →
    ⊢
      CerberusHeapLang.byteInterp mb ==∗
        CerberusHeapLang.byteInterp (Iris.Std.PartialMap.union mbnew mb) ∗
          [∗map] k ↦ b ∈ mbnew, CerberusHeapLang.byteOwn k (Iris.DFrac.own 1) b
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.byteHeap_update :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {mb : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerbMem.AbsByte} {k : Int} {b : CerbMem.AbsByte}
  (b' : CerbMem.AbsByte),
  ⊢
    CerberusHeapLang.byteInterp mb ∗ CerberusHeapLang.byteOwn k (Iris.DFrac.own 1) b ==∗
      CerberusHeapLang.byteInterp (Iris.Std.insert mb k b') ∗
        CerberusHeapLang.byteOwn k (Iris.DFrac.own 1) b'
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.byteHeap_valid :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {mb : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerbMem.AbsByte} {k : Int} {dq : Iris.DFrac}
  {b : CerbMem.AbsByte},
  ⊢
    CerberusHeapLang.byteInterp mb ∗ CerberusHeapLang.byteOwn k dq b ==∗
      ⌜Iris.Std.get? mb k = some b⌝
----
def CerberusHeapLang.byteInterp :
{hlc : Iris.HasLC} →
  {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} →
    [CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF] → CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerbMem.AbsByte → Iris.IProp GF

def CerberusHeapLang.byteOwn :
{hlc : Iris.HasLC} →
  {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} →
    [CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF] → Int → Iris.DFrac → CerbMem.AbsByte → Iris.IProp GF
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.byteOwn_agree :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF] (k : Int)
  (dq₁ dq₂ : Iris.DFrac) (b₁ b₂ : CerbMem.AbsByte),
  CerberusHeapLang.byteOwn k dq₁ b₁ ∗ CerberusHeapLang.byteOwn k dq₂ b₂ ⊢ ⌜b₁ = b₂⌝
----
def CerberusHeapLang.bytesOwn :
{hlc : Iris.HasLC} →
  {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} →
    [CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF] → Int → Iris.DFrac → List CerbMem.AbsByte → Iris.IProp GF
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.bytesOwn_agree :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF] (a : Int)
  (dq₁ dq₂ : Iris.DFrac) (bs₁ bs₂ : List CerbMem.AbsByte),
  bs₁.length = bs₂.length →
    CerberusHeapLang.bytesOwn a dq₁ bs₁ ∗ CerberusHeapLang.bytesOwn a dq₂ bs₂ ⊢ ⌜bs₁ = bs₂⌝
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.bytesOwn_append :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF] (a : Int)
  (dq : Iris.DFrac) (bs₁ bs₂ : List CerbMem.AbsByte),
  CerberusHeapLang.bytesOwn a dq (bs₁ ++ bs₂) ⊣⊢
    CerberusHeapLang.bytesOwn a dq bs₁ ∗ CerberusHeapLang.bytesOwn (a + ↑bs₁.length) dq bs₂
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.bytesOwn_cons :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF] (a : Int)
  (dq : Iris.DFrac) (b : CerbMem.AbsByte) (bs : List CerbMem.AbsByte),
  CerberusHeapLang.bytesOwn a dq (b :: bs) =
    iprop(CerberusHeapLang.byteOwn a dq b ∗ CerberusHeapLang.bytesOwn (a + 1) dq bs)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.bytesOwn_fractional :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF] (a : Int)
  (q₁ q₂ : Iris.Qp) (bs : List CerbMem.AbsByte),
  CerberusHeapLang.bytesOwn a (Iris.DFrac.own (q₁ + q₂)) bs ⊣⊢
    CerberusHeapLang.bytesOwn a (Iris.DFrac.own q₁) bs ∗
      CerberusHeapLang.bytesOwn a (Iris.DFrac.own q₂) bs
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.bytesOwn_get :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (mb : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerbMem.AbsByte) (a : Int) (dq : Iris.DFrac)
  (bs : List CerbMem.AbsByte),
  CerberusHeapLang.byteInterp mb ∗ CerberusHeapLang.bytesOwn a dq bs ⊢
    ⌜∀ (j : Nat), j < bs.length → Iris.Std.get? mb (a + ↑j) = bs[j]?⌝
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.bytesOwn_nil :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF] (a : Int)
  (dq : Iris.DFrac), CerberusHeapLang.bytesOwn a dq [] = iprop(emp)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.bytesOwn_read :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem} {mm : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerberusHeapLang.MetaCell}
  {mb : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerbMem.AbsByte}
  {mk : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerberusHeapLang.AllocCursor},
  CerberusHeapLang.CohG σ mm mb mk →
    ∀ (a : Int) (dq : Iris.DFrac) (bs : List CerbMem.AbsByte),
      CerberusHeapLang.byteInterp mb ∗ CerberusHeapLang.bytesOwn a dq bs ⊢
        ⌜CerbMem.readBytesFrom σ a bs.length = bs⌝
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.bytesOwn_update :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (mb : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerbMem.AbsByte) (a : Int) (bs bs' : List CerbMem.AbsByte),
  bs'.length = bs.length →
    ⊢
      CerberusHeapLang.byteInterp mb ∗ CerberusHeapLang.bytesOwn a (Iris.DFrac.own 1) bs ==∗
        CerberusHeapLang.byteInterp (CerberusHeapLang.insertRange mb a bs') ∗
          CerberusHeapLang.bytesOwn a (Iris.DFrac.own 1) bs'
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.bytesToInt_go_cons :
∀ (p : CerbMem.Provenance) (c : Option Int) (v : UInt8) (rest : List CerbMem.AbsByte) (i : Nat)
  (acc : Int),
  CerbMem.bytesToInt.go ({ prov := p, copyOffset := c, value := some v } :: rest) i acc =
    CerbMem.bytesToInt.go rest (i + 1) (acc + ↑v.toNat <<< (i * 8))

theorem CerberusHeapLang.bytesToInt_go_nil :
∀ (i : Nat) (acc : Int), CerbMem.bytesToInt.go [] i acc = acc

theorem CerberusHeapLang.bytesToInt_of_all_some :
∀ (bs : List CerbMem.AbsByte),
  (bs.any fun x => x.value.isNone) = false →
    CerbMem.bytesToInt bs false = some (CerbMem.bytesToInt.go bs 0 0)

  0 ≤ a →
    a < 2 ^ 64 →
      CerbMem.bytesToInt (CerberusHeapLang.ptrImg (CerberusHeapLang.cellPtr id a)) false = some a

def CerberusHeapLang.callRedex :

def CerberusHeapLang.callRedex? :
CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr → Option (context × sym × List (generic_pexpr Unit sym))
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.callRedex?.eq_def :
∀ (x : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr),
  CerberusHeapLang.callRedex? x =
    match x with
    | generic_expr.Expr a (Eproc a_1 (Sym f) pes) => some (CTX, f, pes)
    | generic_expr.Expr a (Esseq pat e1 e2) =>
      Option.map (fun q => (Csseq a pat q.fst e2, q.snd)) (CerberusHeapLang.callRedex? e1)
    | generic_expr.Expr a (Ewseq pat e1 e2) =>
      Option.map (fun q => (Cwseq a pat q.fst e2, q.snd)) (CerberusHeapLang.callRedex? e1)
    | generic_expr.Expr a (Eannot ds b) =>
      if CerberusHeapLang.annotRooted b = true then none
      else Option.map (fun q => (Cannot a ds q.fst, q.snd)) (CerberusHeapLang.callRedex? b)
    | x => none
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.callRedex?_action :
∀ (a : List annot) (p : generic_paction core_run_annotation Unit sym),
  CerberusHeapLang.callRedex? (generic_expr.Expr a (Eaction p)) = none
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.callRedex?_annot :
∀ (a : List annot) (ds : List dyn_annotation) (b : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr),
  CerberusHeapLang.callRedex? (generic_expr.Expr a (Eannot ds b)) =
    if CerberusHeapLang.annotRooted b = true then none
    else Option.map (fun q => (Cannot a ds q.fst, q.snd)) (CerberusHeapLang.callRedex? b)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.callRedex?_annot_none :
∀ {a : List annot} {ds : List dyn_annotation} {b : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr},
  CerberusHeapLang.callRedex? b = none →
    CerberusHeapLang.callRedex? (generic_expr.Expr a (Eannot ds b)) = none

    CerberusHeapLang.callRedex? (generic_expr.Expr a (Eannot ds b)) =

theorem CerberusHeapLang.call_proc_arity :
∀ {file : generic_file Unit core_run_annotation} {ext : Fmap sym sym} {f : sym}
  {params : List (sym × core_base_type)} {body : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {vs : List value},
  CerberusHeapLang.lookupProc file ext f = some (params, body) →
    params.length ≠ vs.length →
      call_proc ext file f vs =
        fail0
          (Illformed_program
            ("calling procedure `".append
              ((show_symbol f).append
                ("' with the wrong number of args: |args|=".append
                  ((Lem_String_extra.stringFromNat vs.length).append
                    ("expecting: ".append (Lem_String_extra.stringFromNat params.length)))))))
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.call_proc_eq :
∀ (ext : Fmap sym sym) (file : generic_file Unit core_run_annotation) (f : sym) (vs : List value),
  call_proc ext file f vs =
    match CerberusHeapLang.lookupProc file ext f with
    | some (params, body) =>
      if (!params.length == vs.length) = true then
        fail0
          (Illformed_program
            ("calling procedure `".append
              ((show_symbol f).append
                ("' with the wrong number of args: |args|=".append
                  ((Lem_String_extra.stringFromNat vs.length).append
                    ("expecting: ".append (Lem_String_extra.stringFromNat params.length)))))))
      else except_return (CerberusHeapLang.procEnv params vs, body)
    | none => fail0 (Illformed_program ("calling an unknown procedure: ".append (show_symbol f)))
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.call_proc_of_lookupProc :
∀ {file : generic_file Unit core_run_annotation} {ext : Fmap sym sym} {f : sym}
  {params : List (sym × core_base_type)} {body : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {vs : List value},
  CerberusHeapLang.lookupProc file ext f = some (params, body) →
    params.length = vs.length →
      call_proc ext file f vs = except_return (CerberusHeapLang.procEnv params vs, body)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.call_proc_unknown :
∀ {file : generic_file Unit core_run_annotation} {ext : Fmap sym sym} {f : sym} {vs : List value},
  CerberusHeapLang.lookupProc file ext f = none →
    call_proc ext file f vs =
      fail0 (Illformed_program ("calling an unknown procedure: ".append (show_symbol f)))
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.call_smoke_engine :
∀ (ra : core_run_annotation) (bty ybty : core_base_type) (σ₀ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem),
  CerberusHeapLang.DriverSafeCtl (CerberusHeapLang.csCtx ra bty ybty)
    ((CerberusHeapLang.csCtx ra bty ybty).thread (CerberusHeapLang.csMainBody ra) [fmapEmpty]
      { κ := [], proc := some CerberusHeapLang.csMain, execLoc := default })
    (CerberusHeapLang.csMainBody ra) [fmapEmpty]
    { κ := [], proc := some CerberusHeapLang.csMain, execLoc := default } σ₀ fun v x =>
    v = CerberusHeapLang.csInt 4

  ⊢
    CerberusHeapLang.blockSpecs CerberusHeapLang.spikeCtx none CerberusHeapLang.caseLs

  CerberusHeapLang.DriverSafeCtl CerberusHeapLang.spikeCtx
    (CerberusHeapLang.spikeThread (CerberusHeapLang.caseProg v)) (CerberusHeapLang.caseProg v)
    CerberusHeapLang.spikeEnv CerberusHeapLang.spikeCtl σ₀ fun v' x => v' = v

def CerberusHeapLang.cellOwn :
{hlc : Iris.HasLC} →
  {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} →
    [CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF] →
      CerbTags.TagDefsMap → Int → Iris.DFrac → CerberusHeapLang.SpikeCell → Iris.IProp GF

theorem CerberusHeapLang.cellOwn_cellCoh :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem} {mm : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerberusHeapLang.MetaCell}
  {mb : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerbMem.AbsByte}
  {mk : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerberusHeapLang.AllocCursor} (tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap),
  CerberusHeapLang.CohG σ mm mb mk →
    ∀ (i : Int) (dq : Iris.DFrac) (c : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeCell),
      CerberusHeapLang.metaInterp mm ∗
          CerberusHeapLang.byteInterp mb ∗ CerberusHeapLang.cellOwn tds i dq c ⊢
        ⌜CerberusHeapLang.CellCoh tds σ i c ∧
            Iris.Std.get? mm i = some (CerberusHeapLang.metaOf tds c)⌝
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.cellOwn_consequence :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {mm : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerberusHeapLang.MetaCell}
  {mb : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerbMem.AbsByte} {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem}
  {mk : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerberusHeapLang.AllocCursor},
  CerberusHeapLang.CohG σ mm mb mk →
    ∀ (tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap) (i : Int) (dq : Iris.DFrac) (c : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeCell),
      CerberusHeapLang.cellOwn tds i dq c ∗
          CerberusHeapLang.metaInterp mm ∗ CerberusHeapLang.byteInterp mb ⊢
        ⌜CerberusHeapLang.CellCoh tds σ i c⌝
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.cellOwn_fractional :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap) (i : Int) (q₁ q₂ : Iris.Qp) (c : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeCell),
  CerberusHeapLang.cellOwn tds i (Iris.DFrac.own (q₁ + q₂)) c ⊣⊢
    CerberusHeapLang.cellOwn tds i (Iris.DFrac.own q₁) c ∗
      CerberusHeapLang.cellOwn tds i (Iris.DFrac.own q₂) c
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.cellOwn_iff :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap) (i : Int) (dq : Iris.DFrac) (c : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeCell),
  CerberusHeapLang.cellOwn tds i dq c ⊣⊢
    CerberusHeapLang.metaOwn i dq (CerberusHeapLang.metaOf tds c) ∗
      CerberusHeapLang.bytesOwn c.addr dq c.bytes ∗
        ⌜c.bytes.length = CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds c.ty ∧
            CerberusHeapLang.decIndep tds c.addr c.ty c.bytes⌝
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.cellOwn_readout :
∀ (tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap) {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors}
  [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF] (i : Int) (dq : Iris.DFrac)
  (c : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeCell),
  CerberusHeapLang.cellOwn tds i dq c ⊢
    ∀ σ' ns κs nt, Iris.stateInterp σ' ns κs nt ={⊤,∅}=∗ ⌜CerberusHeapLang.CellCoh tds σ' i c⌝

theorem CerberusHeapLang.cellOwn_view :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap) (i : Int) (dq : Iris.DFrac) (c : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeCell),
  CerberusHeapLang.cellOwn tds i dq c ⊣⊢
    CerberusHeapLang.pointsToView tds i c.addr c.ty 0 dq dq c.ty c.bytes ∗
      ⌜CerberusHeapLang.decIndep tds c.addr c.ty c.bytes⌝

theorem CerberusHeapLang.cellPtr_arrayShift :
∀ (tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap) (id a : Int) (ty : ctype) (k : Int),
  (∀ (q : List annot), ty ≠ Ctype q Void0) →
    CerbMem.arrayShiftPtrval tds (CerberusHeapLang.cellPtr id a) ty (CerbMem.integerIval k) =
      CerberusHeapLang.cellPtr id (a + k * ↑(CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds ty))

theorem CerberusHeapLang.cell_read_shared_wps :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p : Option sym} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpec GF}
  {Θ : CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpec GF} (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ann : core_run_annotation)
  (pv : CerbMem.PointerValue) (mo : memory_order) (bs bs' : List CerbMem.AbsByte)
  (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack),
  CerberusHeapLang.cellLoadTrap M.tagDefs
        { addr := CerberusHeapLang.addrOf pv, ty := CerberusHeapLang.intTy, bytes := bs } =
      false →
    pv ↦c[M.tagDefs]{Iris.DFrac.own (Iris.Qp.half 1)} CerberusHeapLang.intTy ; bs ∗
        pv ↦c[M.tagDefs]{Iris.DFrac.own (Iris.Qp.half 1)} CerberusHeapLang.intTy ; bs' ⊢
      CerberusHeapLang.wps M p Ls Θ
        (fun w x =>
          iprop(⌜∃ fp,
                  w =
                    CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.annot [DA_pos [] fp]
                      (CerberusHeapLang.loadedVal M.tagDefs pv CerberusHeapLang.intTy bs)⌝ ∗
              pv ↦c[M.tagDefs]{Iris.DFrac.own 1} CerberusHeapLang.intTy ; bs))
        (CerberusHeapLang.loadExpr loc ann CerberusHeapLang.intTy pv mo) ρ

theorem CerberusHeapLang.cells_consequence :
∀ {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS Iris.HasLC.hasLC GF]
  {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem} {mm : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerberusHeapLang.MetaCell}
  {mb : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerbMem.AbsByte}
  {mk : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerberusHeapLang.AllocCursor},
  CerberusHeapLang.CohG σ mm mb mk →
    ∀ (tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap) (post : value → CerberusHeapLang.CellMap → Prop)
      (R : CerberusHeapLang.CellMap) (vv : value),
      ((∃ Q, ⌜post vv Q⌝ ∗ [∗map] i ↦ c ∈ Q, CerberusHeapLang.cellOwn tds i (Iris.DFrac.own 1) c) ∗
            [∗map] i ↦ c ∈ R, CerberusHeapLang.cellOwn tds i (Iris.DFrac.own 1) c) ∗
          CerberusHeapLang.metaInterp mm ∗ CerberusHeapLang.byteInterp mb ⊢
        ⌜∃ Q,
            post vv Q ∧
              Iris.Std.PartialMap.disjoint Q R ∧
                CerberusHeapLang.Coh tds σ (Iris.Std.PartialMap.union Q R)⌝

CerberusHeapLang.cellsDisjoint fmapEmpty CerberusHeapLang.cellY CerberusHeapLang.cellX

theorem CerberusHeapLang.cells_readout :
∀ (tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap) {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors}
  [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS Iris.HasLC.hasLC GF]
  (post : value → CerberusHeapLang.CellMap → Prop) (R : CerberusHeapLang.CellMap) (vv : value),
  ((∃ Q, ⌜post vv Q⌝ ∗ [∗map] i ↦ c ∈ Q, CerberusHeapLang.cellOwn tds i (Iris.DFrac.own 1) c) ∗
      [∗map] i ↦ c ∈ R, CerberusHeapLang.cellOwn tds i (Iris.DFrac.own 1) c) ⊢
    ∀ σ' ns κs nt,
      Iris.stateInterp σ' ns κs nt ={⊤,∅}=∗
        ⌜∃ Q,
            post vv Q ∧
              Iris.Std.PartialMap.disjoint Q R ∧
                CerberusHeapLang.Coh tds σ' (Iris.Std.PartialMap.union Q R)⌝

theorem CerberusHeapLang.cells_to_mC :
∀ {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS Iris.HasLC.hasLC GF],
  CerberusHeapLang.xPtr ↦c[fmapEmpty]{Iris.DFrac.own 1} CerberusHeapLang.intTy ;
        CerberusHeapLang.fiveBytes fmapEmpty ∗
      CerberusHeapLang.yPtr ↦c[fmapEmpty]{Iris.DFrac.own 1} CerberusHeapLang.intTy ;
        CerberusHeapLang.sixBytes fmapEmpty ⊢
    [∗map] i ↦ c ∈ CerberusHeapLang.mC, CerberusHeapLang.cellOwn fmapEmpty i (Iris.DFrac.own 1) c

theorem CerberusHeapLang.col_aux_sseq :
∀ {A : Type} (n : Nat) (st : collect_saves_state A) (a : List annot) (pat : pattern)
  (e1 e2 : generic_expr A Unit sym),
  collect_saves_aux_lemFuel (n + 1) st (generic_expr.Expr a (Esseq pat e1 e2)) =
    union_saves st
      (union_saves
        (have __src := collect_saves_aux_lemFuel n empty_saves e1;
        {
          tmp_acc :=
            fmapMap
              (fun p =>
                match p with
                | (syms, e) => (syms, generic_expr.Expr a (Esseq pat e e2)))
              (collect_saves_aux_lemFuel n empty_saves e1).tmp_acc,
          closed_acc := __src.closed_acc })
        (collect_saves_aux_lemFuel n empty_saves e2))
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.col_dlProdSave :
∀ (m : Nat) (ra : core_run_annotation) (mo : memory_order)
  (sbty cbty bbty nbty ubty : core_base_type),
  collect_saves_aux_lemFuel (m + 9) empty_saves
      (generic_expr.Expr []
        (Esave (CerberusHeapLang.dlLoopSym, sbty) (CerberusHeapLang.dlProdParams cbty)
          (CerberusHeapLang.dlBody CerberusHeapLang.loc0 empty_annotation ra mo bbty nbty ubty))) =
    {
      tmp_acc :=

    CerberusHeapLang.esize e ≤ lemDefaultFuel →
      valueFromPexprs [pe2, pe3] = none →
        CerberusHeapLang.PePure pe2 →
          CerberusHeapLang.PePure pe3 →
            CerberusHeapLang.peDepth pe2 ≤ lemDefaultFuel →
              CerberusHeapLang.peDepth pe3 ≤ lemDefaultFuel →
                ∀ (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack) (ctl : CerberusHeapLang.Ctl)
                  (σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem), CerberusHeapLang.RoundComplete M (e, ρ, ctl, σ)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.complete_wbeta_annot :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {e : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {ctx : context}
  {pa : List annot} {bty : core_base_type} {ds : List dyn_annotation} {v : value}
  {e2 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr},
  CerberusHeapLang.Decomp e ctx
      (generic_expr.Expr []
        (Ewseq (Pattern pa (CaseBase (none, bty)))
          (CerberusHeapLang.ofVal (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.annot ds v)) e2)) →
    ∀ (ev0 : Fmap sym value) (evs : List (Fmap sym value)) (ctl : CerberusHeapLang.Ctl)
      (σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem), CerberusHeapLang.RoundComplete M (e, ev0 :: evs, ctl, σ)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.complete_wbeta_pure :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {e : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {ctx : context}
  {pa : List annot} {bty : core_base_type} {v : value} {e2 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr},
  CerberusHeapLang.Decomp e ctx
      (generic_expr.Expr []
        (Ewseq (Pattern pa (CaseBase (none, bty)))
          (CerberusHeapLang.ofVal (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.pure v)) e2)) →
    ∀ (ev0 : Fmap sym value) (evs : List (Fmap sym value)) (ctl : CerberusHeapLang.Ctl)
      (σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem), CerberusHeapLang.RoundComplete M (e, ev0 :: evs, ctl, σ)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.consequences_intro :
∀ {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} {Φ : Iris.IProp GF} {H : Prop → Prop},
  (∀ (ψ : Prop), H ψ → Φ ⊢ ⌜ψ⌝) → Φ ⊢ ⌜∀ (ψ : Prop), H ψ → ψ⌝

theorem CerberusHeapLang.contains_cons_int :
∀ (b : Int) (l : List Int) (a : Int), (b :: l).contains a = true → a = b ∨ l.contains a = true

theorem CerberusHeapLang.contains_cons_ne_int :
∀ (b : Int) (l : List Int) (a : Int), a ≠ b → (b :: l).contains a = l.contains a

theorem CerberusHeapLang.counter_loop_certified :
∀ (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ann ra : core_run_annotation) (mo : memory_order)
  (bty xbty sbty : core_base_type) (idx addr : Int) (bs0 : List CerbMem.AbsByte) (n : Int),
  0 ≤ n →
    ∀ (σ₀ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem),
      CerberusHeapLang.Coh fmapEmpty σ₀
          (Iris.Std.PartialMap.singleton idx
            { addr := addr, ty := CerberusHeapLang.intTy, bytes := bs0 }) →
        have prog :=
          CerberusHeapLang.loopProg loc ann ra mo bty xbty sbty (CerberusHeapLang.cellPtr idx addr)
            n;
        have rs :=
          CerberusHeapLang.loopRS loc ann ra mo bty xbty (CerberusHeapLang.cellPtr idx addr);
        CerberusHeapLang.DriverSafeCtl (CerberusHeapLang.procCtx rs)
          (CerberusHeapLang.procThread CerberusHeapLang.loopProcSym prog [fmapEmpty]) prog
          [fmapEmpty] (CerberusHeapLang.procCtl CerberusHeapLang.loopProcSym) σ₀ fun v σ' =>
          v = Vunit ∧
            ∃ bs',
              (n = 0 ∧ bs' = bs0 ∨ 0 < n ∧ bs' = CerberusHeapLang.sevenBytes fmapEmpty) ∧
                CerberusHeapLang.CellCoh fmapEmpty σ' idx
                  { addr := addr, ty := CerberusHeapLang.intTy, bytes := bs' }
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.counter_loop_certified_irrelevant_binding :
∀ (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ann ra : core_run_annotation) (mo : memory_order)
  (bty xbty sbty : core_base_type) (idx addr : Int) (bs0 : List CerbMem.AbsByte) (n : Int),
  0 ≤ n →
    ∀ (junk : value) (σ₀ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem),
      CerberusHeapLang.Coh fmapEmpty σ₀
          (Iris.Std.PartialMap.singleton idx
            { addr := addr, ty := CerberusHeapLang.intTy, bytes := bs0 }) →
        have prog :=
          CerberusHeapLang.loopProg loc ann ra mo bty xbty sbty (CerberusHeapLang.cellPtr idx addr)
            n;
        have rs :=
          CerberusHeapLang.loopRS loc ann ra mo bty xbty (CerberusHeapLang.cellPtr idx addr);
        have ρ₀ := [CerberusHeapLang.envAdd CerberusHeapLang.ySym junk fmapEmpty];
        CerberusHeapLang.DriverSafeCtl (CerberusHeapLang.procCtx rs)
          (CerberusHeapLang.procThread CerberusHeapLang.loopProcSym prog ρ₀) prog ρ₀
          (CerberusHeapLang.procCtl CerberusHeapLang.loopProcSym) σ₀ fun v σ' =>
          v = Vunit ∧
            ∃ bs',
              (n = 0 ∧ bs' = bs0 ∨ 0 < n ∧ bs' = CerberusHeapLang.sevenBytes fmapEmpty) ∧
                CerberusHeapLang.CellCoh fmapEmpty σ' idx
                  { addr := addr, ty := CerberusHeapLang.intTy, bytes := bs' }
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.counter_loop_certified_production :
∀ (sup : Nat) (ra : core_run_annotation) (mo : memory_order) (bty xbty cbty sbty : core_base_type)
  (n : Int),
  0 ≤ n →
    6 * n.toNat + 8 ≤ CerbFuel.driverFuel →
      ∀ (fs : CerbFS.FsState) (args : List String),
        ∃ dres dst',
          CerbND.runND
                (drive fmapEmpty false
                  (CerberusHeapLang.prodFile
                    (CerberusHeapLang.counterProdProg ra mo bty xbty cbty sbty n))
                  args)
                (initial_driver_state sup
                    (CerberusHeapLang.prodFile
                      (CerberusHeapLang.counterProdProg ra mo bty xbty cbty sbty n))
                    fs).fst =
              [(Active dres, [], dst')] ∧
            dres.dres_core_value = Vunit ∧
              (∃ i a bs',
                  (n = 0 ∧ bs' = CerberusHeapLang.intUndefBytes fmapEmpty ∨
                      0 < n ∧ bs' = CerberusHeapLang.sevenBytes fmapEmpty) ∧
                    CerberusHeapLang.CellCoh fmapEmpty dst'.layout_state i
                      { addr := a, ty := CerberusHeapLang.intTy, bytes := bs' }) ∧
                dres.dres_blocked = false ∧ dres.dres_stdout = "" ∧ dres.dres_stderr = ""
----

theorem CerberusHeapLang.create_atomic :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {ctl : CerberusHeapLang.Ctl} (loc : CerbLocation.Loc)
  (ann : core_run_annotation) (aprov : CerbMem.Provenance) (alignN : Int) (ty : ctype)
  (pref : prefix0) (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack),
  0 < CerbMem.sizeofCtype M.tagDefs ty →
    CerberusHeapLang.atomicTy ty = false →
      (∀ (a : Int),
          CerberusHeapLang.decIndep M.tagDefs a ty
            (List.replicate (CerbMem.sizeofCtype M.tagDefs ty) CerberusHeapLang.undefByte)) →
        CerberusHeapLang.AtomicStep M ctl
          (CerberusHeapLang.createExpr loc ann (CerbMem.IntegerValue.IV aprov alignN) ty pref) ρ 1
          (CerberusHeapLang.allocBudget (CerberusHeapLang.allocCost M.tagDefs ty alignN)) fun w =>
          iprop(∃ p,
              ⌜w = CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.pure (Vobject (OVpointer p))⌝ ∗
                p ↦c[M.tagDefs]{Iris.DFrac.own 1} ty ;
                    List.replicate (CerbMem.sizeofCtype M.tagDefs ty) CerberusHeapLang.undefByte ∗
                  ⌜0 < CerberusHeapLang.addrOf p ∧ CerberusHeapLang.addrOf p < 2 ^ 64⌝)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.create_fresh_global :
∀ (tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap) (σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem) (alignN : Int) (ty : ctype),
  CerberusHeapLang.MemWF σ →
    0 < CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds ty →
      CerberusHeapLang.freshBase σ.lastAddress alignN (CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds ty) ≠ 0 →
        σ.allocations.get? σ.nextAllocId = none ∧
          σ.deadAllocations.contains σ.nextAllocId = false ∧
            ∀ (id : Int) (al : CerbMem.Allocation),
              σ.allocations.get? id = some al →
                CerberusHeapLang.freshBase σ.lastAddress alignN (CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds ty) +
                    ↑(CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds ty) ≤
                  al.base

  (n : Int),
  CerberusHeapLang.LabeledAt

          (CerberusHeapLang.prodFile
            (CerberusHeapLang.counterProdProg ra mo bty xbty cbty sbty n)))).fst
    CerberusHeapLang.mainSym (CerberusHeapLang.ctrQ ra mo bty xbty cbty)

theorem CerberusHeapLang.ctrProd_wpt :
∀ {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS Iris.HasLC.hasLC GF]
  (ra : core_run_annotation) (mo : memory_order) (bty xbty cbty : core_base_type) (n : Int)
  (p : sym) (rs : core_run_state),
  CerberusHeapLang.LabeledAt rs p (CerberusHeapLang.ctrQ ra mo bty xbty cbty) →
    ∀ (sbty : core_base_type),
      0 ≤ n →
        ∀ (ev0 : Fmap sym value) (evs : List (Fmap sym value)),
          CerberusHeapLang.SymFrame ev0 →
            CerberusHeapLang.allocBudget
                (CerberusHeapLang.allocCost (CerberusHeapLang.procCtx rs).tagDefs
                  CerberusHeapLang.intTy 4) ⊢
              CerberusHeapLang.wpt (CerberusHeapLang.procCtx rs) (some p)
                (CerberusHeapLang.ctrLsT n) CerberusHeapLang.emptyProcSpecT
                (2 +
                  (CerberusHeapLang.ctrCost n.toNat +
                    CerberusHeapLang.saveEntryCost (CerberusHeapLang.ctrParams xbty cbty n)))
                (CerberusHeapLang.readoutPost (CerberusHeapLang.ψC n))
                (CerberusHeapLang.counterProdProg ra mo bty xbty cbty sbty n) (ev0 :: evs)

theorem CerberusHeapLang.ctrQ_inv :
∀ (ra : core_run_annotation) (mo : memory_order) (bty xbty cbty : core_base_type) {l : sym}

  CerberusHeapLang.lookupLabel (CerberusHeapLang.ctrQ ra mo bty xbty cbty) l = some (params, cont) →
    params = [(CerberusHeapLang.ctrXSym, xbty), (CerberusHeapLang.ctrCSym, cbty)] ∧
      cont = CerberusHeapLang.ctrBody ra mo bty

theorem CerberusHeapLang.ctr_blockSpecsT :
∀ {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS Iris.HasLC.hasLC GF]
  (ra : core_run_annotation) (mo : memory_order) (bty xbty cbty : core_base_type) (n : Int)

  CerberusHeapLang.LabeledAt rs p (CerberusHeapLang.ctrQ ra mo bty xbty cbty) →
    ⊢
      CerberusHeapLang.blockSpecsT (CerberusHeapLang.procCtx rs) (some p)
        (CerberusHeapLang.ctrLsT n) CerberusHeapLang.emptyProcSpecT
        (CerberusHeapLang.readoutPost (CerberusHeapLang.ψC n))

theorem CerberusHeapLang.ctr_body_wpt :
∀ {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS Iris.HasLC.hasLC GF]
  (ra : core_run_annotation) (mo : memory_order) (bty xbty cbty : core_base_type) (n : Int)
  (p : sym) (rs : core_run_state),
  CerberusHeapLang.LabeledAt rs p (CerberusHeapLang.ctrQ ra mo bty xbty cbty) →
    ∀ (i : Int) (pptr : CerbMem.PointerValue) (bs : List CerbMem.AbsByte) (f : Fmap sym value)
      (rest : List (Fmap sym value)),
      CerberusHeapLang.SymFrame f →
        0 ≤ i →
          i ≤ n →
            i = n ∧ bs = CerberusHeapLang.intUndefBytes fmapEmpty ∨
                i < n ∧ bs = CerberusHeapLang.sevenBytes (CerberusHeapLang.procCtx rs).tagDefs →
              pptr ↦c[(CerberusHeapLang.procCtx rs).tagDefs]{Iris.DFrac.own 1}
                  CerberusHeapLang.intTy ; bs ⊢
                CerberusHeapLang.wpt (CerberusHeapLang.procCtx rs) (some p)
                  (CerberusHeapLang.ctrLsT n) CerberusHeapLang.emptyProcSpecT
                  (CerberusHeapLang.ctrCost i.toNat)
                  (CerberusHeapLang.readoutPost (CerberusHeapLang.ψC n))
                  (CerberusHeapLang.ctrBody ra mo bty)
                  (CerberusHeapLang.ctrFrame (CerberusHeapLang.ivVal i)
                      (CerberusHeapLang.ptrVal pptr) f ::
                    rest)

theorem CerberusHeapLang.cursorHeap_alloc :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {mk : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerberusHeapLang.AllocCursor}
  (c : CerberusHeapLang.AllocCursor),
  Iris.Std.get? mk 0 = none →
    ⊢
      CerberusHeapLang.cursorInterp mk ==∗
        CerberusHeapLang.cursorInterp (Iris.Std.insert mk 0 c) ∗ CerberusHeapLang.cursorOwn c

theorem CerberusHeapLang.cursorHeap_update :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {mk : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerberusHeapLang.AllocCursor} {c : CerberusHeapLang.AllocCursor}
  (c' : CerberusHeapLang.AllocCursor),
  ⊢
    CerberusHeapLang.cursorInterp mk ∗ CerberusHeapLang.cursorOwn c ==∗
      CerberusHeapLang.cursorInterp (Iris.Std.insert mk 0 c') ∗ CerberusHeapLang.cursorOwn c'
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.cursorHeap_valid :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {mk : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerberusHeapLang.AllocCursor}
  {c : CerberusHeapLang.AllocCursor},
  ⊢
    CerberusHeapLang.cursorInterp mk ∗ CerberusHeapLang.cursorOwn c ==∗
      ⌜Iris.Std.get? mk 0 = some c⌝

theorem CerberusHeapLang.deadObj_consequence :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {mm : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerberusHeapLang.MetaCell}
  {mb : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerbMem.AbsByte} {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem}
  {mk : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerberusHeapLang.AllocCursor},
  CerberusHeapLang.CohG σ mm mb mk →
    ∀ (tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap) (id a : Int) (ty : ctype),
      CerberusHeapLang.deadObj tds id a ty ∗
          CerberusHeapLang.metaInterp mm ∗ CerberusHeapLang.byteInterp mb ⊢
        ⌜CerberusHeapLang.DeadAt σ id⌝

theorem CerberusHeapLang.deadObj_dead :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem} {mm : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerberusHeapLang.MetaCell}
  {mb : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerbMem.AbsByte}
  {mk : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerberusHeapLang.AllocCursor} (tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap),
  CerberusHeapLang.CohG σ mm mb mk →
    ∀ (id a : Int) (ty : ctype),
      CerberusHeapLang.metaInterp mm ∗ CerberusHeapLang.deadObj tds id a ty ⊢
        ⌜σ.deadAllocations.contains id = true ∧ σ.allocations.get? id = none⌝

          (CerberusHeapLang.dgQ ra) →
        ∃ dst',

            (NDkilled CerbND.fuelExhaustedKill, dst')

  Ψ w ρ' ⊢ CerberusHeapLang.readoutPost (fun x x_1 => True) w ρ'

theorem CerberusHeapLang.dispose_list_certified_production :
∀ (sup : Nat) (ra : core_run_annotation) (mo : memory_order)
  (bty sbty cbty bbty nbty ubty : core_base_type) (fs : CerbFS.FsState) (args : List String),
  ∃ dres dst',
    CerbND.runND
          (drive fmapEmpty false
            (CerberusHeapLang.prodFile
              (CerberusHeapLang.dlProdProg ra mo bty sbty cbty bbty nbty ubty))
            args)
          (initial_driver_state sup
              (CerberusHeapLang.prodFile
                (CerberusHeapLang.dlProdProg ra mo bty sbty cbty bbty nbty ubty))
              fs).fst =
        [(Active dres, [], dst')] ∧
      dres.dres_core_value = Vunit ∧
        (∃ i₁ i₂,
            i₁ ≠ i₂ ∧
              (dst'.layout_state.deadAllocations.contains i₁ = true ∧
                  dst'.layout_state.allocations.get? i₁ = none) ∧
                dst'.layout_state.deadAllocations.contains i₂ = true ∧
                  dst'.layout_state.allocations.get? i₂ = none) ∧
          dres.dres_blocked = false ∧ dres.dres_stdout = "" ∧ dres.dres_stderr = ""
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.diverge_total_unprovable :
∀ {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGpreS GF] (ra : core_run_annotation)
  (σ₀ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem) (m₀ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerberusHeapLang.SpikeCell),
  CerberusHeapLang.Coh fmapEmpty σ₀ m₀ →
    ∀ (Ls : [CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS Iris.HasLC.hasLC GF] → CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpecT GF)
      (Ψ :
        [CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS Iris.HasLC.hasLC GF] →
          CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF)
      (k : Nat),
      (∀ [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS Iris.HasLC.hasLC GF],
          ([∗map] i ↦ c ∈ m₀, CerberusHeapLang.cellOwn fmapEmpty i (Iris.DFrac.own 1) c) ⊢
            CerberusHeapLang.blockSpecsT (CerberusHeapLang.procCtx (CerberusHeapLang.dgRS ra))
                (some CerberusHeapLang.dgProcSym) Ls CerberusHeapLang.emptyProcSpecT Ψ ∗
              CerberusHeapLang.wpt (CerberusHeapLang.procCtx (CerberusHeapLang.dgRS ra))
                (some CerberusHeapLang.dgProcSym) Ls CerberusHeapLang.emptyProcSpecT k Ψ
                (CerberusHeapLang.dgBody ra) [fmapEmpty]) →
        False

  {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} →

      List (Int × Int) → CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF

theorem CerberusHeapLang.dlPost_readout :
∀ {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS Iris.HasLC.hasLC GF]
  (ns : List (Int × Int)) (R : CerberusHeapLang.CellMap) (w : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal)
  (ρ' : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack),
  CerberusHeapLang.dlPost ns w ρ' ∗ CerberusHeapLang.lrCellFrame R ⊢
    CerberusHeapLang.readoutPost
      (fun v σ' =>
        v = Vunit ∧
          (∀ (nd : Int × Int), nd ∈ ns → CerberusHeapLang.DeadAt σ' nd.fst) ∧
            CerberusHeapLang.Coh fmapEmpty σ' R)
      w ρ'

theorem CerberusHeapLang.dlProd_blockSpecsT :
∀ {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS Iris.HasLC.hasLC GF]
  (ra : core_run_annotation) (mo : memory_order) (p : sym) (rs : core_run_state)
  (cbty bbty nbty ubty : core_base_type),
  CerberusHeapLang.LabeledAt rs p
      (CerberusHeapLang.dlQ CerberusHeapLang.loc0 empty_annotation ra mo cbty bbty nbty ubty) →
    ⊢
      CerberusHeapLang.blockSpecsT (CerberusHeapLang.procCtx rs) (some p) CerberusHeapLang.dlProdLsT
        CerberusHeapLang.emptyProcSpecT (CerberusHeapLang.readoutPost CerberusHeapLang.ψD)

  (bty sbty cbty bbty nbty ubty : core_base_type),
  CerberusHeapLang.LabeledAt
    (initial_core_run_state sup
        (collect_labeled_continuations_NEW
          (CerberusHeapLang.prodFile
            (CerberusHeapLang.dlProdProg ra mo bty sbty cbty bbty nbty ubty)))).fst
    CerberusHeapLang.mainSym
    (CerberusHeapLang.dlQ CerberusHeapLang.loc0 empty_annotation ra mo cbty bbty nbty ubty)

∀ {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS Iris.HasLC.hasLC GF] (i₁ i₂ : Int),
  i₁ ≠ i₂ →
    ∀ (w : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal) (ρ' : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack),
      CerberusHeapLang.dlPost [(i₁, 1), (i₂, 2)] w ρ' ∗ CerberusHeapLang.lrCellFrame ∅ ⊢
        CerberusHeapLang.readoutPost CerberusHeapLang.ψD w ρ'
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.dlProd_wpt :
∀ {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS Iris.HasLC.hasLC GF]
  (ra : core_run_annotation) (mo : memory_order) (p : sym) (rs : core_run_state)
  (cbty bbty nbty ubty : core_base_type),
  CerberusHeapLang.LabeledAt rs p
      (CerberusHeapLang.dlQ CerberusHeapLang.loc0 empty_annotation ra mo cbty bbty nbty ubty) →
    ∀ (bty sbty : core_base_type) (ev0 : Fmap sym value) (evs : List (Fmap sym value)),
      CerberusHeapLang.SymFrame ev0 →
        CerberusHeapLang.allocBudget
            (CerberusHeapLang.allocCost (CerberusHeapLang.procCtx rs).tagDefs
                CerberusHeapLang.nodeTy 8 +
              CerberusHeapLang.allocCost (CerberusHeapLang.procCtx rs).tagDefs
                CerberusHeapLang.nodeTy 8) ⊢
          CerberusHeapLang.wpt (CerberusHeapLang.procCtx rs) (some p) CerberusHeapLang.dlProdLsT
            CerberusHeapLang.emptyProcSpecT
            (2 +
              (2 +
                (3 + 1 +
                  (3 + 1 +
                    (3 + 1 +
                      (3 + 1 +
                        (CerberusHeapLang.dlCost 2 +
                          CerberusHeapLang.saveEntryCost (CerberusHeapLang.dlProdParams cbty))))))))
            (CerberusHeapLang.readoutPost CerberusHeapLang.ψD)
            (CerberusHeapLang.dlProdProg ra mo bty sbty cbty bbty nbty ubty) (ev0 :: evs)

def CerberusHeapLang.dlProg :
CerbLocation.Loc →
  core_run_annotation →
    core_run_annotation →
      memory_order →
        core_base_type →
          core_base_type →
            core_base_type →
              core_base_type → core_base_type → CerbMem.PointerValue → CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.dlProg_pot :
∀ (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ann ra : core_run_annotation) (mo : memory_order)
  (bbty nbty ubty sbty cbty : core_base_type) (head : CerbMem.PointerValue),
  CerberusHeapLang.pot (CerberusHeapLang.dlProg loc ann ra mo sbty cbty bbty nbty ubty head) = 7
----
def CerberusHeapLang.dlQ :
CerbLocation.Loc →
  core_run_annotation →
    core_run_annotation →
      memory_order →
        core_base_type →
          core_base_type → core_base_type → core_base_type → CerberusHeapLang.LabelMap
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.dlQ_inv :
∀ (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ann ra : core_run_annotation) (mo : memory_order)
  (cbty bbty nbty ubty : core_base_type) {l : sym} {params : List (sym × core_base_type)}
  {cont : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr},
  CerberusHeapLang.lookupLabel (CerberusHeapLang.dlQ loc ann ra mo cbty bbty nbty ubty) l =
      some (params, cont) →
    params = [(CerberusHeapLang.dlCurSym, cbty)] ∧
      cont = CerberusHeapLang.dlBody loc ann ra mo bbty nbty ubty
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.dlQ_lookup :
∀ (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ann ra : core_run_annotation) (mo : memory_order)
  (cbty bbty nbty ubty : core_base_type),
  CerberusHeapLang.lookupLabel (CerberusHeapLang.dlQ loc ann ra mo cbty bbty nbty ubty)
      CerberusHeapLang.dlLoopSym =
    some ([(CerberusHeapLang.dlCurSym, cbty)], CerberusHeapLang.dlBody loc ann ra mo bbty nbty ubty)

theorem CerberusHeapLang.dl_body_wps :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ann ra : core_run_annotation) (mo : memory_order)
  (cbty bbty nbty ubty : core_base_type) (ns : List (Int × Int)) (p : sym) (rs : core_run_state),
  CerberusHeapLang.LabeledAt rs p (CerberusHeapLang.dlQ loc ann ra mo cbty bbty nbty ubty) →
    ∀ (done rest' : List (Int × Int)) (pCur : CerbMem.PointerValue) (f : Fmap sym value)
      (renv : List (Fmap sym value)),
      CerberusHeapLang.SymFrame f →
        ns = done ++ rest' →
          CerberusHeapLang.deadNodes done ∗ CerberusHeapLang.isList pCur rest' ⊢
            CerberusHeapLang.wps (CerberusHeapLang.procCtx rs) (some p) (CerberusHeapLang.dlLs ns)
              CerberusHeapLang.emptyProcSpec (CerberusHeapLang.dlPost ns)
              (CerberusHeapLang.dlBody loc ann ra mo bbty nbty ubty)
              (CerberusHeapLang.dlFrame (CerberusHeapLang.ptrVal pCur) f :: renv)

theorem CerberusHeapLang.drive_after_setup :
∀ (sup : Nat) (e : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr) (fs : CerbFS.FsState) (args : List String)
  (dstD : driver_state),
  CerberusHeapLang.runOne (driver2_lemFuel CerbFuel.driverFuel fmapEmpty false)
        (CerberusHeapLang.prodEntryState sup e fs) =
      (NDactive (), dstD) →
    CerberusHeapLang.runOne (drive fmapEmpty false (CerberusHeapLang.prodFile e) args)
        (initial_driver_state sup (CerberusHeapLang.prodFile e) fs).fst =
      (NDactive (finalize fmapEmpty "drive (without concur)" dstD), dstD)
----

  (e : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr) (fs : CerbFS.FsState) (args : List String) (dstD : driver_state),
  CerberusHeapLang.runOne (driver2_lemFuel CerbFuel.driverFuel fmapEmpty false)
        (CerberusHeapLang.prodEntryStateWith procs sup e fs) =
      (NDactive (), dstD) →
    CerberusHeapLang.runOne (drive fmapEmpty false (CerberusHeapLang.prodFileWith procs e) args)
        (initial_driver_state sup (CerberusHeapLang.prodFileWith procs e) fs).fst =
      (NDactive (finalize fmapEmpty "drive (without concur)" dstD), dstD)

theorem CerberusHeapLang.driver2_done :
∀ (fl : Nat) (tds : Fmap sym (CerbLocation.Loc × tag_definition)) (dst dstF : driver_state)
  (th thF : thread_state) (v : value),
  dst.core_state0.thread_states = [(0, none, th)] →
    CerberusHeapLang.runOne
          (drive_nonmemory_steps_aux2_lemFuel CerbFuel.driverFuel tds fmapEmpty [0]) dst =
        (NDactive (fmapAddBy defaultCompare 0 [Step_done2 v] fmapEmpty), dstF) →
      dstF.core_state0.thread_states = [(0, none, thF)] →
        CerberusHeapLang.runOne (driver2_lemFuel fl.succ tds false) dst =
          (NDactive (),
            { core_file := dstF.core_file, core_extern := dstF.core_extern,
              core_state0 :=
                have __src := dstF.core_state0;
                {
                  thread_states :=
                    [(0, none,
                        { arena := mk_value_e v, stack0 := Stack_empty, errno := thF.errno,
                          env := thF.env, current_proc_opt := thF.current_proc_opt,
                          exec_loc := thF.exec_loc, current_loc := thF.current_loc })],
                  io := __src.io },
              core_run_state0 := dstF.core_run_state0, layout_state := dstF.layout_state,
              concurrency_state := dstF.concurrency_state, fs_state0 := dstF.fs_state0,
              trace := dstF.trace, symbolic_assoc := dstF.symbolic_assoc, blocked := dstF.blocked,
              dr_step_counter := dstF.dr_step_counter })
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.driver2_killed :
∀ (fl : Nat) (tds : Fmap sym (CerbLocation.Loc × tag_definition)) (dst dstK : driver_state)
  (th : thread_state) (r : kill_reason driver_error),
  dst.core_state0.thread_states = [(0, none, th)] →
    CerberusHeapLang.runOne
          (drive_nonmemory_steps_aux2_lemFuel CerbFuel.driverFuel tds fmapEmpty [0]) dst =
        (NDkilled r, dstK) →
      CerberusHeapLang.runOne (driver2_lemFuel fl.succ tds false) dst = (NDkilled r, dstK)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.driverDoneCtl_annot :
∀ (M₀ : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx) (th₀ : thread_state) (ds : List dyn_annotation) (v : value)
  (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack) (p : Option sym) (ℓ : exec_location) (σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem)
  (ψ : value → CerberusHeapLang.Mem → Prop),
  ψ v σ →
    ∀ (k : Nat),
      1 ≤ k →
        CerberusHeapLang.DriverDoneCtl M₀ th₀
          (CerberusHeapLang.ofVal (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.annot ds v)) ρ
          { κ := [], proc := p, execLoc := ℓ } σ ψ k
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.driverDoneCtl_step :
∀ {M₀ : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx},
  M₀.tagDefs = fmapEmpty →
    M₀.extern = fmapEmpty →
      ∀ {ctl ctl' : CerberusHeapLang.Ctl} {p : sym},
        ctl.proc = some p →
          (∃ params body, CerberusHeapLang.lookupProc M₀.file M₀.extern p = some (params, body)) →
            ∀ {th₀ : thread_state},
              th₀.current_loc = M₀.currentLoc →
                ∀ {e e' : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {ev0 : Fmap sym value}
                  {evs : List (Fmap sym value)} {ρ' : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack}
                  {σ σ' : CerberusHeapLang.Mem} {ψ : value → CerberusHeapLang.Mem → Prop} {k : Nat},
                  CerberusHeapLang.Frag e →
                    CerberusHeapLang.esize e ≤ lemDefaultFuel →
                      CerberusHeapLang.Step M₀ (e, ev0 :: evs, ctl, σ) (e', ρ', ctl', σ') →
                        CerberusHeapLang.DriverDoneCtl M₀ th₀ e' ρ' ctl' σ' ψ k →
                          CerberusHeapLang.DriverDoneCtl M₀ th₀ e (ev0 :: evs) ctl σ ψ (k + 1)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.driverDoneCtl_value :
∀ (M₀ : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx) (th₀ : thread_state) (v : value)
  (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack) (p : Option sym) (ℓ : exec_location) (σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem)
  (ψ : value → CerberusHeapLang.Mem → Prop),
  ψ v σ →
    ∀ (k : Nat),
      CerberusHeapLang.DriverDoneCtl M₀ th₀
        (CerberusHeapLang.ofVal (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.pure v)) ρ
        { κ := [], proc := p, execLoc := ℓ } σ ψ k
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.driverDone_annot :
∀ (p : sym) (Q : CerberusHeapLang.LabelMap) (th₀ : thread_state),
  th₀.stack0 = Stack_empty →
    ∀ (ds : List dyn_annotation) (v : value) (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack)
      (σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem) (ψ : value → CerberusHeapLang.Mem → Prop),
      ψ v σ →
        ∀ (k : Nat),
          1 ≤ k →
            CerberusHeapLang.DriverDoneAt p Q th₀
              (CerberusHeapLang.ofVal (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.annot ds v)) ρ σ ψ k
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.driverDone_step :
∀ {M₀ : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {ctl : CerberusHeapLang.Ctl},
  M₀.tagDefs = fmapEmpty →
    M₀.extern = fmapEmpty →
      ∀ {Q : CerberusHeapLang.LabelMap},
        M₀.labelsAt ctl.proc = Q →
          ∀ {p : sym},
            ctl.proc = some p →
              ∀ {th₀ : thread_state},
                th₀.current_proc_opt = ctl.proc →
                  ∀ {e e' : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {ev0 : Fmap sym value}
                    {evs : List (Fmap sym value)} {ρ' : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack}
                    {σ σ' : CerberusHeapLang.Mem} {ψ : value → CerberusHeapLang.Mem → Prop}
                    {k : Nat},
                    CerberusHeapLang.Frag e →
                      CerberusHeapLang.esize e ≤ lemDefaultFuel →
                        CerberusHeapLang.Step M₀ (e, ev0 :: evs, ctl, σ) (e', ρ', ctl, σ') →
                          CerberusHeapLang.DriverDoneAt p Q th₀ e' ρ' σ' ψ k →
                            CerberusHeapLang.DriverDoneAt p Q th₀ e (ev0 :: evs) σ ψ (k + 1)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.driverDone_value :
∀ (p : sym) (Q : CerberusHeapLang.LabelMap) (th₀ : thread_state),
  th₀.stack0 = Stack_empty →
    ∀ (v : value) (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack) (σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem)

        ∀ (k : Nat),
          CerberusHeapLang.DriverDoneAt p Q th₀
            (CerberusHeapLang.ofVal (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.pure v)) ρ σ ψ k

theorem CerberusHeapLang.engine_adequacy :
∀ {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGpreS GF] {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx},
  M.tagDefs = fmapEmpty →
    M.extern = fmapEmpty →
      ∀ {ctl : CerberusHeapLang.Ctl},
        ctl.κ = [] →
          (∀ (l : sym) (params : List (sym × core_base_type)) (cont : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr),
              CerberusHeapLang.lookupLabel (M.labelsAt ctl.proc) l = some (params, cont) →
                CerberusHeapLang.Frag cont) →
            (∀ (l : sym) (params : List (sym × core_base_type)) (cont : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr),
                CerberusHeapLang.lookupLabel (M.labelsAt ctl.proc) l = some (params, cont) →
                  CerberusHeapLang.pot cont ≤ lemDefaultFuel) →
              M.FragProcs →
                ∀ (e₀ : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr) (ev00 : Fmap sym value)
                  (evs0 : List (Fmap sym value)) (σ₀ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem)
                  (m₀ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerberusHeapLang.SpikeCell),
                  CerberusHeapLang.Frag e₀ →
                    CerberusHeapLang.pot e₀ ≤ lemDefaultFuel →
                      CerberusHeapLang.Coh M.tagDefs σ₀ m₀ →
                        ∀ (ψ : value → CerberusHeapLang.Mem → Prop),
                          (∀ [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS Iris.HasLC.hasLC GF],
                              ([∗map] i ↦ c ∈ m₀,
                                  CerberusHeapLang.cellOwn M.tagDefs i (Iris.DFrac.own 1) c) ⊢
                                WP { e := e₀, ρ := ev00 :: evs0, ctl := ctl, M := M } @
                                  Iris.Stuckness.NotStuck ;
                                  ⊤ {{
                                    w,
                                      ∀ σ' ns κs nt,
                                        Iris.stateInterp σ' ns κs nt ={⊤,∅}=∗ ⌜ψ w.val σ'⌝ }}
                                    ) →
                            ∀ {th₀ : thread_state},
                              th₀.current_loc = M.currentLoc →
                                CerberusHeapLang.DriverSafeCtl M th₀ e₀ (ev00 :: evs0) ctl σ₀ ψ
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.engine_adequacy_alloc :
∀ {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGpreS GF] {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx},
  M.tagDefs = fmapEmpty →
    M.extern = fmapEmpty →
      ∀ {ctl : CerberusHeapLang.Ctl},
        ctl.κ = [] →
          (∀ (l : sym) (params : List (sym × core_base_type)) (cont : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr),
              CerberusHeapLang.lookupLabel (M.labelsAt ctl.proc) l = some (params, cont) →
                CerberusHeapLang.Frag cont) →
            (∀ (l : sym) (params : List (sym × core_base_type)) (cont : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr),
                CerberusHeapLang.lookupLabel (M.labelsAt ctl.proc) l = some (params, cont) →
                  CerberusHeapLang.pot cont ≤ lemDefaultFuel) →
              M.FragProcs →
                ∀ (e₀ : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr) (ev00 : Fmap sym value)
                  (evs0 : List (Fmap sym value)) (σ₀ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem)
                  (m₀ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerberusHeapLang.SpikeCell) (B : Nat),
                  CerberusHeapLang.Frag e₀ →
                    CerberusHeapLang.pot e₀ ≤ lemDefaultFuel →
                      CerberusHeapLang.LaunchCoh M.tagDefs σ₀ m₀ B →
                        ∀ (ψ : value → CerberusHeapLang.Mem → Prop),
                          (∀ [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS Iris.HasLC.hasLC GF],
                              ([∗map] i ↦ c ∈ m₀,
                                    CerberusHeapLang.cellOwn M.tagDefs i (Iris.DFrac.own 1) c) ∗
                                  CerberusHeapLang.allocBudget B ⊢
                                WP { e := e₀, ρ := ev00 :: evs0, ctl := ctl, M := M } @
                                  Iris.Stuckness.NotStuck ;
                                  ⊤ {{
                                    w,
                                      ∀ σ' ns κs nt,
                                        Iris.stateInterp σ' ns κs nt ={⊤,∅}=∗ ⌜ψ w.val σ'⌝ }}
                                    ) →
                            ∀ {th₀ : thread_state},
                              th₀.current_loc = M.currentLoc →
                                CerberusHeapLang.DriverSafeCtl M th₀ e₀ (ev00 :: evs0) ctl σ₀ ψ
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.engine_complete_caseU :
∀ (M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx) (aid : Nat) {b : List annot} {cval : value}
  {pats : List (pattern × CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr)},
  CerberusHeapLang.esize (CerberusHeapLang.caseRedex (Pexpr b () (PEval cval)) pats) ≤
      lemDefaultFuel →
    ∀ (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack) (ctl : CerberusHeapLang.Ctl) (σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem),
      ∃ o,
        CerberusHeapLang.outcomesU M aid (CerberusHeapLang.caseRedex (Pexpr b () (PEval cval)) pats)
              ρ ctl σ =
            [o] ∧
          CerberusHeapLang.EngineMatchU M
            (CerberusHeapLang.caseRedex (Pexpr b () (PEval cval)) pats) ρ ctl σ o
----

theorem CerberusHeapLang.engine_step_matchU :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {e e' : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {ev0 : Fmap sym value}
  {evs : List (Fmap sym value)} {ρ' : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack} {ctl ctl' : CerberusHeapLang.Ctl}
  {σ σ' : CerberusHeapLang.Mem},

    CerberusHeapLang.esize e ≤ lemDefaultFuel →

theorem CerberusHeapLang.eqPtrval_layer :
∀ (l : CerbLocation.Loc) (pv1 pv2 : CerbMem.PointerValue) (σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem),
  (∃ b, CerberusHeapLang.runOne (CerbMem.eqPtrval l pv1 pv2) σ = (NDactive b, σ)) ∨
    ∃ a1 a2,
      CerberusHeapLang.runOne (CerbMem.eqPtrval l pv1 pv2) σ =
        (NDnd "pointer equality"
            [("using provenance", CerbMem.memReturn false),
              ("ignoring provenance", CerbMem.memReturn (a1 == a2))],
          σ)

def CerberusHeapLang.esize :
CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr → Nat
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.esize.eq_def :
∀ (x : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr),
  CerberusHeapLang.esize x =
    match x with
    | generic_expr.Expr a (Esseq a_1 e1 e2) =>
      1 + max (CerberusHeapLang.esize e1) (CerberusHeapLang.esize e2)
    | generic_expr.Expr a (Ewseq a_1 e1 e2) =>
      1 + max (CerberusHeapLang.esize e1) (CerberusHeapLang.esize e2)
    | generic_expr.Expr a (Eannot a_1 b) => 1 + CerberusHeapLang.esize b
    | generic_expr.Expr a (Eif a_1 e2 e3) =>
      1 + max (CerberusHeapLang.esize e2) (CerberusHeapLang.esize e3)
    | generic_expr.Expr a (Esave a_1 a_2 body) => 1 + CerberusHeapLang.esize body
    | generic_expr.Expr a (Ecase a_1 pats) => 1 + CerberusHeapLang.esizeAlts pats
    | x => 1
----
def CerberusHeapLang.esizeAlts :
List (pattern × CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr) → Nat
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.esize_action :
∀ {a : List annot} {p : generic_paction core_run_annotation Unit sym},
  CerberusHeapLang.esize (generic_expr.Expr a (Eaction p)) = 1

∀ {a : List annot} {ds : List dyn_annotation} {b : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr},
  CerberusHeapLang.esize (generic_expr.Expr a (Eannot ds b)) = 1 + CerberusHeapLang.esize b

theorem CerberusHeapLang.eval1_bridge :
∀ {tds : Fmap sym (CerbLocation.Loc × tag_definition)} {ext : Fmap sym sym} {th : thread_state}
  {pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym} {v : value},
  CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr tds ext th.env pe = some v →
    CerberusHeapLang.peDepth pe ≤ lemDefaultFuel →
      ∀ (σ : CerbMem.MemState) (file : generic_file Unit core_run_annotation) (rs : core_run_state),
        stExceptUndef_bind (E.eval_pexpr20 tds th ext σ file pe)
            (fun x =>
              match (motive :=
                pexpr ⊕ value → core_run_state → exceptM (t0 pexpr × core_run_state) core_run_cause)
                x with
              | Sum.inl pe' => stExceptUndef_return pe'
              | Sum.inr cval => stExceptUndef_return (mk_value_pe cval))
            rs =
          Result (Defined (mk_value_pe v), rs)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.eval1_bridge_kill :
∀ {tds : Fmap sym (CerbLocation.Loc × tag_definition)} {ext : Fmap sym sym} {th : thread_state}
  {file : generic_file Unit core_run_annotation} {pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym}
  {err : core_run_cause},
  CerberusHeapLang.PePure pe →
    CerberusHeapLang.evalClass tds th.current_loc ext file th.env pe =
        CerberusHeapLang.EvalOut.kill err →
      CerberusHeapLang.peDepth pe ≤ lemDefaultFuel →
        ∀ (σ : CerbMem.MemState)
          (k :
            generic_pexpr Unit sym ⊕ value →
              core_run_state →
                exceptM (t0 (generic_pexpr Unit sym) × core_run_state) core_run_cause)
          (rs : core_run_state),
          stExceptUndef_bind (E.eval_pexpr20 tds th ext σ file pe) k rs = exceptM.Exception err

def CerberusHeapLang.evalClass :
CerbTags.TagDefsMap →
  CerbLocation.Loc →
    Fmap sym sym →
      generic_file Unit core_run_annotation →
        CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → generic_pexpr Unit sym → CerberusHeapLang.EvalOut
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.evalClass.eq_def :
∀ (tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap) (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ext : Fmap sym sym)
  (file : generic_file Unit core_run_annotation) (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack)
  (x : generic_pexpr Unit sym),
  CerberusHeapLang.evalClass tds loc ext file ρ x =
    match x with
    | Pexpr a a_1 (PEval v) => CerberusHeapLang.EvalOut.val v
    | Pexpr a a_1 (PEsym x) =>
      match lookup_env (CerberusHeapLang.resolveExtern ext x) ρ with
      | some v => CerberusHeapLang.EvalOut.val v
      | none =>
        match
          fmapLookupBy (fun s1 s2 => Lem_Basic_classes.ordCompare s1 s2)
            (CerberusHeapLang.resolveExtern ext x) file.funs with
        | some (Proc a a_2 a_3 a_4 a_5) => CerberusHeapLang.EvalOut.uncovered
        | x_1 =>
          CerberusHeapLang.EvalOut.kill
            (Unresolved_symbol loc (CerberusHeapLang.resolveExtern ext x))
    | Pexpr a a_1 (PEop op pe1 pe2) =>
      match CerberusHeapLang.evalClass tds loc ext file ρ pe1 with
      | CerberusHeapLang.EvalOut.kill err => CerberusHeapLang.EvalOut.kill err
      | CerberusHeapLang.EvalOut.uncovered => CerberusHeapLang.EvalOut.uncovered
      | CerberusHeapLang.EvalOut.val v1 =>
        match CerberusHeapLang.evalClass tds loc ext file ρ pe2 with
        | CerberusHeapLang.EvalOut.kill err => CerberusHeapLang.EvalOut.kill err
        | CerberusHeapLang.EvalOut.uncovered => CerberusHeapLang.EvalOut.uncovered
        | CerberusHeapLang.EvalOut.val v2 =>
          CerberusHeapLang.binopOut loc op (CerberusHeapLang.peStrip pe1)
            (CerberusHeapLang.peStrip pe2) v1 v2
    | Pexpr a a_1 (PEarray_shift pe1 ty pe2) =>
      match CerberusHeapLang.evalClass tds loc ext file ρ pe1 with
      | CerberusHeapLang.EvalOut.kill err => CerberusHeapLang.EvalOut.kill err
      | CerberusHeapLang.EvalOut.uncovered => CerberusHeapLang.EvalOut.uncovered
      | CerberusHeapLang.EvalOut.val v1 =>
        match CerberusHeapLang.evalClass tds loc ext file ρ pe2 with
        | CerberusHeapLang.EvalOut.kill err => CerberusHeapLang.EvalOut.kill err
        | CerberusHeapLang.EvalOut.uncovered => CerberusHeapLang.EvalOut.uncovered
        | CerberusHeapLang.EvalOut.val v2 => CerberusHeapLang.shiftOut tds ty v1 v2
    | x => CerberusHeapLang.EvalOut.uncovered
----
def CerberusHeapLang.evalClassList :
CerbTags.TagDefsMap →
  CerbLocation.Loc →
    Fmap sym sym →
      generic_file Unit core_run_annotation →
        CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → List (generic_pexpr Unit sym) → CerberusHeapLang.EvalListOut
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.evalClassList.eq_def :
∀ (tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap) (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ext : Fmap sym sym)
  (file : generic_file Unit core_run_annotation) (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack)
  (x : List (generic_pexpr Unit sym)),
  CerberusHeapLang.evalClassList tds loc ext file ρ x =
    match x with
    | [] => CerberusHeapLang.EvalListOut.vals []
    | pe :: pes =>
      match CerberusHeapLang.evalClass tds loc ext file ρ pe with
      | CerberusHeapLang.EvalOut.kill err => CerberusHeapLang.EvalListOut.kill err
      | CerberusHeapLang.EvalOut.uncovered => CerberusHeapLang.EvalListOut.uncovered pe
      | CerberusHeapLang.EvalOut.val v =>
        match CerberusHeapLang.evalClassList tds loc ext file ρ pes with
        | CerberusHeapLang.EvalListOut.vals vs => CerberusHeapLang.EvalListOut.vals (v :: vs)
        | CerberusHeapLang.EvalListOut.kill err => CerberusHeapLang.EvalListOut.kill err
        | CerberusHeapLang.EvalListOut.uncovered pe' => CerberusHeapLang.EvalListOut.uncovered pe'
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.evalClassList_of_none :
∀ {tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap} {ext : Fmap sym sym} {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack}
  {pes : List (generic_pexpr Unit sym)} (loc : CerbLocation.Loc)
  (file : generic_file Unit core_run_annotation),
  CerberusHeapLang.evalPexprs tds ext ρ pes = none →
    (∃ err,
        CerberusHeapLang.evalClassList tds loc ext file ρ pes =
          CerberusHeapLang.EvalListOut.kill err) ∨
      ∃ pe,
        CerberusHeapLang.evalClassList tds loc ext file ρ pes =
          CerberusHeapLang.EvalListOut.uncovered pe
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.evalClassList_uncovered :
∀ {tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap} {loc : CerbLocation.Loc} {ext : Fmap sym sym}
  {file : generic_file Unit core_run_annotation} {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack}
  {pes : List (generic_pexpr Unit sym)} {pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym},
  CerberusHeapLang.evalClassList tds loc ext file ρ pes =
      CerberusHeapLang.EvalListOut.uncovered pe →
    pe ∈ pes ∧ CerberusHeapLang.evalClass tds loc ext file ρ pe = CerberusHeapLang.EvalOut.uncovered
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.evalClassList_vals_iff :
∀ (tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap) (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ext : Fmap sym sym)
  (file : generic_file Unit core_run_annotation) (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack)
  (pes : List (generic_pexpr Unit sym)) (vs : List value),
  CerberusHeapLang.evalClassList tds loc ext file ρ pes = CerberusHeapLang.EvalListOut.vals vs ↔
    CerberusHeapLang.evalPexprs tds ext ρ pes = some vs
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.evalClass_of_none :
∀ {tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap} {ext : Fmap sym sym} {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack}
  {pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym} (loc : CerbLocation.Loc)
  (file : generic_file Unit core_run_annotation),
  CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr tds ext ρ pe = none →
    (∃ err, CerberusHeapLang.evalClass tds loc ext file ρ pe = CerberusHeapLang.EvalOut.kill err) ∨
      CerberusHeapLang.evalClass tds loc ext file ρ pe = CerberusHeapLang.EvalOut.uncovered
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.evalClass_peStrip :
∀ {tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap} {loc : CerbLocation.Loc} {ext : Fmap sym sym}
  {file : generic_file Unit core_run_annotation} {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack}
  {pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym},
  CerberusHeapLang.PePure pe →
    CerberusHeapLang.evalClass tds loc ext file ρ (CerberusHeapLang.peStrip pe) =
      CerberusHeapLang.evalClass tds loc ext file ρ pe
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.evalClass_val_iff :
∀ (tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap) (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ext : Fmap sym sym)
  (file : generic_file Unit core_run_annotation) (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack)
  (pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym) (v : value),
  CerberusHeapLang.evalClass tds loc ext file ρ pe = CerberusHeapLang.EvalOut.val v ↔
    CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr tds ext ρ pe = some v
----
def CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr :
CerbTags.TagDefsMap →
  Fmap sym sym → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → generic_pexpr Unit sym → Option value
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr.eq_def :
∀ (tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap) (ext : Fmap sym sym) (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack)
  (x : generic_pexpr Unit sym),
  CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr tds ext ρ x =
    match x with
    | Pexpr a a_1 (PEval v) => some v
    | Pexpr a a_1 (PEsym x) => lookup_env (CerberusHeapLang.resolveExtern ext x) ρ
    | Pexpr a a_1 (PEop op pe1 pe2) => do
      let v1 ← CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr tds ext ρ pe1
      let v2 ← CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr tds ext ρ pe2
      CerberusHeapLang.evalBinop op v1 v2
    | Pexpr a a_1 (PEarray_shift pe1 ty pe2) => do
      let v1 ← CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr tds ext ρ pe1
      let v2 ← CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr tds ext ρ pe2
      CerberusHeapLang.evalArrayShift tds ty v1 v2
    | x => none
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr.induct :
∀ (motive : generic_pexpr Unit sym → Prop),
  (∀ (a : List annot) (a_1 : Unit) (v : value), motive (Pexpr a a_1 (PEval v))) →
    (∀ (a : List annot) (a_1 : Unit) (x : sym), motive (Pexpr a a_1 (PEsym x))) →
      (∀ (a : List annot) (a_1 : Unit) (op : binop) (pe1 pe2 : generic_pexpr Unit sym),
          motive pe1 → motive pe2 → motive (Pexpr a a_1 (PEop op pe1 pe2))) →
        (∀ (a : List annot) (a_1 : Unit) (pe1 : generic_pexpr Unit sym) (ty : ctype)
            (pe2 : generic_pexpr Unit sym),
            motive pe1 → motive pe2 → motive (Pexpr a a_1 (PEarray_shift pe1 ty pe2))) →
          (∀ (t : generic_pexpr Unit sym),
              (∀ (a : List annot) (a_1 : Unit) (v : value), t = Pexpr a a_1 (PEval v) → False) →
                (∀ (a : List annot) (a_1 : Unit) (x : sym), t = Pexpr a a_1 (PEsym x) → False) →
                  (∀ (a : List annot) (a_1 : Unit) (op : binop) (pe1 pe2 : generic_pexpr Unit sym),
                      t = Pexpr a a_1 (PEop op pe1 pe2) → False) →
                    (∀ (a : List annot) (a_1 : Unit) (pe1 : generic_pexpr Unit sym) (ty : ctype)
                        (pe2 : generic_pexpr Unit sym),
                        t = Pexpr a a_1 (PEarray_shift pe1 ty pe2) → False) →
                      motive t) →
            ∀ (a : generic_pexpr Unit sym), motive a
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr_array_shift :
∀ (tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap) (ext : Fmap sym sym) (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack) (a : List annot)
  (ty : ctype) (pe1 pe2 : generic_pexpr Unit sym),
  CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr tds ext ρ (Pexpr a () (PEarray_shift pe1 ty pe2)) = do
    let v1 ← CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr tds ext ρ pe1
    let v2 ← CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr tds ext ρ pe2
    CerberusHeapLang.evalArrayShift tds ty v1 v2
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr_none_of_kill :
∀ {tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap} {ext : Fmap sym sym} {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack}
  {pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym} {loc : CerbLocation.Loc}
  {file : generic_file Unit core_run_annotation} {err : core_run_cause},
  CerberusHeapLang.evalClass tds loc ext file ρ pe = CerberusHeapLang.EvalOut.kill err →
    CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr tds ext ρ pe = none
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr_none_of_shape :
∀ {tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap} {ext : Fmap sym sym} {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack}
  {pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym},
  (∀ (a : List annot) (u : Unit) (v : value), pe = Pexpr a u (PEval v) → False) →
    (∀ (a : List annot) (u : Unit) (x : sym), pe = Pexpr a u (PEsym x) → False) →
      (∀ (a : List annot) (u : Unit) (op : binop) (pe1 pe2 : generic_pexpr Unit sym),
          pe = Pexpr a u (PEop op pe1 pe2) → False) →
        (∀ (a : List annot) (u : Unit) (pe1 : generic_pexpr Unit sym) (ty : ctype)
            (pe2 : generic_pexpr Unit sym), pe = Pexpr a u (PEarray_shift pe1 ty pe2) → False) →
          CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr tds ext ρ pe = none
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr_none_of_uncovered :
∀ {tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap} {ext : Fmap sym sym} {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack}
  {pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym} {loc : CerbLocation.Loc}
  {file : generic_file Unit core_run_annotation},
  CerberusHeapLang.evalClass tds loc ext file ρ pe = CerberusHeapLang.EvalOut.uncovered →
    CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr tds ext ρ pe = none

theorem CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr_op :
∀ (tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap) (ext : Fmap sym sym) (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack) (a : List annot)
  (op : binop) (pe1 pe2 : generic_pexpr Unit sym),

    let v1 ← CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr tds ext ρ pe1
    let v2 ← CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr tds ext ρ pe2

theorem CerberusHeapLang.exhibitA_engine :
CerberusHeapLang.DriverSafeCtl CerberusHeapLang.spikeCtx
  (CerberusHeapLang.spikeThread CerberusHeapLang.progA) CerberusHeapLang.progA
  CerberusHeapLang.spikeEnv CerberusHeapLang.spikeCtl CerberusHeapLang.σ₀ fun v x =>
  v = CerberusHeapLang.sevenVal

theorem CerberusHeapLang.exhibitA_prod :
∀ (sup : Nat) (fs : CerbFS.FsState) (args : List String),
  ∃ dres dst',
    CerbND.runND (drive fmapEmpty false (CerberusHeapLang.prodFile CerberusHeapLang.progAProd) args)
          (initial_driver_state sup (CerberusHeapLang.prodFile CerberusHeapLang.progAProd) fs).fst =
        [(Active dres, [], dst')] ∧
      dres.dres_core_value = CerberusHeapLang.sevenVal ∧
        (∃ i a,
            CerberusHeapLang.CellCoh fmapEmpty dst'.layout_state i
              { addr := a, ty := CerberusHeapLang.intTy,
                bytes := CerberusHeapLang.sevenBytes fmapEmpty }) ∧
          dres.dres_blocked = false ∧ dres.dres_stdout = "" ∧ dres.dres_stderr = ""
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.exhibitA_semantic :
∀ {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGpreS GF],
  CerberusHeapLang.SemTriple CerberusHeapLang.spikeCtx CerberusHeapLang.spikeCtl
    CerberusHeapLang.spikeEnv CerberusHeapLang.progA CerberusHeapLang.mA fun v Q =>
    v = CerberusHeapLang.sevenVal ∧ Q = CerberusHeapLang.mA7
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.exhibitB_engine :
CerberusHeapLang.DriverSafeCtl CerberusHeapLang.spikeCtx
  (CerberusHeapLang.spikeThread CerberusHeapLang.progB) CerberusHeapLang.progB
  CerberusHeapLang.spikeEnv CerberusHeapLang.spikeCtl CerberusHeapLang.σ₀ fun v σ' =>
  v = Vunit ∧
    CerbMem.readBytesFrom σ' CerberusHeapLang.xAddr 4 =
        (CerbMem.memValueToBytes fmapEmpty [] CerberusHeapLang.sevenMval).snd ∧
      CerbMem.readBytesFrom σ' CerberusHeapLang.yAddr 4 = CerberusHeapLang.bytesY
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.exhibitB_semantic :
∀ {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGpreS GF],
  CerberusHeapLang.SemTriple CerberusHeapLang.spikeCtx CerberusHeapLang.spikeCtl
    CerberusHeapLang.spikeEnv CerberusHeapLang.progB
    (Iris.Std.PartialMap.union CerberusHeapLang.mA CerberusHeapLang.mF) fun v Q =>
    ∃ Q₀,
      (v = Vunit ∧ Q₀ = CerberusHeapLang.mA7) ∧
        Iris.Std.PartialMap.disjoint Q₀ CerberusHeapLang.mF ∧
          Q = Iris.Std.PartialMap.union Q₀ CerberusHeapLang.mF

  (CerberusHeapLang.spikeThread CerberusHeapLang.progC) CerberusHeapLang.progC

theorem CerberusHeapLang.exists_consequence :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {mm : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerberusHeapLang.MetaCell}
  {mb : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerbMem.AbsByte} {α : Type u_1} {Φ : α → Iris.IProp GF}

    (∃ a, Φ a) ∗ CerberusHeapLang.metaInterp mm ∗ CerberusHeapLang.byteInterp mb ⊢ ⌜∃ a, ψ a⌝

theorem CerberusHeapLang.fibFrame_lookup_i :
∀ {f : Fmap sym value},
  CerberusHeapLang.SymFrame f →
    ∀ (vi va vb : value),
      fmapLookupBy CerberusHeapLang.symCmpK CerberusHeapLang.fibISym
          (CerberusHeapLang.fibFrame vi va vb f) =
        some vi

    ∀ (vi va vb : value), CerberusHeapLang.SymFrame (CerberusHeapLang.fibFrame vi va vb f)

def CerberusHeapLang.fibRounds :
Nat → Nat
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.fibRounds_add_two :
∀ (n : Nat),
  CerberusHeapLang.fibRounds (n + 2) =
    CerberusHeapLang.fibRounds (n + 1) + CerberusHeapLang.fibRounds n + 9
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.fibRounds_closed :
∀ (n : Nat), ↑(CerberusHeapLang.fibRounds n) + 9 = 12 * CerberusHeapLang.fibSpec (n + 1)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.fibRounds_one :
CerberusHeapLang.fibRounds 1 = 3
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.fibRounds_rec :
∀ {n : Int},
  2 ≤ n →
    CerberusHeapLang.fibRounds n.toNat =
      CerberusHeapLang.fibRounds (n - 1).toNat + CerberusHeapLang.fibRounds (n - 2).toNat + 9
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.fibRounds_small :
∀ {n : Int}, 0 ≤ n → n < 2 → CerberusHeapLang.fibRounds n.toNat = 3
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.fibRounds_zero :
CerberusHeapLang.fibRounds 0 = 3
----
def CerberusHeapLang.fibSpec :
Nat → Int
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.fibSpec_add_two :
∀ (n : Nat),
  CerberusHeapLang.fibSpec (n + 2) = CerberusHeapLang.fibSpec n + CerberusHeapLang.fibSpec (n + 1)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.fibSpec_one :
CerberusHeapLang.fibSpec 1 = 1
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.fibSpec_rec :
∀ {n : Int},
  2 ≤ n →
    CerberusHeapLang.ivVal
        (CerberusHeapLang.fibSpec (n - 1).toNat + CerberusHeapLang.fibSpec (n - 2).toNat) =
      CerberusHeapLang.ivVal (CerberusHeapLang.fibSpec n.toNat)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.fibSpec_small :
∀ {n : Int},
  0 ≤ n →
    n < 2 → CerberusHeapLang.ivVal (CerberusHeapLang.fibSpec n.toNat) = CerberusHeapLang.ivVal n
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.fibSpec_zero :
CerberusHeapLang.fibSpec 0 = 0
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.fib_args_eval :
∀ {f : Fmap sym value},
  CerberusHeapLang.SymFrame f →
    ∀ (i a b : Int) (rest : List (Fmap sym value)),
      CerberusHeapLang.evalPexprs fmapEmpty fmapEmpty
          (CerberusHeapLang.fibFrame (CerberusHeapLang.ivVal i) (CerberusHeapLang.ivVal a)
              (CerberusHeapLang.ivVal b) f ::
            rest)
          [CerberusHeapLang.fibIncPe, CerberusHeapLang.fibBPe, CerberusHeapLang.fibABPe] =
        some
          [CerberusHeapLang.ivVal (i + 1), CerberusHeapLang.ivVal b, CerberusHeapLang.ivVal (a + b)]

theorem CerberusHeapLang.fib_body_wps :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (ra : core_run_annotation) (n : Int) (ibty abty bbty : core_base_type) (p : sym)
  (rs : core_run_state),
  CerberusHeapLang.LabeledAt rs p (CerberusHeapLang.fibQ ra n ibty abty bbty) →
    ∀ (i : Int) (f : Fmap sym value) (rest : List (Fmap sym value)),
      CerberusHeapLang.SymFrame f →
        0 ≤ i →
          i ≤ n →
            ⊢
              CerberusHeapLang.wps (CerberusHeapLang.procCtx rs) (some p) (CerberusHeapLang.fibLs n)
                CerberusHeapLang.emptyProcSpec (CerberusHeapLang.fibPost n)
                (CerberusHeapLang.fibBody ra n)
                (CerberusHeapLang.fibFrame (CerberusHeapLang.ivVal i)
                    (CerberusHeapLang.ivVal (CerberusHeapLang.fibSpec i.toNat))
                    (CerberusHeapLang.ivVal (CerberusHeapLang.fibSpec (i.toNat + 1))) f ::
                  rest)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.fib_body_wpt :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (ra : core_run_annotation) (n : Int) (ibty abty bbty : core_base_type) (p : sym)
  (rs : core_run_state),
  CerberusHeapLang.LabeledAt rs p (CerberusHeapLang.fibQ ra n ibty abty bbty) →
    ∀ (i : Int) (f : Fmap sym value) (rest : List (Fmap sym value)),
      CerberusHeapLang.SymFrame f →
        0 ≤ i →
          i ≤ n →
            ⊢
              CerberusHeapLang.wpt (CerberusHeapLang.procCtx rs) (some p)
                (CerberusHeapLang.fibLsT n) CerberusHeapLang.emptyProcSpecT (2 * (n - i).toNat + 3)
                (CerberusHeapLang.fibPost n) (CerberusHeapLang.fibBody ra n)
                (CerberusHeapLang.fibFrame (CerberusHeapLang.ivVal i)
                    (CerberusHeapLang.ivVal (CerberusHeapLang.fibSpec i.toNat))
                    (CerberusHeapLang.ivVal (CerberusHeapLang.fibSpec (i.toNat + 1))) f ::
                  rest)

theorem CerberusHeapLang.fib_certified :
∀ (ra : core_run_annotation) (ibty abty bbty sbty : core_base_type) (n : Int),
  0 ≤ n →
    ∀ (σ₀ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem),
      have prog := CerberusHeapLang.fibProg ra n sbty ibty abty bbty;
      have rs := CerberusHeapLang.fibRS ra n ibty abty bbty;
      CerberusHeapLang.DriverSafeCtl (CerberusHeapLang.procCtx rs)
        (CerberusHeapLang.procThread CerberusHeapLang.fibProcSym prog [fmapEmpty]) prog [fmapEmpty]
        (CerberusHeapLang.procCtl CerberusHeapLang.fibProcSym) σ₀ fun v x =>
        v = CerberusHeapLang.ivVal (CerberusHeapLang.fibSpec n.toNat)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.fib_certified_production :
∀ (sup : Nat) (ra : core_run_annotation) (n : Int) (sbty ibty abty bbty : core_base_type),
  0 ≤ n →
    2 * n.toNat + 6 ≤ CerbFuel.driverFuel →
      ∀ (fs : CerbFS.FsState) (args : List String),
        ∃ dres dst',
          CerbND.runND
                (drive fmapEmpty false
                  (CerberusHeapLang.prodFile (CerberusHeapLang.fibProg ra n sbty ibty abty bbty))
                  args)
                (initial_driver_state sup
                    (CerberusHeapLang.prodFile (CerberusHeapLang.fibProg ra n sbty ibty abty bbty))
                    fs).fst =
              [(Active dres, [], dst')] ∧
            dres.dres_core_value = CerberusHeapLang.ivVal (CerberusHeapLang.fibSpec n.toNat) ∧
              dres.dres_blocked = false ∧ dres.dres_stdout = "" ∧ dres.dres_stderr = ""
----

∀ {f : Fmap sym value},
  CerberusHeapLang.SymFrame f →
    ∀ (i a b : Int) (rest : List (Fmap sym value)),

            rest)

        some (CerberusHeapLang.ivVal a)

theorem CerberusHeapLang.fib_guard_eval :

  CerberusHeapLang.SymFrame f →
    ∀ (i a b : Int) (rest : List (Fmap sym value)) (n : Int),

theorem CerberusHeapLang.fib_rec_certified :
∀ (sup : Nat) (ra : core_run_annotation) (n : Int) (nbty xbty ybty sbty zbty : core_base_type),
  0 ≤ n →
    ∀ (fs : CerbFS.FsState) (args : List String) (fuel : Nat),
      ∃ st dst',
        CerbND.runND
              (CerbND.drive_lemFuel fuel fmapEmpty false
                (CerberusHeapLang.prodFileWith
                  (CerberusHeapLang.frProcs ra nbty xbty ybty sbty zbty)
                  (CerberusHeapLang.frMain ra n))

            [(st, [], dst')] ∧
          (st = Killed dst' CerbND.fuelExhaustedKill ∨
            ∃ dres,
              st = Active dres ∧
                dres.dres_core_value = CerberusHeapLang.ivVal (CerberusHeapLang.fibSpec n.toNat) ∧
                  dres.dres_blocked = false ∧ dres.dres_stdout = "" ∧ dres.dres_stderr = "")

theorem CerberusHeapLang.fib_wp_readout :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (ra : core_run_annotation) (n : Int) (ibty abty bbty : core_base_type) (p : sym)
