                    ⌜w.val = CerberusHeapLang.ivVal (CerberusHeapLang.fibSpec n.toNat)⌝ }}

theorem CerberusHeapLang.finalize_done :
∀ (tds : Fmap sym (CerbLocation.Loc × tag_definition)) (s : String) (dst : driver_state)
  (th : thread_state) (v : value),
  dst.core_state0.thread_states = [(0, none, th)] →
    th.arena = mk_value_e v →
      finalize tds s dst =
        { dres_blocked := dst.blocked, dres_concurrency_state := dst.concurrency_state,
          dres_driver_steps := dst.dr_step_counter, dres_core_value := v,
          dres_stdout := List.foldr String.append "" (toList dst.core_state0.io.stdout),
          dres_stderr := List.foldr String.append "" (toList dst.core_state0.io.stderr) }

theorem CerberusHeapLang.foldM_args_bridge :
∀ {th : thread_state} {tds : Fmap sym (CerbLocation.Loc × tag_definition)}
  {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem} {file : generic_file Unit core_run_annotation} {ext : Fmap sym sym}
  (f :
    CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack →
      (sym × core_base_type) × generic_pexpr Unit sym →
        core_run_state → exceptM (t0 CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack × core_run_state) core_run_cause),
  (∀ (acc : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack) (s : sym) (bTy : core_base_type)
      (pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym) (rs' : core_run_state),
      f acc ((s, bTy), pe) rs' =
        stExceptUndef_bind (full_eval_pexpr tds th ext σ file pe)
          (fun cval => stExceptUndef_return (update_env (mk_sym_pat s bTy) cval acc)) rs') →
    ∀ (params : List (sym × core_base_type)) (pes : List (generic_pexpr Unit sym)) (vs : List value)
      (acc : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack) (rs : core_run_state),
      CerberusHeapLang.evalPexprs tds ext th.env pes = some vs →
        (∀ (pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym), pe ∈ pes → CerberusHeapLang.peDepth pe ≤ lemDefaultFuel) →
          stExceptUndef_foldM f acc (params.zip pes) rs =
            Result (Defined (CerberusHeapLang.bindArgs params vs acc), rs)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.foldM_args_kill :
∀ {th : thread_state} {tds : Fmap sym (CerbLocation.Loc × tag_definition)}
  {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem} {file : generic_file Unit core_run_annotation} {ext : Fmap sym sym}
  (f :
    CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack →
      (sym × core_base_type) × generic_pexpr Unit sym →
        core_run_state → exceptM (t0 CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack × core_run_state) core_run_cause),
  (∀ (acc : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack) (s : sym) (bTy : core_base_type)
      (pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym) (rs' : core_run_state),
      f acc ((s, bTy), pe) rs' =
        stExceptUndef_bind (full_eval_pexpr tds th ext σ file pe)
          (fun cval => stExceptUndef_return (update_env (mk_sym_pat s bTy) cval acc)) rs') →
    ∀ (params : List (sym × core_base_type)) (pes : List (generic_pexpr Unit sym))
      {err : core_run_cause} (acc : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack) (rs : core_run_state),
      (∀ (pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym), pe ∈ pes → CerberusHeapLang.PePure pe) →
        (∀ (pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym), pe ∈ pes → CerberusHeapLang.peDepth pe ≤ lemDefaultFuel) →
          CerberusHeapLang.evalClassList tds th.current_loc ext file th.env
                (CerberusHeapLang.zipArgs params pes) =
              CerberusHeapLang.EvalListOut.kill err →
            stExceptUndef_foldM f acc (params.zip pes) rs = exceptM.Exception err
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.foldl_append_singletons_length :
∀ {α β : Type} (g : α → List β) (bs : List α) (init : List β),
  (∀ (p : α), p ∈ bs → (g p).length = 1) →
    (List.foldl (fun acc p => g p ++ acc) init bs).length = init.length + bs.length
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.foldl_update_env_cons :
∀ {α : Type} (f : α → pattern) (g : α → value) (xs : List α) (ev0 : Fmap sym value)
  (evs : List (Fmap sym value)),
  ∃ ev0', List.foldl (fun acc a => update_env (f a) (g a) acc) (ev0 :: evs) xs = ev0' :: evs
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.frBind_save :
∀ (zbty : core_base_type) (n a b : Int) (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack),
  CerberusHeapLang.bindSaveParams
      [(CerberusHeapLang.frZSym, (zbty, none), CerberusHeapLang.frSumPe)]
      [CerberusHeapLang.ivVal (a + b)] (CerberusHeapLang.frF2 n a b :: ρ) =
    CerberusHeapLang.frF3 n a b :: ρ

  (CerberusHeapLang.frFile ra n nbty xbty ybty sbty zbty).funs =

      (CerberusHeapLang.mainDecl (CerberusHeapLang.frMain ra n))
      (CerberusHeapLang.symAdd CerberusHeapLang.frSym
        (Proc CerbLocation.unknown none BTy_unit [(CerberusHeapLang.frNSym, nbty)]

        fmapEmpty)

theorem CerberusHeapLang.frFile_lookup_inv :
∀ (ra : core_run_annotation) (n : Int) (nbty xbty ybty sbty zbty : core_base_type) {g : sym}
  {params : List (sym × core_base_type)} {body : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr},
  CerberusHeapLang.lookupProc (CerberusHeapLang.frFile ra n nbty xbty ybty sbty zbty) fmapEmpty g =
      some (params, body) →
    CerberusHeapLang.symOrd g CerberusHeapLang.mainSym = Ordering.eq ∧
        params = [] ∧ body = CerberusHeapLang.frMain ra n ∨
      CerberusHeapLang.symOrd g CerberusHeapLang.frSym = Ordering.eq ∧
        params = [(CerberusHeapLang.frNSym, nbty)] ∧
          body = CerberusHeapLang.frBody ra xbty ybty sbty zbty

      CerberusHeapLang.mainSym =
    some ([], CerberusHeapLang.frMain ra n)

theorem CerberusHeapLang.fr_wp_readout :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (ra : core_run_annotation) (n : Int) (nbty xbty ybty sbty zbty : core_base_type) (sup : Nat),
  0 ≤ n →
    ∀ (ℓ : exec_location),
      ⊢
        WP
          { e := CerberusHeapLang.frMain ra n, ρ := [fmapEmpty],
            ctl := { κ := [], proc := some CerberusHeapLang.mainSym, execLoc := ℓ },
            M := CerberusHeapLang.frCtx ra n nbty xbty ybty sbty zbty sup } @
          Iris.Stuckness.NotStuck ;
          ⊤ {{
            w,
              ∀ σ' ns κs nt,
                Iris.stateInterp σ' ns κs nt ={⊤,∅}=∗
                  ⌜w.val = CerberusHeapLang.ivVal (CerberusHeapLang.fibSpec n.toNat)⌝ }}
----

theorem CerberusHeapLang.free_atomic :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {ctl : CerberusHeapLang.Ctl} (loc : CerbLocation.Loc)
  (ann : core_run_annotation) (kind : kill_kind) (id a : Int) (n : Nat) (bs : List CerbMem.AbsByte)
  (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack),
  is_dynamic kind = true →
    CerberusHeapLang.AtomicStep M ctl
      (CerberusHeapLang.killExpr loc ann kind (CerberusHeapLang.cellPtr id a)) ρ 1
      (CerberusHeapLang.regionOwn id a n (Iris.DFrac.own 1) bs) fun w =>
      iprop(⌜w = CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.pure Vunit⌝ ∗ CerberusHeapLang.deadRegion id a n)

def CerberusHeapLang.freshBase :
Int → Int → Nat → Int
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.freshBase_add_le :
∀ (tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap) (la alignN : Int) (ty : ctype),
  0 < CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds ty →
    CerberusHeapLang.freshBase la alignN (CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds ty) ≠ 0 →
      CerberusHeapLang.freshBase la alignN (CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds ty) +
          ↑(CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds ty) ≤
        la
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.freshBase_add_le_nat :
∀ (la alignN : Int) (size : Nat),
  CerberusHeapLang.freshBase la alignN size ≠ 0 →
    CerberusHeapLang.freshBase la alignN size + ↑size ≤ la
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.freshBase_lt_two64 :
∀ (tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap) (la alignN : Int) (ty : ctype),
  0 < CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds ty →
    CerberusHeapLang.freshBase la alignN (CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds ty) ≠ 0 →
      la ≤ 2 ^ 64 → CerberusHeapLang.freshBase la alignN (CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds ty) < 2 ^ 64
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.freshBase_ne_zero_of_cost :
∀ (la al : Int) (size : Nat),
  0 < size →
    size + al.toNat.max 1 - 1 ≤ CerberusHeapLang.headroom la →
      CerberusHeapLang.freshBase la al size ≠ 0
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.freshBase_ne_zero_of_cost' :
∀ (la al : Int) (size : Nat),
  0 < la →
    size + al.toNat.max 1 - 1 ≤ CerberusHeapLang.headroom la →
      CerberusHeapLang.freshBase la al size ≠ 0
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.freshBase_pos :
∀ (tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap) (la alignN : Int) (ty : ctype),
  CerberusHeapLang.freshBase la alignN (CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds ty) ≠ 0 →
    0 < CerberusHeapLang.freshBase la alignN (CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds ty)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.freshBase_pos_nat :
∀ (la alignN : Int) (size : Nat),
  CerberusHeapLang.freshBase la alignN size ≠ 0 → 0 < CerberusHeapLang.freshBase la alignN size
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.full_eval_bridge :
∀ {tds : Fmap sym (CerbLocation.Loc × tag_definition)} {b : Type} {ext : Fmap sym sym}
  {th : thread_state} {pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym} {v : value},
  CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr tds ext th.env pe = some v →
    CerberusHeapLang.peDepth pe ≤ lemDefaultFuel →
      ∀ (σ : CerbMem.MemState) (file : generic_file Unit core_run_annotation),
        full_eval_pexpr tds th ext σ file pe = stExceptUndef_return v
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.full_eval_bridge_kill :
∀ {tds : Fmap sym (CerbLocation.Loc × tag_definition)} {b : Type} {ext : Fmap sym sym}
  {th : thread_state} {file : generic_file Unit core_run_annotation} {pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym}
  {err : core_run_cause},
  CerberusHeapLang.PePure pe →
    CerberusHeapLang.evalClass tds th.current_loc ext file th.env pe =
        CerberusHeapLang.EvalOut.kill err →
      CerberusHeapLang.peDepth pe ≤ lemDefaultFuel →
        ∀ (σ : CerbMem.MemState),
          full_eval_pexpr tds th ext σ file pe = fun x => exceptM.Exception err

theorem CerberusHeapLang.get?_singleton_isSome :
∀ (i : Int) (x : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeCell) (k : Int),
  (Iris.Std.get? (Iris.Std.PartialMap.singleton i x) k).isSome = true ↔ k = i

theorem CerberusHeapLang.get?_union' :
∀ (m₁ m₂ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerberusHeapLang.SpikeCell) (k : Int),
  Iris.Std.get? (Iris.Std.PartialMap.union m₁ m₂) k =
    (Iris.Std.get? m₁ k).orElse fun x => Iris.Std.get? m₂ k

theorem CerberusHeapLang.get?_union_isSome :
∀ (m₁ m₂ : CerberusHeapLang.CellMap) (k : Int),
  (Iris.Std.get? (Iris.Std.PartialMap.union m₁ m₂) k).isSome = true ↔
    (Iris.Std.get? m₁ k).isSome = true ∨ (Iris.Std.get? m₂ k).isSome = true

    ∀ {i : Int} {c : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeCell},
      Iris.Std.get? m' i = some c → Iris.Std.get? (Iris.Std.PartialMap.union s m') i = some c

∀ (m : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerbMem.AbsByte) (a : Int) (x : List CerbMem.AbsByte),
  CerberusHeapLang.insertRange m a x =
    match x with
    | [] => m
    | b :: bs => CerberusHeapLang.insertRange (Iris.Std.insert m a b) (a + 1) bs

  Iris.Std.get? (CerberusHeapLang.insertRange m a bs) k =
    if a ≤ k ∧ k < a + ↑bs.length then bs[(k - a).toNat]? else Iris.Std.get? m k

def CerberusHeapLang.isList :
{hlc : Iris.HasLC} →
  {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} →
    [CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF] → CerbMem.PointerValue → List (Int × Int) → Iris.IProp GF
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.isList_cons :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (p : CerbMem.PointerValue) (nd : Int × Int) (ns : List (Int × Int)),
  CerberusHeapLang.isList p (nd :: ns) =
    iprop(∃ aN q bs,
        ⌜p = CerberusHeapLang.cellPtr nd.fst aN ∧
              0 < aN ∧
                aN < 2 ^ 64 ∧
                  bs.length = 16 ∧
                    CerberusHeapLang.nodeValDec fmapEmpty bs nd.snd ∧
                      CerberusHeapLang.nodeNextDec fmapEmpty bs q⌝ ∗
          CerberusHeapLang.cellOwn fmapEmpty nd.fst (Iris.DFrac.own 1)
              { addr := aN, ty := CerberusHeapLang.nodeTy, bytes := bs } ∗
            CerberusHeapLang.isList q ns)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.isList_cons_intro :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (id aN : Int) (q : CerbMem.PointerValue) (bs : List CerbMem.AbsByte) (v : Int)
  (ns : List (Int × Int)),
  0 < aN →
    aN < 2 ^ 64 →
      bs.length = 16 →
        CerberusHeapLang.nodeValDec fmapEmpty bs v →
          CerberusHeapLang.nodeNextDec fmapEmpty bs q →
            CerberusHeapLang.cellOwn fmapEmpty id (Iris.DFrac.own 1)
                  { addr := aN, ty := CerberusHeapLang.nodeTy, bytes := bs } ∗
                CerberusHeapLang.isList q ns ⊢
              CerberusHeapLang.isList (CerberusHeapLang.cellPtr id aN) ((id, v) :: ns)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.isList_nil :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (p : CerbMem.PointerValue), CerberusHeapLang.isList p [] = iprop(⌜p = CerberusHeapLang.nullNode⌝)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.isList_nil_intro :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF],
  ⊢ CerberusHeapLang.isList CerberusHeapLang.nullNode []
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.isList_shape :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (p : CerbMem.PointerValue) (ws : List (Int × Int)),
  CerberusHeapLang.isList p ws ⊢
    ⌜p = CerberusHeapLang.nullNode ∨
          ∃ id aN, p = CerberusHeapLang.cellPtr id aN ∧ 0 < aN ∧ aN < 2 ^ 64⌝ ∗
      CerberusHeapLang.isList p ws
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.isList_to_cells :
∀ {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS Iris.HasLC.hasLC GF]
  (ws : List (Int × Int)) (p : CerbMem.PointerValue),
  CerberusHeapLang.isList p ws ⊢
    ∃ m,
      ⌜CerberusHeapLang.SeedChain m p ws⌝ ∗
        [∗map] i ↦ c ∈ m, CerberusHeapLang.cellOwn fmapEmpty i (Iris.DFrac.own 1) c
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.isList_two_ne :
∀ {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS Iris.HasLC.hasLC GF]
  (p : CerbMem.PointerValue) (i₁ v₁ i₂ v₂ : Int),
  CerberusHeapLang.isList p [(i₁, v₁), (i₂, v₂)] ⊢
    ⌜i₁ ≠ i₂⌝ ∗ CerberusHeapLang.isList p [(i₁, v₁), (i₂, v₂)]
----
def CerberusHeapLang.isMirroredOp :
binop → Bool
----
def CerberusHeapLang.isPePure :
generic_pexpr Unit sym → Bool
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.isPePure.eq_def :
∀ (x : generic_pexpr Unit sym),
  CerberusHeapLang.isPePure x =
    match x with
    | Pexpr a a_1 (PEval a_2) => true
    | Pexpr a a_1 (PEsym a_2) => true
    | Pexpr a a_1 (PEop op pe1 pe2) =>
      CerberusHeapLang.isMirroredOp op && CerberusHeapLang.isPePure pe1 &&
        CerberusHeapLang.isPePure pe2
    | Pexpr a a_1 (PEarray_shift pe1 a_2 pe2) =>
      CerberusHeapLang.isPePure pe1 && CerberusHeapLang.isPePure pe2
    | x => false
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.isPePure.induct :
∀ (motive : generic_pexpr Unit sym → Prop),
  (∀ (a : List annot) (a_1 : Unit) (a_2 : value), motive (Pexpr a a_1 (PEval a_2))) →
    (∀ (a : List annot) (a_1 : Unit) (a_2 : sym), motive (Pexpr a a_1 (PEsym a_2))) →
      (∀ (a : List annot) (a_1 : Unit) (op : binop) (pe1 pe2 : generic_pexpr Unit sym),
          motive pe1 → motive pe2 → motive (Pexpr a a_1 (PEop op pe1 pe2))) →
        (∀ (a : List annot) (a_1 : Unit) (pe1 : generic_pexpr Unit sym) (a_2 : ctype)
            (pe2 : generic_pexpr Unit sym),
            motive pe1 → motive pe2 → motive (Pexpr a a_1 (PEarray_shift pe1 a_2 pe2))) →
          (∀ (t : generic_pexpr Unit sym),
              (∀ (a : List annot) (a_1 : Unit) (a_2 : value), t = Pexpr a a_1 (PEval a_2) → False) →
                (∀ (a : List annot) (a_1 : Unit) (a_2 : sym), t = Pexpr a a_1 (PEsym a_2) → False) →
                  (∀ (a : List annot) (a_1 : Unit) (op : binop) (pe1 pe2 : generic_pexpr Unit sym),
                      t = Pexpr a a_1 (PEop op pe1 pe2) → False) →
                    (∀ (a : List annot) (a_1 : Unit) (pe1 : generic_pexpr Unit sym) (a_2 : ctype)
                        (pe2 : generic_pexpr Unit sym),
                        t = Pexpr a a_1 (PEarray_shift pe1 a_2 pe2) → False) →
                      motive t) →
            ∀ (a : generic_pexpr Unit sym), motive a
----
def CerberusHeapLang.isRegionList :
{hlc : Iris.HasLC} →
  {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} →
    [CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF] → CerbMem.PointerValue → List Int → Iris.IProp GF
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.isRegionList_cons :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (p : CerbMem.PointerValue) (id : Int) (ids : List Int),
  CerberusHeapLang.isRegionList p (id :: ids) =
    iprop(∃ aN q bs,
        ⌜p = CerberusHeapLang.cellPtr id aN ∧
              0 < aN ∧ aN < 2 ^ 64 ∧ bs.length = 16 ∧ CerberusHeapLang.nodeNextDec fmapEmpty bs q⌝ ∗
          CerberusHeapLang.regionOwn id aN 16 (Iris.DFrac.own 1) bs ∗
            CerberusHeapLang.isRegionList q ids)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.isRegionList_cons_intro :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (id aN : Int) (q : CerbMem.PointerValue) (bs : List CerbMem.AbsByte) (ids : List Int),
  0 < aN →
    aN < 2 ^ 64 →
      bs.length = 16 →
        CerberusHeapLang.nodeNextDec fmapEmpty bs q →
          CerberusHeapLang.regionOwn id aN 16 (Iris.DFrac.own 1) bs ∗
              CerberusHeapLang.isRegionList q ids ⊢
            CerberusHeapLang.isRegionList (CerberusHeapLang.cellPtr id aN) (id :: ids)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.isRegionList_nil :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (p : CerbMem.PointerValue),
  CerberusHeapLang.isRegionList p [] = iprop(⌜p = CerberusHeapLang.nullNode⌝)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.isRegionList_nil_intro :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF],
  ⊢ CerberusHeapLang.isRegionList CerberusHeapLang.nullNode []
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.isRegionList_wf :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (p : CerbMem.PointerValue) (ids : List Int),
  CerberusHeapLang.isRegionList p ids ⊢ ⌜CerberusHeapLang.NodePtrWF p⌝

def CerberusHeapLang.isTree :
{hlc : Iris.HasLC} →
  {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} →
    [CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF] →
      CerbMem.PointerValue → CerberusHeapLang.NodeTree → Iris.IProp GF
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.isTree_leaf :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (p : CerbMem.PointerValue),
  CerberusHeapLang.isTree p CerberusHeapLang.NodeTree.leaf = iprop(⌜p = CerberusHeapLang.nullTree⌝)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.isTree_leaf_intro :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF],
  ⊢ CerberusHeapLang.isTree CerberusHeapLang.nullTree CerberusHeapLang.NodeTree.leaf
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.isTree_node :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (p : CerbMem.PointerValue) (id v : Int) (l r : CerberusHeapLang.NodeTree),
  CerberusHeapLang.isTree p (CerberusHeapLang.NodeTree.node id v l r) =
    iprop(∃ aN ql qr bs,
        ⌜p = CerberusHeapLang.cellPtr id aN ∧
              0 < aN ∧
                aN < 2 ^ 64 ∧
                  bs.length = 24 ∧
                    CerberusHeapLang.nodeValDec fmapEmpty bs v ∧
                      CerberusHeapLang.treePtrDec fmapEmpty bs 8 ql ∧
                        CerberusHeapLang.treePtrDec fmapEmpty bs 16 qr⌝ ∗
          CerberusHeapLang.cellOwn fmapEmpty id (Iris.DFrac.own 1)
              { addr := aN, ty := CerberusHeapLang.treeTy, bytes := bs } ∗
            CerberusHeapLang.isTree ql l ∗ CerberusHeapLang.isTree qr r)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.isTree_node_intro :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (id aN : Int) (ql qr : CerbMem.PointerValue) (bs : List CerbMem.AbsByte) (v : Int)
  (l r : CerberusHeapLang.NodeTree),
  0 < aN →
    aN < 2 ^ 64 →
      bs.length = 24 →
        CerberusHeapLang.nodeValDec fmapEmpty bs v →
          CerberusHeapLang.treePtrDec fmapEmpty bs 8 ql →
            CerberusHeapLang.treePtrDec fmapEmpty bs 16 qr →
              CerberusHeapLang.cellOwn fmapEmpty id (Iris.DFrac.own 1)
                    { addr := aN, ty := CerberusHeapLang.treeTy, bytes := bs } ∗
                  CerberusHeapLang.isTree ql l ∗ CerberusHeapLang.isTree qr r ⊢
                CerberusHeapLang.isTree (CerberusHeapLang.cellPtr id aN)
                  (CerberusHeapLang.NodeTree.node id v l r)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.isTree_shape :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (p : CerbMem.PointerValue) (t : CerberusHeapLang.NodeTree),
  CerberusHeapLang.isTree p t ⊢
    ⌜p = CerberusHeapLang.nullTree ∨
          ∃ id aN, p = CerberusHeapLang.cellPtr id aN ∧ 0 < aN ∧ aN < 2 ^ 64⌝ ∗
      CerberusHeapLang.isTree p t

theorem CerberusHeapLang.isTree_to_cells :
∀ {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS Iris.HasLC.hasLC GF]

    ∃ m,
      ⌜CerberusHeapLang.SeedTree m p t⌝ ∗
        [∗map] i ↦ c ∈ m, CerberusHeapLang.cellOwn fmapEmpty i (Iris.DFrac.own 1) c

def CerberusHeapLang.jumpRedex? :
CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr → Option (sym × List (generic_pexpr Unit sym))
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.jumpRedex?.eq_def :
∀ (x : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr),
  CerberusHeapLang.jumpRedex? x =
    match x with
    | generic_expr.Expr a (Erun a_1 l pes) => some (l, pes)
    | generic_expr.Expr a (Esseq a_1 e1 a_2) => CerberusHeapLang.jumpRedex? e1
    | generic_expr.Expr a (Ewseq a_1 e1 a_2) => CerberusHeapLang.jumpRedex? e1
    | generic_expr.Expr a (Eannot a_1 b) =>
      if CerberusHeapLang.annotRooted b = true then none else CerberusHeapLang.jumpRedex? b
    | x => none
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.jumpRedex?_action :
∀ (a : List annot) (p : generic_paction core_run_annotation Unit sym),
  CerberusHeapLang.jumpRedex? (generic_expr.Expr a (Eaction p)) = none
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.jumpRedex?_annot :
∀ (a : List annot) (ds : List dyn_annotation) (b : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr),
  CerberusHeapLang.jumpRedex? (generic_expr.Expr a (Eannot ds b)) =
    if CerberusHeapLang.annotRooted b = true then none else CerberusHeapLang.jumpRedex? b
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.jumpRedex?_annot_of_not_root :
∀ {b : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} (a : List annot) (ds : List dyn_annotation),
  CerberusHeapLang.annotRooted b = false →
    CerberusHeapLang.jumpRedex? (generic_expr.Expr a (Eannot ds b)) = CerberusHeapLang.jumpRedex? b

  CerberusHeapLang.annotRooted b = true →
    CerberusHeapLang.jumpRedex? (generic_expr.Expr a (Eannot ds b)) = none

theorem CerberusHeapLang.killM_killed_inv :
∀ (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (isDyn : Bool) (pv : CerbMem.PointerValue) (σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem)
  {r : kill_reason mem_error} {σ' : CerberusHeapLang.Mem},
  CerberusHeapLang.runOne (CerbMem.killM loc isDyn pv) σ = (NDkilled r, σ') →
    σ' = σ ∧
      (r = Undef0 loc [UB179a_non_matching_allocation_free] ∨
        r = Undef0 loc [UB179b_dead_allocation_free] ∨
          r = Other (MerrUndefinedFree Free_out_of_bound))
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.killM_layer :
∀ (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (isDyn : Bool) (pv : CerbMem.PointerValue) (σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem),
  (∃ u σ', CerberusHeapLang.runOne (CerbMem.killM loc isDyn pv) σ = (NDactive u, σ')) ∨
    ∃ r σ', CerberusHeapLang.runOne (CerbMem.killM loc isDyn pv) σ = (NDkilled r, σ')
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.killM_loc_irrel :
∀ (loc loc' : CerbLocation.Loc) {isDyn : Bool} {pv : CerbMem.PointerValue}
  {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem},
  CerberusHeapLang.applyMemM (CerbMem.killM loc' isDyn pv) σ =
    CerberusHeapLang.applyMemM (CerbMem.killM loc isDyn pv) σ
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.killM_success :
∀ (σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem) (id : Int) (mc : CerberusHeapLang.MetaCell) (loc : CerbLocation.Loc),
  CerberusHeapLang.MetaCoh σ id mc →
    mc.alive = true →
      CerberusHeapLang.applyMemM (CerbMem.killM loc false (CerberusHeapLang.cellPtr id mc.addr)) σ =
        some
          ((),
            { nextAllocId := σ.nextAllocId, nextIota := σ.nextIota, lastAddress := σ.lastAddress,
              allocations := σ.allocations.erase id, iotaMap := σ.iotaMap, funptrmap := σ.funptrmap,
              varargs := σ.varargs, nextVarargsId := σ.nextVarargsId, bytemap := σ.bytemap,
              lastUsedUnionMembers := σ.lastUsedUnionMembers,
              deadAllocations := id :: σ.deadAllocations, dynamicAddrs := σ.dynamicAddrs,
              lastUsed := σ.lastUsed, requested := σ.requested })
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.killM_success_dynamic :
∀ (σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem) (id : Int) (mc : CerberusHeapLang.MetaCell) (loc : CerbLocation.Loc),
  CerberusHeapLang.MetaCoh σ id mc →
    mc.alive = true →
      mc.dynamic = true →
        CerberusHeapLang.applyMemM (CerbMem.killM loc true (CerberusHeapLang.cellPtr id mc.addr))
            σ =
          some
            ((),
              { nextAllocId := σ.nextAllocId, nextIota := σ.nextIota, lastAddress := σ.lastAddress,
                allocations := σ.allocations.erase id, iotaMap := σ.iotaMap,
                funptrmap := σ.funptrmap, varargs := σ.varargs, nextVarargsId := σ.nextVarargsId,
                bytemap := σ.bytemap, lastUsedUnionMembers := σ.lastUsedUnionMembers,
                deadAllocations := id :: σ.deadAllocations, dynamicAddrs := σ.dynamicAddrs,
                lastUsed := σ.lastUsed, requested := σ.requested })

theorem CerberusHeapLang.kill_atomic :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {ctl : CerberusHeapLang.Ctl} (loc : CerbLocation.Loc)
  (ann : core_run_annotation) (kind : kill_kind) (pv : CerbMem.PointerValue) (ty : ctype)
  (bs : List CerbMem.AbsByte) (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack),
  is_dynamic kind = false →
    CerberusHeapLang.AtomicStep M ctl (CerberusHeapLang.killExpr loc ann kind pv) ρ 1
      (pv ↦c[M.tagDefs]{Iris.DFrac.own 1} ty ; bs) fun w =>
      iprop(⌜w = CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.pure Vunit⌝ ∗
          ∃ id a, ⌜pv = CerberusHeapLang.cellPtr id a⌝ ∗ CerberusHeapLang.deadObj M.tagDefs id a ty)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.kill_sym_step :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {loc : CerbLocation.Loc} {ann : core_run_annotation}
  {kind : kill_kind} {x : sym} {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack} {ctl : CerberusHeapLang.Ctl}
  {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem} {pv : CerbMem.PointerValue},
  CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr M.tagDefs M.extern ρ (Pexpr [] () (PEsym x)) =
      some (Vobject (OVpointer pv)) →
    CerberusHeapLang.Step M
      (CerberusHeapLang.killOpRedex loc ann kind (Pexpr [] () (PEsym x)), ρ, ctl, σ)
      (CerberusHeapLang.killRedex loc ann kind pv, ρ, ctl, σ)

    some { lastAddr := σ.lastAddress, nextId := σ.nextAllocId }

theorem CerberusHeapLang.launchResources :
∀ (tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap) {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors}
  [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS Iris.HasLC.hasLC GF] (σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem)
  (m : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerberusHeapLang.SpikeCell) (B : Nat),
  CerberusHeapLang.LaunchCoh tds σ m B →
    CerberusHeapLang.metaInterp ∅ ∗
        CerberusHeapLang.byteInterp ∅ ∗
          CerberusHeapLang.cursorInterp ∅ ∗ CerberusHeapLang.budgetAuth 0 ⊢
      |==>
        (Iris.stateInterp σ 0 [] 0 ∗
          ([∗map] i ↦ c ∈ m, CerberusHeapLang.cellOwn tds i (Iris.DFrac.own 1) c) ∗
            CerberusHeapLang.allocBudget B)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.lemNatBeq_iff :
∀ (n1 n2 : Nat), (n1 == n2) = true ↔ n1 = n2
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.lemNatBeq_self :
∀ (n : Nat), (n == n) = true

theorem CerberusHeapLang.list_reverse_certified :
∀ (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ann ra : core_run_annotation) (mo : memory_order)
  (pbty cbty bbty nbty ubty sbty : core_base_type) (ns : List (Int × Int))
  (head : CerbMem.PointerValue) (m₀ : CerberusHeapLang.CellMap),
  CerberusHeapLang.SeedChain m₀ head ns →
    ∀ (R : CerberusHeapLang.CellMap),
      Iris.Std.PartialMap.disjoint m₀ R →
        ∀ (σ₀ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem),
          CerberusHeapLang.Sat fmapEmpty σ₀ (Iris.Std.PartialMap.union m₀ R) →
            have prog := CerberusHeapLang.lrProg loc ann ra mo sbty pbty cbty bbty nbty ubty head;
            have rs := CerberusHeapLang.lrRS loc ann ra mo pbty cbty bbty nbty ubty;
            CerberusHeapLang.DriverSafeCtl (CerberusHeapLang.procCtx rs)
              (CerberusHeapLang.procThread CerberusHeapLang.lrProcSym prog [fmapEmpty]) prog
              [fmapEmpty] (CerberusHeapLang.procCtl CerberusHeapLang.lrProcSym) σ₀ fun v σ' =>
              ∃ p' Q,
                v = CerberusHeapLang.ptrVal p' ∧
                  CerberusHeapLang.SeedChain Q p' ns.reverse ∧
                    (∀ (k : Int),
                        (Iris.Std.get? Q k).isSome = true ↔ (Iris.Std.get? m₀ k).isSome = true) ∧
                      Iris.Std.PartialMap.disjoint Q R ∧
                        CerberusHeapLang.Sat fmapEmpty σ' (Iris.Std.PartialMap.union Q R)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.list_reverse_certified_production :
∀ (sup : Nat) (ra : core_run_annotation) (mo : memory_order)
  (bty sbty pbty cbty bbty nbty ubty : core_base_type) (fs : CerbFS.FsState) (args : List String),
  ∃ dres dst',
    CerbND.runND
          (drive fmapEmpty false
            (CerberusHeapLang.prodFile
              (CerberusHeapLang.lrProdProg ra mo bty sbty pbty cbty bbty nbty ubty))
            args)
          (initial_driver_state sup
              (CerberusHeapLang.prodFile
                (CerberusHeapLang.lrProdProg ra mo bty sbty pbty cbty bbty nbty ubty))
              fs).fst =
        [(Active dres, [], dst')] ∧
      (∃ i₁ i₂ Q p',
          dres.dres_core_value = CerberusHeapLang.ptrVal p' ∧
            CerberusHeapLang.SeedChain Q p' [(i₂, 2), (i₁, 1)] ∧
              CerberusHeapLang.Sat fmapEmpty dst'.layout_state Q) ∧
        dres.dres_blocked = false ∧ dres.dres_stdout = "" ∧ dres.dres_stderr = ""
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.list_reverse_demo :
∀ (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ann ra : core_run_annotation) (mo : memory_order)
  (pbty cbty bbty nbty ubty sbty : core_base_type) (R : CerberusHeapLang.CellMap),
  Iris.Std.PartialMap.disjoint CerberusHeapLang.demoM R →
    ∀ (σ₀ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem),
      CerberusHeapLang.Sat fmapEmpty σ₀ (Iris.Std.PartialMap.union CerberusHeapLang.demoM R) →
        have prog :=
          CerberusHeapLang.lrProg loc ann ra mo sbty pbty cbty bbty nbty ubty
            CerberusHeapLang.demoHead;
        have rs := CerberusHeapLang.lrRS loc ann ra mo pbty cbty bbty nbty ubty;
        CerberusHeapLang.DriverSafeCtl (CerberusHeapLang.procCtx rs)
          (CerberusHeapLang.procThread CerberusHeapLang.lrProcSym prog [fmapEmpty]) prog [fmapEmpty]
          (CerberusHeapLang.procCtl CerberusHeapLang.lrProcSym) σ₀ fun v σ' =>
          ∃ p' Q,
            v = CerberusHeapLang.ptrVal p' ∧
              CerberusHeapLang.SeedChain Q p' [(3, 3), (2, 2), (1, 1)] ∧
                (∀ (k : Int),
                    (Iris.Std.get? Q k).isSome = true ↔
                      (Iris.Std.get? CerberusHeapLang.demoM k).isSome = true) ∧
                  Iris.Std.PartialMap.disjoint Q R ∧
                    CerberusHeapLang.Sat fmapEmpty σ' (Iris.Std.PartialMap.union Q R) ∧
                      CerberusHeapLang.ChainAt σ' p' [(3, 3), (2, 2), (1, 1)]

theorem CerberusHeapLang.loadAt_atomic :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {ctl : CerberusHeapLang.Ctl} (loc : CerbLocation.Loc)
  (ann : core_run_annotation) (id a : Int) (aty : ctype) (off : Nat) (vty : ctype)
  (mo : memory_order) (dqm dqb : Iris.DFrac) (bs : List CerbMem.AbsByte)
  (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack) {mv : CerbMem.MemValue},
  (∀ (lum : List (Int × identifier)) (fpm : CerbMem.Funptrmap),
      CerbMem.reconstructValue M.tagDefs lum fpm (a + ↑off) vty bs = mv) →
    CerberusHeapLang.loadTrapV vty mv = false →
      CerberusHeapLang.AtomicStep M ctl
        (CerberusHeapLang.loadExpr loc ann vty (CerberusHeapLang.cellPtr id (a + ↑off)) mo) ρ 2
        (CerberusHeapLang.pointsToView M.tagDefs id a aty off dqm dqb vty bs) fun w =>
        iprop(∃ fp,
            ⌜w = CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.annot [DA_pos [] fp] (valueFromMemValue mv).snd⌝ ∗
              CerberusHeapLang.pointsToView M.tagDefs id a aty off dqm dqb vty bs)

theorem CerberusHeapLang.loadM_at :
∀ (tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap) (σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem) (id a : Int) (aty : ctype) (off : Nat)
  (vty : ctype) (bs : List CerbMem.AbsByte) (mv : CerbMem.MemValue) (loc : CerbLocation.Loc),
  CerberusHeapLang.MetaCoh σ id (CerberusHeapLang.objCell tds a aty true false) →
    off + CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds vty ≤ CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds aty →
      CerbMem.readBytesFrom σ (a + ↑off) (CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds vty) = bs →
        CerbMem.reconstructValue tds σ.lastUsedUnionMembers σ.funptrmap (a + ↑off) vty bs = mv →
          CerberusHeapLang.loadTrapV vty mv = false →
            CerberusHeapLang.applyMemM
                (CerbMem.loadM tds loc vty (CerberusHeapLang.cellPtr id (a + ↑off))) σ =
              some
                ((CerbMem.Footprint.FP CerbMem.FootprintAccess.R (a + ↑off)
                      ↑(CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds vty),
                    mv),
                  σ)

theorem CerberusHeapLang.loadM_layer :
∀ (tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap) (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ty : ctype) (pv : CerbMem.PointerValue)
  (σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem),
  (∃ p σ', CerberusHeapLang.runOne (CerbMem.loadM tds loc ty pv) σ = (NDactive p, σ')) ∨
    ∃ r σ', CerberusHeapLang.runOne (CerbMem.loadM tds loc ty pv) σ = (NDkilled r, σ')
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.loadM_live :
∀ (tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap) (σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem) (id : Int) (mc : CerberusHeapLang.MetaCell)
  (off : Nat) (vty : ctype) (bs : List CerbMem.AbsByte) (mv : CerbMem.MemValue)
  (loc : CerbLocation.Loc),
  CerberusHeapLang.MetaCoh σ id mc →
    mc.alive = true →
      off + CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds vty ≤ mc.size →
        CerbMem.readBytesFrom σ (mc.addr + ↑off) (CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds vty) = bs →
          CerbMem.reconstructValue tds σ.lastUsedUnionMembers σ.funptrmap (mc.addr + ↑off) vty bs =
              mv →
            CerberusHeapLang.loadTrapV vty mv = false →
              CerberusHeapLang.applyMemM
                  (CerbMem.loadM tds loc vty (CerberusHeapLang.cellPtr id (mc.addr + ↑off))) σ =
                some
                  ((CerbMem.Footprint.FP CerbMem.FootprintAccess.R (mc.addr + ↑off)
                        ↑(CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds vty),
                      mv),
                    σ)

theorem CerberusHeapLang.loadM_success :
∀ (tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap) (σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem) (id : Int) (c : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeCell)
  (loc : CerbLocation.Loc),
  CerberusHeapLang.CellCoh tds σ id c →
    CerberusHeapLang.cellLoadTrap tds c = false →
      CerberusHeapLang.applyMemM (CerbMem.loadM tds loc c.ty (CerberusHeapLang.cellPtr id c.addr))
          σ =
        some
          ((CerbMem.Footprint.FP CerbMem.FootprintAccess.R c.addr ↑(CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds c.ty),
              CerberusHeapLang.decodeCell tds c),

theorem CerberusHeapLang.load_atomic :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {ctl : CerberusHeapLang.Ctl} (loc : CerbLocation.Loc)
  (ann : core_run_annotation) (ty : ctype) (pv : CerbMem.PointerValue) (mo : memory_order)
  (dq : Iris.DFrac) (bs : List CerbMem.AbsByte) (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack),
  CerberusHeapLang.cellLoadTrap M.tagDefs
        { addr := CerberusHeapLang.addrOf pv, ty := ty, bytes := bs } =
      false →
    CerberusHeapLang.AtomicStep M ctl (CerberusHeapLang.loadExpr loc ann ty pv mo) ρ 2
      (pv ↦c[M.tagDefs]{dq} ty ; bs) fun w =>
      iprop(∃ fp,
          ⌜w =
                CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.annot [DA_pos [] fp]
                  (CerberusHeapLang.loadedVal M.tagDefs pv ty bs)⌝ ∗
            pv ↦c[M.tagDefs]{dq} ty ; bs)

        { addr := CerberusHeapLang.addrOf pv, ty := ty, bytes := bs } =
      false →
    CerberusHeapLang.AtomicStep M ctl (CerberusHeapLang.loadExpr loc ann ty pv mo) ρ 2
      (CerberusHeapLang.readonlyCell M.tagDefs pv dq ty bs) fun w =>

                CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.annot [DA_pos [] fp]
                  (CerberusHeapLang.loadedVal M.tagDefs pv ty bs)⌝ ∗

∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ann ra : core_run_annotation) (mo : memory_order)

theorem CerberusHeapLang.loop_body_wps :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ann ra : core_run_annotation) (mo : memory_order)
  (bty xbty : core_base_type) (c : CerbMem.PointerValue) (n : Int) (bs0 : List CerbMem.AbsByte)
  (p : sym) (rs : core_run_state),
  CerberusHeapLang.LabeledAt rs p (CerberusHeapLang.loopQ loc ann ra mo bty xbty c) →
    ∀ (i : Int) (f : Fmap sym value) (rest : List (Fmap sym value)),
      CerberusHeapLang.SymFrame f →
        0 ≤ i →
          i ≤ n →
            ⌜i = n⌝ ∗
                  c ↦c[(CerberusHeapLang.procCtx rs).tagDefs]{Iris.DFrac.own 1}
                    CerberusHeapLang.intTy ; bs0 ∨
                ⌜i < n⌝ ∗
                  c ↦c[(CerberusHeapLang.procCtx rs).tagDefs]{Iris.DFrac.own 1}
                    CerberusHeapLang.intTy ;
                    CerberusHeapLang.sevenBytes (CerberusHeapLang.procCtx rs).tagDefs ⊢
              CerberusHeapLang.wps (CerberusHeapLang.procCtx rs) (some p)
                (CerberusHeapLang.loopLs c n bs0) CerberusHeapLang.emptyProcSpec
                (CerberusHeapLang.loopPost c n bs0) (CerberusHeapLang.loopBody loc ann ra mo bty c)
                (CerberusHeapLang.envAdd CerberusHeapLang.xSym (CerberusHeapLang.ivVal i) f :: rest)

theorem CerberusHeapLang.loop_readout_val :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (c : CerbMem.PointerValue) (n : Int) (bs0 : List CerbMem.AbsByte) (w : CerberusHeapLang.CoreRVal),
  CerberusHeapLang.loopPost c n bs0 w.w w.ρ ⊢
    ∀ σ' ns κs nt,
      Iris.stateInterp σ' ns κs nt ={⊤,∅}=∗
        ⌜w.val = Vunit ∧
            ∃ bs',
              (n = 0 ∧ bs' = bs0 ∨ 0 < n ∧ bs' = CerberusHeapLang.sevenBytes fmapEmpty) ∧
                ∃ i a,
                  c = CerberusHeapLang.cellPtr i a ∧
                    CerberusHeapLang.CellCoh fmapEmpty σ' i
                      { addr := a, ty := CerberusHeapLang.intTy, bytes := bs' }⌝
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.loop_step_action :
∀ (fl : Nat) (tds : Fmap sym (CerbLocation.Loc × tag_definition))
  (acc : Fmap thread_id (List core_step2)) {dst dst' : driver_state} {th : thread_state}
  {s : String} {loc : CerbLocation.Loc} {req : action_request2 thread_state},
  dst.core_state0.thread_states = [(0, none, th)] →
    step_ctx tds dst.layout_state dst.core_file dst.core_extern 0 (none, th) =
        [Step_action_request2 s loc 0 false (stExceptUndef_return req)] →
      CerberusHeapLang.runOne
            (action_request_sequential2 tds loc 0 dst.core_run_state0.aid_supply req)
            { core_file := dst.core_file, core_extern := dst.core_extern,
              core_state0 := dst.core_state0,
              core_run_state0 :=
                have __src := dst.core_run_state0;
                { tid_supply := __src.tid_supply, aid_supply := dst.core_run_state0.aid_supply + 1,
                  excluded_supply := __src.excluded_supply, sym_supply := __src.sym_supply,
                  labeled := __src.labeled },
              layout_state := dst.layout_state, concurrency_state := dst.concurrency_state,
              fs_state0 := dst.fs_state0, trace := dst.trace, symbolic_assoc := dst.symbolic_assoc,
              blocked := dst.blocked, dr_step_counter := dst.dr_step_counter } =
          (NDactive (), dst') →
        CerberusHeapLang.runOne (drive_nonmemory_steps_aux2_lemFuel fl.succ tds acc [0]) dst =
          CerberusHeapLang.runOne (drive_nonmemory_steps_aux2_lemFuel fl tds acc [0]) dst'
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.loop_step_done :
∀ (fl : Nat) (tds : Fmap sym (CerbLocation.Loc × tag_definition))
  (acc : Fmap thread_id (List core_step2)) {dst : driver_state} {th : thread_state} {v : value},
  dst.core_state0.thread_states = [(0, none, th)] →
    step_ctx tds dst.layout_state dst.core_file dst.core_extern 0 (none, th) = [Step_done2 v] →
      CerberusHeapLang.runOne (drive_nonmemory_steps_aux2_lemFuel fl.succ.succ tds acc [0]) dst =
        (NDactive (fmapAddBy defaultCompare 0 [Step_done2 v] acc), dst)

theorem CerberusHeapLang.loop_step_done_exhaust :
∀ (tds : Fmap sym (CerbLocation.Loc × tag_definition)) (acc : Fmap thread_id (List core_step2))
  {dst : driver_state} {th : thread_state} {v : value},
  dst.core_state0.thread_states = [(0, none, th)] →
    step_ctx tds dst.layout_state dst.core_file dst.core_extern 0 (none, th) = [Step_done2 v] →
      CerberusHeapLang.runOne (drive_nonmemory_steps_aux2_lemFuel (Nat.succ 0) tds acc [0]) dst =
        (NDkilled CerbND.fuelExhaustedKill, dst)

theorem CerberusHeapLang.loop_step_frag :
∀ {M₀ : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {ctl ctl' : CerberusHeapLang.Ctl},
  M₀.tagDefs = fmapEmpty →
    M₀.extern = fmapEmpty →
      ∀ {Q : CerberusHeapLang.LabelMap},
        M₀.labelsAt ctl.proc = Q →
          ∀ {p : sym},
            ctl.proc = some p →
              ∀ {th₀ : thread_state},
                th₀.stack0 = ctl.toStack →
                  th₀.current_proc_opt = ctl.proc →
                    th₀.exec_loc = ctl.execLoc →
                      th₀.current_loc = M₀.currentLoc →
                        ∀ (fl : Nat) (acc : Fmap thread_id (List core_step2)) {dst : driver_state}
                          {e e' : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {ev0 : Fmap sym value}
                          {evs : List (Fmap sym value)} {ρ' : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack}
                          {σ' : CerberusHeapLang.Mem},
                          dst.core_state0.thread_states =
                              [(0, none,
                                  { arena := e, stack0 := th₀.stack0, errno := th₀.errno,
                                    env := ev0 :: evs, current_proc_opt := th₀.current_proc_opt,
                                    exec_loc := th₀.exec_loc, current_loc := th₀.current_loc })] →
                            dst.core_extern = fmapEmpty →
                              dst.core_file = M₀.file →
                                CerberusHeapLang.LabeledAt dst.core_run_state0 p Q →
                                  CerberusHeapLang.Frag e →
                                    CerberusHeapLang.esize e ≤ lemDefaultFuel →
                                      CerberusHeapLang.Step M₀
                                          (e, ev0 :: evs, ctl, dst.layout_state)
                                          (e', ρ', ctl', σ') →
                                        ∃ rs' tr ctr,
                                          rs'.labeled = dst.core_run_state0.labeled ∧
                                            CerberusHeapLang.runOne
                                                (drive_nonmemory_steps_aux2_lemFuel fl.succ
                                                  fmapEmpty acc [0])
                                                dst =
                                              CerberusHeapLang.runOne
                                                (drive_nonmemory_steps_aux2_lemFuel fl fmapEmpty acc
                                                  [0])
                                                { core_file := dst.core_file,
                                                  core_extern := dst.core_extern,
                                                  core_state0 :=
                                                    update_thread_state 0
                                                      { arena := e', stack0 := ctl'.toStack,
                                                        errno := th₀.errno, env := ρ',
                                                        current_proc_opt := ctl'.proc,
                                                        exec_loc := ctl'.execLoc,
                                                        current_loc := th₀.current_loc }
                                                      dst.core_state0,
                                                  core_run_state0 := rs', layout_state := σ',
                                                  concurrency_state := dst.concurrency_state,
                                                  fs_state0 := dst.fs_state0, trace := tr,
                                                  symbolic_assoc := dst.symbolic_assoc,
                                                  blocked := dst.blocked, dr_step_counter := ctr }
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.loop_step_frag' :
∀ {M₀ : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {ctl ctl' : CerberusHeapLang.Ctl},
  M₀.tagDefs = fmapEmpty →
    M₀.extern = fmapEmpty →
      ∀ {th₀ : thread_state},
        th₀.stack0 = ctl.toStack →
          th₀.current_proc_opt = ctl.proc →
            th₀.exec_loc = ctl.execLoc →
              th₀.current_loc = M₀.currentLoc →
                ∀ (fl : Nat) (acc : Fmap thread_id (List core_step2)) {dst : driver_state}
                  {e e' : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {ev0 : Fmap sym value}
                  {evs : List (Fmap sym value)} {ρ' : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack}
                  {σ' : CerberusHeapLang.Mem},
                  dst.core_state0.thread_states =
                      [(0, none,
                          { arena := e, stack0 := th₀.stack0, errno := th₀.errno, env := ev0 :: evs,
                            current_proc_opt := th₀.current_proc_opt, exec_loc := th₀.exec_loc,
                            current_loc := th₀.current_loc })] →
                    dst.core_extern = fmapEmpty →
                      dst.core_file = M₀.file →
                        (∀ (l : sym) (params : List (sym × core_base_type))
                            (cont : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr),
                            CerberusHeapLang.lookupLabel (M₀.labelsAt ctl.proc) l =
                                some (params, cont) →
                              ∃ p,
                                th₀.current_proc_opt = some p ∧
                                  CerberusHeapLang.LabeledAt dst.core_run_state0 p
                                    (M₀.labelsAt ctl.proc)) →
                          CerberusHeapLang.Frag e →
                            CerberusHeapLang.esize e ≤ lemDefaultFuel →
                              CerberusHeapLang.Step M₀ (e, ev0 :: evs, ctl, dst.layout_state)
                                  (e', ρ', ctl', σ') →
                                ∃ rs' tr ctr,
                                  rs'.labeled = dst.core_run_state0.labeled ∧
                                    CerberusHeapLang.runOne
                                        (drive_nonmemory_steps_aux2_lemFuel fl.succ fmapEmpty acc
                                          [0])
                                        dst =
                                      CerberusHeapLang.runOne
                                        (drive_nonmemory_steps_aux2_lemFuel fl fmapEmpty acc [0])
                                        { core_file := dst.core_file,
                                          core_extern := dst.core_extern,
                                          core_state0 :=
                                            update_thread_state 0
                                              { arena := e', stack0 := ctl'.toStack,
                                                errno := th₀.errno, env := ρ',
                                                current_proc_opt := ctl'.proc,
                                                exec_loc := ctl'.execLoc,
                                                current_loc := th₀.current_loc }
                                              dst.core_state0,
                                          core_run_state0 := rs', layout_state := σ',
                                          concurrency_state := dst.concurrency_state,
                                          fs_state0 := dst.fs_state0, trace := tr,
                                          symbolic_assoc := dst.symbolic_assoc,
                                          blocked := dst.blocked, dr_step_counter := ctr }

theorem CerberusHeapLang.loop_step_of_advance :
∀ {tds : Fmap sym (CerbLocation.Loc × tag_definition)} {tid : Nat} {parent : Option Nat}
  {th : thread_state} {s : core_step2} {dst dst' : driver_state} (fl : Nat)
  (acc : Fmap thread_id (List core_step2)),
  dst.core_state0.thread_states = [(tid, parent, th)] →
    step_ctx tds dst.layout_state dst.core_file dst.core_extern tid (parent, th) = [s] →
      can_advance s = true →
        CerberusHeapLang.runOne (advance_step tds tid s) dst = (NDactive NOWAKEUP, dst') →
          CerberusHeapLang.runOne (drive_nonmemory_steps_aux2_lemFuel fl.succ tds acc [tid]) dst =
            CerberusHeapLang.runOne (drive_nonmemory_steps_aux2_lemFuel fl tds acc [tid]) dst'

theorem CerberusHeapLang.loop_step_tau :
∀ (fl : Nat) (tds : Fmap sym (CerbLocation.Loc × tag_definition))
  (acc : Fmap thread_id (List core_step2)) {dst : driver_state} {th th' : thread_state}
  {s : String},
  dst.core_state0.thread_states = [(0, none, th)] →
    step_ctx tds dst.layout_state dst.core_file dst.core_extern 0 (none, th) =
        [Step_tau2 s TSK_Misc th'] →
      CerberusHeapLang.runOne (drive_nonmemory_steps_aux2_lemFuel fl.succ tds acc [0]) dst =
        CerberusHeapLang.runOne (drive_nonmemory_steps_aux2_lemFuel fl tds acc [0])
          (have __src :=
            { core_file := dst.core_file, core_extern := dst.core_extern,
              core_state0 := dst.core_state0, core_run_state0 := dst.core_run_state0,
              layout_state := dst.layout_state, concurrency_state := dst.concurrency_state,
              fs_state0 := dst.fs_state0, trace := dst.trace, symbolic_assoc := dst.symbolic_assoc,
              blocked := dst.blocked, dr_step_counter := dst.dr_step_counter + 1 };
          { core_file := __src.core_file, core_extern := __src.core_extern,
            core_state0 := update_thread_state 0 th' dst.core_state0,
            core_run_state0 := __src.core_run_state0, layout_state := __src.layout_state,
            concurrency_state := __src.concurrency_state, fs_state0 := __src.fs_state0,
            trace := __src.trace, symbolic_assoc := __src.symbolic_assoc, blocked := __src.blocked,
            dr_step_counter := __src.dr_step_counter })

              trace := __src.trace, symbolic_assoc := __src.symbolic_assoc,
              blocked := __src.blocked, dr_step_counter := __src.dr_step_counter })

theorem CerberusHeapLang.loop_wp_readout :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ann ra : core_run_annotation) (mo : memory_order)
  (bty xbty : core_base_type) (c : CerbMem.PointerValue) (n : Int) (bs0 : List CerbMem.AbsByte)
  (p : sym) (rs : core_run_state),
  CerberusHeapLang.LabeledAt rs p (CerberusHeapLang.loopQ loc ann ra mo bty xbty c) →
    0 ≤ n →
      ∀ (sbty : core_base_type) (f : Fmap sym value),
        CerberusHeapLang.SymFrame f →
          ∀ (rest : List (Fmap sym value)),
            c ↦c[(CerberusHeapLang.procCtx rs).tagDefs]{Iris.DFrac.own 1} CerberusHeapLang.intTy ;
                bs0 ⊢
              WP
                { e := CerberusHeapLang.loopProg loc ann ra mo bty xbty sbty c n, ρ := f :: rest,
                  ctl := CerberusHeapLang.procCtl p, M := CerberusHeapLang.procCtx rs } @
                Iris.Stuckness.NotStuck ;
                ⊤ {{
                  w,
                    ∀ σ' ns κs nt,
                      Iris.stateInterp σ' ns κs nt ={⊤,∅}=∗
                        ⌜w.val = Vunit ∧
                            ∃ bs',
                              (n = 0 ∧ bs' = bs0 ∨
                                  0 < n ∧
                                    bs' =
                                      CerberusHeapLang.sevenBytes
                                        (CerberusHeapLang.procCtx rs).tagDefs) ∧
                                ∃ i a,
                                  c = CerberusHeapLang.cellPtr i a ∧
                                    CerberusHeapLang.CellCoh (CerberusHeapLang.procCtx rs).tagDefs
                                      σ' i
                                      { addr := a, ty := CerberusHeapLang.intTy, bytes := bs' }⌝ }}

theorem CerberusHeapLang.lrPost_readout :
∀ {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS Iris.HasLC.hasLC GF]
  (ns : List (Int × Int)) (R : CerberusHeapLang.CellMap) (w : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal)
  (ρ' : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack),
  CerberusHeapLang.lrPost ns w ρ' ∗ CerberusHeapLang.lrCellFrame R ⊢
    CerberusHeapLang.readoutPost
      (fun v σ' =>
        ∃ Q,
          (∃ p', v = CerberusHeapLang.ptrVal p' ∧ CerberusHeapLang.SeedChain Q p' ns.reverse) ∧
            Iris.Std.PartialMap.disjoint Q R ∧
              CerberusHeapLang.Coh fmapEmpty σ' (Iris.Std.PartialMap.union Q R))
      w ρ'

theorem CerberusHeapLang.lrProdPrefix_wpt :
∀ {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS Iris.HasLC.hasLC GF]
  (ra : core_run_annotation) (mo : memory_order) (p : sym) (rs : core_run_state)
  {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpecT GF} (bty : core_base_type) (k : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr)
  (kk : Nat) (ψ : value → CerberusHeapLang.Mem → Prop) (RF : Iris.IProp GF) (ev0 : Fmap sym value)
  (evs : List (Fmap sym value)),
  CerberusHeapLang.SymFrame ev0 →
    (∀ (i₁ a₁ i₂ a₂ : Int),
        0 < a₁ ∧ a₁ < 2 ^ 64 →
          0 < a₂ ∧ a₂ < 2 ^ 64 →
            CerberusHeapLang.isList (CerberusHeapLang.cellPtr i₁ a₁) [(i₁, 1), (i₂, 2)] ∗ RF ⊢
              CerberusHeapLang.wpt (CerberusHeapLang.procCtx rs) (some p) Ls
                CerberusHeapLang.emptyProcSpecT kk (CerberusHeapLang.readoutPost ψ) k
                (CerberusHeapLang.lrPFrame
                    (CerberusHeapLang.ptrVal (CerberusHeapLang.cellPtr i₁ a₁))
                    (CerberusHeapLang.ptrVal (CerberusHeapLang.cellPtr i₂ a₂)) ev0 ::
                  evs)) →
      CerberusHeapLang.allocBudget
            (CerberusHeapLang.allocCost (CerberusHeapLang.procCtx rs).tagDefs
                CerberusHeapLang.nodeTy 8 +
              CerberusHeapLang.allocCost (CerberusHeapLang.procCtx rs).tagDefs
                CerberusHeapLang.nodeTy 8) ∗
          RF ⊢
        CerberusHeapLang.wpt (CerberusHeapLang.procCtx rs) (some p) Ls
          CerberusHeapLang.emptyProcSpecT (2 + (2 + (3 + 1 + (3 + 1 + (3 + 1 + (3 + 1 + kk))))))
          (CerberusHeapLang.readoutPost ψ) (CerberusHeapLang.lrProdPrefix ra mo bty k) (ev0 :: evs)

theorem CerberusHeapLang.lrProd_wpt :
∀ {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS Iris.HasLC.hasLC GF]
  (ra : core_run_annotation) (mo : memory_order) (pbty cbty bbty nbty ubty : core_base_type)
  (p : sym) (rs : core_run_state),
  CerberusHeapLang.LabeledAt rs p
      (CerberusHeapLang.lrQ CerberusHeapLang.loc0 empty_annotation ra mo pbty cbty bbty nbty ubty) →
    ∀ (bty sbty : core_base_type) (ev0 : Fmap sym value) (evs : List (Fmap sym value)),
      CerberusHeapLang.SymFrame ev0 →
        CerberusHeapLang.allocBudget
            (CerberusHeapLang.allocCost (CerberusHeapLang.procCtx rs).tagDefs
                CerberusHeapLang.nodeTy 8 +
              CerberusHeapLang.allocCost (CerberusHeapLang.procCtx rs).tagDefs
                CerberusHeapLang.nodeTy 8) ⊢
          CerberusHeapLang.wpt (CerberusHeapLang.procCtx rs) (some p) CerberusHeapLang.lrProdLsT
            CerberusHeapLang.emptyProcSpecT
            (2 +
              (2 +
                (3 + 1 +
                  (3 + 1 +
                    (3 + 1 +
                      (3 + 1 +
                        (CerberusHeapLang.lrCost 2 +
                          CerberusHeapLang.saveEntryCost
                            (CerberusHeapLang.lrProdParams pbty cbty))))))))
            (CerberusHeapLang.readoutPost CerberusHeapLang.ψL)
            (CerberusHeapLang.lrProdProg ra mo bty sbty pbty cbty bbty nbty ubty) (ev0 :: evs)
----

theorem CerberusHeapLang.lr_wp_readout :
∀ (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ann ra : core_run_annotation) (mo : memory_order)
  (pbty cbty bbty nbty ubty : core_base_type) {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors}
  [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS Iris.HasLC.hasLC GF] (ns : List (Int × Int)) (p : sym)
  (rs : core_run_state),
  CerberusHeapLang.LabeledAt rs p (CerberusHeapLang.lrQ loc ann ra mo pbty cbty bbty nbty ubty) →
    ∀ (sbty : core_base_type) (head : CerbMem.PointerValue) (R : CerberusHeapLang.CellMap),
      CerberusHeapLang.isList head ns ∗ CerberusHeapLang.lrCellFrame R ⊢
        WP
          { e := CerberusHeapLang.lrProg loc ann ra mo sbty pbty cbty bbty nbty ubty head,
            ρ := [fmapEmpty], ctl := CerberusHeapLang.procCtl p,
            M := CerberusHeapLang.procCtx rs } @
          Iris.Stuckness.NotStuck ;
          ⊤ {{
            w,
              ∀ σ' ns' κs nt,
                Iris.stateInterp σ' ns' κs nt ={⊤,∅}=∗
                  ⌜∃ Q,
                      (∃ p',
                          w.val = CerberusHeapLang.ptrVal p' ∧
                            CerberusHeapLang.SeedChain Q p' ns.reverse) ∧
                        Iris.Std.PartialMap.disjoint Q R ∧
                          CerberusHeapLang.Coh (CerberusHeapLang.procCtx rs).tagDefs σ'
                            (Iris.Std.PartialMap.union Q R)⌝ }}

theorem CerberusHeapLang.malloc_list_certified_production :
∀ (ra : core_run_annotation) (mo : memory_order) (al : Int) (pref : prefix0)
  (sbty ibty pbty qbty bbty nbty ubty : core_base_type) (sup : Nat) (n : Int),
  0 ≤ n →
    n.toNat * (15 + max al.toNat 1) ≤ 281474976710647 →
      25 * n.toNat + 9 ≤ CerbFuel.driverFuel →
        ∀ (fs : CerbFS.FsState) (args : List String),
          ∃ dres dst',
            CerbND.runND
                  (drive fmapEmpty false
                    (CerberusHeapLang.prodFile
                      (CerberusHeapLang.mlProg CerberusHeapLang.loc0 empty_annotation ra mo al pref
                        sbty ibty pbty qbty bbty nbty ubty n))
                    args)
                  (initial_driver_state sup
                      (CerberusHeapLang.prodFile
                        (CerberusHeapLang.mlProg CerberusHeapLang.loc0 empty_annotation ra mo al
                          pref sbty ibty pbty qbty bbty nbty ubty n))
                      fs).fst =
                [(Active dres, [], dst')] ∧
              dres.dres_core_value = Vunit ∧
                (∃ ids,
                    ids.length = n.toNat ∧
                      ids.Nodup ∧
                        ∀ (id : Int),
                          id ∈ ids →
                            dst'.layout_state.deadAllocations.contains id = true ∧
                              dst'.layout_state.allocations.get? id = none) ∧
                  dres.dres_blocked = false ∧ dres.dres_stdout = "" ∧ dres.dres_stderr = ""
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.mapM1_id_defined :
∀ {α : Type} (vs : List α), mapM1 (fun x => x) (List.map Defined vs) = Defined vs
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.mapM_eval1_bridge :
∀ {ext : Fmap sym sym} {th : thread_state} {tds : Fmap sym (CerbLocation.Loc × tag_definition)}
  {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem} {file : generic_file Unit core_run_annotation}
  (f :
    generic_pexpr Unit sym →
      core_run_state → exceptM (t0 (generic_pexpr Unit sym) × core_run_state) core_run_cause),
  (∀ (pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym) (rs' : core_run_state),
      f pe rs' =
        stExceptUndef_bind (E.eval_pexpr20 tds th ext σ file pe)
          (fun x =>
            match (motive :=
              pexpr ⊕ value → core_run_state → exceptM (t0 pexpr × core_run_state) core_run_cause)
              x with
            | Sum.inl pe' => stExceptUndef_return pe'
            | Sum.inr cval => stExceptUndef_return (mk_value_pe cval))
          rs') →
    ∀ {pe1 pe2 : generic_pexpr Unit sym} {v1 v2 : value},
      CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr tds ext th.env pe1 = some v1 →
        CerberusHeapLang.peDepth pe1 ≤ lemDefaultFuel →
          CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr tds ext th.env pe2 = some v2 →
            CerberusHeapLang.peDepth pe2 ≤ lemDefaultFuel →
              ∀ (rs : core_run_state),
                stExceptUndef_mapM f [pe1, pe2] rs =
                  Result (Defined [mk_value_pe v1, mk_value_pe v2], rs)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.mapM_eval1_kill :
∀ {ext : Fmap sym sym} {th : thread_state} {tds : Fmap sym (CerbLocation.Loc × tag_definition)}
  {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem} {file : generic_file Unit core_run_annotation}
  (f :
    generic_pexpr Unit sym →
      core_run_state → exceptM (t0 (generic_pexpr Unit sym) × core_run_state) core_run_cause),
  (∀ (pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym) (rs' : core_run_state),
      f pe rs' =
        stExceptUndef_bind (E.eval_pexpr20 tds th ext σ file pe)
          (fun x =>
            match (motive :=
              pexpr ⊕ value → core_run_state → exceptM (t0 pexpr × core_run_state) core_run_cause)
              x with
            | Sum.inl pe' => stExceptUndef_return pe'
            | Sum.inr cval => stExceptUndef_return (mk_value_pe cval))
          rs') →
    ∀ (pes : List (generic_pexpr Unit sym)) {err : core_run_cause},
      (∀ (pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym), pe ∈ pes → CerberusHeapLang.PePure pe) →
        (∀ (pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym), pe ∈ pes → CerberusHeapLang.peDepth pe ≤ lemDefaultFuel) →
          CerberusHeapLang.evalClassList tds th.current_loc ext file th.env pes =
              CerberusHeapLang.EvalListOut.kill err →
            ∀ (rs : core_run_state), stExceptUndef_mapM f pes rs = exceptM.Exception err

theorem CerberusHeapLang.mapM_full_eval_bridge :
∀ {th : thread_state} {tds : Fmap sym (CerbLocation.Loc × tag_definition)}
  {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem} {file : generic_file Unit core_run_annotation} {ext : Fmap sym sym}
  (f :
    generic_pexpr Unit sym → core_run_state → exceptM (t0 value × core_run_state) core_run_cause),
  (∀ (pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym) (rs' : core_run_state),
      f pe rs' = full_eval_pexpr tds th ext σ file pe rs') →

        (∀ (pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym), pe ∈ pes → CerberusHeapLang.peDepth pe ≤ lemDefaultFuel) →
          ∀ (rs : core_run_state), stExceptUndef_mapM f pes rs = Result (Defined vs, rs)

theorem CerberusHeapLang.mapM_save_bridge :
∀ {ext : Fmap sym sym} {th : thread_state} {tds : Fmap sym (CerbLocation.Loc × tag_definition)}
  {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem} {file : generic_file Unit core_run_annotation}
  (f :
    generic_pexpr Unit sym →
      core_run_state → exceptM (t0 (generic_pexpr Unit sym) × core_run_state) core_run_cause),
  (∀ (pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym) (rs' : core_run_state),
      f pe rs' =
        stExceptUndef_bind (E.eval_pexpr20 tds th ext σ file pe)
          (fun x =>
            match (motive :=
              pexpr ⊕ value → core_run_state → exceptM (t0 pexpr × core_run_state) core_run_cause)
              x with
            | Sum.inl pe' => stExceptUndef_return pe'
            | Sum.inr cval => stExceptUndef_return (mk_value_pe cval))
          rs') →
    ∀
      (g :
        sym ×
            (core_base_type × Option (ctype × pass_by_value_or_pointer)) × generic_pexpr Unit sym →
          core_run_state →
            exceptM
              (t0
                  (sym ×
                    (core_base_type × Option (ctype × pass_by_value_or_pointer)) ×
                      generic_pexpr Unit sym) ×
                core_run_state)
              core_run_cause),
      (∀
          (p :
            sym ×
              (core_base_type × Option (ctype × pass_by_value_or_pointer)) × generic_pexpr Unit sym)
          (rs' : core_run_state),
          g p rs' =
            stExceptUndef_bind (f p.snd.snd)
              (fun pe' => stExceptUndef_return (p.fst, p.snd.fst, pe')) rs') →
        ∀
          (ps :
            List
              (sym ×
                (core_base_type × Option (ctype × pass_by_value_or_pointer)) ×
                  generic_pexpr Unit sym))
          {cvals : List value},
          CerberusHeapLang.evalPexprs tds ext th.env (CerberusHeapLang.saveParamPexprs ps) =
              some cvals →
            (∀ (pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym),
                pe ∈ CerberusHeapLang.saveParamPexprs ps →
                  CerberusHeapLang.peDepth pe ≤ lemDefaultFuel) →
              ∀ (rs : core_run_state),
                stExceptUndef_mapM g ps rs =
                  Result (Defined (CerberusHeapLang.saveParamsWithValues ps cvals), rs)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.mapM_save_kill :
∀ {ext : Fmap sym sym} {th : thread_state} {tds : Fmap sym (CerbLocation.Loc × tag_definition)}
  {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem} {file : generic_file Unit core_run_annotation}
  (f :
    generic_pexpr Unit sym →
      core_run_state → exceptM (t0 (generic_pexpr Unit sym) × core_run_state) core_run_cause),
  (∀ (pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym) (rs' : core_run_state),
      f pe rs' =
        stExceptUndef_bind (E.eval_pexpr20 tds th ext σ file pe)
          (fun x =>
            match (motive :=
              pexpr ⊕ value → core_run_state → exceptM (t0 pexpr × core_run_state) core_run_cause)
              x with
            | Sum.inl pe' => stExceptUndef_return pe'
            | Sum.inr cval => stExceptUndef_return (mk_value_pe cval))
          rs') →
    ∀
      (g :
        sym ×
            (core_base_type × Option (ctype × pass_by_value_or_pointer)) × generic_pexpr Unit sym →
          core_run_state →
            exceptM
              (t0
                  (sym ×
                    (core_base_type × Option (ctype × pass_by_value_or_pointer)) ×
                      generic_pexpr Unit sym) ×
                core_run_state)
              core_run_cause),
      (∀
          (p :
            sym ×
              (core_base_type × Option (ctype × pass_by_value_or_pointer)) × generic_pexpr Unit sym)
          (rs' : core_run_state),
          g p rs' =
            stExceptUndef_bind (f p.snd.snd)
              (fun pe' => stExceptUndef_return (p.fst, p.snd.fst, pe')) rs') →
        ∀
          (ps :
            List
              (sym ×
                (core_base_type × Option (ctype × pass_by_value_or_pointer)) ×
                  generic_pexpr Unit sym))
          {err : core_run_cause},
          (∀ (pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym),
              pe ∈ CerberusHeapLang.saveParamPexprs ps → CerberusHeapLang.PePure pe) →
            (∀ (pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym),
                pe ∈ CerberusHeapLang.saveParamPexprs ps →
                  CerberusHeapLang.peDepth pe ≤ lemDefaultFuel) →
              CerberusHeapLang.evalClassList tds th.current_loc ext file th.env
                    (CerberusHeapLang.saveParamPexprs ps) =
                  CerberusHeapLang.EvalListOut.kill err →
                ∀ (rs : core_run_state), stExceptUndef_mapM g ps rs = exceptM.Exception err

theorem CerberusHeapLang.memop_fork :
∀ {tds : Fmap sym (CerbLocation.Loc × tag_definition)} {tid : Nat} {loc : CerbLocation.Loc}
  {pv1 pv2 : CerbMem.PointerValue} {k : value → thread_state} {dst : driver_state} {a1 a2 : Int},
  CerberusHeapLang.runOne (CerbMem.eqPtrval loc pv1 pv2) dst.layout_state =
      (NDnd "pointer equality"
          [("using provenance", CerbMem.memReturn false),
            ("ignoring provenance", CerbMem.memReturn (a1 == a2))],
        dst.layout_state) →
    2 ≤
      (CerbND.runND
          (advance_step tds tid
            (Step_memop_request2 loc PtrEq [Vobject (OVpointer pv1), Vobject (OVpointer pv2)] tid
              false k))
          dst).length

theorem CerberusHeapLang.metaHeap_alloc :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {mm : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerberusHeapLang.MetaCell} {id : Int}
  (mc : CerberusHeapLang.MetaCell),
  Iris.Std.get? mm id = none →
    ⊢
      CerberusHeapLang.metaInterp mm ==∗
        CerberusHeapLang.metaInterp (Iris.Std.insert mm id mc) ∗
          CerberusHeapLang.metaOwn id (Iris.DFrac.own 1) mc
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.metaHeap_update :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {mm : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerberusHeapLang.MetaCell} {id : Int}
  {mc : CerberusHeapLang.MetaCell} (mc' : CerberusHeapLang.MetaCell),
  ⊢
    CerberusHeapLang.metaInterp mm ∗ CerberusHeapLang.metaOwn id (Iris.DFrac.own 1) mc ==∗
      CerberusHeapLang.metaInterp (Iris.Std.insert mm id mc') ∗
        CerberusHeapLang.metaOwn id (Iris.DFrac.own 1) mc'
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.metaHeap_valid :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {mm : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerberusHeapLang.MetaCell} {id : Int} {dq : Iris.DFrac}
  {mc : CerberusHeapLang.MetaCell},
  ⊢
    CerberusHeapLang.metaInterp mm ∗ CerberusHeapLang.metaOwn id dq mc ==∗
      ⌜Iris.Std.get? mm id = some mc⌝

def CerberusHeapLang.metaOwn :
{hlc : Iris.HasLC} →
  {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} →
    [CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF] → Int → Iris.DFrac → CerberusHeapLang.MetaCell → Iris.IProp GF
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.metaOwn_agree :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (id : Int) (dq₁ dq₂ : Iris.DFrac) (mc₁ mc₂ : CerberusHeapLang.MetaCell),
  CerberusHeapLang.metaOwn id dq₁ mc₁ ∗ CerberusHeapLang.metaOwn id dq₂ mc₂ ⊢ ⌜mc₁ = mc₂⌝
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.metaOwn_fractional :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (id : Int) (mc : CerberusHeapLang.MetaCell) (q₁ q₂ : Iris.Qp),
  CerberusHeapLang.metaOwn id (Iris.DFrac.own (q₁ + q₂)) mc ⊣⊢
    CerberusHeapLang.metaOwn id (Iris.DFrac.own q₁) mc ∗
      CerberusHeapLang.metaOwn id (Iris.DFrac.own q₂) mc
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.metaOwn_ne :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {i₁ i₂ : Int} {dq₂ : Iris.DFrac} {mc₁ mc₂ : CerberusHeapLang.MetaCell},
  ⊢
    CerberusHeapLang.metaOwn i₁ (Iris.DFrac.own 1) mc₁ -∗
      CerberusHeapLang.metaOwn i₂ dq₂ mc₂ -∗ ⌜i₁ ≠ i₂⌝
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.metaOwn_persist :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (id : Int) (dq : Iris.DFrac) (mc : CerberusHeapLang.MetaCell),
  CerberusHeapLang.metaOwn id dq mc ⊢ |==> CerberusHeapLang.metaOwn id Iris.DFrac.discard mc

    Int →
      List
        (sym ×
          (core_base_type × Option (ctype × pass_by_value_or_pointer)) × generic_pexpr Unit sym)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.mlParams_depth :
∀ (ibty pbty : core_base_type) (n : Int) (pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym),
  pe ∈ CerberusHeapLang.saveParamPexprs (CerberusHeapLang.mlParams ibty pbty n) →
    CerberusHeapLang.peDepth pe ≤ lemDefaultFuel
----
def CerberusHeapLang.mlPost :
{hlc : Iris.HasLC} →
  {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} →
    [CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF] →
      Int → CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.mlPost_readout :
∀ {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS Iris.HasLC.hasLC GF] (n : Int)
  (w : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal) (ρ' : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack),
  CerberusHeapLang.mlPost n w ρ' ⊢
    CerberusHeapLang.readoutPost
      (fun v σ' =>
        v = Vunit ∧
          ∃ ids,
            ids.length = n.toNat ∧
              ids.Nodup ∧ ∀ (id : Int), id ∈ ids → CerberusHeapLang.DeadAt σ' id)
      w ρ'

theorem CerberusHeapLang.ml_body_wps :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ann ra : core_run_annotation) (mo : memory_order) (al : Int)
  (pref : prefix0) (ibty pbty qbty bbty nbty ubty : core_base_type) (n : Int) (p : sym)
  (rs : core_run_state),
  CerberusHeapLang.LabeledAt rs p
      (CerberusHeapLang.mlQ loc ann ra mo al pref ibty pbty qbty bbty nbty ubty) →
    ∀ (i : Int) (pc : CerbMem.PointerValue) (ids done : List Int) (f : Fmap sym value)
      (renv : List (Fmap sym value)),
      CerberusHeapLang.SymFrame f →
        0 ≤ i →
          i.toNat + ids.length + done.length = n.toNat →
            (ids ++ done).Nodup →
              CerberusHeapLang.allocBudget (i.toNat * CerberusHeapLang.regionCost al 16) ∗
                  CerberusHeapLang.isRegionList pc ids ∗ CerberusHeapLang.deadRegions done ⊢
                CerberusHeapLang.wps (CerberusHeapLang.procCtx rs) (some p)
                  (CerberusHeapLang.mlLs al n) CerberusHeapLang.emptyProcSpec
                  (CerberusHeapLang.mlPost n)
                  (CerberusHeapLang.mlBody loc ann ra mo al pref qbty bbty nbty ubty)
                  (CerberusHeapLang.mlFrame (CerberusHeapLang.ivVal i) (CerberusHeapLang.ptrVal pc)
                      f ::
                    renv)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.ml_body_wpt :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ann ra : core_run_annotation) (mo : memory_order) (al : Int)
  (pref : prefix0) (ibty pbty qbty bbty nbty ubty : core_base_type) (n : Int) (p : sym)
  (rs : core_run_state),
  CerberusHeapLang.LabeledAt rs p
      (CerberusHeapLang.mlQ loc ann ra mo al pref ibty pbty qbty bbty nbty ubty) →
    ∀ (i : Int) (pc : CerbMem.PointerValue) (ids done : List Int) (f : Fmap sym value)
      (renv : List (Fmap sym value)),
      CerberusHeapLang.SymFrame f →
        0 ≤ i →
          i.toNat + ids.length + done.length = n.toNat →
            (ids ++ done).Nodup →
              CerberusHeapLang.allocBudget (i.toNat * CerberusHeapLang.regionCost al 16) ∗
                  CerberusHeapLang.isRegionList pc ids ∗ CerberusHeapLang.deadRegions done ⊢
                CerberusHeapLang.wpt (CerberusHeapLang.procCtx rs) (some p)
                  (CerberusHeapLang.mlLsT al n) CerberusHeapLang.emptyProcSpecT
                  (CerberusHeapLang.mlCost i.toNat ids.length) (CerberusHeapLang.mlPost n)
                  (CerberusHeapLang.mlBody loc ann ra mo al pref qbty bbty nbty ubty)
                  (CerberusHeapLang.mlFrame (CerberusHeapLang.ivVal i) (CerberusHeapLang.ptrVal pc)
                      f ::
                    renv)

      CerberusHeapLang.headroom CerberusHeapLang.prodMem₀.lastAddress

  CerbMem.reconstructValue tds lum fpm addr CerberusHeapLang.nodeTy bs =
    CerbMem.reconstructValue tds [] [] addr CerberusHeapLang.nodeTy bs
----

theorem CerberusHeapLang.node_store_kit :
∀ {tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap} (pPrev : CerbMem.PointerValue),
  (pPrev = CerberusHeapLang.nullNode ∨
      ∃ id aN, pPrev = CerberusHeapLang.cellPtr id aN ∧ 0 < aN ∧ aN < 2 ^ 64) →
    (CerbMem.memValueToBytes tds []
              (CerbMem.pointerMval CerberusHeapLang.nodeTy pPrev)).snd.length =
        8 ∧
      (∀ (fpm : CerbMem.Funptrmap),
          (CerbMem.memValueToBytes tds fpm
                (CerbMem.pointerMval CerberusHeapLang.nodeTy pPrev)).fst =
            fpm) ∧
        (∀ (fpm : CerbMem.Funptrmap),
            (CerbMem.memValueToBytes tds fpm
                  (CerbMem.pointerMval CerberusHeapLang.nodeTy pPrev)).snd =
              (CerbMem.memValueToBytes tds []
                  (CerbMem.pointerMval CerberusHeapLang.nodeTy pPrev)).snd) ∧
          ∀ (bs' : List CerbMem.AbsByte),
            List.take 8 (List.drop 8 bs') =
                (CerbMem.memValueToBytes tds []
                    (CerbMem.pointerMval CerberusHeapLang.nodeTy pPrev)).snd →
              CerberusHeapLang.nodeNextDec tds bs' pPrev

def CerberusHeapLang.peDepth :
generic_pexpr Unit sym → Nat
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.peDepth.eq_def :
∀ (x : generic_pexpr Unit sym),
  CerberusHeapLang.peDepth x =
    match x with
    | Pexpr a a_1 (PEop a_2 pe1 pe2) =>
      1 + max (CerberusHeapLang.peDepth pe1) (CerberusHeapLang.peDepth pe2)
    | Pexpr a a_1 (PEarray_shift pe1 a_2 pe2) =>
      1 + max (CerberusHeapLang.peDepth pe1) (CerberusHeapLang.peDepth pe2)
    | x => 1
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.peDepth_array_shift :
∀ (a : List annot) (ty : ctype) (pe1 pe2 : generic_pexpr Unit sym),
  CerberusHeapLang.peDepth (Pexpr a () (PEarray_shift pe1 ty pe2)) =
    1 + max (CerberusHeapLang.peDepth pe1) (CerberusHeapLang.peDepth pe2)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.peDepth_op :
∀ (a : List annot) (op : binop) (pe1 pe2 : generic_pexpr Unit sym),
  CerberusHeapLang.peDepth (Pexpr a () (PEop op pe1 pe2)) =
    1 + max (CerberusHeapLang.peDepth pe1) (CerberusHeapLang.peDepth pe2)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.peDepth_peStrip :
∀ {pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym},
  CerberusHeapLang.PePure pe →
    CerberusHeapLang.peDepth (CerberusHeapLang.peStrip pe) = CerberusHeapLang.peDepth pe
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.peDepth_pos :
∀ (pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym), 1 ≤ CerberusHeapLang.peDepth pe
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.peDepth_sym_le :
∀ (pb : List annot) (x : sym), CerberusHeapLang.peDepth (Pexpr pb () (PEsym x)) ≤ lemDefaultFuel
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.peDepth_val_le :
∀ (a : List annot) (v : value), CerberusHeapLang.peDepth (Pexpr a () (PEval v)) ≤ lemDefaultFuel

  CerberusHeapLang.PePure pe →
    CerberusHeapLang.peStrip (CerberusHeapLang.peStrip pe) = CerberusHeapLang.peStrip pe

∀ (tds : Fmap sym (CerbLocation.Loc × tag_definition)) (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (tid : Nat)
  (k : value → thread_state) (v1 v2 : value),
  (¬∃ pv1 pv2, v1 = Vobject (OVpointer pv1) ∧ v2 = Vobject (OVpointer pv2)) →
    ∃ msg g, perform_memop_request2 tds loc PtrEq [v1, v2] tid k = nd_bind (failwithI msg) g
