def CerberusHeapLang.pointsToCell :
{hlc : Iris.HasLC} →
  {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} →
    [CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF] →
      CerbTags.TagDefsMap →
        CerbMem.PointerValue → Iris.DFrac → ctype → List CerbMem.AbsByte → Iris.IProp GF
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.pointsToCell_agree :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap) (pv : CerbMem.PointerValue) (dq₁ dq₂ : Iris.DFrac) (ty₁ ty₂ : ctype)
  (bs₁ bs₂ : List CerbMem.AbsByte),
  pv ↦c[tds]{dq₁} ty₁ ; bs₁ ∗ pv ↦c[tds]{dq₂} ty₂ ; bs₂ ⊢ ⌜ty₁ = ty₂ ∧ bs₁ = bs₂⌝
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.pointsToCell_cellOwn_iff :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap) (pv : CerbMem.PointerValue) (dq : Iris.DFrac) (ty : ctype)
  (bs : List CerbMem.AbsByte),
  pv ↦c[tds]{dq} ty ; bs ⊣⊢
    ∃ id a,
      ⌜pv = CerberusHeapLang.cellPtr id a⌝ ∗
        CerberusHeapLang.cellOwn tds id dq { addr := a, ty := ty, bytes := bs }
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.pointsToCell_combine :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap) (pv : CerbMem.PointerValue) (q₁ q₂ : Iris.Qp) (ty₁ ty₂ : ctype)
  (bs₁ bs₂ : List CerbMem.AbsByte),
  pv ↦c[tds]{Iris.DFrac.own q₁} ty₁ ; bs₁ ∗ pv ↦c[tds]{Iris.DFrac.own q₂} ty₂ ; bs₂ ⊢
    ⌜ty₁ = ty₂ ∧ bs₁ = bs₂⌝ ∗ pv ↦c[tds]{Iris.DFrac.own (q₁ + q₂)} ty₁ ; bs₁
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.pointsToCell_consequence :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {mm : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerberusHeapLang.MetaCell}
  {mb : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerbMem.AbsByte} {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem}
  {mk : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerberusHeapLang.AllocCursor},
  CerberusHeapLang.CohG σ mm mb mk →
    ∀ (tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap) (pv : CerbMem.PointerValue) (dq : Iris.DFrac) (ty : ctype)
      (bs : List CerbMem.AbsByte),
      pv ↦c[tds]{dq} ty ; bs ∗ CerberusHeapLang.metaInterp mm ∗ CerberusHeapLang.byteInterp mb ⊢
        ⌜∃ i a,
            pv = CerberusHeapLang.cellPtr i a ∧
              CerberusHeapLang.CellCoh tds σ i { addr := a, ty := ty, bytes := bs }⌝
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.pointsToCell_deadObj_false :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap) (id a a' : Int) (dq : Iris.DFrac) (ty ty' : ctype)
  (bs : List CerbMem.AbsByte),
  CerberusHeapLang.cellPtr id a ↦c[tds]{dq} ty ; bs ∗ CerberusHeapLang.deadObj tds id a' ty' ⊢ False
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.pointsToCell_fractional :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap) (pv : CerbMem.PointerValue) (q₁ q₂ : Iris.Qp) (ty : ctype)
  (bs : List CerbMem.AbsByte),
  pv ↦c[tds]{Iris.DFrac.own (q₁ + q₂)} ty ; bs ⊣⊢
    pv ↦c[tds]{Iris.DFrac.own q₁} ty ; bs ∗ pv ↦c[tds]{Iris.DFrac.own q₂} ty ; bs
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.pointsToCell_iff :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap) (pv : CerbMem.PointerValue) (dq : Iris.DFrac) (ty : ctype)
  (bs : List CerbMem.AbsByte),
  pv ↦c[tds]{dq} ty ; bs ⊣⊢
    ∃ i a,
      ⌜pv = CerberusHeapLang.cellPtr i a⌝ ∗
        CerberusHeapLang.metaOwn i dq (CerberusHeapLang.objCell tds a ty true false) ∗
          CerberusHeapLang.bytesOwn a dq bs ∗
            ⌜bs.length = CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds ty ∧ CerberusHeapLang.decIndep tds a ty bs⌝
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.pointsToCell_live :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem} {mm : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerberusHeapLang.MetaCell}
  {mb : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerbMem.AbsByte}
  {mk : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerberusHeapLang.AllocCursor} (tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap),
  CerberusHeapLang.CohG σ mm mb mk →
    ∀ (pv : CerbMem.PointerValue) (dq : Iris.DFrac) (ty : ctype) (bs : List CerbMem.AbsByte),
      CerberusHeapLang.metaInterp mm ∗ pv ↦c[tds]{dq} ty ; bs ⊢
        ⌜∃ id a,
            pv = CerberusHeapLang.cellPtr id a ∧
              σ.deadAllocations.contains id = false ∧
                ∃ al,
                  σ.allocations.get? id = some al ∧
                    al.base = a ∧
                      al.ty = some ty ∧ al.isReadonly = CerbMem.ReadonlyStatus.IsWritable⌝
----
def CerberusHeapLang.pointsToView :
{hlc : Iris.HasLC} →
  {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} →
    [CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF] →
      CerbTags.TagDefsMap →
        Int →
          Int → ctype → Nat → Iris.DFrac → Iris.DFrac → ctype → List CerbMem.AbsByte → Iris.IProp GF
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.pointsToView_agree :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap) (id a a' : Int) (aty aty' : ctype) (off off' : Nat)
  (dqm dqb dqm' dqb' : Iris.DFrac) (vty vty' : ctype) (bs bs' : List CerbMem.AbsByte),
  CerberusHeapLang.pointsToView tds id a aty off dqm dqb vty bs ∗
      CerberusHeapLang.pointsToView tds id a' aty' off' dqm' dqb' vty' bs' ⊢
    ⌜a = a' ∧ aty = aty'⌝
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.pointsToView_fractional :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap) (id a : Int) (aty : ctype) (off : Nat) (q₁ q₂ : Iris.Qp) (vty : ctype)
  (bs : List CerbMem.AbsByte),
  CerberusHeapLang.pointsToView tds id a aty off (Iris.DFrac.own (q₁ + q₂))
      (Iris.DFrac.own (q₁ + q₂)) vty bs ⊣⊢
    CerberusHeapLang.pointsToView tds id a aty off (Iris.DFrac.own q₁) (Iris.DFrac.own q₁) vty bs ∗
      CerberusHeapLang.pointsToView tds id a aty off (Iris.DFrac.own q₂) (Iris.DFrac.own q₂) vty bs
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.pointsToView_iff :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap) (id a : Int) (aty : ctype) (off : Nat) (dqm dqb : Iris.DFrac)
  (vty : ctype) (bs : List CerbMem.AbsByte),
  CerberusHeapLang.pointsToView tds id a aty off dqm dqb vty bs ⊣⊢
    CerberusHeapLang.metaOwn id dqm (CerberusHeapLang.objCell tds a aty true false) ∗
      ⌜off + CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds vty ≤ CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds aty ∧
            bs.length = CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds vty⌝ ∗
        CerberusHeapLang.bytesOwn (a + ↑off) dqb bs
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.pointsToView_join :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap) (id a : Int) (aty : ctype) (off : Nat) (q₁ q₂ : Iris.Qp)
  (dqb : Iris.DFrac) (vty vty₁ vty₂ : ctype) (bs₁ bs₂ : List CerbMem.AbsByte),
  CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds vty = CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds vty₁ + CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds vty₂ →
    off + CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds vty ≤ CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds aty →
      CerberusHeapLang.pointsToView tds id a aty off (Iris.DFrac.own q₁) dqb vty₁ bs₁ ∗
          CerberusHeapLang.pointsToView tds id a aty (off + CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds vty₁)
            (Iris.DFrac.own q₂) dqb vty₂ bs₂ ⊢
        CerberusHeapLang.pointsToView tds id a aty off (Iris.DFrac.own (q₁ + q₂)) dqb vty
          (bs₁ ++ bs₂)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.pointsToView_locInBounds :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap) (id a : Int) (aty : ctype) (off : Nat) (dqb : Iris.DFrac)
  (vty : ctype) (bs : List CerbMem.AbsByte),
  CerberusHeapLang.pointsToView tds id a aty off Iris.DFrac.discard dqb vty bs ⊢
    CerberusHeapLang.locInBounds tds id a aty off (CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds vty) ∗
      CerberusHeapLang.pointsToView tds id a aty off Iris.DFrac.discard dqb vty bs
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.pointsToView_persist :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap) (id a : Int) (aty : ctype) (off : Nat) (dqm dqb : Iris.DFrac)
  (vty : ctype) (bs : List CerbMem.AbsByte),
  CerberusHeapLang.pointsToView tds id a aty off dqm dqb vty bs ⊢
    |==> CerberusHeapLang.pointsToView tds id a aty off Iris.DFrac.discard dqb vty bs
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.pointsToView_split :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap) (id a : Int) (aty : ctype) (off : Nat) (q₁ q₂ : Iris.Qp)
  (dqb : Iris.DFrac) (vty vty₁ vty₂ : ctype) (bs₁ bs₂ : List CerbMem.AbsByte),
  CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds vty = CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds vty₁ + CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds vty₂ →
    bs₁.length = CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds vty₁ →
      CerberusHeapLang.pointsToView tds id a aty off (Iris.DFrac.own (q₁ + q₂)) dqb vty
          (bs₁ ++ bs₂) ⊢
        CerberusHeapLang.pointsToView tds id a aty off (Iris.DFrac.own q₁) dqb vty₁ bs₁ ∗
          CerberusHeapLang.pointsToView tds id a aty (off + CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds vty₁)
            (Iris.DFrac.own q₂) dqb vty₂ bs₂
----
def CerberusHeapLang.pot :
CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr → Nat
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.pot.eq_def :
∀ (x : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr),
  CerberusHeapLang.pot x =
    match x with
    | generic_expr.Expr a (Esseq a_1 e1 e2) =>
      1 + max (CerberusHeapLang.pot e1) (CerberusHeapLang.pot e2)
    | generic_expr.Expr a (Ewseq a_1 e1 e2) =>
      1 + max (CerberusHeapLang.pot e1) (CerberusHeapLang.pot e2)
    | generic_expr.Expr a (Eannot a_1 b) => 1 + CerberusHeapLang.pot b
    | generic_expr.Expr a (Eif a_1 e2 e3) =>
      1 + max (CerberusHeapLang.pot e2) (CerberusHeapLang.pot e3)
    | generic_expr.Expr a (Esave a_1 a_2 body) => 1 + CerberusHeapLang.pot body
    | generic_expr.Expr a (Ecase a_1 pats) => 2 * (1 + CerberusHeapLang.esizeAlts pats)
    | generic_expr.Expr a (Epure (Pexpr a_1 a_2 (PEval a_3))) => 1
    | x => 2
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.pot_action :
∀ {a : List annot} {p : generic_paction core_run_annotation Unit sym},
  CerberusHeapLang.pot (generic_expr.Expr a (Eaction p)) = 2
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.pot_annot :
∀ {a : List annot} {ds : List dyn_annotation} {b : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr},
  CerberusHeapLang.pot (generic_expr.Expr a (Eannot ds b)) = 1 + CerberusHeapLang.pot b
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.pot_case :
∀ {a : List annot} {pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym}
  {pats : List (pattern × CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr)},
  CerberusHeapLang.pot (generic_expr.Expr a (Ecase pe pats)) =
    2 * (1 + CerberusHeapLang.esizeAlts pats)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.pot_if :
∀ {a : List annot} {g : generic_pexpr Unit sym} {e2 e3 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr},
  CerberusHeapLang.pot (generic_expr.Expr a (Eif g e2 e3)) =
    1 + max (CerberusHeapLang.pot e2) (CerberusHeapLang.pot e3)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.pot_memop :
∀ {a : List annot} {mop : memop} {pes : List (generic_pexpr Unit sym)},
  CerberusHeapLang.pot (generic_expr.Expr a (Ememop mop pes)) = 2
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.pot_ofVal_annot :
∀ {ds : List dyn_annotation} {v : value},
  CerberusHeapLang.pot (CerberusHeapLang.ofVal (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.annot ds v)) = 2
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.pot_ofVal_pure :
∀ {v : value}, CerberusHeapLang.pot (CerberusHeapLang.ofVal (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.pure v)) = 1
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.pot_pos :
∀ (e : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr), 1 ≤ CerberusHeapLang.pot e
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.pot_pure_sym :
∀ {a pb : List annot} {x : sym},
  CerberusHeapLang.pot (generic_expr.Expr a (Epure (Pexpr pb () (PEsym x)))) = 2
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.pot_pure_val :
∀ {a pb : List annot} {v : value},
  CerberusHeapLang.pot (generic_expr.Expr a (Epure (Pexpr pb () (PEval v)))) = 1
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.pot_run :
∀ {a : List annot} {ra : core_run_annotation} {l : sym} {pes : List (generic_pexpr Unit sym)},
  CerberusHeapLang.pot (generic_expr.Expr a (Erun ra l pes)) = 2
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.pot_save :
∀ {a : List annot} {sb : sym × core_base_type}
  {ps :
    List
      (sym × (core_base_type × Option (ctype × pass_by_value_or_pointer)) × generic_pexpr Unit sym)}
  {body : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr},
  CerberusHeapLang.pot (generic_expr.Expr a (Esave sb ps body)) = 1 + CerberusHeapLang.pot body
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.pot_sseq :
∀ {a : List annot} {pat : pattern} {e1 e2 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr},
  CerberusHeapLang.pot (generic_expr.Expr a (Esseq pat e1 e2)) =
    1 + max (CerberusHeapLang.pot e1) (CerberusHeapLang.pot e2)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.pot_wseq :
∀ {a : List annot} {pat : pattern} {e1 e2 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr},
  CerberusHeapLang.pot (generic_expr.Expr a (Ewseq pat e1 e2)) =
    1 + max (CerberusHeapLang.pot e1) (CerberusHeapLang.pot e2)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.prepare_exit_single :
∀ (cs : core_state) (th : thread_state) (v : value),
  cs.thread_states = [(0, none, th)] →
    prepare_exit cs v =
      {
        thread_states :=
          [(0, none,
              { arena := mk_value_e v, stack0 := Stack_empty, errno := th.errno, env := th.env,
                current_proc_opt := th.current_proc_opt, exec_loc := th.exec_loc,
                current_loc := th.current_loc })],
        io := cs.io }
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.primStep_eq :
∀ (r : CerberusHeapLang.CoreRt) (σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem) (obs : List Empty)
  (r' : CerberusHeapLang.CoreRt) (σ' : CerberusHeapLang.Mem) (efs : List CerberusHeapLang.CoreRt),
  Iris.ProgramLogic.PrimStep.primStep (r, σ) obs (r', σ', efs) ↔
    CerberusHeapLang.Step r.M (r.e, r.ρ, r.ctl, σ) (r'.e, r'.ρ, r'.ctl, σ') ∧ r'.M = r.M ∧ efs = []

def CerberusHeapLang.procEnv :
List (sym × core_base_type) → List value → Fmap sym value
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.procEnv_cons :
∀ (x : sym) (bty : core_base_type) (params : List (sym × core_base_type)) (v : value)
  (vs : List value),
  CerberusHeapLang.procEnv ((x, bty) :: params) (v :: vs) =
    foldl2
      (fun acc p cval =>
        match acc, p, cval with
        | acc, (sym1, snd), cval =>
          fmapAddBy (fun s1 s2 => Lem_Basic_classes.ordCompare s1 s2) sym1 cval acc)
      (fmapAddBy (fun s1 s2 => Lem_Basic_classes.ordCompare s1 s2) x v fmapEmpty) params vs
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.procEnv_nil :
CerberusHeapLang.procEnv [] [] = fmapEmpty
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.procEnv_single :
∀ (x : sym) (bty : core_base_type) (v : value),
  CerberusHeapLang.procEnv [(x, bty)] [v] = CerberusHeapLang.envAdd x v fmapEmpty

def CerberusHeapLang.procSpecs :
{hlc : Iris.HasLC} →
  {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} →
    [CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF] →
      CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx → CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpec GF → Iris.IProp GF
----
def CerberusHeapLang.procSpecsT :
{hlc : Iris.HasLC} →
  {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} →
    [CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF] →
      CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx → CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpecT GF → Iris.IProp GF
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.procSpecsT_empty :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx}, ⊢ CerberusHeapLang.procSpecsT M CerberusHeapLang.emptyProcSpecT
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.procSpecsT_intro :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {Θ : CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpecT GF}
  (Lsₚ : sym → Nat → List value → CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpecT GF),
  (∀ (f : sym) (params : List (sym × core_base_type)) (body : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr) (m : Nat)
      (vs : List value),
      CerberusHeapLang.lookupProc M.file M.extern f = some (params, body) →
        params.length = vs.length →
          ⊢
            CerberusHeapLang.blockSpecsT M (some f) (Lsₚ f m vs) Θ fun w x =>
              (Θ f m vs).snd w.val) →
    (∀ (f : sym) (params : List (sym × core_base_type)) (body : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr) (m : Nat)
        (vs : List value) (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack),
        CerberusHeapLang.lookupProc M.file M.extern f = some (params, body) →
          params.length = vs.length →
            (Θ f m vs).fst ⊢
              CerberusHeapLang.wpt M (some f) (Lsₚ f m vs) Θ m (fun w x => (Θ f m vs).snd w.val)
                body (CerberusHeapLang.procEnv params vs :: ρ)) →
      ⊢ CerberusHeapLang.procSpecsT M Θ
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.procSpecs_empty :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx}, ⊢ CerberusHeapLang.procSpecs M CerberusHeapLang.emptyProcSpec
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.procSpecs_intro :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {Θ : CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpec GF}
  (Lsₚ : sym → List value → CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpec GF),
  (∀ (f : sym) (params : List (sym × core_base_type)) (body : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr)
      (vs : List value),
      CerberusHeapLang.lookupProc M.file M.extern f = some (params, body) →
        params.length = vs.length →
          ⊢ CerberusHeapLang.blockSpecs M (some f) (Lsₚ f vs) Θ fun w x => (Θ f vs).snd w.val) →
    (∀ (f : sym) (params : List (sym × core_base_type)) (body : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr)
        (vs : List value) (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack),
        CerberusHeapLang.lookupProc M.file M.extern f = some (params, body) →
          params.length = vs.length →
            (Θ f vs).fst ⊢
              CerberusHeapLang.wps M (some f) (Lsₚ f vs) Θ (fun w x => (Θ f vs).snd w.val) body
                (CerberusHeapLang.procEnv params vs :: ρ)) →
      ⊢ CerberusHeapLang.procSpecs M Θ

theorem CerberusHeapLang.process_done :
∀ (tds : Fmap sym (CerbLocation.Loc × tag_definition))
  (cont : Bool → ndM Unit step_kind driver_error (mem_constraint CerbMem.IntegerValue) driver_state)
  (v : value) (dst : driver_state) (th : thread_state),
  dst.core_state0.thread_states = [(0, none, th)] →
    CerberusHeapLang.runOne (process_core_step2 tds false cont (Step_done2 v)) dst =
      (NDactive (),
        { core_file := dst.core_file, core_extern := dst.core_extern,
          core_state0 :=
            have __src := dst.core_state0;
            {
              thread_states :=
                [(0, none,
                    { arena := mk_value_e v, stack0 := Stack_empty, errno := th.errno,
                      env := th.env, current_proc_opt := th.current_proc_opt,
                      exec_loc := th.exec_loc, current_loc := th.current_loc })],
              io := __src.io },
          core_run_state0 := dst.core_run_state0, layout_state := dst.layout_state,
          concurrency_state := dst.concurrency_state, fs_state0 := dst.fs_state0,
          trace := dst.trace, symbolic_assoc := dst.symbolic_assoc, blocked := dst.blocked,
          dr_step_counter := dst.dr_step_counter })

theorem CerberusHeapLang.prod_run_eqJ :
∀ (sup : Nat) (e : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr) {Q : CerberusHeapLang.LabelMap},
  CerberusHeapLang.LabeledAt
      (initial_core_run_state sup
          (collect_labeled_continuations_NEW (CerberusHeapLang.prodFile e))).fst
      CerberusHeapLang.mainSym Q →
    ∀ (ψ : value → CerberusHeapLang.Mem → Prop) (k : Nat),
      CerberusHeapLang.DriverDoneAt CerberusHeapLang.mainSym Q (CerberusHeapLang.prodThread e) e
          [fmapEmpty] CerberusHeapLang.prodMem₀ ψ k →
        k + 2 ≤ CerbFuel.driverFuel →
          ∀ (fs : CerbFS.FsState) (args : List String),
            ∃ dres dst',
              CerbND.runND (drive fmapEmpty false (CerberusHeapLang.prodFile e) args)
                    (initial_driver_state sup (CerberusHeapLang.prodFile e) fs).fst =
                  [(Active dres, [], dst')] ∧
                ψ dres.dres_core_value dst'.layout_state ∧
                  dres.dres_blocked = false ∧ dres.dres_stdout = "" ∧ dres.dres_stderr = ""
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.prod_run_eqJ_procs :
∀ (sup : Nat) (procs : List (sym × List (sym × core_base_type) × CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr))
  (e : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr),
  CerberusHeapLang.LabeledProcs
      (CerberusHeapLang.prodCtx (CerberusHeapLang.prodFileWith procs e)
        (CerberusHeapLang.prodRS procs sup e))
      (CerberusHeapLang.prodRS procs sup e).labeled →
    ∀ (ψ : value → CerberusHeapLang.Mem → Prop) (k : Nat),
      CerberusHeapLang.DriverDoneCtl
          (CerberusHeapLang.prodCtx (CerberusHeapLang.prodFileWith procs e)
            (CerberusHeapLang.prodRS procs sup e))
          (CerberusHeapLang.prodThread e) e [fmapEmpty] CerberusHeapLang.prodCtl
          CerberusHeapLang.prodMem₀ ψ k →
        k + 2 ≤ CerbFuel.driverFuel →
          ∀ (fs : CerbFS.FsState) (args : List String),
            ∃ dres dst',
              CerbND.runND (drive fmapEmpty false (CerberusHeapLang.prodFileWith procs e) args)
                    (initial_driver_state sup (CerberusHeapLang.prodFileWith procs e) fs).fst =
                  [(Active dres, [], dst')] ∧
                ψ dres.dres_core_value dst'.layout_state ∧
                  dres.dres_blocked = false ∧ dres.dres_stdout = "" ∧ dres.dres_stderr = ""
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.prod_run_safe_procs :
∀ (sup : Nat) (procs : List (sym × List (sym × core_base_type) × CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr))
  (e : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr),
  CerberusHeapLang.LabeledProcs
      (CerberusHeapLang.prodCtx (CerberusHeapLang.prodFileWith procs e)
        (CerberusHeapLang.prodRS procs sup e))
      (CerberusHeapLang.prodRS procs sup e).labeled →
    ∀ (ψ : value → CerberusHeapLang.Mem → Prop),
      CerberusHeapLang.DriverSafeCtl
          (CerberusHeapLang.prodCtx (CerberusHeapLang.prodFileWith procs e)
            (CerberusHeapLang.prodRS procs sup e))
          (CerberusHeapLang.prodThread e) e [fmapEmpty] CerberusHeapLang.prodCtl
          CerberusHeapLang.prodMem₀ ψ →
        ∀ (fs : CerbFS.FsState) (args : List String) (fuel : Nat),
          ∃ st dst',
            CerbND.runND
                  (CerbND.drive_lemFuel fuel fmapEmpty false (CerberusHeapLang.prodFileWith procs e)
                    args)
                  (initial_driver_state sup (CerberusHeapLang.prodFileWith procs e) fs).fst =
                [(st, [], dst')] ∧
              (st = Killed dst' CerbND.fuelExhaustedKill ∨
                ∃ dres,
                  st = Active dres ∧
                    ψ dres.dres_core_value dst'.layout_state ∧
                      dres.dres_blocked = false ∧ dres.dres_stdout = "" ∧ dres.dres_stderr = "")

CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr

theorem CerberusHeapLang.project_triple :
∀ {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGpreS GF] {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx},
  M.tagDefs = fmapEmpty →
    M.extern = fmapEmpty →
      ∀ {ctl : CerberusHeapLang.Ctl},
        ctl.κ = [] →
          (∀ (l : sym) (params : List (sym × core_base_type)) (cont : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr),
              CerberusHeapLang.lookupLabel (M.labelsAt ctl.proc) l = some (params, cont) →
                CerberusHeapLang.Frag cont) →
            (∀ (l : sym) (params : List (sym × core_base_type)) (cont : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr),
                CerberusHeapLang.lookupLabel (M.labelsAt ctl.proc) l = some (params, cont) →
                  CerberusHeapLang.pot cont ≤ lemDefaultFuel) →
              M.FragProcs →
                ∀ {e : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr},
                  CerberusHeapLang.Frag e →
                    CerberusHeapLang.pot e ≤ lemDefaultFuel →
                      ∀ (ev0 : Fmap sym value) (evs : List (Fmap sym value))
                        (P : CerberusHeapLang.CellMap)
                        (Q :
                          [CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS Iris.HasLC.hasLC GF] →
                            CerberusHeapLang.CoreRVal → Iris.IProp GF),
                        (∀ [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS Iris.HasLC.hasLC GF],
                            ([∗map] i ↦ c ∈ P,
                                CerberusHeapLang.cellOwn M.tagDefs i (Iris.DFrac.own 1) c) ⊢
                              WP { e := e, ρ := ev0 :: evs, ctl := ctl, M := M } @
                                Iris.Stuckness.NotStuck ; ⊤ {{ w, Q w }} ) →
                          CerberusHeapLang.MemTriple M ctl (ev0 :: evs) e P fun R v σ' =>
                            ∀ (ψ : Prop),
                              (∀ [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS Iris.HasLC.hasLC GF]
                                  (w : CerberusHeapLang.CoreRVal),
                                  w.val = v →
                                    ∀ (mm : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerberusHeapLang.MetaCell)
                                      (mb : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerbMem.AbsByte)
                                      (mk :
                                        CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerberusHeapLang.AllocCursor),
                                      CerberusHeapLang.CohG σ' mm mb mk →
                                        Q w ∗
                                            ([∗map] i ↦ c ∈ R,
                                                CerberusHeapLang.cellOwn M.tagDefs i
                                                  (Iris.DFrac.own 1) c) ∗
                                              CerberusHeapLang.metaInterp mm ∗
                                                CerberusHeapLang.byteInterp mb ⊢
                                          ⌜ψ⌝) →
                                ψ
----

def CerberusHeapLang.ptrImg :
CerbMem.PointerValue → List CerbMem.AbsByte
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.ptrImg_cell :
∀ (id a : Int),
  CerberusHeapLang.ptrImg (CerberusHeapLang.cellPtr id a) =
    List.map
      (fun x =>
        match x with
        | (v, i) => { prov := CerbMem.Provenance.Prov_some id, copyOffset := some ↑i, value := v })
      ((CerbMem.intToBytes a 8).zip (List.range (CerbMem.intToBytes a 8).length))
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.ptrImg_cell_explicit :
∀ (id a : Int),
  0 ≤ a →
    CerberusHeapLang.ptrImg (CerberusHeapLang.cellPtr id a) =
      [{ prov := CerbMem.Provenance.Prov_some id, copyOffset := some 0,
          value := some ((a >>> (0 * 8)).toNat % 256).toUInt8 },
        { prov := CerbMem.Provenance.Prov_some id, copyOffset := some 1,
          value := some ((a >>> (1 * 8)).toNat % 256).toUInt8 },
        { prov := CerbMem.Provenance.Prov_some id, copyOffset := some 2,
          value := some ((a >>> (2 * 8)).toNat % 256).toUInt8 },
        { prov := CerbMem.Provenance.Prov_some id, copyOffset := some 3,
          value := some ((a >>> (3 * 8)).toNat % 256).toUInt8 },
        { prov := CerbMem.Provenance.Prov_some id, copyOffset := some 4,
          value := some ((a >>> (4 * 8)).toNat % 256).toUInt8 },
        { prov := CerbMem.Provenance.Prov_some id, copyOffset := some 5,
          value := some ((a >>> (5 * 8)).toNat % 256).toUInt8 },
        { prov := CerbMem.Provenance.Prov_some id, copyOffset := some 6,
          value := some ((a >>> (6 * 8)).toNat % 256).toUInt8 },
        { prov := CerbMem.Provenance.Prov_some id, copyOffset := some 7,
          value := some ((a >>> (7 * 8)).toNat % 256).toUInt8 }]
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.ptrImg_cell_length :
∀ (id a : Int), (CerberusHeapLang.ptrImg (CerberusHeapLang.cellPtr id a)).length = 8
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.ptrImg_null_length :
(CerberusHeapLang.ptrImg CerberusHeapLang.nullNode).length = 8

def CerberusHeapLang.rangeMap :
Int → List CerbMem.AbsByte → CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerbMem.AbsByte
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.rangeMap.eq_def :
∀ (a : Int) (x : List CerbMem.AbsByte),
  CerberusHeapLang.rangeMap a x =
    match x with
    | [] => ∅
    | b :: bs => Iris.Std.insert (CerberusHeapLang.rangeMap (a + 1) bs) a b
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.rangeMap_get? :
∀ (a : Int) (bs : List CerbMem.AbsByte) (k : Int),
  Iris.Std.get? (CerberusHeapLang.rangeMap a bs) k =
    if a ≤ k ∧ k < a + ↑bs.length then bs[(k - a).toNat]? else none
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.readBytesFrom_eq_map_byteAt :
∀ (σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem) (a : Int) (n : Nat),
  CerbMem.readBytesFrom σ a n =
    List.map (fun i => CerberusHeapLang.byteAt σ (a + ↑i)) (List.range n)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.readBytesFrom_of_byteAt :
∀ (σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem) (a : Int) (bs : List CerbMem.AbsByte),
  (∀ (i : Nat) (hi : i < bs.length), CerberusHeapLang.byteAt σ (a + ↑i) = bs[i]) →
    CerbMem.readBytesFrom σ a bs.length = bs
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.readBytesFrom_sub :
∀ (σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem) (a : Int) (m : Nat) (bs : List CerbMem.AbsByte),
  CerbMem.readBytesFrom σ a m = bs →
    ∀ (off k : Nat),
      off + k ≤ m → CerbMem.readBytesFrom σ (a + ↑off) k = List.take k (List.drop off bs)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.readBytesFrom_writeBytesTo_disjoint :
∀ (st : CerberusHeapLang.Mem) (a : Int) (bs : List CerbMem.AbsByte) (a' : Int) (n : Nat),
  a' + ↑n ≤ a ∨ a + ↑bs.length ≤ a' →
    CerbMem.readBytesFrom (CerbMem.writeBytesTo st a bs) a' n = CerbMem.readBytesFrom st a' n
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.readBytesFrom_writeBytesTo_self :
∀ (st : CerberusHeapLang.Mem) (a : Int) (bs : List CerbMem.AbsByte),
  CerbMem.readBytesFrom (CerbMem.writeBytesTo st a bs) a bs.length = bs
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.readBytesFrom_write_interior :
∀ (σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem) (a : Int) (off : Nat) (img : List CerbMem.AbsByte) (n : Nat)
  (bs : List CerbMem.AbsByte),
  CerbMem.readBytesFrom σ a n = bs →
    off + img.length ≤ n →
      CerbMem.readBytesFrom (CerbMem.writeBytesTo σ (a + ↑off) img) a n =
        CerberusHeapLang.spliceBytes off img bs
----
def CerberusHeapLang.readonlyCell :
{hlc : Iris.HasLC} →
  {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} →
    [CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF] →
      CerbTags.TagDefsMap →
        CerbMem.PointerValue → Iris.DFrac → ctype → List CerbMem.AbsByte → Iris.IProp GF
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.readonlyCell_agree :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap) (pv : CerbMem.PointerValue) (dq₁ dq₂ : Iris.DFrac) (ty₁ ty₂ : ctype)
  (bs₁ bs₂ : List CerbMem.AbsByte),
  CerberusHeapLang.readonlyCell tds pv dq₁ ty₁ bs₁ ∗
      CerberusHeapLang.readonlyCell tds pv dq₂ ty₂ bs₂ ⊢
    ⌜ty₁ = ty₂ ∧ bs₁ = bs₂⌝
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.readonlyCell_fractional :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap) (pv : CerbMem.PointerValue) (q₁ q₂ : Iris.Qp) (ty : ctype)
  (bs : List CerbMem.AbsByte),
  CerberusHeapLang.readonlyCell tds pv (Iris.DFrac.own (q₁ + q₂)) ty bs ⊣⊢
    CerberusHeapLang.readonlyCell tds pv (Iris.DFrac.own q₁) ty bs ∗
      CerberusHeapLang.readonlyCell tds pv (Iris.DFrac.own q₂) ty bs
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.readonlyCell_iff :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap) (pv : CerbMem.PointerValue) (dq : Iris.DFrac) (ty : ctype)
  (bs : List CerbMem.AbsByte),
  CerberusHeapLang.readonlyCell tds pv dq ty bs ⊣⊢
    ∃ id a,
      ⌜pv = CerberusHeapLang.cellPtr id a⌝ ∗
        CerberusHeapLang.metaOwn id dq (CerberusHeapLang.objCell tds a ty true true) ∗
          CerberusHeapLang.bytesOwn a dq bs ∗
            ⌜bs.length = CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds ty ∧ CerberusHeapLang.decIndep tds a ty bs⌝
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.readonlyCell_pointsToCell_false :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap) (pv : CerbMem.PointerValue) (dq dq' : Iris.DFrac) (ty ty' : ctype)
  (bs bs' : List CerbMem.AbsByte),
  CerberusHeapLang.readonlyCell tds pv dq ty bs ∗ pv ↦c[tds]{dq'} ty' ; bs' ⊢ False
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.readonlyCell_readonly :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem} {mm : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerberusHeapLang.MetaCell}
  {mb : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerbMem.AbsByte}
  {mk : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerberusHeapLang.AllocCursor} (tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap),
  CerberusHeapLang.CohG σ mm mb mk →
    ∀ (pv : CerbMem.PointerValue) (dq : Iris.DFrac) (ty : ctype) (bs : List CerbMem.AbsByte),
      CerberusHeapLang.metaInterp mm ∗ CerberusHeapLang.readonlyCell tds pv dq ty bs ⊢
        ⌜∃ id a,
            pv = CerberusHeapLang.cellPtr id a ∧
              σ.deadAllocations.contains id = false ∧
                ∃ al kind,
                  σ.allocations.get? id = some al ∧
                    al.base = a ∧
                      al.ty = some ty ∧ al.isReadonly = CerbMem.ReadonlyStatus.IsReadOnly kind⌝
----
def CerberusHeapLang.readoutPost :
{hlc : Iris.HasLC} →
  {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} →
    [CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF] →
      (value → CerberusHeapLang.Mem → Prop) →
        CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.readoutPost_annot_absorb :
∀ {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS Iris.HasLC.hasLC GF]
  (ψ : value → CerberusHeapLang.Mem → Prop) (ds : List dyn_annotation) (v : value)
  (u : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal) (ρ' : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack),
  CerberusHeapLang.readoutPost ψ u ρ' ⊢
    CerberusHeapLang.readoutPost ψ ((CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.annot ds v).mergeInto u) ρ'
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.readoutPost_mergeInto_annot :
∀ {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS Iris.HasLC.hasLC GF]
  (ψ : value → CerberusHeapLang.Mem → Prop) (ds : List dyn_annotation) (v : value),
  (fun u ρ' =>
      CerberusHeapLang.readoutPost ψ ((CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.annot ds v).mergeInto u) ρ') =
    fun u ρ' => CerberusHeapLang.readoutPost ψ u ρ'
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.readoutPost_mono :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {ψ ψ' : value → CerberusHeapLang.Mem → Prop},
  (∀ (v : value) (σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem), ψ v σ → ψ' v σ) →
    ∀ (w : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal) (ρ' : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack),
      CerberusHeapLang.readoutPost ψ w ρ' ⊢ CerberusHeapLang.readoutPost ψ' w ρ'

theorem CerberusHeapLang.reconstruct_ptrImg_cell :

          CerbMem.MemValue.MVpointer CerberusHeapLang.nodeTy (CerberusHeapLang.cellPtr id a)

theorem CerberusHeapLang.regionCost_eq :

  CerberusHeapLang.regionCost alignN sizeN = sizeN.toNat + alignN.toNat.max 1 - 1

theorem CerberusHeapLang.regionLoadAt_atomic :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {ctl : CerberusHeapLang.Ctl} (loc : CerbLocation.Loc)
  (ann : core_run_annotation) (id a : Int) (n off : Nat) (vty : ctype) (mo : memory_order)
  (dqm dqb : Iris.DFrac) (bs : List CerbMem.AbsByte) (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack)
  {mv : CerbMem.MemValue},
  (∀ (lum : List (Int × identifier)) (fpm : CerbMem.Funptrmap),
      CerbMem.reconstructValue M.tagDefs lum fpm (a + ↑off) vty bs = mv) →
    CerberusHeapLang.loadTrapV vty mv = false →
      CerberusHeapLang.AtomicStep M ctl
        (CerberusHeapLang.loadExpr loc ann vty (CerberusHeapLang.cellPtr id (a + ↑off)) mo) ρ 2
        (CerberusHeapLang.typedRegionView M.tagDefs id a n off dqm dqb vty bs) fun w =>
        iprop(∃ fp,
            ⌜w = CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.annot [DA_pos [] fp] (valueFromMemValue mv).snd⌝ ∗
              CerberusHeapLang.typedRegionView M.tagDefs id a n off dqm dqb vty bs)
----
def CerberusHeapLang.regionOwn :
{hlc : Iris.HasLC} →
  {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} →
    [CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF] →
      Int → Int → Nat → Iris.DFrac → List CerbMem.AbsByte → Iris.IProp GF
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.regionOwn_agree :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (id a a' : Int) (n n' : Nat) (dq dq' : Iris.DFrac) (bs bs' : List CerbMem.AbsByte),
  CerberusHeapLang.regionOwn id a n dq bs ∗ CerberusHeapLang.regionOwn id a' n' dq' bs' ⊢
    ⌜a = a' ∧ n = n' ∧ bs = bs'⌝
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.regionOwn_alloc16 :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (id a : Int),
  CerberusHeapLang.regionOwn id a (Int.toNat 16) (Iris.DFrac.own 1)
      (List.replicate (Int.toNat 16) CerberusHeapLang.undefByte) ⊢
    CerberusHeapLang.regionOwn id a 16 (Iris.DFrac.own 1) CerberusHeapLang.regionUndef16
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.regionOwn_carve :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap) (id a : Int) (n off : Nat) (dq : Iris.DFrac) (vty : ctype)
  (bs : List CerbMem.AbsByte),
  off + CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds vty ≤ n →
    CerberusHeapLang.regionOwn id a n dq bs ⊢
      ⌜bs.length = n⌝ ∗
        CerberusHeapLang.typedRegionView tds id a n off dq dq vty
            (List.take (CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds vty) (List.drop off bs)) ∗
          CerberusHeapLang.bytesOwn a dq (List.take off bs) ∗
            CerberusHeapLang.bytesOwn (a + ↑off + ↑(CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds vty)) dq
              (List.drop (CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds vty) (List.drop off bs))
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.regionOwn_deadRegion_ne :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (id id' a a' : Int) (n n' : Nat) (bs : List CerbMem.AbsByte),
  CerberusHeapLang.regionOwn id a n (Iris.DFrac.own 1) bs ∗ CerberusHeapLang.deadRegion id' a' n' ⊢
    ⌜id ≠ id'⌝
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.regionOwn_deadRegions_ne :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (id a : Int) (bs : List CerbMem.AbsByte) (ids : List Int),
  CerberusHeapLang.regionOwn id a 16 (Iris.DFrac.own 1) bs ∗ CerberusHeapLang.deadRegions ids ⊢
    ⌜¬id ∈ ids⌝
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.regionOwn_facts :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem} {mm : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerberusHeapLang.MetaCell}
  {mb : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerbMem.AbsByte}
  {mk : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerberusHeapLang.AllocCursor},
  CerberusHeapLang.CohG σ mm mb mk →
    ∀ (id a : Int) (n : Nat) (dq : Iris.DFrac) (bs : List CerbMem.AbsByte),
      CerberusHeapLang.metaInterp mm ∗
          CerberusHeapLang.byteInterp mb ∗ CerberusHeapLang.regionOwn id a n dq bs ⊢
        ⌜σ.deadAllocations.contains id = false ∧
            (∃ al,
                σ.allocations.get? id = some al ∧
                  al.base = a ∧
                    al.size = ↑n ∧
                      al.ty = none ∧ al.isReadonly = CerbMem.ReadonlyStatus.IsWritable) ∧
              CerbMem.readBytesFrom σ a n = bs ∧ a ∈ σ.dynamicAddrs⌝
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.regionOwn_fractional :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (id a : Int) (n : Nat) (q₁ q₂ : Iris.Qp) (bs : List CerbMem.AbsByte),
  CerberusHeapLang.regionOwn id a n (Iris.DFrac.own (q₁ + q₂)) bs ⊣⊢
    CerberusHeapLang.regionOwn id a n (Iris.DFrac.own q₁) bs ∗
      CerberusHeapLang.regionOwn id a n (Iris.DFrac.own q₂) bs
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.regionOwn_isRegionList_ne :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (id a : Int) (bs : List CerbMem.AbsByte) (p : CerbMem.PointerValue) (ids : List Int),
  CerberusHeapLang.regionOwn id a 16 (Iris.DFrac.own 1) bs ∗ CerberusHeapLang.isRegionList p ids ⊢
    ⌜¬id ∈ ids⌝
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.regionOwn_ne :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (id id' a a' : Int) (n n' : Nat) (dq' : Iris.DFrac) (bs bs' : List CerbMem.AbsByte),
  CerberusHeapLang.regionOwn id a n (Iris.DFrac.own 1) bs ∗
      CerberusHeapLang.regionOwn id' a' n' dq' bs' ⊢
    ⌜id ≠ id'⌝
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.regionOwn_uncarve :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap) (id a : Int) (n off : Nat) (dq : Iris.DFrac) (vty : ctype)
  (pre mid suf : List CerbMem.AbsByte),
  pre.length = off →
    (pre ++ (mid ++ suf)).length = n →
      CerberusHeapLang.typedRegionView tds id a n off dq dq vty mid ∗
          CerberusHeapLang.bytesOwn a dq pre ∗
            CerberusHeapLang.bytesOwn (a + ↑off + ↑(CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds vty)) dq suf ⊢
        CerberusHeapLang.regionOwn id a n dq (pre ++ (mid ++ suf))
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.regionOwn_view :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (id a : Int) (n : Nat) (dq : Iris.DFrac) (bs : List CerbMem.AbsByte),
  CerberusHeapLang.regionOwn id a n dq bs ⊣⊢
    CerberusHeapLang.regionView id a n 0 dq dq bs ∗ ⌜bs.length = n⌝
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.regionStoreAt_atomic :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {ctl : CerberusHeapLang.Ctl} (loc : CerbLocation.Loc)
  (ann : core_run_annotation) (id a : Int) (n off : Nat) (vty : ctype) (cv : value)
  (mo : memory_order) (dqm : Iris.DFrac) (bs : List CerbMem.AbsByte) (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack)
  {mv : CerbMem.MemValue},
  memValueFromValue M.tagDefs (Ctype [] (unatomic_ vty)) cv = some mv →
    CerberusHeapLang.StorableView M.tagDefs vty mv →
      CerberusHeapLang.AtomicStep M ctl
        (CerberusHeapLang.storeExpr loc ann vty (CerberusHeapLang.cellPtr id (a + ↑off)) cv mo) ρ 2
        (CerberusHeapLang.typedRegionView M.tagDefs id a n off dqm (Iris.DFrac.own 1) vty bs)
        fun w =>
        iprop(∃ fp,
            ⌜w = CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.annot [DA_pos [] fp] Vunit⌝ ∗
              CerberusHeapLang.typedRegionView M.tagDefs id a n off dqm (Iris.DFrac.own 1) vty
                (CerbMem.memValueToBytes M.tagDefs [] mv).snd)

def CerberusHeapLang.regionUndef16 :

def CerberusHeapLang.regionView :
{hlc : Iris.HasLC} →
  {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} →
    [CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF] →
      Int → Int → Nat → Nat → Iris.DFrac → Iris.DFrac → List CerbMem.AbsByte → Iris.IProp GF

theorem CerberusHeapLang.regionView_join :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (id a : Int) (n off : Nat) (q₁ q₂ : Iris.Qp) (dqb : Iris.DFrac) (bs₁ bs₂ : List CerbMem.AbsByte),
  CerberusHeapLang.regionView id a n off (Iris.DFrac.own q₁) dqb bs₁ ∗
      CerberusHeapLang.regionView id a n (off + bs₁.length) (Iris.DFrac.own q₂) dqb bs₂ ⊢
    CerberusHeapLang.regionView id a n off (Iris.DFrac.own (q₁ + q₂)) dqb (bs₁ ++ bs₂)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.regionView_split :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (id a : Int) (n off : Nat) (q₁ q₂ : Iris.Qp) (dqb : Iris.DFrac) (bs₁ bs₂ : List CerbMem.AbsByte),
  CerberusHeapLang.regionView id a n off (Iris.DFrac.own (q₁ + q₂)) dqb (bs₁ ++ bs₂) ⊢
    CerberusHeapLang.regionView id a n off (Iris.DFrac.own q₁) dqb bs₁ ∗
      CerberusHeapLang.regionView id a n (off + bs₁.length) (Iris.DFrac.own q₂) dqb bs₂
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.region_loop_certified_production :
∀ (ra : core_run_annotation) (al sz : Int) (pref : prefix0) (sbty ibty pbty ubty : core_base_type)
  (sup : Nat),
  0 < CerberusHeapLang.regionCost al sz →
    ∀ (n : Int),
      0 ≤ n →
        n.toNat * CerberusHeapLang.regionCost al sz ≤
            CerberusHeapLang.headroom CerberusHeapLang.prodMem₀.lastAddress →
          7 * n.toNat + 5 ≤ CerbFuel.driverFuel →
            ∀ (fs : CerbFS.FsState) (args : List String),
              ∃ dres dst',
                CerbND.runND
                      (drive fmapEmpty false
                        (CerberusHeapLang.prodFile
                          (CerberusHeapLang.rlProg CerberusHeapLang.loc0 empty_annotation ra al sz
                            pref sbty ibty pbty ubty n))
                        args)
                      (initial_driver_state sup
                          (CerberusHeapLang.prodFile
                            (CerberusHeapLang.rlProg CerberusHeapLang.loc0 empty_annotation ra al sz
                              pref sbty ibty pbty ubty n))
                          fs).fst =
                    [(Active dres, [], dst')] ∧
                  dres.dres_core_value = Vunit ∧
                    dres.dres_blocked = false ∧ dres.dres_stdout = "" ∧ dres.dres_stderr = ""

def CerberusHeapLang.rlPSym :
sym
----
def CerberusHeapLang.rlParams :
core_base_type →
  Int →
    List
      (sym × (core_base_type × Option (ctype × pass_by_value_or_pointer)) × generic_pexpr Unit sym)

theorem CerberusHeapLang.rlParams_depth :
∀ (ibty : core_base_type) (n : Int) (pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym),
  pe ∈ CerberusHeapLang.saveParamPexprs (CerberusHeapLang.rlParams ibty n) →
    CerberusHeapLang.peDepth pe ≤ lemDefaultFuel

  (w : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal) (ρ' : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack),
  CerberusHeapLang.rlPost w ρ' ⊢ CerberusHeapLang.readoutPost (fun v x => v = Vunit) w ρ'

∀ (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ann ra : core_run_annotation) (al sz : Int) (pref : prefix0)
  (pbty ubty sbty ibty : core_base_type) (n : Int),
  CerberusHeapLang.pot (CerberusHeapLang.rlProg loc ann ra al sz pref sbty ibty pbty ubty n) = 6

def CerberusHeapLang.rlQ :
CerbLocation.Loc →
  core_run_annotation →
    core_run_annotation →
      Int →
        Int → prefix0 → core_base_type → core_base_type → core_base_type → CerberusHeapLang.LabelMap
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.rlQ_inv :
∀ (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ann ra : core_run_annotation) (al sz : Int) (pref : prefix0)
  (ibty pbty ubty : core_base_type) {l : sym} {params : List (sym × core_base_type)}
  {cont : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr},
  CerberusHeapLang.lookupLabel (CerberusHeapLang.rlQ loc ann ra al sz pref ibty pbty ubty) l =
      some (params, cont) →
    params = [(CerberusHeapLang.rlISym, ibty)] ∧
      cont = CerberusHeapLang.rlBody loc ann ra al sz pref pbty ubty
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.rlQ_lookup :
∀ (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ann ra : core_run_annotation) (al sz : Int) (pref : prefix0)
  (ibty pbty ubty : core_base_type),
  CerberusHeapLang.lookupLabel (CerberusHeapLang.rlQ loc ann ra al sz pref ibty pbty ubty)
      CerberusHeapLang.rlLoopSym =
    some
      ([(CerberusHeapLang.rlISym, ibty)], CerberusHeapLang.rlBody loc ann ra al sz pref pbty ubty)

theorem CerberusHeapLang.runNDFuel_active :
∀ {a info err cs st : Type} [Inhabited a] [Inhabited st] (n : Nat) {m : ndM a info err cs st}
  {s s' : st} {z : a},
  CerberusHeapLang.runOne m s = (NDactive z, s') →
    CerbND.runNDFuel n.succ m s = [(Active z, [], s')]

theorem CerberusHeapLang.runNDFuel_nd :
∀ {a info err cs st : Type} [Inhabited a] [Inhabited st] (n : Nat) {m : ndM a info err cs st}
  {s s' : st} {i : info} {bs : List (info × ndM a info err cs st)},
  CerberusHeapLang.runOne m s = (NDnd i bs, s') →
    CerbND.runNDFuel n.succ m s = List.foldl (fun acc p => CerbND.runNDFuel n p.snd s' ++ acc) [] bs
----

∀ {a info err cs st : Type} [Inhabited a] [Inhabited st] {m : ndM a info err cs st} {s s' : st}
  {z : a}, CerberusHeapLang.runOne m s = (NDactive z, s') → CerbND.runND m s = [(Active z, [], s')]

theorem CerberusHeapLang.runOne_bind_killed :

  {r : kill_reason err},

    CerberusHeapLang.runOne (nd_bind m f) s = (NDkilled r, s')

theorem CerberusHeapLang.runOne_bind_nd :
∀ {a b cs err info st : Type} {m : ndM a info err cs st} (f : a → ndM b info err cs st) {s s' : st}
  {i : info} {bs : List (info × ndM a info err cs st)},
  CerberusHeapLang.runOne m s = (NDnd i bs, s') →
    ∃ bs',
      CerberusHeapLang.runOne (nd_bind m f) s = (NDnd i bs', s') ∧
        bs'.length = bs.length ∧
          ∀ (p' : info × ndM b info err cs st),
            p' ∈ bs' → ∃ p, p ∈ bs ∧ p'.snd = nd_bind_lemFuel 99999999 p.snd f

          { tid_supply := __src.tid_supply, aid_supply := dst.core_run_state0.aid_supply + 1,
            excluded_supply := __src.excluded_supply, sym_supply := __src.sym_supply,
            labeled := __src.labeled },
        layout_state := dst.layout_state, concurrency_state := dst.concurrency_state,
        fs_state0 := dst.fs_state0, trace := dst.trace, symbolic_assoc := dst.symbolic_assoc,
        blocked := dst.blocked, dr_step_counter := dst.dr_step_counter })

theorem CerberusHeapLang.runOne_liftNDF_active :
∀ {a cs err1 err2 info1 info2 st1 st2 : Type} (n : Nat) (get2 : st2 → st1) (put1 : st2 → st1 → st2)
  (li : info1 → info2) (le : err1 → err2) {m : ndM a info1 err1 cs st1} {s2 : st2} {z : a}
  {s1' : st1},
  CerberusHeapLang.runOne m (get2 s2) = (NDactive z, s1') →
    CerberusHeapLang.runOne (liftND_lemFuel n.succ.succ get2 put1 li le m) s2 =
      (NDactive z, put1 s2 s1')
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.runOne_liftNDF_nd :
∀ {a cs err1 err2 info1 info2 st1 st2 : Type} (n : Nat) (get2 : st2 → st1) (put1 : st2 → st1 → st2)
  (li : info1 → info2) (le : err1 → err2) {m : ndM a info1 err1 cs st1} {s2 : st2} {i : info1}
  {bs : List (info1 × ndM a info1 err1 cs st1)} {s1' : st1},
  CerberusHeapLang.runOne m (get2 s2) = (NDnd i bs, s1') →
    ∃ bs',
      CerberusHeapLang.runOne (liftND_lemFuel n.succ.succ get2 put1 li le m) s2 =
          (NDnd (li i) bs', put1 s2 s1') ∧
        bs'.length = bs.length ∧
          ∀ (p' : info2 × ndM a info2 err2 cs st2),
            p' ∈ bs' → ∃ p, p ∈ bs ∧ p'.snd = liftND_lemFuel n get2 put1 li le p.snd
----

  Nat

theorem CerberusHeapLang.saveEntryCost_of_eval :
∀
  {ps :
    List
      (sym ×
        (core_base_type × Option (ctype × pass_by_value_or_pointer)) × generic_pexpr Unit sym)},
  valueFromPexprs (CerberusHeapLang.saveParamPexprs ps) = none →
    CerberusHeapLang.saveEntryCost ps = 2
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.saveEntryCost_of_vals :
∀
  {ps :
    List
      (sym × (core_base_type × Option (ctype × pass_by_value_or_pointer)) × generic_pexpr Unit sym)}
  {cvals : List value},
  valueFromPexprs (CerberusHeapLang.saveParamPexprs ps) = some cvals →
    CerberusHeapLang.saveEntryCost ps = 1

def CerberusHeapLang.saveParamPexprs :
List (sym × (core_base_type × Option (ctype × pass_by_value_or_pointer)) × generic_pexpr Unit sym) →
  List (generic_pexpr Unit sym)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.saveParamPexprs_withValues :
∀
  (ps :
    List
      (sym × (core_base_type × Option (ctype × pass_by_value_or_pointer)) × generic_pexpr Unit sym))
  (cvals : List value),
  ps.length = cvals.length →
    CerberusHeapLang.saveParamPexprs (CerberusHeapLang.saveParamsWithValues ps cvals) =
      List.map (fun v => Pexpr [] () (PEval v)) cvals
----
def CerberusHeapLang.saveParamsWithValues :
List (sym × (core_base_type × Option (ctype × pass_by_value_or_pointer)) × generic_pexpr Unit sym) →
  List value →
    List
      (sym × (core_base_type × Option (ctype × pass_by_value_or_pointer)) × generic_pexpr Unit sym)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.saveParamsWithValues_cons :
∀ (p : sym × (core_base_type × Option (ctype × pass_by_value_or_pointer)) × generic_pexpr Unit sym)
  (ps :
    List
      (sym × (core_base_type × Option (ctype × pass_by_value_or_pointer)) × generic_pexpr Unit sym))
  (v : value) (cvals : List value),
  CerberusHeapLang.saveParamsWithValues (p :: ps) (v :: cvals) =
    (p.fst, p.snd.fst, Pexpr [] () (PEval v)) :: CerberusHeapLang.saveParamsWithValues ps cvals
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.saveParamsWithValues_depth :
∀
  (ps :
    List
      (sym × (core_base_type × Option (ctype × pass_by_value_or_pointer)) × generic_pexpr Unit sym))
  (cvals : List value),
  (CerberusHeapLang.saveParamPexprs ps).length = cvals.length →
    ∀ (pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym),
      pe ∈ CerberusHeapLang.saveParamPexprs (CerberusHeapLang.saveParamsWithValues ps cvals) →
        CerberusHeapLang.peDepth pe ≤ lemDefaultFuel
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.saveParamsWithValues_nil :
∀ (cvals : List value), CerberusHeapLang.saveParamsWithValues [] cvals = []
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.saveParamsWithValues_pure :
∀
  (ps :
    List
      (sym × (core_base_type × Option (ctype × pass_by_value_or_pointer)) × generic_pexpr Unit sym))
  (cvals : List value) (pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym),
  pe ∈ CerberusHeapLang.saveParamPexprs (CerberusHeapLang.saveParamsWithValues ps cvals) →
    CerberusHeapLang.PePure pe
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.saveParams_depth_of_vals :
∀
  {ps :
    List
      (sym × (core_base_type × Option (ctype × pass_by_value_or_pointer)) × generic_pexpr Unit sym)}
  {cvals : List value},
  valueFromPexprs (CerberusHeapLang.saveParamPexprs ps) = some cvals →
    ∀ (pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym),
      pe ∈ CerberusHeapLang.saveParamPexprs ps → CerberusHeapLang.peDepth pe ≤ lemDefaultFuel

theorem CerberusHeapLang.saveParams_pure_of_vals :

  {ps :
    List
      (sym × (core_base_type × Option (ctype × pass_by_value_or_pointer)) × generic_pexpr Unit sym)}

theorem CerberusHeapLang.semantic_frame :
∀ {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGpreS GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx},
  M.tagDefs = fmapEmpty →
    M.extern = fmapEmpty →
      ∀ {ctl : CerberusHeapLang.Ctl},
        ctl.κ = [] →
          (∀ (l : sym) (params : List (sym × core_base_type)) (cont : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr),
              CerberusHeapLang.lookupLabel (M.labelsAt ctl.proc) l = some (params, cont) →
                CerberusHeapLang.Frag cont) →
            (∀ (l : sym) (params : List (sym × core_base_type)) (cont : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr),
                CerberusHeapLang.lookupLabel (M.labelsAt ctl.proc) l = some (params, cont) →
                  CerberusHeapLang.pot cont ≤ lemDefaultFuel) →
              M.FragProcs →
                ∀ {e : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr},
                  CerberusHeapLang.Frag e →
                    CerberusHeapLang.pot e ≤ lemDefaultFuel →
                      ∀ (ev0 : Fmap sym value) (evs : List (Fmap sym value))
                        {P : CerberusHeapLang.CellMap} (F : CerberusHeapLang.CellMap)
                        {post : value → CerberusHeapLang.CellMap → Prop},
                        Iris.Std.PartialMap.disjoint P F →
                          CerberusHeapLang.ProvenTriple GF M ctl (ev0 :: evs) e P post →
                            CerberusHeapLang.SemTriple M ctl (ev0 :: evs) e
                              (Iris.Std.PartialMap.union P F) fun v Q =>
                              ∃ Q₀,
                                post v Q₀ ∧
                                  Iris.Std.PartialMap.disjoint Q₀ F ∧
                                    Q = Iris.Std.PartialMap.union Q₀ F
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.semantic_triple_sound :
∀ {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGpreS GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx},
  M.tagDefs = fmapEmpty →
    M.extern = fmapEmpty →
      ∀ {ctl : CerberusHeapLang.Ctl},
        ctl.κ = [] →
          (∀ (l : sym) (params : List (sym × core_base_type)) (cont : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr),
              CerberusHeapLang.lookupLabel (M.labelsAt ctl.proc) l = some (params, cont) →
                CerberusHeapLang.Frag cont) →
            (∀ (l : sym) (params : List (sym × core_base_type)) (cont : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr),
                CerberusHeapLang.lookupLabel (M.labelsAt ctl.proc) l = some (params, cont) →
                  CerberusHeapLang.pot cont ≤ lemDefaultFuel) →
              M.FragProcs →
                ∀ {e : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr},
                  CerberusHeapLang.Frag e →
                    CerberusHeapLang.pot e ≤ lemDefaultFuel →
                      ∀ (ev0 : Fmap sym value) (evs : List (Fmap sym value))
                        {P : CerberusHeapLang.CellMap}
                        {post : value → CerberusHeapLang.CellMap → Prop},
                        CerberusHeapLang.ProvenTriple GF M ctl (ev0 :: evs) e P post →
                          CerberusHeapLang.SemTriple M ctl (ev0 :: evs) e P post
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.sep_consequence :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {mm : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerberusHeapLang.MetaCell}
  {mb : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerbMem.AbsByte} {Φ₁ Φ₂ : Iris.IProp GF} {ψ₁ ψ₂ : Prop},
  (Φ₁ ∗ CerberusHeapLang.metaInterp mm ∗ CerberusHeapLang.byteInterp mb ⊢ ⌜ψ₁⌝) →
    (Φ₂ ∗ CerberusHeapLang.metaInterp mm ∗ CerberusHeapLang.byteInterp mb ⊢ ⌜ψ₂⌝) →
      (Φ₁ ∗ Φ₂) ∗ CerberusHeapLang.metaInterp mm ∗ CerberusHeapLang.byteInterp mb ⊢ ⌜ψ₁ ∧ ψ₂⌝

  CerberusHeapLang.specPat pa pb x bty = CerberusHeapLang.specPat pa' pb' x' bty' →

theorem CerberusHeapLang.spike_step_adequacy :
∀ (tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap) {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGpreS GF]
  (e : CerberusHeapLang.CoreRt) (σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem)
  (m₀ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerberusHeapLang.SpikeCell),
  CerberusHeapLang.Coh tds σ m₀ →
    ∀ (φp : CerberusHeapLang.CoreRVal → CerberusHeapLang.Mem → Prop),
      (∀ [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS Iris.HasLC.hasLC GF],
          ([∗map] i ↦ c ∈ m₀, CerberusHeapLang.cellOwn tds i (Iris.DFrac.own 1) c) ⊢
            WP e @ Iris.Stuckness.NotStuck ;
              ⊤ {{ v, ∀ σ' ns κs nt, Iris.stateInterp σ' ns κs nt ={⊤,∅}=∗ ⌜φp v σ'⌝ }} ) →
        ∀ {t2 : List CerberusHeapLang.CoreRt} {σ2 : CerberusHeapLang.Mem},
          FromMathlib.Relation.ReflTransGen Iris.ProgramLogic.Language.ErasedStep ([e], σ)
              (t2, σ2) →
            (∀ (e2 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreRt),
                e2 ∈ t2 → Iris.ProgramLogic.PrimStep.NotStuck (e2, σ2)) ∧
              ∀ (w : CerberusHeapLang.CoreRVal) (t2' : List CerberusHeapLang.CoreRt),
                t2 = CerberusHeapLang.ofValRt w :: t2' → φp w σ2
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.spike_step_adequacy_alloc :
∀ (tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap) {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGpreS GF]
  (e : CerberusHeapLang.CoreRt) (σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem)
  (m₀ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerberusHeapLang.SpikeCell) (B : Nat),
  CerberusHeapLang.LaunchCoh tds σ m₀ B →
    ∀ (φp : CerberusHeapLang.CoreRVal → CerberusHeapLang.Mem → Prop),
      (∀ [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS Iris.HasLC.hasLC GF],
          ([∗map] i ↦ c ∈ m₀, CerberusHeapLang.cellOwn tds i (Iris.DFrac.own 1) c) ∗
              CerberusHeapLang.allocBudget B ⊢
            WP e @ Iris.Stuckness.NotStuck ;
              ⊤ {{ v, ∀ σ' ns κs nt, Iris.stateInterp σ' ns κs nt ={⊤,∅}=∗ ⌜φp v σ'⌝ }} ) →
        ∀ {t2 : List CerberusHeapLang.CoreRt} {σ2 : CerberusHeapLang.Mem},
          FromMathlib.Relation.ReflTransGen Iris.ProgramLogic.Language.ErasedStep ([e], σ)
              (t2, σ2) →
            (∀ (e2 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreRt),
                e2 ∈ t2 → Iris.ProgramLogic.PrimStep.NotStuck (e2, σ2)) ∧
              ∀ (w : CerberusHeapLang.CoreRVal) (t2' : List CerberusHeapLang.CoreRt),
                t2 = CerberusHeapLang.ofValRt w :: t2' → φp w σ2
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.spike_wp_wand :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {s : Iris.Stuckness} {E : CoPset} {e : CerberusHeapLang.CoreRt}
  {Φ Ψ : CerberusHeapLang.CoreRVal → Iris.IProp GF},
  WP e @ s ; E {{ Φ }} ⊢ (∀ v, Φ v -∗ Ψ v) -∗ WP e @ s ; E {{ Ψ }}
----
def CerberusHeapLang.spliceBytes :
Nat → List CerbMem.AbsByte → List CerbMem.AbsByte → List CerbMem.AbsByte
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.spliceBytes_getElem? :
∀ (off : Nat) (img bs : List CerbMem.AbsByte),
  off + img.length ≤ bs.length →
    ∀ (k : Nat),
      (CerberusHeapLang.spliceBytes off img bs)[k]? =
        if k < off then bs[k]? else if k < off + img.length then img[k - off]? else bs[k]?
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.spliceBytes_length :
∀ (off : Nat) (img bs : List CerbMem.AbsByte),
  off + img.length ≤ bs.length → (CerberusHeapLang.spliceBytes off img bs).length = bs.length
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.spliceBytes_next_slice :
∀ (img bs : List CerbMem.AbsByte),
  img.length = 8 →
    bs.length = 16 → List.take 8 (List.drop 8 (CerberusHeapLang.spliceBytes 8 img bs)) = img
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.spliceBytes_slice_above :
∀ (off : Nat) (img bs : List CerbMem.AbsByte),
  off + img.length ≤ bs.length →
    ∀ (o' n : Nat),
      off + img.length ≤ o' →
        List.take n (List.drop o' (CerberusHeapLang.spliceBytes off img bs)) =
          List.take n (List.drop o' bs)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.spliceBytes_slice_below :
∀ (off : Nat) (img bs : List CerbMem.AbsByte),
  off + img.length ≤ bs.length →
    ∀ (o' n : Nat),
      o' + n ≤ off →
        List.take n (List.drop o' (CerberusHeapLang.spliceBytes off img bs)) =
          List.take n (List.drop o' bs)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.spliceBytes_slice_self :
∀ (off : Nat) (img bs : List CerbMem.AbsByte),
  off + img.length ≤ bs.length →
    List.take img.length (List.drop off (CerberusHeapLang.spliceBytes off img bs)) = img
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.spliceBytes_value_slice :
∀ (img bs : List CerbMem.AbsByte),
  img.length = 8 →
    bs.length = 16 →
      List.take 8 (List.drop 0 (CerberusHeapLang.spliceBytes 8 img bs)) =
        List.take 8 (List.drop 0 bs)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.splitBytesProv_ptrImg_cell_fst :
∀ (id a : Int),
  0 ≤ a →
    (CerbMem.splitBytesProv (CerberusHeapLang.ptrImg (CerberusHeapLang.cellPtr id a))).fst =
      CerbMem.Provenance.Prov_some id

def CerberusHeapLang.sseqExpr :
core_base_type → CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr → CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr → CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.stExceptUndef_bind_apply :
∀ {a b c d e : Type} (m : e → exceptM (t0 d × a) c) (f : d → a → exceptM (t0 b × a) c) (st : e),
  stExceptUndef_bind m f st =
    match m st with
    | Result (Defined z, st') => f z st'
    | Result (Undef loc1 ubs, st') => stExpect_return (undef loc1 ubs) st'
    | Result (Error loc1 str, st') => stExpect_return (error0 loc1 str) st'
    | exceptM.Exception err => fail0 err
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.stExceptUndef_bind_return_right :
∀ {a b c : Type} (m : c → exceptM (t0 a × b) core_run_cause),
  (stExceptUndef_bind m fun z => stExceptUndef_return z) = m
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.stExceptUndef_foldM_cons :
∀ {a b c e : Type} (f : a → e → c → exceptM (t0 a × c) b) (acc : a) (x : e) (xs : List e),
  stExceptUndef_foldM f acc (x :: xs) =
    stExceptUndef_bind (f acc x) fun z => stExceptUndef_foldM f z xs
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.stExceptUndef_return_apply :
∀ {a b c : Type} (z : a) (st : b), stExceptUndef_return z st = Result (Defined z, st)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.stExpect_bind_apply :
∀ {a b msg s : Type} (m : s → exceptM (a × s) msg) (f : a → s → exceptM (b × s) msg) (st : s),
  stExpect_bind m f st =
    match m st with
    | Result (a1, s') => f a1 s'
    | exceptM.Exception err => exceptM.Exception err
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.stExpect_bind_result :
∀ {a b msg s : Type} (m : s → exceptM (a × s) msg) (f : a → s → exceptM (b × s) msg) (st st' : s)
  (x : a), m st = Result (x, st') → stExpect_bind m f st = f x st'
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.stExpect_mapM_eval1_kill :
∀ {ext : Fmap sym sym} {th : thread_state} {tds : Fmap sym (CerbLocation.Loc × tag_definition)}
  {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem} {file : generic_file Unit core_run_annotation}
  (f :
    generic_pexpr Unit sym →
      core_run_state → exceptM (t0 (generic_pexpr Unit sym) × core_run_state) core_run_cause),
  (∀ (pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym) (rs' : core_run_state),
      f pe rs' =
        stExceptUndef_bind (E.eval_pexpr20 tds th ext σ file pe)
          (fun x =>
            match (motive :=
              pexpr ⊕ value → core_run_state → exceptM (t0 pexpr × core_run_state) core_run_cause)
              x with
            | Sum.inl pe' => stExceptUndef_return pe'
            | Sum.inr cval => stExceptUndef_return (mk_value_pe cval))
          rs') →
    ∀ (pes : List (generic_pexpr Unit sym)) {err : core_run_cause},
      (∀ (pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym), pe ∈ pes → CerberusHeapLang.PePure pe) →
        (∀ (pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym), pe ∈ pes → CerberusHeapLang.peDepth pe ≤ lemDefaultFuel) →
          CerberusHeapLang.evalClassList tds th.current_loc ext file th.env pes =
              CerberusHeapLang.EvalListOut.kill err →
            ∀ (rs : core_run_state), stExpect_mapM f pes rs = exceptM.Exception err
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.stExpect_mapM_full_eval_kill :
∀ {th : thread_state} {tds : Fmap sym (CerbLocation.Loc × tag_definition)}
  {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem} {file : generic_file Unit core_run_annotation} {ext : Fmap sym sym}
  (f :
    generic_pexpr Unit sym → core_run_state → exceptM (t0 value × core_run_state) core_run_cause),
  (∀ (pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym) (rs' : core_run_state),
      f pe rs' = full_eval_pexpr tds th ext σ file pe rs') →
    ∀ (pes : List (generic_pexpr Unit sym)) {err : core_run_cause},
      (∀ (pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym), pe ∈ pes → CerberusHeapLang.PePure pe) →
        (∀ (pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym), pe ∈ pes → CerberusHeapLang.peDepth pe ≤ lemDefaultFuel) →
          CerberusHeapLang.evalClassList tds th.current_loc ext file th.env pes =
              CerberusHeapLang.EvalListOut.kill err →
            ∀ (rs : core_run_state), stExpect_mapM f pes rs = exceptM.Exception err
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.stateInterp_eq :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem) (ns : Nat) (κs : List Empty) (nt : Nat),
  Iris.stateInterp σ ns κs nt =
    iprop(∃ mm mb mk,
        ⌜CerberusHeapLang.CohG σ mm mb mk⌝ ∗
          CerberusHeapLang.metaInterp mm ∗
            CerberusHeapLang.byteInterp mb ∗
              CerberusHeapLang.cursorInterp mk ∗ CerberusHeapLang.budgetInterp mk)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.stateInterp_iff :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem) (ns : Nat) (κs : List Empty) (nt : Nat),
  Iris.stateInterp σ ns κs nt ⊣⊢
    ∃ mm mb mk,
      ⌜CerberusHeapLang.CohG σ mm mb mk⌝ ∗
        CerberusHeapLang.metaInterp mm ∗
          CerberusHeapLang.byteInterp mb ∗
            CerberusHeapLang.cursorInterp mk ∗ CerberusHeapLang.budgetInterp mk
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.stateInterp_readout :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {Φ : Iris.IProp GF} {ψ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem → Prop},
  (∀ (σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem) (mm : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerberusHeapLang.MetaCell)
      (mb : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerbMem.AbsByte)
      (mk : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerberusHeapLang.AllocCursor),
      CerberusHeapLang.CohG σ mm mb mk →
        Φ ∗ CerberusHeapLang.metaInterp mm ∗ CerberusHeapLang.byteInterp mb ⊢ ⌜ψ σ⌝) →
    Φ ⊢ ∀ σ' ns κs nt, Iris.stateInterp σ' ns κs nt ={⊤,∅}=∗ ⌜ψ σ'⌝
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.stepDischarge_alloc_eval :
∀ {e : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {ctx : context} {loc : CerbLocation.Loc}
  {ann : core_run_annotation} {pe1 pe2 : generic_pexpr Unit sym} {pref : prefix0}
  {align size : CerbMem.IntegerValue},
  CerberusHeapLang.Decomp e ctx (CerberusHeapLang.allocOpRedex loc ann pe1 pe2 pref) →
    CerberusHeapLang.esize e ≤ lemDefaultFuel →
      valueFromPexprs [pe1, pe2] = none →
        CerberusHeapLang.PePure pe1 →
          CerberusHeapLang.PePure pe2 →
            CerberusHeapLang.peDepth pe1 ≤ lemDefaultFuel →
              CerberusHeapLang.peDepth pe2 ≤ lemDefaultFuel →
                ∀ (tds : Fmap sym (CerbLocation.Loc × tag_definition)) (σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem)
                  (file : generic_file Unit core_run_annotation) (ext : Fmap sym sym) (tid : Nat)
                  (parent : Option Nat) (th : thread_state),
                  th.arena = e →
                    CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr tds ext th.env pe1 =
                        some (Vobject (OVinteger align)) →
                      CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr tds ext th.env pe2 =
                          some (Vobject (OVinteger size)) →
                        ∀ (aid : Nat) (rs : core_run_state),
                          List.map (CerberusHeapLang.dischargeStep tds aid rs σ)
                              (step_ctx tds σ file ext tid (parent, th)) =
                            [CerberusHeapLang.EngineOutcome.next
                                {
                                  arena :=
                                    apply_ctx ctx
                                      (CerberusHeapLang.allocRedex loc ann align size pref),
                                  stack0 := th.stack0, errno := th.errno, env := th.env,
                                  current_proc_opt := th.current_proc_opt, exec_loc := th.exec_loc,
                                  current_loc := th.current_loc }
                                σ]
----

theorem CerberusHeapLang.stepDischarge_run :
∀ {e : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {ctx : context} {ra : core_run_annotation} {l : sym}
  {pes : List (generic_pexpr Unit sym)},
  CerberusHeapLang.Decomp e ctx (CerberusHeapLang.runRedex ra l pes) →
    CerberusHeapLang.esize e ≤ lemDefaultFuel →
      ∀ {Q : CerberusHeapLang.LabelMap} {params : List (sym × core_base_type)}
        {cont : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {vs : List value},
        CerberusHeapLang.lookupLabel Q l = some (params, cont) →
          (∀ (pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym),
              pe ∈ pes → CerberusHeapLang.peDepth pe ≤ lemDefaultFuel) →
            ∀ (tds : Fmap sym (CerbLocation.Loc × tag_definition)) (σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem)
              (file : generic_file Unit core_run_annotation) (ext : Fmap sym sym) (tid : Nat)
              (parent : Option Nat) (p : sym) (th : thread_state),
              th.arena = e →
                th.current_proc_opt = some p →
                  CerberusHeapLang.evalPexprs tds ext th.env pes = some vs →
                    ∀ (aid : Nat) (rs : core_run_state),
                      CerberusHeapLang.LabeledAt rs (CerberusHeapLang.resolveExtern ext p) Q →
                        List.map (CerberusHeapLang.dischargeStep tds aid rs σ)
                            (step_ctx tds σ file ext tid (parent, th)) =
                          [CerberusHeapLang.EngineOutcome.next
                              { arena := cont, stack0 := th.stack0, errno := th.errno,
                                env := CerberusHeapLang.bindArgs params vs th.env,
                                current_proc_opt := th.current_proc_opt, exec_loc := th.exec_loc,
                                current_loc := th.current_loc }
                              σ]

theorem CerberusHeapLang.stepDischarge_save_eval :
∀ {e : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {ctx : context} {sb : sym × core_base_type}
  {ps :
    List
      (sym × (core_base_type × Option (ctype × pass_by_value_or_pointer)) × generic_pexpr Unit sym)}
  {body : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {cvals : List value},
  CerberusHeapLang.Decomp e ctx (CerberusHeapLang.saveRedex sb ps body) →
    CerberusHeapLang.esize e ≤ lemDefaultFuel →
      valueFromPexprs (CerberusHeapLang.saveParamPexprs ps) = none →
        (∀ (pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym),
            pe ∈ CerberusHeapLang.saveParamPexprs ps →
              CerberusHeapLang.peDepth pe ≤ lemDefaultFuel) →
          ∀ (tds : Fmap sym (CerbLocation.Loc × tag_definition)) (σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem)
            (file : generic_file Unit core_run_annotation) (ext : Fmap sym sym) (tid : Nat)
            (parent : Option Nat) (th : thread_state),
            th.arena = e →
              CerberusHeapLang.evalPexprs tds ext th.env (CerberusHeapLang.saveParamPexprs ps) =
                  some cvals →
                ∀ (aid : Nat) (rs : core_run_state),
                  List.map (CerberusHeapLang.dischargeStep tds aid rs σ)
                      (step_ctx tds σ file ext tid (parent, th)) =
                    [CerberusHeapLang.EngineOutcome.next
                        {
                          arena :=
                            apply_ctx ctx
                              (CerberusHeapLang.saveRedex sb
                                (CerberusHeapLang.saveParamsWithValues ps cvals) body),
                          stack0 := th.stack0, errno := th.errno, env := th.env,
                          current_proc_opt := th.current_proc_opt, exec_loc := th.exec_loc,
                          current_loc := th.current_loc }
                        σ]
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.stepDischarge_store_eval :
∀ {e : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {ctx : context} {loc : CerbLocation.Loc}
  {ann : core_run_annotation} {ty : ctype} {pe2 pe3 : generic_pexpr Unit sym} {mo : memory_order}
  {pv : CerbMem.PointerValue} {cv : value},
  CerberusHeapLang.Decomp e ctx (CerberusHeapLang.storeOpRedex loc ann ty pe2 pe3 mo) →
    CerberusHeapLang.esize e ≤ lemDefaultFuel →
      valueFromPexprs [pe2, pe3] = none →
        CerberusHeapLang.PePure pe2 →
          CerberusHeapLang.PePure pe3 →
            CerberusHeapLang.peDepth pe2 ≤ lemDefaultFuel →
              CerberusHeapLang.peDepth pe3 ≤ lemDefaultFuel →
                ∀ (tds : Fmap sym (CerbLocation.Loc × tag_definition)) (σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem)
                  (file : generic_file Unit core_run_annotation) (ext : Fmap sym sym) (tid : Nat)
                  (parent : Option Nat) (th : thread_state),
                  th.arena = e →
                    CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr tds ext th.env pe2 = some (Vobject (OVpointer pv)) →
                      CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr tds ext th.env pe3 = some cv →
                        ∀ (aid : Nat) (rs : core_run_state),
                          List.map (CerberusHeapLang.dischargeStep tds aid rs σ)
                              (step_ctx tds σ file ext tid (parent, th)) =
                            [CerberusHeapLang.EngineOutcome.next
                                {
                                  arena :=
                                    apply_ctx ctx
                                      (CerberusHeapLang.storeRedex loc ann false ty pv cv mo),
                                  stack0 := th.stack0, errno := th.errno, env := th.env,
                                  current_proc_opt := th.current_proc_opt, exec_loc := th.exec_loc,
                                  current_loc := th.current_loc }
                                σ]
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.step_ctx_alloc :
∀ {e : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {ctx : context} {loc : CerbLocation.Loc}
  {ann : core_run_annotation} {align size : CerbMem.IntegerValue} {pref : prefix0},
  CerberusHeapLang.Decomp e ctx (CerberusHeapLang.allocRedex loc ann align size pref) →
    CerberusHeapLang.esize e ≤ lemDefaultFuel →
      ∀ (tds : Fmap sym (CerbLocation.Loc × tag_definition)) (σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem)
        (file : generic_file Unit core_run_annotation) (ext : Fmap sym sym) (tid : Nat)
        (parent : Option Nat) (th : thread_state),
        th.arena = e →
          step_ctx tds σ file ext tid (parent, th) =
            [Step_action_request2 "AllocRequest" (CerberusHeapLang.requestLoc th loc) tid
                (is_unseq_with_ccall ctx)
                (stExceptUndef_return
                  (AllocRequest2 pref align size fun x pv =>
                    {
                      arena :=
                        apply_ctx ctx
                          (generic_expr.Expr []
                            (Epure (Pexpr [] () (PEval (Vobject (OVpointer pv)))))),
                      stack0 := th.stack0, errno := th.errno, env := th.env,
                      current_proc_opt := th.current_proc_opt, exec_loc := th.exec_loc,
                      current_loc := th.current_loc }))]

                      current_proc_opt := th.current_proc_opt, exec_loc := th.exec_loc,
                      current_loc := th.current_loc }]

theorem CerberusHeapLang.step_ctx_call_arity :
∀ {e : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {ctx : context} {ra : core_run_annotation} {f : sym}
  {pes : List (generic_pexpr Unit sym)},
  CerberusHeapLang.Decomp e ctx (CerberusHeapLang.callRedex ra f pes) →
    CerberusHeapLang.esize e ≤ lemDefaultFuel →
      (∀ (pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym), pe ∈ pes → CerberusHeapLang.peDepth pe ≤ lemDefaultFuel) →
        ∀ (tds : Fmap sym (CerbLocation.Loc × tag_definition)) (σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem)
          (file : generic_file Unit core_run_annotation) (ext : Fmap sym sym) (tid : Nat)
          (parent : Option Nat) (th : thread_state),
          th.arena = e →
            ∀ {vs : List value},
              CerberusHeapLang.evalPexprs tds ext th.env pes = some vs →
                ∀ {params : List (sym × core_base_type)} {body : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr},
                  CerberusHeapLang.lookupProc file ext f = some (params, body) →
                    params.length ≠ vs.length →
                      ∃ m,
                        step_ctx tds σ file ext tid (parent, th) =
                            [Step_with_runstate2 (RSK_eval "Eproc") m] ∧
                          ∀ (rs : core_run_state),
                            m rs =
                              exceptM.Exception
                                (Illformed_program
                                  ("calling procedure `".append
                                    ((show_symbol f).append
                                      ("' with the wrong number of args: |args|=".append
                                        ((Lem_String_extra.stringFromNat vs.length).append
                                          ("expecting: ".append
                                            (Lem_String_extra.stringFromNat params.length)))))))
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.step_ctx_call_kill_args :
∀ {e : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {ctx : context} {ra : core_run_annotation} {f : sym}
  {pes : List (generic_pexpr Unit sym)},
  CerberusHeapLang.Decomp e ctx (CerberusHeapLang.callRedex ra f pes) →
    CerberusHeapLang.esize e ≤ lemDefaultFuel →
      (∀ (pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym), pe ∈ pes → CerberusHeapLang.PePure pe) →
        (∀ (pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym), pe ∈ pes → CerberusHeapLang.peDepth pe ≤ lemDefaultFuel) →
          ∀ (tds : Fmap sym (CerbLocation.Loc × tag_definition)) (σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem)
            (file : generic_file Unit core_run_annotation) (ext : Fmap sym sym) (tid : Nat)
            (parent : Option Nat) (th : thread_state),
            th.arena = e →
              ∀ {err : core_run_cause},
                CerberusHeapLang.evalClassList tds th.current_loc ext file th.env pes =
                    CerberusHeapLang.EvalListOut.kill err →
                  ∃ m,
                    step_ctx tds σ file ext tid (parent, th) =
                        [Step_with_runstate2 (RSK_eval "Eproc") m] ∧
                      ∀ (rs : core_run_state), m rs = exceptM.Exception err
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.step_ctx_call_shape :

        (parent : Option Nat) (th : thread_state),
        th.arena = e →
          ∃ m, step_ctx tds σ file ext tid (parent, th) = [Step_with_runstate2 (RSK_eval "Eproc") m]
