theorem CerberusHeapLang.step_ctx_call_unknown :
∀ {e : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {ctx : context} {ra : core_run_annotation} {f : sym}
  {pes : List (generic_pexpr Unit sym)},
  CerberusHeapLang.Decomp e ctx (CerberusHeapLang.callRedex ra f pes) →
    CerberusHeapLang.esize e ≤ lemDefaultFuel →
      (∀ (pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym), pe ∈ pes → CerberusHeapLang.peDepth pe ≤ lemDefaultFuel) →
        ∀ (tds : Fmap sym (CerbLocation.Loc × tag_definition)) (σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem)
          (file : generic_file Unit core_run_annotation) (ext : Fmap sym sym) (tid : Nat)
          (parent : Option Nat) (th : thread_state),
          th.arena = e →
            ∀ {vs : List value},
              CerberusHeapLang.evalPexprs tds ext th.env pes = some vs →
                CerberusHeapLang.lookupProc file ext f = none →
                  ∃ m,
                    step_ctx tds σ file ext tid (parent, th) =
                        [Step_with_runstate2 (RSK_eval "Eproc") m] ∧
                      ∀ (rs : core_run_state),
                        m rs =
                          exceptM.Exception
                            (Illformed_program
                              ("calling an unknown procedure: ".append (show_symbol f)))
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.step_ctx_call_ws :
∀ {e : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {ctx : context} {ra : core_run_annotation} {f : sym}
  {pes : List (generic_pexpr Unit sym)},
  CerberusHeapLang.Decomp e ctx (CerberusHeapLang.callRedex ra f pes) →
    CerberusHeapLang.esize e ≤ lemDefaultFuel →
      (∀ (pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym), pe ∈ pes → CerberusHeapLang.peDepth pe ≤ lemDefaultFuel) →
        ∀ (tds : Fmap sym (CerbLocation.Loc × tag_definition)) (σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem)
          (file : generic_file Unit core_run_annotation) (ext : Fmap sym sym) (tid : Nat)
          (parent : Option Nat) (th : thread_state),
          th.arena = e →
            ∀ {vs : List value},
              CerberusHeapLang.evalPexprs tds ext th.env pes = some vs →
                ∀ {params : List (sym × core_base_type)} {body : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr},
                  CerberusHeapLang.lookupProc file ext f = some (params, body) →
                    params.length = vs.length →
                      ∃ m,
                        step_ctx tds σ file ext tid (parent, th) =
                            [Step_with_runstate2 (RSK_eval "Eproc") m] ∧
                          ∀ (rs : core_run_state),
                            m rs =
                              Result
                                (Defined
                                    { arena := body,
                                      stack0 := Stack_cons2 th.current_proc_opt ctx th.stack0,
                                      errno := th.errno,
                                      env := CerberusHeapLang.procEnv params vs :: th.env,
                                      current_proc_opt := some f,
                                      exec_loc := push_exec_loc f th.current_loc th.exec_loc,
                                      current_loc := th.current_loc },
                                  rs)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.step_ctx_case_illtyped :
∀ {e : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {ctx : context} {a : List annot} {cval : value}
  {pats : List (pattern × CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr)},
  CerberusHeapLang.Decomp e ctx (CerberusHeapLang.caseRedex (Pexpr a () (PEval cval)) pats) →
    CerberusHeapLang.esize e ≤ lemDefaultFuel →
      select_case subst_sym_expr cval pats = none →
        ∀ (tds : Fmap sym (CerbLocation.Loc × tag_definition)) (σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem)
          (file : generic_file Unit core_run_annotation) (ext : Fmap sym sym) (tid : Nat)
          (parent : Option Nat) (th : thread_state),
          th.arena = e →
            step_ctx tds σ file ext tid (parent, th) =
              [Step_error2
                  ("Ecase, mismatched ==> ".append
                    (CerbPP.stringFromCore_expr
                      (CerberusHeapLang.caseRedex (Pexpr a () (PEval cval)) pats)))]
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.step_ctx_case_value :
∀ {e : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {ctx : context} {a : List annot} {cval : value}
  {pats : List (pattern × CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr)} {e' : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr},
  CerberusHeapLang.Decomp e ctx (CerberusHeapLang.caseRedex (Pexpr a () (PEval cval)) pats) →
    CerberusHeapLang.esize e ≤ lemDefaultFuel →
      select_case subst_sym_expr cval pats = some e' →
        ∀ (tds : Fmap sym (CerbLocation.Loc × tag_definition)) (σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem)
          (file : generic_file Unit core_run_annotation) (ext : Fmap sym sym) (tid : Nat)
          (parent : Option Nat) (th : thread_state),
          th.arena = e →
            step_ctx tds σ file ext tid (parent, th) =
              [Step_tau2 "Ecase" TSK_Misc
                  { arena := apply_ctx ctx e', stack0 := th.stack0, errno := th.errno,
                    env := th.env, current_proc_opt := th.current_proc_opt, exec_loc := th.exec_loc,
                    current_loc := th.current_loc }]
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.step_ctx_create :
∀ {e : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {ctx : context} {loc : CerbLocation.Loc}
  {ann : core_run_annotation} {align : CerbMem.IntegerValue} {ty : ctype} {pref : prefix0},
  CerberusHeapLang.Decomp e ctx (CerberusHeapLang.createRedex loc ann align ty pref) →
    CerberusHeapLang.esize e ≤ lemDefaultFuel →
      ∀ (tds : Fmap sym (CerbLocation.Loc × tag_definition)) (σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem)
        (file : generic_file Unit core_run_annotation) (ext : Fmap sym sym) (tid : Nat)
        (parent : Option Nat) (th : thread_state),
        th.arena = e →
          step_ctx tds σ file ext tid (parent, th) =
            [Step_action_request2 "CreateRequest" (CerberusHeapLang.requestLoc th loc) tid
                (is_unseq_with_ccall ctx)
                (stExceptUndef_return
                  (CreateRequest2 pref align ty (get_with_address []) none fun x pv =>
                    {
                      arena :=
                        apply_ctx ctx
                          (generic_expr.Expr []
                            (Epure (Pexpr [] () (PEval (Vobject (OVpointer pv)))))),
                      stack0 := th.stack0, errno := th.errno, env := th.env,
                      current_proc_opt := th.current_proc_opt, exec_loc := th.exec_loc,
                      current_loc := th.current_loc }))]
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.step_ctx_done :
∀ (v : value) (tds : Fmap sym (CerbLocation.Loc × tag_definition)) (σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem)
  (file : generic_file Unit core_run_annotation) (ext : Fmap sym sym) (tid : Nat)
  (th : thread_state),
  th.arena = CerberusHeapLang.ofVal (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.pure v) →
    th.stack0 = Stack_empty → step_ctx tds σ file ext tid (none, th) = [Step_done2 v]

              ∃ s m,
                step_ctx tds σ file ext tid (parent, th) =
                    [Step_with_runstate2 (RSK_tau s TSK_Misc) m] ∧
                  ∀ (rs : core_run_state),
                    m rs =
                      Result
                        (Defined
                            { arena := apply_ctx ctx e3, stack0 := th.stack0, errno := th.errno,
                              env := th.env, current_proc_opt := th.current_proc_opt,
                              exec_loc := th.exec_loc, current_loc := th.current_loc },
                          rs)

theorem CerberusHeapLang.step_ctx_if_kill :
∀ {e : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {ctx : context} {g : generic_pexpr Unit sym}
  {e2 e3 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {err : core_run_cause},
  CerberusHeapLang.Decomp e ctx (CerberusHeapLang.ifRedex g e2 e3) →
    CerberusHeapLang.esize e ≤ lemDefaultFuel →
      CerberusHeapLang.PePure g →
        CerberusHeapLang.peDepth g ≤ lemDefaultFuel →
          ∀ (tds : Fmap sym (CerbLocation.Loc × tag_definition)) (σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem)
            (file : generic_file Unit core_run_annotation) (ext : Fmap sym sym) (tid : Nat)
            (parent : Option Nat) (th : thread_state),
            th.arena = e →
              CerberusHeapLang.evalClass tds th.current_loc ext file th.env g =
                  CerberusHeapLang.EvalOut.kill err →
                ∃ s m,
                  step_ctx tds σ file ext tid (parent, th) =
                      [Step_with_runstate2 (RSK_tau s TSK_Misc) m] ∧
                    ∀ (rs : core_run_state), m rs = exceptM.Exception err
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.step_ctx_if_panic :
∀ {e : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {ctx : context} {g : generic_pexpr Unit sym}
  {e2 e3 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {v : value},
  CerberusHeapLang.Decomp e ctx (CerberusHeapLang.ifRedex g e2 e3) →
    CerberusHeapLang.esize e ≤ lemDefaultFuel →
      CerberusHeapLang.peDepth g ≤ lemDefaultFuel →
        ∀ (tds : Fmap sym (CerbLocation.Loc × tag_definition)) (σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem)
          (file : generic_file Unit core_run_annotation) (ext : Fmap sym sym) (tid : Nat)
          (parent : Option Nat) (th : thread_state),
          th.arena = e →
            CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr tds ext th.env g = some v →
              v ≠ Vtrue →
                v ≠ Vfalse →
                  ∃ s m inst step_m k msg,
                    step_ctx tds σ file ext tid (parent, th) =
                        [Step_with_runstate2 (RSK_tau s TSK_Misc) m] ∧
                      m = stExceptUndef_bind step_m k ∧
                        ∀ (rs : core_run_state), step_m rs = failwithI msg rs
----

theorem CerberusHeapLang.step_ctx_kill :
∀ {e : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {ctx : context} {loc : CerbLocation.Loc}
  {ann : core_run_annotation} {kind : kill_kind} {pv : CerbMem.PointerValue},
  CerberusHeapLang.Decomp e ctx (CerberusHeapLang.killRedex loc ann kind pv) →
    CerberusHeapLang.esize e ≤ lemDefaultFuel →
      ∀ (tds : Fmap sym (CerbLocation.Loc × tag_definition)) (σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem)
        (file : generic_file Unit core_run_annotation) (ext : Fmap sym sym) (tid : Nat)
        (parent : Option Nat) (th : thread_state),
        th.arena = e →
          step_ctx tds σ file ext tid (parent, th) =
            [Step_action_request2 "KillRequest" (CerberusHeapLang.requestLoc th loc) tid
                (is_unseq_with_ccall ctx)
                (stExceptUndef_return
                  (KillRequest2 (is_dynamic kind) pv fun x =>
                    {
                      arena :=
                        apply_ctx ctx (generic_expr.Expr [] (Epure (Pexpr [] () (PEval Vunit)))),
                      stack0 := th.stack0, errno := th.errno, env := th.env,
                      current_proc_opt := th.current_proc_opt, exec_loc := th.exec_loc,
                      current_loc := th.current_loc }))]

theorem CerberusHeapLang.step_ctx_load :
∀ {e : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {ctx : context} {loc : CerbLocation.Loc}
  {ann : core_run_annotation} {ty : ctype} {pv : CerbMem.PointerValue} {mo : memory_order},
  CerberusHeapLang.Decomp e ctx (CerberusHeapLang.loadRedex loc ann ty pv mo) →
    CerberusHeapLang.esize e ≤ lemDefaultFuel →
      ∀ (tds : Fmap sym (CerbLocation.Loc × tag_definition)) (σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem)
        (file : generic_file Unit core_run_annotation) (ext : Fmap sym sym) (tid : Nat)
        (parent : Option Nat) (th : thread_state),
        th.arena = e →
          step_ctx tds σ file ext tid (parent, th) =
            [Step_action_request2 "LoadRequest" (CerberusHeapLang.requestLoc th loc) tid
                (is_unseq_with_ccall ctx)
                (stExceptUndef_return
                  (LoadRequest2 mo ty pv fun x fp mval =>
                    {
                      arena :=
                        apply_ctx ctx
                          (generic_expr.Expr []
                            (Eannot [DA_pos [] fp]
                              (generic_expr.Expr []
                                (Epure (Pexpr [] () (PEval (valueFromMemValue mval).snd)))))),
                      stack0 := th.stack0, errno := th.errno, env := th.env,
                      current_proc_opt := th.current_proc_opt, exec_loc := th.exec_loc,
                      current_loc := th.current_loc }))]
----

                        step_ctx tds σ file ext tid (parent, th) =
                            [Step_with_runstate2 (RSK_eval s) m] ∧

theorem CerberusHeapLang.step_ctx_merge :
∀ {e : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {ctx : context} {ds1 ds2 : List dyn_annotation}
  {b : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr},
  CerberusHeapLang.Decomp e ctx
      (generic_expr.Expr [] (Eannot ds1 (generic_expr.Expr [] (Eannot ds2 b)))) →
    is_irreducible (generic_expr.Expr [] (Eannot ds1 (generic_expr.Expr [] (Eannot ds2 b)))) =
        false →
      CerberusHeapLang.esize e ≤ lemDefaultFuel →
        ∀ (tds : Fmap sym (CerbLocation.Loc × tag_definition)) (σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem)
          (file : generic_file Unit core_run_annotation) (ext : Fmap sym sym) (tid : Nat)
          (parent : Option Nat) (th : thread_state),
          th.arena = e →
            step_ctx tds σ file ext tid (parent, th) =
              [Step_tau2 "Eannot" TSK_Misc
                  { arena := apply_ctx ctx (generic_expr.Expr [] (Eannot (ds1 ++ ds2) b)),
                    stack0 := th.stack0, errno := th.errno, env := th.env,
                    current_proc_opt := th.current_proc_opt, exec_loc := th.exec_loc,
                    current_loc := th.current_loc }]

theorem CerberusHeapLang.step_ctx_ret :
∀ (v : value) (tds : Fmap sym (CerbLocation.Loc × tag_definition)) (σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem)
  (file : generic_file Unit core_run_annotation) (ext : Fmap sym sym) (tid : Nat)
  (parent : Option Nat) (th : thread_state),
  th.arena = generic_expr.Expr [] (Epure (Pexpr [] () (PEval v))) →
    ∀ {p : Option sym} {ctx : context} {sk' : stack core_run_annotation},
      th.stack0 = Stack_cons2 p ctx sk' →
        ∀ {ev0 : Fmap sym value} {evs : List (Fmap sym value)},
          th.env = ev0 :: evs →
            ∃ tsk,
              step_ctx tds σ file ext tid (parent, th) =
                [Step_tau2 "end of procedure" tsk
                    { arena := apply_ctx ctx (generic_expr.Expr [] (Epure (Pexpr [] () (PEval v)))),
                      stack0 := sk', errno := th.errno, env := evs, current_proc_opt := p,
                      exec_loc := th.exec_loc, current_loc := th.current_loc }]
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.step_ctx_run_kill :
∀ {e : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {ctx : context} {ra : core_run_annotation} {l : sym}
  {pes : List (generic_pexpr Unit sym)},
  CerberusHeapLang.Decomp e ctx (CerberusHeapLang.runRedex ra l pes) →
    CerberusHeapLang.esize e ≤ lemDefaultFuel →
      ∀ {Q : CerberusHeapLang.LabelMap} {params : List (sym × core_base_type)}
        {cont : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr},
        CerberusHeapLang.lookupLabel Q l = some (params, cont) →
          (∀ (pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym), pe ∈ pes → CerberusHeapLang.PePure pe) →
            (∀ (pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym),
                pe ∈ pes → CerberusHeapLang.peDepth pe ≤ lemDefaultFuel) →
              ∀ (tds : Fmap sym (CerbLocation.Loc × tag_definition)) (σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem)
                (file : generic_file Unit core_run_annotation) (ext : Fmap sym sym) (tid : Nat)
                (parent : Option Nat) (p : sym) (th : thread_state),
                th.arena = e →
                  th.current_proc_opt = some p →
                    ∀ {err : core_run_cause},
                      CerberusHeapLang.evalClassList tds th.current_loc ext file th.env
                            (CerberusHeapLang.zipArgs params pes) =
                          CerberusHeapLang.EvalListOut.kill err →
                        ∃ s m,
                          step_ctx tds σ file ext tid (parent, th) =
                              [Step_with_runstate2 (RSK_eval s) m] ∧
                            ∀ (rs : core_run_state),
                              CerberusHeapLang.LabeledAt rs (CerberusHeapLang.resolveExtern ext p)
                                  Q →
                                m rs = exceptM.Exception err
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.step_ctx_run_noproc :
∀ {e : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {ctx : context} {ra : core_run_annotation} {l : sym}
  {pes : List (generic_pexpr Unit sym)},
  CerberusHeapLang.Decomp e ctx (CerberusHeapLang.runRedex ra l pes) →
    CerberusHeapLang.esize e ≤ lemDefaultFuel →
      ∀ (tds : Fmap sym (CerbLocation.Loc × tag_definition)) (σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem)
        (file : generic_file Unit core_run_annotation) (ext : Fmap sym sym) (tid : Nat)
        (parent : Option Nat) (th : thread_state),
        th.arena = e →
          th.current_proc_opt = none →
            ∃ s inst k,
              step_ctx tds σ file ext tid (parent, th) =
                [Step_with_runstate2 (RSK_eval s)
                    (stExceptUndef_bind
                      (runSE
                        (state_except_read fun rs =>
                          Lem_Maybe.bind0
                            (fmapLookupBy (fun s1 s2 => Lem_Basic_classes.ordCompare s1 s2)
                              (CerberusHeapLang.resolveExtern ext
                                (failwithI "Core_reduction ==> Erun outside of a proc"))
                              rs.labeled)
                            (fmapLookupBy (fun s1 s2 => Lem_Basic_classes.ordCompare s1 s2) l)))
                      k)]
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.step_ctx_run_shape :
∀ {e : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {ctx : context} {ra : core_run_annotation} {l : sym}
  {pes : List (generic_pexpr Unit sym)},
  CerberusHeapLang.Decomp e ctx (CerberusHeapLang.runRedex ra l pes) →
    CerberusHeapLang.esize e ≤ lemDefaultFuel →
      ∀ (tds : Fmap sym (CerbLocation.Loc × tag_definition)) (σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem)
        (file : generic_file Unit core_run_annotation) (ext : Fmap sym sym) (tid : Nat)
        (parent : Option Nat) (th : thread_state),
        th.arena = e →
          ∃ s m, step_ctx tds σ file ext tid (parent, th) = [Step_with_runstate2 (RSK_eval s) m]
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.step_ctx_run_unresolved :
∀ {e : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {ctx : context} {ra : core_run_annotation} {l : sym}
  {pes : List (generic_pexpr Unit sym)},
  CerberusHeapLang.Decomp e ctx (CerberusHeapLang.runRedex ra l pes) →
    CerberusHeapLang.esize e ≤ lemDefaultFuel →
      ∀ (tds : Fmap sym (CerbLocation.Loc × tag_definition)) (σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem)
        (file : generic_file Unit core_run_annotation) (ext : Fmap sym sym) (tid : Nat)
        (parent : Option Nat) (p : sym) (th : thread_state),
        th.arena = e →
          th.current_proc_opt = some p →
            ∀ (rs : core_run_state),
              Lem_Maybe.bind0
                    (fmapLookupBy (fun s1 s2 => Lem_Basic_classes.ordCompare s1 s2)
                      (CerberusHeapLang.resolveExtern ext p) rs.labeled)
                    (fmapLookupBy (fun s1 s2 => Lem_Basic_classes.ordCompare s1 s2) l) =
                  none →
                ∃ s m inst msg,
                  step_ctx tds σ file ext tid (parent, th) = [Step_with_runstate2 (RSK_eval s) m] ∧
                    m rs = failwithI msg rs
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.step_ctx_run_ws :
∀ {e : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {ctx : context} {ra : core_run_annotation} {l : sym}
  {pes : List (generic_pexpr Unit sym)},
  CerberusHeapLang.Decomp e ctx (CerberusHeapLang.runRedex ra l pes) →
    CerberusHeapLang.esize e ≤ lemDefaultFuel →
      ∀ {Q : CerberusHeapLang.LabelMap} {params : List (sym × core_base_type)}
        {cont : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {vs : List value},
        CerberusHeapLang.lookupLabel Q l = some (params, cont) →
          (∀ (pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym),
              pe ∈ pes → CerberusHeapLang.peDepth pe ≤ lemDefaultFuel) →
            ∀ (tds : Fmap sym (CerbLocation.Loc × tag_definition)) (σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem)
              (file : generic_file Unit core_run_annotation) (ext : Fmap sym sym) (tid : Nat)
              (parent : Option Nat) (p : sym) (th : thread_state),
              th.arena = e →
                th.current_proc_opt = some p →
                  CerberusHeapLang.evalPexprs tds ext th.env pes = some vs →
                    ∃ s m,
                      step_ctx tds σ file ext tid (parent, th) =
                          [Step_with_runstate2 (RSK_eval s) m] ∧
                        ∀ (rs : core_run_state),
                          CerberusHeapLang.LabeledAt rs (CerberusHeapLang.resolveExtern ext p) Q →
                            m rs =
                              Result
                                (Defined
                                    { arena := cont, stack0 := th.stack0, errno := th.errno,
                                      env := CerberusHeapLang.bindArgs params vs th.env,
                                      current_proc_opt := th.current_proc_opt,
                                      exec_loc := th.exec_loc, current_loc := th.current_loc },
                                  rs)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.step_ctx_save :
∀ {e : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {ctx : context} {sb : sym × core_base_type}
  {ps :
    List
      (sym × (core_base_type × Option (ctype × pass_by_value_or_pointer)) × generic_pexpr Unit sym)}
  {body : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {cvals : List value},
  CerberusHeapLang.Decomp e ctx (CerberusHeapLang.saveRedex sb ps body) →
    CerberusHeapLang.esize e ≤ lemDefaultFuel →
      valueFromPexprs (CerberusHeapLang.saveParamPexprs ps) = some cvals →
        ∀ (tds : Fmap sym (CerbLocation.Loc × tag_definition)) (σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem)
          (file : generic_file Unit core_run_annotation) (ext : Fmap sym sym) (tid : Nat)
          (parent : Option Nat) (th : thread_state),
          th.arena = e →
            ∀ {ev0 : Fmap sym value} {evs : List (Fmap sym value)},
              th.env = ev0 :: evs →
                step_ctx tds σ file ext tid (parent, th) =
                  [Step_tau2 "Esave" TSK_Misc
                      { arena := apply_ctx ctx body, stack0 := th.stack0, errno := th.errno,
                        env := CerberusHeapLang.bindSaveParams ps cvals (ev0 :: evs),
                        current_proc_opt := th.current_proc_opt, exec_loc := th.exec_loc,
                        current_loc := th.current_loc }]

theorem CerberusHeapLang.step_ctx_save_eval_kill :
∀ {e : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {ctx : context} {sb : sym × core_base_type}
  {ps :
    List
      (sym × (core_base_type × Option (ctype × pass_by_value_or_pointer)) × generic_pexpr Unit sym)}
  {body : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {err : core_run_cause},
  CerberusHeapLang.Decomp e ctx (CerberusHeapLang.saveRedex sb ps body) →
    CerberusHeapLang.esize e ≤ lemDefaultFuel →
      valueFromPexprs (CerberusHeapLang.saveParamPexprs ps) = none →
        (∀ (pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym),
            pe ∈ CerberusHeapLang.saveParamPexprs ps → CerberusHeapLang.PePure pe) →
          (∀ (pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym),
              pe ∈ CerberusHeapLang.saveParamPexprs ps →
                CerberusHeapLang.peDepth pe ≤ lemDefaultFuel) →
            ∀ (tds : Fmap sym (CerbLocation.Loc × tag_definition)) (σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem)
              (file : generic_file Unit core_run_annotation) (ext : Fmap sym sym) (tid : Nat)
              (parent : Option Nat) (th : thread_state),
              th.arena = e →
                CerberusHeapLang.evalClassList tds th.current_loc ext file th.env
                      (CerberusHeapLang.saveParamPexprs ps) =
                    CerberusHeapLang.EvalListOut.kill err →
                  ∃ s m,
                    step_ctx tds σ file ext tid (parent, th) =
                        [Step_with_runstate2 (RSK_eval s) m] ∧
                      ∀ (rs : core_run_state), m rs = exceptM.Exception err

theorem CerberusHeapLang.step_ctx_save_eval_ws :
∀ {e : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {ctx : context} {sb : sym × core_base_type}
  {ps :
    List
      (sym × (core_base_type × Option (ctype × pass_by_value_or_pointer)) × generic_pexpr Unit sym)}
  {body : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {cvals : List value},
  CerberusHeapLang.Decomp e ctx (CerberusHeapLang.saveRedex sb ps body) →
    CerberusHeapLang.esize e ≤ lemDefaultFuel →
      valueFromPexprs (CerberusHeapLang.saveParamPexprs ps) = none →

            pe ∈ CerberusHeapLang.saveParamPexprs ps →
              CerberusHeapLang.peDepth pe ≤ lemDefaultFuel) →

            (parent : Option Nat) (th : thread_state),
            th.arena = e →
              CerberusHeapLang.evalPexprs tds ext th.env (CerberusHeapLang.saveParamPexprs ps) =
                  some cvals →
                ∃ s m,
                  step_ctx tds σ file ext tid (parent, th) = [Step_with_runstate2 (RSK_eval s) m] ∧

                        Result

                              {
                                arena :=
                                  apply_ctx ctx

                                stack0 := th.stack0, errno := th.errno, env := th.env,
                                current_proc_opt := th.current_proc_opt, exec_loc := th.exec_loc,
                                current_loc := th.current_loc },
                            rs)

theorem CerberusHeapLang.step_ctx_store :
∀ {e : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {ctx : context} {loc : CerbLocation.Loc}
  {ann : core_run_annotation} {lk : Bool} {ty : ctype} {pv : CerbMem.PointerValue} {cv : value}
  {mo : memory_order} {mv : CerbMem.MemValue},
  CerberusHeapLang.Decomp e ctx (CerberusHeapLang.storeRedex loc ann lk ty pv cv mo) →
    CerberusHeapLang.esize e ≤ lemDefaultFuel →
      ∀ (tds : Fmap sym (CerbLocation.Loc × tag_definition)),
        memValueFromValue tds (Ctype [] (unatomic_ ty)) cv = some mv →
          ∀ (σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem) (file : generic_file Unit core_run_annotation)
            (ext : Fmap sym sym) (tid : Nat) (parent : Option Nat) (th : thread_state),
            th.arena = e →
              step_ctx tds σ file ext tid (parent, th) =
                [Step_action_request2 "StoreRequest" (CerberusHeapLang.requestLoc th loc) tid
                    (is_unseq_with_ccall ctx)
                    (stExceptUndef_return
                      (StoreRequest2 mo ty lk pv mv fun x fp =>
                        {
                          arena :=
                            apply_ctx ctx
                              (generic_expr.Expr []
                                (Eannot [DA_pos [] fp]
                                  (generic_expr.Expr [] (Epure (Pexpr [] () (PEval Vunit)))))),
                          stack0 := th.stack0, errno := th.errno, env := th.env,
                          current_proc_opt := th.current_proc_opt, exec_loc := th.exec_loc,
                          current_loc := th.current_loc }))]

theorem CerberusHeapLang.step_eval_bridge :
∀ {tds : Fmap sym (CerbLocation.Loc × tag_definition)} {ext : Fmap sym sym}
  {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack} {pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym} {v : value},
  CerberusHeapLang.PePure pe →
    CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr tds ext ρ pe = some v →
      ∀ (fuel : Nat),
        CerberusHeapLang.peDepth pe ≤ fuel →
          ∀ (n : Nat) (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (cloc : Option CerbLocation.Loc)
            (mem : Option CerbMem.MemState) (file : generic_file Unit core_run_annotation),
            step_eval_pexpr_lemFuel fuel tds n loc cloc ext ρ mem file false pe =
              exception_undef_return (Pexpr [] () (PEval v))

theorem CerberusHeapLang.step_eval_bridge_kill :
∀ {tds : Fmap sym (CerbLocation.Loc × tag_definition)} {ext : Fmap sym sym}
  {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack} {loc : CerbLocation.Loc}
  {file : generic_file Unit core_run_annotation} {pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym}
  {err : core_run_cause},
  CerberusHeapLang.PePure pe →
    CerberusHeapLang.peStrip pe = pe →
      CerberusHeapLang.evalClass tds loc ext file ρ pe = CerberusHeapLang.EvalOut.kill err →
        ∀ (fuel : Nat),
          CerberusHeapLang.peDepth pe ≤ fuel →
            ∀ (n : Nat) (cloc : Option CerbLocation.Loc) (mem : Option CerbMem.MemState),
              step_eval_pexpr_lemFuel fuel tds n loc cloc ext ρ mem file false pe =
                exceptM.Exception err

theorem CerberusHeapLang.step_iff_cerberusRound :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {e : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {ev0 : Fmap sym value}
  {evs : List (Fmap sym value)} {ctl : CerberusHeapLang.Ctl} {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem},
  CerberusHeapLang.Frag e →
    CerberusHeapLang.esize e ≤ lemDefaultFuel →
      (∃ c', CerberusHeapLang.Step M (e, ev0 :: evs, ctl, σ) c') →
        ∀ (c' : CerberusHeapLang.Config),
          CerberusHeapLang.Step M (e, ev0 :: evs, ctl, σ) c' ↔
            CerberusHeapLang.CerberusRound M (e, ev0 :: evs, ctl, σ) c'

theorem CerberusHeapLang.storeAt_atomic :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {ctl : CerberusHeapLang.Ctl} (loc : CerbLocation.Loc)
  (ann : core_run_annotation) (id a : Int) (aty : ctype) (off : Nat) (vty : ctype) (cv : value)
  (mo : memory_order) (dqm : Iris.DFrac) (bs : List CerbMem.AbsByte) (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack)
  {mv : CerbMem.MemValue},
  memValueFromValue M.tagDefs (Ctype [] (unatomic_ vty)) cv = some mv →
    CerberusHeapLang.StorableView M.tagDefs vty mv →
      CerberusHeapLang.AtomicStep M ctl
        (CerberusHeapLang.storeExpr loc ann vty (CerberusHeapLang.cellPtr id (a + ↑off)) cv mo) ρ 2
        (CerberusHeapLang.pointsToView M.tagDefs id a aty off dqm (Iris.DFrac.own 1) vty bs)
        fun w =>
        iprop(∃ fp,
            ⌜w = CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.annot [DA_pos [] fp] Vunit⌝ ∗
              CerberusHeapLang.pointsToView M.tagDefs id a aty off dqm (Iris.DFrac.own 1) vty
                (CerbMem.memValueToBytes M.tagDefs [] mv).snd)

  core_run_annotation →
    ctype → CerbMem.PointerValue → value → memory_order → CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.storeM_at :
∀ (tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap) (σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem) (id a : Int) (aty : ctype) (off : Nat)
  (vty : ctype) (mv : CerbMem.MemValue) (loc : CerbLocation.Loc),
  CerberusHeapLang.MetaCoh σ id (CerberusHeapLang.objCell tds a aty true false) →
    off + CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds vty ≤ CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds aty →
      CerbMem.ctypeMemCompatible vty (CerbMem.typeofMval mv) = true →
        (∀ (fpm : CerbMem.Funptrmap), (CerbMem.memValueToBytes tds fpm mv).fst = fpm) →
          (∀ (fpm : CerbMem.Funptrmap),
              (CerbMem.memValueToBytes tds fpm mv).snd = (CerbMem.memValueToBytes tds [] mv).snd) →
            CerberusHeapLang.applyMemM
                (CerbMem.storeM tds loc vty false (CerberusHeapLang.cellPtr id (a + ↑off)) mv) σ =
              some
                (CerbMem.Footprint.FP CerbMem.FootprintAccess.W (a + ↑off)
                    ↑(CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds vty),
                  CerbMem.writeBytesTo σ (a + ↑off) (CerbMem.memValueToBytes tds [] mv).snd)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.storeM_layer :
∀ (tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap) (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ty : ctype) (lk : Bool)
  (pv : CerbMem.PointerValue) (mv : CerbMem.MemValue) (σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem),
  (∃ fp σ', CerberusHeapLang.runOne (CerbMem.storeM tds loc ty lk pv mv) σ = (NDactive fp, σ')) ∨
    ∃ r σ', CerberusHeapLang.runOne (CerbMem.storeM tds loc ty lk pv mv) σ = (NDkilled r, σ')
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.storeM_live :
∀ (tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap) (σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem) (id : Int) (mc : CerberusHeapLang.MetaCell)
  (off : Nat) (vty : ctype) (mv : CerbMem.MemValue) (loc : CerbLocation.Loc),
  CerberusHeapLang.MetaCoh σ id mc →
    mc.alive = true →
      mc.readonly = false →
        off + CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds vty ≤ mc.size →
          CerbMem.ctypeMemCompatible vty (CerbMem.typeofMval mv) = true →
            (∀ (fpm : CerbMem.Funptrmap), (CerbMem.memValueToBytes tds fpm mv).fst = fpm) →
              (∀ (fpm : CerbMem.Funptrmap),
                  (CerbMem.memValueToBytes tds fpm mv).snd =
                    (CerbMem.memValueToBytes tds [] mv).snd) →
                CerberusHeapLang.applyMemM
                    (CerbMem.storeM tds loc vty false (CerberusHeapLang.cellPtr id (mc.addr + ↑off))
                      mv)
                    σ =
                  some
                    (CerbMem.Footprint.FP CerbMem.FootprintAccess.W (mc.addr + ↑off)
                        ↑(CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds vty),
                      CerbMem.writeBytesTo σ (mc.addr + ↑off)
                        (CerbMem.memValueToBytes tds [] mv).snd)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.storeM_loc_irrel :
∀ {tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap} (loc loc' : CerbLocation.Loc) {ty : ctype} {lk : Bool}
  {pv : CerbMem.PointerValue} {mv : CerbMem.MemValue} {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem},

theorem CerberusHeapLang.storeM_readonly_kills :

  (off : Nat) (vty : ctype) (mv : CerbMem.MemValue) (loc : CerbLocation.Loc),

theorem CerberusHeapLang.storeM_success :
∀ (tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap) (σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem) (id : Int) (c : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeCell)
  (mv : CerbMem.MemValue) (loc : CerbLocation.Loc),

theorem CerberusHeapLang.store_atomic :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {ctl : CerberusHeapLang.Ctl} (loc : CerbLocation.Loc)
  (ann : core_run_annotation) (ty : ctype) (pv : CerbMem.PointerValue) (cv : value)
  (mo : memory_order) (mv : CerbMem.MemValue) (bs : List CerbMem.AbsByte)
  (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack),
  memValueFromValue M.tagDefs (Ctype [] (unatomic_ ty)) cv = some mv →
    CerberusHeapLang.StorableAt M.tagDefs ty mv →
      CerberusHeapLang.AtomicStep M ctl (CerberusHeapLang.storeExpr loc ann ty pv cv mo) ρ 2
        (pv ↦c[M.tagDefs]{Iris.DFrac.own 1} ty ; bs) fun w =>
        iprop(∃ fp,
            ⌜w = CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.annot [DA_pos [] fp] Vunit⌝ ∗
              pv ↦c[M.tagDefs]{Iris.DFrac.own 1} ty ; (CerbMem.memValueToBytes M.tagDefs [] mv).snd)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.store_lit_sym_step :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {loc : CerbLocation.Loc} {ann : core_run_annotation}
  {ty : ctype} {pv : CerbMem.PointerValue} {y : sym} {mo : memory_order}
  {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack} {ctl : CerberusHeapLang.Ctl} {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem}
  {cv : value},
  CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr M.tagDefs M.extern ρ (Pexpr [] () (PEsym y)) = some cv →
    CerberusHeapLang.Step M
      (CerberusHeapLang.storeOpRedex loc ann ty (Pexpr [] () (PEval (Vobject (OVpointer pv))))
          (Pexpr [] () (PEsym y)) mo,
        ρ, ctl, σ)
      (CerberusHeapLang.storeExpr loc ann ty pv cv mo, ρ, ctl, σ)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.store_sym_lit_step :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {loc : CerbLocation.Loc} {ann : core_run_annotation}
  {ty : ctype} {x : sym} {cv : value} {mo : memory_order} {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack}

      some (Vobject (OVpointer pv)) →

  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p : Option sym} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpec GF}
  {Θ : CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpec GF} (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ann : core_run_annotation)
  (mo : memory_order) (id a : Int) (q : Iris.Qp) (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack),
  CerberusHeapLang.pointsToView M.tagDefs id a CerberusHeapLang.structTy CerberusHeapLang.fieldX
      (Iris.DFrac.own q) (Iris.DFrac.own q) CerberusHeapLang.intTy
      (CerberusHeapLang.fiveBytes M.tagDefs) ⊢
    CerberusHeapLang.wps M p Ls Θ
      (fun w x =>
        iprop(⌜∃ fp, w = CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.annot [DA_pos [] fp] CerberusHeapLang.fiveVal⌝ ∗
            CerberusHeapLang.pointsToView M.tagDefs id a CerberusHeapLang.structTy
              CerberusHeapLang.fieldX (Iris.DFrac.own q) (Iris.DFrac.own q) CerberusHeapLang.intTy
              (CerberusHeapLang.fiveBytes M.tagDefs)))
      (CerberusHeapLang.loadExpr loc ann CerberusHeapLang.intTy
        (CerberusHeapLang.cellPtr id (a + ↑CerberusHeapLang.fieldX)) mo)
      ρ
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.struct_x_read_persist_wps :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p : Option sym} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpec GF}
  {Θ : CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpec GF} (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ann : core_run_annotation)
  (mo : memory_order) (id a : Int) (q : Iris.Qp) (dqb : Iris.DFrac) (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack),
  CerberusHeapLang.pointsToView M.tagDefs id a CerberusHeapLang.structTy CerberusHeapLang.fieldX
      (Iris.DFrac.own q) dqb CerberusHeapLang.intTy (CerberusHeapLang.fiveBytes M.tagDefs) ⊢
    CerberusHeapLang.wps M p Ls Θ
      (fun w x =>
        iprop(⌜∃ fp, w = CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.annot [DA_pos [] fp] CerberusHeapLang.fiveVal⌝ ∗
            CerberusHeapLang.locInBounds M.tagDefs id a CerberusHeapLang.structTy
                CerberusHeapLang.fieldX (CerbMem.sizeofCtype M.tagDefs CerberusHeapLang.intTy) ∗
              CerberusHeapLang.pointsToView M.tagDefs id a CerberusHeapLang.structTy
                CerberusHeapLang.fieldX Iris.DFrac.discard dqb CerberusHeapLang.intTy
                (CerberusHeapLang.fiveBytes M.tagDefs)))
      (CerberusHeapLang.loadExpr loc ann CerberusHeapLang.intTy
        (CerberusHeapLang.cellPtr id (a + ↑CerberusHeapLang.fieldX)) mo)
      ρ
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.struct_x_read_shared_wps :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p : Option sym} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpec GF}

      (CerberusHeapLang.loadExpr loc ann CerberusHeapLang.intTy
        (CerberusHeapLang.cellPtr id (a + ↑CerberusHeapLang.fieldX)) mo)
      ρ

def CerberusHeapLang.symAdd :
{β : Type} → sym → β → Fmap sym β → Fmap sym β
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.symAdd_lookup :
∀ {β : Type} {m : Fmap sym β},
  CerberusHeapLang.SymMap m →
    ∀ (cmp' : sym → sym → LemOrdering) (l k : sym) (v : β),
      fmapLookupBy cmp' l (CerberusHeapLang.symAdd k v m) =
        if CerberusHeapLang.symOrd l k = Ordering.eq then some v else fmapLookupBy cmp' l m
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.symAdd_lookup_two :
∀ {β : Type} (cmp' : sym → sym → LemOrdering) (k2 k1 l : sym) (v2 v1 : β),
  fmapLookupBy cmp' l (CerberusHeapLang.symAdd k2 v2 (CerberusHeapLang.symAdd k1 v1 fmapEmpty)) =
    if CerberusHeapLang.symOrd l k2 = Ordering.eq then some v2
    else if CerberusHeapLang.symOrd l k1 = Ordering.eq then some v1 else none
----
def CerberusHeapLang.symCmpK :
sym → sym → LemOrdering
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.symCmpK_eq :
∀ (d1 : String) (n1 : Nat) (sd1 : symbol_description) (d2 : String) (n2 : Nat)
  (sd2 : symbol_description),
  CerberusHeapLang.symCmpK (Symbol d1 n1 sd1) (Symbol d2 n2 sd2) =
    if
        (intLtb (CerberusFresh.digest_compare d1 d2) 0 ||
            CerberusFresh.digest_compare d1 d2 == 0 && natLtb n1 n2) =
          true then
      LemOrdering.LT
    else
      if symbolEquality (Symbol d1 n1 sd1) (Symbol d2 n2 sd2) = true then LemOrdering.EQ
      else LemOrdering.GT
----
def CerberusHeapLang.symCmpL :
sym → sym → LemOrdering
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.symFrame_empty :
CerberusHeapLang.SymFrame fmapEmpty
----
def CerberusHeapLang.symKey :
sym → String × Nat
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.symMap_empty :
∀ {β : Type}, CerberusHeapLang.SymMap fmapEmpty
----
def CerberusHeapLang.symOrd :
sym → sym → Ordering
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.symOrd_eq_compareOn :
CerberusHeapLang.symOrd =
  compareLex (compareOn fun s => (CerberusHeapLang.symKey s).fst)
    (compareOn fun s => (CerberusHeapLang.symKey s).snd)
----
def CerberusHeapLang.symPat :
List annot → sym → core_base_type → pattern
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.symPat_inj :
∀ {pa pa' : List annot} {x x' : sym} {bty bty' : core_base_type},
  CerberusHeapLang.symPat pa x bty = CerberusHeapLang.symPat pa' x' bty' →
    pa = pa' ∧ x = x' ∧ bty = bty'
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.symPat_ne_base :
∀ {pa' : List annot} {bty' : core_base_type} {pa : List annot} {x : sym} {bty : core_base_type},
  Pattern pa' (CaseBase (none, bty')) = CerberusHeapLang.symPat pa x bty → False
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.symPat_ne_spec :
∀ {pa pb : List annot} {x : sym} {bty : core_base_type} {pa' : List annot} {x' : sym}
  {bty' : core_base_type},
  CerberusHeapLang.specPat pa pb x bty = CerberusHeapLang.symPat pa' x' bty' → False
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.symbolEquality_eq :
∀ (d1 : String) (n1 : Nat) (sd1 : symbol_description) (d2 : String) (n2 : Nat)
  (sd2 : symbol_description),
  symbolEquality (Symbol d1 n1 sd1) (Symbol d2 n2 sd2) =
    (CerberusFresh.digest_compare d1 d2 == 0 && n1 == n2)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.take_sum_succ :
∀ (vs : List Int) (i : Nat) (h : i < vs.length),
  (List.take (i + 1) vs).sum = (List.take i vs).sum + vs[i]

def CerberusHeapLang.trPost :
{hlc : Iris.HasLC} →
  {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} →
    [CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF] →
      CerberusHeapLang.NodeTree →
        CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.trPost_readout :
∀ {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS Iris.HasLC.hasLC GF]
  (t' : CerberusHeapLang.NodeTree) (R : CerberusHeapLang.CellMap) (w : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal)
  (ρ' : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack),
  CerberusHeapLang.trPost t' w ρ' ∗ CerberusHeapLang.lrCellFrame R ⊢
    CerberusHeapLang.readoutPost
      (fun v σ' =>
        ∃ Q,
          (∃ p', v = CerberusHeapLang.ptrVal p' ∧ CerberusHeapLang.SeedTree Q p' t') ∧
            Iris.Std.PartialMap.disjoint Q R ∧
              CerberusHeapLang.Coh fmapEmpty σ' (Iris.Std.PartialMap.union Q R))
      w ρ'
----

      [CerberusHeapLang.trF2 (CerberusHeapLang.ptrVal (CerberusHeapLang.cellPtr id aY)) vx]
      (CerberusHeapLang.trShift2 CerberusHeapLang.trYSym) =
    some (CerberusHeapLang.ptrVal (CerberusHeapLang.cellPtr id (aY + 16)))

theorem CerberusHeapLang.tr_wp_readout :
∀ {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ann : core_run_annotation)
  (mo : memory_order) (xbty ybty bbty ubty : core_base_type)
  [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS Iris.HasLC.hasLC GF] (idx idy vx vy : Int)
  (ta tb tc : CerberusHeapLang.NodeTree) (px : CerbMem.PointerValue) (R : CerberusHeapLang.CellMap),
  CerberusHeapLang.isTree px
        (CerberusHeapLang.NodeTree.node idx vx (CerberusHeapLang.NodeTree.node idy vy ta tb) tc) ∗
      CerberusHeapLang.lrCellFrame R ⊢
    WP
      { e := CerberusHeapLang.trProg loc ann mo xbty ybty bbty ubty px,
        ρ := CerberusHeapLang.spikeEnv, ctl := CerberusHeapLang.spikeCtl,
        M := CerberusHeapLang.spikeCtx } @
      Iris.Stuckness.NotStuck ;
      ⊤ {{
        w,
          ∀ σ' ns' κs nt,
            Iris.stateInterp σ' ns' κs nt ={⊤,∅}=∗
              ⌜∃ Q,
                  (∃ p',
                      w.val = CerberusHeapLang.ptrVal p' ∧
                        CerberusHeapLang.SeedTree Q p'
                          (CerberusHeapLang.NodeTree.node idy vy ta
                            (CerberusHeapLang.NodeTree.node idx vx tb tc))) ∧
                    Iris.Std.PartialMap.disjoint Q R ∧
                      CerberusHeapLang.Coh CerberusHeapLang.spikeCtx.tagDefs σ'
                        (Iris.Std.PartialMap.union Q R)⌝ }}
----

theorem CerberusHeapLang.tree_rotate_certified :
∀ (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ann : core_run_annotation) (mo : memory_order)
  (xbty ybty bbty ubty sbty : core_base_type) (idx idy vx vy : Int)
  (ta tb tc : CerberusHeapLang.NodeTree) (px : CerbMem.PointerValue)
  (m₀ : CerberusHeapLang.CellMap),
  CerberusHeapLang.SeedTree m₀ px
      (CerberusHeapLang.NodeTree.node idx vx (CerberusHeapLang.NodeTree.node idy vy ta tb) tc) →
    ∀ (R : CerberusHeapLang.CellMap),
      Iris.Std.PartialMap.disjoint m₀ R →
        ∀ (σ₀ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem),
          CerberusHeapLang.Sat fmapEmpty σ₀ (Iris.Std.PartialMap.union m₀ R) →
            have prog := CerberusHeapLang.trProg loc ann mo xbty ybty bbty ubty px;
            CerberusHeapLang.DriverSafeCtl CerberusHeapLang.spikeCtx
              (CerberusHeapLang.spikeThread prog) prog CerberusHeapLang.spikeEnv
              CerberusHeapLang.spikeCtl σ₀ fun v σ' =>
              ∃ py Q,
                v = CerberusHeapLang.ptrVal py ∧
                  CerberusHeapLang.SeedTree Q py
                      (CerberusHeapLang.NodeTree.node idy vy ta
                        (CerberusHeapLang.NodeTree.node idx vx tb tc)) ∧
                    (∀ (k : Int),
                        (Iris.Std.get? Q k).isSome = true ↔ (Iris.Std.get? m₀ k).isSome = true) ∧
                      Iris.Std.PartialMap.disjoint Q R ∧
                        CerberusHeapLang.Sat fmapEmpty σ' (Iris.Std.PartialMap.union Q R)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.tree_rotate_wps :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpec GF} (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ann : core_run_annotation)

      (CerberusHeapLang.trPost
        (CerberusHeapLang.NodeTree.node idy vy ta (CerberusHeapLang.NodeTree.node idx vx tb tc)))
      (CerberusHeapLang.trProg loc ann mo xbty ybty bbty ubty px) [fmapEmpty]

theorem CerberusHeapLang.tree_rotate_wpt :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpecT GF} (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ann : core_run_annotation)

theorem CerberusHeapLang.tree_rotate_wpt_frame :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpecT GF} (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ann : core_run_annotation)

            RF))
      (CerberusHeapLang.trProg loc ann mo xbty ybty bbty ubty px) [fmapEmpty]

theorem CerberusHeapLang.tree_store_kit :
∀ {tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap} (pv : CerbMem.PointerValue),
  (pv = CerberusHeapLang.nullTree ∨
      ∃ id aN, pv = CerberusHeapLang.cellPtr id aN ∧ 0 < aN ∧ aN < 2 ^ 64) →
    (CerbMem.memValueToBytes tds [] (CerbMem.pointerMval CerberusHeapLang.treeTy pv)).snd.length =
        8 ∧
      (∀ (fpm : CerbMem.Funptrmap),
          (CerbMem.memValueToBytes tds fpm (CerbMem.pointerMval CerberusHeapLang.treeTy pv)).fst =
            fpm) ∧
        (∀ (fpm : CerbMem.Funptrmap),
            (CerbMem.memValueToBytes tds fpm (CerbMem.pointerMval CerberusHeapLang.treeTy pv)).snd =
              (CerbMem.memValueToBytes tds []
                  (CerbMem.pointerMval CerberusHeapLang.treeTy pv)).snd) ∧
          ∀ (bs' : List CerbMem.AbsByte) (off : Nat),
            List.take 8 (List.drop off bs') =
                (CerbMem.memValueToBytes tds []
                    (CerbMem.pointerMval CerberusHeapLang.treeTy pv)).snd →
              CerberusHeapLang.treePtrDec tds bs' off pv
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.twp_ret :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {Φ : CerberusHeapLang.CoreRVal → Iris.IProp GF} (v : value)
  (ev0 : Fmap sym value) (evs : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack) (p₀ : Option sym) (ctx : context)
  (κ : List (Option sym × context)) (q : Option sym) (ℓ : exec_location),
  WP
      { e := apply_ctx ctx (generic_expr.Expr [] (Epure (Pexpr [] () (PEval v)))), ρ := evs,
        ctl := { κ := κ, proc := p₀, execLoc := ℓ }, M := M } @
      Iris.Stuckness.NotStuck ; ⊤ [{ Φ }] ⊢
    WP
      { e := generic_expr.Expr [] (Epure (Pexpr [] () (PEval v))), ρ := ev0 :: evs,
        ctl := { κ := (p₀, ctx) :: κ, proc := q, execLoc := ℓ }, M := M } @
      Iris.Stuckness.NotStuck ; ⊤ [{ Φ }]
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.twp_ret_annot :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {Φ : CerberusHeapLang.CoreRVal → Iris.IProp GF}
  (ds : List dyn_annotation) (v : value) (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack) (pc : Option sym × context)
  (κ : List (Option sym × context)) (q : Option sym) (ℓ : exec_location),
  WP
      { e := generic_expr.Expr [] (Epure (Pexpr [] () (PEval v))), ρ := ρ,
        ctl := { κ := pc :: κ, proc := q, execLoc := ℓ }, M := M } @
      Iris.Stuckness.NotStuck ; ⊤ [{ Φ }] ⊢
    WP
      {
        e :=
          generic_expr.Expr [] (Eannot ds (generic_expr.Expr [] (Epure (Pexpr [] () (PEval v))))),
        ρ := ρ, ctl := { κ := pc :: κ, proc := q, execLoc := ℓ }, M := M } @
      Iris.Stuckness.NotStuck ; ⊤ [{ Φ }]

def CerberusHeapLang.typedRegionView :
{hlc : Iris.HasLC} →
  {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} →
    [CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF] →
      CerbTags.TagDefsMap →
        Int →
          Int → Nat → Nat → Iris.DFrac → Iris.DFrac → ctype → List CerbMem.AbsByte → Iris.IProp GF
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.typedRegionView_iff :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap) (id a : Int) (n off : Nat) (dqm dqb : Iris.DFrac) (vty : ctype)
  (bs : List CerbMem.AbsByte),
  CerberusHeapLang.typedRegionView tds id a n off dqm dqb vty bs ⊣⊢
    CerberusHeapLang.metaOwn id dqm (CerberusHeapLang.regionCell a n true) ∗
      ⌜off + CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds vty ≤ n ∧ bs.length = CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds vty⌝ ∗
        CerberusHeapLang.bytesOwn (a + ↑off) dqb bs
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.typedRegionView_join :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap) (id a : Int) (n off : Nat) (q₁ q₂ : Iris.Qp) (dqb : Iris.DFrac)
  (vty vty₁ vty₂ : ctype) (bs₁ bs₂ : List CerbMem.AbsByte),
  CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds vty = CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds vty₁ + CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds vty₂ →
    off + CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds vty ≤ n →
      CerberusHeapLang.typedRegionView tds id a n off (Iris.DFrac.own q₁) dqb vty₁ bs₁ ∗
          CerberusHeapLang.typedRegionView tds id a n (off + CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds vty₁)
            (Iris.DFrac.own q₂) dqb vty₂ bs₂ ⊢
        CerberusHeapLang.typedRegionView tds id a n off (Iris.DFrac.own (q₁ + q₂)) dqb vty
          (bs₁ ++ bs₂)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.typedRegionView_regionView :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap) (id a : Int) (n off : Nat) (dqm dqb : Iris.DFrac) (vty : ctype)
  (bs : List CerbMem.AbsByte),
  CerberusHeapLang.typedRegionView tds id a n off dqm dqb vty bs ⊣⊢
    CerberusHeapLang.regionView id a n off dqm dqb bs ∗ ⌜bs.length = CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds vty⌝
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.typedRegionView_split :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap) (id a : Int) (n off : Nat) (q₁ q₂ : Iris.Qp) (dqb : Iris.DFrac)
  (vty vty₁ vty₂ : ctype) (bs₁ bs₂ : List CerbMem.AbsByte),
  CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds vty = CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds vty₁ + CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds vty₂ →
    bs₁.length = CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds vty₁ →
      CerberusHeapLang.typedRegionView tds id a n off (Iris.DFrac.own (q₁ + q₂)) dqb vty
          (bs₁ ++ bs₂) ⊢
        CerberusHeapLang.typedRegionView tds id a n off (Iris.DFrac.own q₁) dqb vty₁ bs₁ ∗
          CerberusHeapLang.typedRegionView tds id a n (off + CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds vty₁)
            (Iris.DFrac.own q₂) dqb vty₂ bs₂
----

theorem CerberusHeapLang.valueFromPexprs_cons :
∀ (pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym) (pes : List (generic_pexpr Unit sym)),
  valueFromPexprs (pe :: pes) =
    match valueFromPexpr pe, valueFromPexprs pes with
    | some v, some vs => some (v :: vs)
    | x, x_1 => none

  valueFromPexprs pes = some vs → pes.length = vs.length

theorem CerberusHeapLang.valueFromPexprs_pair :
∀ (pe1 pe2 : generic_pexpr Unit sym),
  valueFromPexprs [pe1, pe2] =
    match valueFromPexpr pe1, valueFromPexpr pe2 with
    | some v1, some v2 => some [v1, v2]
    | x, x_1 => none

  (ps :
    List
      (sym × (core_base_type × Option (ctype × pass_by_value_or_pointer)) × generic_pexpr Unit sym))

  ps.length = cvals.length →
    valueFromPexprs
        (CerberusHeapLang.saveParamPexprs (CerberusHeapLang.saveParamsWithValues ps cvals)) =
      some cvals

theorem CerberusHeapLang.wp_load :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {s : Iris.Stuckness} {E : CoPset} {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {ctl : CerberusHeapLang.Ctl}
  (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ann : core_run_annotation) (ty : ctype) (pv : CerbMem.PointerValue)
  (mo : memory_order) (dq : Iris.DFrac) (bs : List CerbMem.AbsByte) (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack),
  CerberusHeapLang.cellLoadTrap M.tagDefs
        { addr := CerberusHeapLang.addrOf pv, ty := ty, bytes := bs } =
      false →
    ctl.κ = [] →
      pv ↦c[M.tagDefs]{dq} ty ; bs ⊢
        WP { e := CerberusHeapLang.loadExpr loc ann ty pv mo, ρ := ρ, ctl := ctl, M := M } @ s ;
          E {{
            w,
              ∃ fp,
                ⌜w =
                      {
                        w :=
                          CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.annot [DA_pos [] fp]
                            (CerberusHeapLang.loadedVal M.tagDefs pv ty bs),
                        ρ := ρ, proc := ctl.proc, execLoc := ctl.execLoc, M := M }⌝ ∗
                  pv ↦c[M.tagDefs]{dq} ty ; bs }}
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.wp_of_atomic :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {s : Iris.Stuckness} {E : CoPset} {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {ctl : CerberusHeapLang.Ctl}
  {e : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack} {c : Nat} {P : Iris.IProp GF}
  {Q : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → Iris.IProp GF},
  CerberusHeapLang.AtomicStep M ctl e ρ c P Q →
    CerberusHeapLang.toVal e = none →
      ctl.κ = [] →
        ∀ (Φ : CerberusHeapLang.CoreRVal → Iris.IProp GF),
          (P ∗ ∀ w, Q w -∗ Φ { w := w, ρ := ρ, proc := ctl.proc, execLoc := ctl.execLoc, M := M }) ⊢
            WP { e := e, ρ := ρ, ctl := ctl, M := M } @ s ; E {{ Φ }}
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.wp_ret :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {Φ : CerberusHeapLang.CoreRVal → Iris.IProp GF} (v : value)
  (ev0 : Fmap sym value) (evs : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack) (p₀ : Option sym) (ctx : context)
  (κ : List (Option sym × context)) (q : Option sym) (ℓ : exec_location),
  WP
      { e := apply_ctx ctx (generic_expr.Expr [] (Epure (Pexpr [] () (PEval v)))), ρ := evs,
        ctl := { κ := κ, proc := p₀, execLoc := ℓ }, M := M } @
      Iris.Stuckness.NotStuck ; ⊤ {{ Φ }} ⊢
    WP
      { e := generic_expr.Expr [] (Epure (Pexpr [] () (PEval v))), ρ := ev0 :: evs,
        ctl := { κ := (p₀, ctx) :: κ, proc := q, execLoc := ℓ }, M := M } @
      Iris.Stuckness.NotStuck ; ⊤ {{ Φ }}
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.wp_ret_annot :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {Φ : CerberusHeapLang.CoreRVal → Iris.IProp GF}
  (ds : List dyn_annotation) (v : value) (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack) (pc : Option sym × context)
  (κ : List (Option sym × context)) (q : Option sym) (ℓ : exec_location),
  WP
      { e := generic_expr.Expr [] (Epure (Pexpr [] () (PEval v))), ρ := ρ,
        ctl := { κ := pc :: κ, proc := q, execLoc := ℓ }, M := M } @
      Iris.Stuckness.NotStuck ; ⊤ {{ Φ }} ⊢
    WP
      {
        e :=
          generic_expr.Expr [] (Eannot ds (generic_expr.Expr [] (Epure (Pexpr [] () (PEval v))))),
        ρ := ρ, ctl := { κ := pc :: κ, proc := q, execLoc := ℓ }, M := M } @
      Iris.Stuckness.NotStuck ; ⊤ {{ Φ }}
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.wp_store :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {s : Iris.Stuckness} {E : CoPset} {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {ctl : CerberusHeapLang.Ctl}
  (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ann : core_run_annotation) (ty : ctype) (pv : CerbMem.PointerValue)
  (cv : value) (mo : memory_order) (mv : CerbMem.MemValue) (bs : List CerbMem.AbsByte)
  (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack),
  memValueFromValue M.tagDefs (Ctype [] (unatomic_ ty)) cv = some mv →
    CerberusHeapLang.StorableAt M.tagDefs ty mv →
      ctl.κ = [] →
        pv ↦c[M.tagDefs]{Iris.DFrac.own 1} ty ; bs ⊢
          WP { e := CerberusHeapLang.storeExpr loc ann ty pv cv mo, ρ := ρ, ctl := ctl, M := M } @
            s ;
            E {{
              w,
                ∃ fp,
                  ⌜w =
                        { w := CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.annot [DA_pos [] fp] Vunit, ρ := ρ,
                          proc := ctl.proc, execLoc := ctl.execLoc, M := M }⌝ ∗
                    pv ↦c[M.tagDefs]{Iris.DFrac.own 1} ty ;
                      (CerbMem.memValueToBytes M.tagDefs [] mv).snd }}
----
def CerberusHeapLang.wps :
{hlc : Iris.HasLC} →
  {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} →
    [CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF] →
      CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx →
        Option sym →
          CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpec GF →
            CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpec GF →
              (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF) →
                CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF
----
def CerberusHeapLang.wps.pre :
{hlc : Iris.HasLC} →
  {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} →
    [CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF] →
      CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx →
        Option sym →
          CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpec GF →
            CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpec GF →
              ((CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF) →
                  CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF) →
                (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF) →
                  CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF

  (M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx) (p : Option sym) (Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpec GF)
  (Θ : CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpec GF), Iris.OFE.Contractive (CerberusHeapLang.wps.pre M p Ls Θ)

theorem CerberusHeapLang.wps_alloc :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p : Option sym} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpec GF}
  {Θ : CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpec GF}
  {Ψ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF}
  (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ann : core_run_annotation) (aprov sprov : CerbMem.Provenance)
  (alignN sizeN : Int) (pref : prefix0) (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack),
  0 < CerberusHeapLang.regionCost alignN sizeN →
    (CerberusHeapLang.allocBudget (CerberusHeapLang.regionCost alignN sizeN) ∗
        ∀ id a,
          CerberusHeapLang.regionOwn id a sizeN.toNat (Iris.DFrac.own 1)
                (List.replicate sizeN.toNat CerberusHeapLang.undefByte) ∗
              ⌜0 < a ∧ a + ↑sizeN.toNat ≤ 2 ^ 64⌝ -∗
            Ψ (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.pure (Vobject (OVpointer (CerberusHeapLang.cellPtr id a))))
              ρ) ⊢
      CerberusHeapLang.wps M p Ls Θ Ψ
        (CerberusHeapLang.allocExpr loc ann (CerbMem.IntegerValue.IV aprov alignN)
          (CerbMem.IntegerValue.IV sprov sizeN) pref)
        ρ
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.wps_alloc_eval :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p : Option sym} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpec GF}
  {Θ : CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpec GF}
  {Ψ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF}
  (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ann : core_run_annotation) (pe1 pe2 : generic_pexpr Unit sym)
  (pref : prefix0) (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack) {align size : CerbMem.IntegerValue},
  valueFromPexprs [pe1, pe2] = none →
    CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr M.tagDefs M.extern ρ pe1 = some (Vobject (OVinteger align)) →
      CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr M.tagDefs M.extern ρ pe2 = some (Vobject (OVinteger size)) →
        CerberusHeapLang.wps M p Ls Θ Ψ (CerberusHeapLang.allocExpr loc ann align size pref) ρ ⊢
          CerberusHeapLang.wps M p Ls Θ Ψ (CerberusHeapLang.allocOpRedex loc ann pe1 pe2 pref) ρ
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.wps_alloc_lit_sym :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p : Option sym} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpec GF}

  CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr M.tagDefs M.extern ρ (Pexpr [] () (PEsym n)) =
      some (Vobject (OVinteger size)) →
    CerberusHeapLang.wps M p Ls Θ Ψ (CerberusHeapLang.allocExpr loc ann align size pref) ρ ⊢
      CerberusHeapLang.wps M p Ls Θ Ψ
        (CerberusHeapLang.allocOpRedex loc ann (Pexpr [] () (PEval (Vobject (OVinteger align))))
          (Pexpr [] () (PEsym n)) pref)
        ρ

theorem CerberusHeapLang.wps_annot :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p : Option sym} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpec GF}

  (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack)
  {Ψ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF},
  CerberusHeapLang.wps M p Ls Θ (fun w ρ' => Ψ (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.merge ds w) ρ') e ρ ⊢

theorem CerberusHeapLang.wps_annot_reindex :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p : Option sym} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpec GF}
  {Θ : CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpec GF} (a : List annot) (dsA dsB : List dyn_annotation)
  (c : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr) (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack)
  {Ψ₁ Ψ₂ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF},
  (∀ (w : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal) (ρ' : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack),
      Ψ₁ (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.merge dsA w) ρ' =
        Ψ₂ (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.merge dsB w) ρ') →
    CerberusHeapLang.wps M p Ls Θ Ψ₁ (generic_expr.Expr a (Eannot dsA c)) ρ ⊢
      CerberusHeapLang.wps M p Ls Θ Ψ₂ (generic_expr.Expr a (Eannot dsB c)) ρ

theorem CerberusHeapLang.wps_arr_elem_load :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M' : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p' : Option sym} {Ls' : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpec GF}
  {Θ' : CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpec GF}
  {Ψ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF}
  (loc' : CerbLocation.Loc) (ann' : core_run_annotation) (aty' : ctype) (id' a' : Int) (i : Nat)
  (mo' : memory_order) (dq : Iris.DFrac) (bs' : List CerbMem.AbsByte)
  (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack) {mv : CerbMem.MemValue},
  4 * i + CerbMem.sizeofCtype M'.tagDefs CerberusHeapLang.intTy ≤
      CerbMem.sizeofCtype M'.tagDefs aty' →
    (∀ (lum : List (Int × identifier)) (fpm : CerbMem.Funptrmap),
        CerbMem.reconstructValue M'.tagDefs lum fpm (a' + ↑(4 * i)) CerberusHeapLang.intTy
            (List.take (CerbMem.sizeofCtype M'.tagDefs CerberusHeapLang.intTy)
              (List.drop (4 * i) bs')) =
          mv) →
      CerberusHeapLang.loadTrapV CerberusHeapLang.intTy mv = false →
        (CerberusHeapLang.cellOwn M'.tagDefs id' dq { addr := a', ty := aty', bytes := bs' } ∗
            ∀ fp,
              CerberusHeapLang.cellOwn M'.tagDefs id' dq { addr := a', ty := aty', bytes := bs' } -∗
                Ψ (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.annot [DA_pos [] fp] (valueFromMemValue mv).snd) ρ) ⊢
          CerberusHeapLang.wps M' p' Ls' Θ' Ψ
            (CerberusHeapLang.loadExpr loc' ann' CerberusHeapLang.intTy
              (CerberusHeapLang.cellPtr id' (a' + ↑(4 * i))) mo')
            ρ
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.wps_call :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p : Option sym} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpec GF}
  {Θ : CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpec GF}
  {Ψ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF}
  {e : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {ctx : context} {f : sym} {pes : List (generic_pexpr Unit sym)}
  {params : List (sym × core_base_type)} {body : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {vs : List value}
  (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack),
  CerberusHeapLang.callRedex? e = some (ctx, f, pes) →
    CerberusHeapLang.lookupProc M.file M.extern f = some (params, body) →
      params.length = vs.length →
        CerberusHeapLang.evalPexprs M.tagDefs M.extern ρ pes = some vs →
          ((Θ f vs).fst ∗
              ∀ ret,
                (Θ f vs).snd ret -∗
                  CerberusHeapLang.wps M p Ls Θ Ψ
                    (apply_ctx ctx (generic_expr.Expr [] (Epure (Pexpr [] () (PEval ret))))) ρ) ⊢
            CerberusHeapLang.wps M p Ls Θ Ψ e ρ
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.wps_call_root :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p : Option sym} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpec GF}
  {Θ : CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpec GF}
  {Ψ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF} (a : List annot)
  (ra : core_run_annotation) (f : sym) (pes : List (generic_pexpr Unit sym))
  {params : List (sym × core_base_type)} {body : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {vs : List value}
  (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack),
  CerberusHeapLang.lookupProc M.file M.extern f = some (params, body) →
    params.length = vs.length →
      CerberusHeapLang.evalPexprs M.tagDefs M.extern ρ pes = some vs →
        ((Θ f vs).fst ∗
            ∀ ret,
              (Θ f vs).snd ret -∗
                CerberusHeapLang.wps M p Ls Θ Ψ
                  (generic_expr.Expr [] (Epure (Pexpr [] () (PEval ret)))) ρ) ⊢
          CerberusHeapLang.wps M p Ls Θ Ψ (generic_expr.Expr a (Eproc ra (Sym f) pes)) ρ
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.wps_case_value :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p : Option sym} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpec GF}
  {Θ : CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpec GF}
  {Ψ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF} (a : List annot)
  (pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym) (pats : List (pattern × CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr)) {cval : value}
  {e' : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack),
  valueFromPexpr pe = some cval →
    select_case subst_sym_expr cval pats = some e' →
      CerberusHeapLang.wps M p Ls Θ Ψ e' ρ ⊢
        CerberusHeapLang.wps M p Ls Θ Ψ (generic_expr.Expr a (Ecase pe pats)) ρ

theorem CerberusHeapLang.wps_create :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p : Option sym} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpec GF}
  {Θ : CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpec GF}
  {Ψ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF}
  (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ann : core_run_annotation) (aprov : CerbMem.Provenance) (alignN : Int)
  (ty : ctype) (pref : prefix0) (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack),
  0 < CerbMem.sizeofCtype M.tagDefs ty →
    CerberusHeapLang.atomicTy ty = false →
      (∀ (a : Int),
          CerberusHeapLang.decIndep M.tagDefs a ty
            (List.replicate (CerbMem.sizeofCtype M.tagDefs ty) CerberusHeapLang.undefByte)) →
        (CerberusHeapLang.allocBudget (CerberusHeapLang.allocCost M.tagDefs ty alignN) ∗
            ∀ p,
              p ↦c[M.tagDefs]{Iris.DFrac.own 1} ty ;
                    List.replicate (CerbMem.sizeofCtype M.tagDefs ty) CerberusHeapLang.undefByte ∗
                  ⌜0 < CerberusHeapLang.addrOf p ∧ CerberusHeapLang.addrOf p < 2 ^ 64⌝ -∗
                Ψ (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.pure (Vobject (OVpointer p))) ρ) ⊢
          CerberusHeapLang.wps M p Ls Θ Ψ
            (CerberusHeapLang.createExpr loc ann (CerbMem.IntegerValue.IV aprov alignN) ty pref) ρ
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.wps_create_of_plan :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p : Option sym} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpec GF}
  {Θ : CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpec GF}
  {Ψ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF}
  (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ann : core_run_annotation) (aprov : CerbMem.Provenance)
  (req : CerberusHeapLang.AllocReq) (rest : List CerberusHeapLang.AllocReq) (pref : prefix0)
  (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack),
  0 < CerbMem.sizeofCtype M.tagDefs req.ty →
    CerberusHeapLang.atomicTy req.ty = false →
      (∀ (a : Int),
          CerberusHeapLang.decIndep M.tagDefs a req.ty
            (List.replicate (CerbMem.sizeofCtype M.tagDefs req.ty) CerberusHeapLang.undefByte)) →
        (CerberusHeapLang.allocBudget (CerberusHeapLang.planCost M.tagDefs (req :: rest)) ∗
            ∀ p,
              p ↦c[M.tagDefs]{Iris.DFrac.own 1} req.ty ;
                    List.replicate (CerbMem.sizeofCtype M.tagDefs req.ty)
                      CerberusHeapLang.undefByte ∗
                  CerberusHeapLang.allocBudget (CerberusHeapLang.planCost M.tagDefs rest) ∗
                    ⌜0 < CerberusHeapLang.addrOf p ∧ CerberusHeapLang.addrOf p < 2 ^ 64⌝ -∗
                Ψ (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.pure (Vobject (OVpointer p))) ρ) ⊢
          CerberusHeapLang.wps M p Ls Θ Ψ
            (CerberusHeapLang.createExpr loc ann (CerbMem.IntegerValue.IV aprov req.align) req.ty
              pref)
            ρ

theorem CerberusHeapLang.wps_empty_call_false :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p : Option sym} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpec GF}

theorem CerberusHeapLang.wps_exhibit_seq_stores :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p : Option sym} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpec GF}
  {Θ : CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpec GF} (x y : CerbMem.PointerValue) (loc loc' : CerbLocation.Loc)
  (ann ann' : core_run_annotation) (mo mo' : memory_order) (bty : core_base_type)
  (bsx bsy : List CerbMem.AbsByte) (ev0 : Fmap sym value) (evs : List (Fmap sym value)),
  x ↦c[M.tagDefs]{Iris.DFrac.own 1} CerberusHeapLang.intTy ; bsx ∗
      y ↦c[M.tagDefs]{Iris.DFrac.own 1} CerberusHeapLang.intTy ; bsy ⊢
    CerberusHeapLang.wps M p Ls Θ
      (fun x_1 x_2 =>
        iprop(x ↦c[M.tagDefs]{Iris.DFrac.own 1} CerberusHeapLang.intTy ;
              CerberusHeapLang.fiveBytes M.tagDefs ∗
            y ↦c[M.tagDefs]{Iris.DFrac.own 1} CerberusHeapLang.intTy ;
              CerberusHeapLang.sixBytes M.tagDefs))
      (CerberusHeapLang.sseqExpr bty
        (CerberusHeapLang.storeExpr loc ann CerberusHeapLang.intTy x CerberusHeapLang.fiveVal mo)
        (CerberusHeapLang.storeExpr loc' ann' CerberusHeapLang.intTy y CerberusHeapLang.sixVal mo'))
      (ev0 :: evs)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.wps_exhibit_store_frame :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p : Option sym} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpec GF}
  {Θ : CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpec GF} (x y : CerbMem.PointerValue) (loc : CerbLocation.Loc)
  (ann : core_run_annotation) (mo : memory_order) (bs bs' : List CerbMem.AbsByte) (ty' : ctype)
  (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack),
  x ↦c[M.tagDefs]{Iris.DFrac.own 1} CerberusHeapLang.intTy ; bs ∗
      y ↦c[M.tagDefs]{Iris.DFrac.own 1} ty' ; bs' ⊢
    CerberusHeapLang.wps M p Ls Θ
      (fun x_1 x_2 =>
        iprop(x ↦c[M.tagDefs]{Iris.DFrac.own 1} CerberusHeapLang.intTy ;
              CerberusHeapLang.sevenBytes M.tagDefs ∗
            y ↦c[M.tagDefs]{Iris.DFrac.own 1} ty' ; bs'))
      (CerberusHeapLang.storeExpr loc ann CerberusHeapLang.intTy x CerberusHeapLang.sevenVal mo) ρ

  CerberusHeapLang.wps M p Ls Θ Ψ e ρ ∗ R ⊢

    CerberusHeapLang.wps M p Ls Θ Ψ (generic_expr.Expr a (Eif g e2 e3)) ρ

theorem CerberusHeapLang.wps_kill :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p : Option sym} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpec GF}
  {Θ : CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpec GF}
  {Ψ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF}
  (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ann : core_run_annotation) (kind : kill_kind)
  (pv : CerbMem.PointerValue) (ty : ctype) (bs : List CerbMem.AbsByte)
  (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack),
  is_dynamic kind = false →
    pv ↦c[M.tagDefs]{Iris.DFrac.own 1} ty ; bs ∗
        ((∃ id a,
            ⌜pv = CerberusHeapLang.cellPtr id a⌝ ∗ CerberusHeapLang.deadObj M.tagDefs id a ty) -∗
          Ψ (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.pure Vunit) ρ) ⊢
      CerberusHeapLang.wps M p Ls Θ Ψ (CerberusHeapLang.killExpr loc ann kind pv) ρ
----

∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]

theorem CerberusHeapLang.wps_load :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p : Option sym} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpec GF}
  {Θ : CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpec GF}
  {Ψ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF}
  (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ann : core_run_annotation) (ty : ctype) (pv : CerbMem.PointerValue)
  (mo : memory_order) (dq : Iris.DFrac) (bs : List CerbMem.AbsByte) (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack),
  CerberusHeapLang.cellLoadTrap M.tagDefs
        { addr := CerberusHeapLang.addrOf pv, ty := ty, bytes := bs } =
      false →
    (pv ↦c[M.tagDefs]{dq} ty ; bs ∗
        ∀ fp,
          pv ↦c[M.tagDefs]{dq} ty ; bs -∗
            Ψ
              (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.annot [DA_pos [] fp]
                (CerberusHeapLang.loadedVal M.tagDefs pv ty bs))
              ρ) ⊢
      CerberusHeapLang.wps M p Ls Θ Ψ (CerberusHeapLang.loadExpr loc ann ty pv mo) ρ

theorem CerberusHeapLang.wps_load_at :

  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p : Option sym} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpec GF}

  (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ann : core_run_annotation) (id a : Int) (aty : ctype) (off : Nat)
  (vty : ctype) (mo : memory_order) (dqm dqb : Iris.DFrac) (bs : List CerbMem.AbsByte)
  (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack) {mv : CerbMem.MemValue},
  (∀ (lum : List (Int × identifier)) (fpm : CerbMem.Funptrmap),
      CerbMem.reconstructValue M.tagDefs lum fpm (a + ↑off) vty bs = mv) →
    CerberusHeapLang.loadTrapV vty mv = false →
      (CerberusHeapLang.pointsToView M.tagDefs id a aty off dqm dqb vty bs ∗
          ∀ fp,
            CerberusHeapLang.pointsToView M.tagDefs id a aty off dqm dqb vty bs -∗
              Ψ (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.annot [DA_pos [] fp] (valueFromMemValue mv).snd) ρ) ⊢
        CerberusHeapLang.wps M p Ls Θ Ψ
          (CerberusHeapLang.loadExpr loc ann vty (CerberusHeapLang.cellPtr id (a + ↑off)) mo) ρ

theorem CerberusHeapLang.wps_load_tree_field :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p : Option sym} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpec GF}
  {Θ : CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpec GF}
  {Ψ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF}
  (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ann : core_run_annotation) (id a : Int) (off : Nat) (mo : memory_order)
  (dq : Iris.DFrac) (bs : List CerbMem.AbsByte) (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack)
  {mv : CerbMem.MemValue},
  off + 8 ≤ CerbMem.sizeofCtype M.tagDefs CerberusHeapLang.treeTy →
    (∀ (lum : List (Int × identifier)) (fpm : CerbMem.Funptrmap),
        CerbMem.reconstructValue M.tagDefs lum fpm (a + ↑off) CerberusHeapLang.treePtrTy
            (List.take 8 (List.drop off bs)) =
          mv) →
      (CerberusHeapLang.cellOwn M.tagDefs id dq
            { addr := a, ty := CerberusHeapLang.treeTy, bytes := bs } ∗
          ∀ fp,
            CerberusHeapLang.cellOwn M.tagDefs id dq
                { addr := a, ty := CerberusHeapLang.treeTy, bytes := bs } -∗
              Ψ (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.annot [DA_pos [] fp] (valueFromMemValue mv).snd) ρ) ⊢
        CerberusHeapLang.wps M p Ls Θ Ψ
          (CerberusHeapLang.loadExpr loc ann CerberusHeapLang.treePtrTy
            (CerberusHeapLang.cellPtr id (a + ↑off)) mo)
          ρ
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.wps_memop_eval :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p : Option sym} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpec GF}
  {Θ : CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpec GF}
  {Ψ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF} (mop : memop)
  (pe1 pe2 : generic_pexpr Unit sym) {v1 v2 : value} (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack),
  valueFromPexprs [pe1, pe2] = none →
    CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr M.tagDefs M.extern ρ pe1 = some v1 →
      CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr M.tagDefs M.extern ρ pe2 = some v2 →
        CerberusHeapLang.wps M p Ls Θ Ψ
            (CerberusHeapLang.memopRedex mop [Pexpr [] () (PEval v1), Pexpr [] () (PEval v2)]) ρ ⊢
          CerberusHeapLang.wps M p Ls Θ Ψ (CerberusHeapLang.memopRedex mop [pe1, pe2]) ρ
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.wps_memop_ptreq :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p : Option sym} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpec GF}
  {Θ : CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpec GF}
  {Ψ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF}
  (pv1 pv2 : CerbMem.PointerValue) {b : Bool} (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack),
  (∀ (σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem),
      CerberusHeapLang.applyMemM (CerbMem.eqPtrval default pv1 pv2) σ = some (b, σ)) →
    Ψ (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.pure (CerberusHeapLang.boolValue b)) ρ ⊢
      CerberusHeapLang.wps M p Ls Θ Ψ
        (CerberusHeapLang.memopPtrEqVals (Vobject (OVpointer pv1)) (Vobject (OVpointer pv2))) ρ
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.wps_mono_Ls :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p : Option sym} {Θ : CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpec GF}
  {Ls₁ Ls₂ : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpec GF}
  {Ψ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF},
  (∀ (l : sym) (vs : List value) (ρ' : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack), Ls₁ l vs ρ' ⊢ Ls₂ l vs ρ') →
    ∀ (e : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr) (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack),
      CerberusHeapLang.wps M p Ls₁ Θ Ψ e ρ ⊢ CerberusHeapLang.wps M p Ls₂ Θ Ψ e ρ

theorem CerberusHeapLang.wps_of_atomic :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p : Option sym} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpec GF}
  {Θ : CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpec GF}
  {Ψ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF}
  {e : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack} {c : Nat} {P : Iris.IProp GF}
  {Q : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → Iris.IProp GF},
  (∀ (κ : List (Option sym × context)) (ℓ : exec_location),
      CerberusHeapLang.AtomicStep M { κ := κ, proc := p, execLoc := ℓ } e ρ c P Q) →
    CerberusHeapLang.toVal e = none →
      CerberusHeapLang.jumpRedex? e = none →
        CerberusHeapLang.callRedex? e = none →
          (P ∗ ∀ w, Q w -∗ Ψ w ρ) ⊢ CerberusHeapLang.wps M p Ls Θ Ψ e ρ
----

  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p : Option sym} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpec GF}

  (pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym) (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack) {v : value},
  valueFromPexpr pe = none →
    CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr M.tagDefs M.extern ρ pe = some v →
      Ψ (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.pure v) ρ ⊢
        CerberusHeapLang.wps M p Ls Θ Ψ (generic_expr.Expr [] (Epure pe)) ρ

theorem CerberusHeapLang.wps_run :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p : Option sym} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpec GF}

  {Ψ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF} (a : List annot)
  (ra : core_run_annotation) (l : sym) (pes : List (generic_pexpr Unit sym))
  {params : List (sym × core_base_type)} {cont : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {vs : List value}
  (ev0 : Fmap sym value) (evs : List (Fmap sym value)),
  CerberusHeapLang.lookupLabel (M.labelsAt p) l = some (params, cont) →
    CerberusHeapLang.evalPexprs M.tagDefs M.extern (ev0 :: evs) pes = some vs →
      Ls l vs (ev0 :: evs) ⊢
        CerberusHeapLang.wps M p Ls Θ Ψ (generic_expr.Expr a (Erun ra l pes)) (ev0 :: evs)
