theorem CerberusHeapLang.wps_seq :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p : Option sym} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpec GF}
  {Θ : CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpec GF}
  {Ψ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF} (a pa : List annot)
  (bty : core_base_type) (e1 e2 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr) (ev0 : Fmap sym value)
  (evs : List (Fmap sym value)),
  CerberusHeapLang.wps M p Ls Θ
      (fun w ρ' => CerberusHeapLang.wps M p Ls Θ (fun u ρ'' => Ψ (w.mergeInto u) ρ'') e2 ρ') e1
      (ev0 :: evs) ⊢
    CerberusHeapLang.wps M p Ls Θ Ψ
      (generic_expr.Expr a (Esseq (Pattern pa (CaseBase (none, bty))) e1 e2)) (ev0 :: evs)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.wps_seq_spec :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p : Option sym} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpec GF}
  {Θ : CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpec GF}
  {Ψ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF} (a pa pb : List annot)
  (x : sym) (bty : core_base_type) (e1 e2 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr) (ev0 : Fmap sym value)
  (evs : List (Fmap sym value)),
  CerberusHeapLang.wps M p Ls Θ
      (fun w ρ' =>
        iprop(∃ ov,
            ⌜w.val = Vloaded (LVspecified ov)⌝ ∗
              CerberusHeapLang.wps M p Ls Θ (fun u ρ'' => Ψ (w.mergeInto u) ρ'') e2
                (update_env (CerberusHeapLang.specPat pa pb x bty) (Vloaded (LVspecified ov)) ρ')))
      e1 (ev0 :: evs) ⊢
    CerberusHeapLang.wps M p Ls Θ Ψ
      (generic_expr.Expr a (Esseq (CerberusHeapLang.specPat pa pb x bty) e1 e2)) (ev0 :: evs)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.wps_seq_sym :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p : Option sym} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpec GF}
  {Θ : CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpec GF}
  {Ψ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF} (a pa : List annot)
  (x : sym) (bty : core_base_type) (e1 e2 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr) (ev0 : Fmap sym value)
  (evs : List (Fmap sym value)),
  CerberusHeapLang.wps M p Ls Θ
      (fun w ρ' =>
        iprop(∃ v,
            ⌜w = CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.pure v⌝ ∗
              CerberusHeapLang.wps M p Ls Θ Ψ e2
                (update_env (CerberusHeapLang.symPat pa x bty) v ρ')))
      e1 (ev0 :: evs) ⊢
    CerberusHeapLang.wps M p Ls Θ Ψ
      (generic_expr.Expr a (Esseq (CerberusHeapLang.symPat pa x bty) e1 e2)) (ev0 :: evs)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.wps_sound :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpec GF}
  {Θ : CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpec GF}
  {Ψ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF}
  {ctl : CerberusHeapLang.Ctl},
  ctl.κ = [] →
    ∀ (e : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr) (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack),
      CerberusHeapLang.procSpecs M Θ ∗ CerberusHeapLang.blockSpecs M ctl.proc Ls Θ Ψ ⊢
        CerberusHeapLang.wps M ctl.proc Ls Θ Ψ e ρ -∗
          WP { e := e, ρ := ρ, ctl := ctl, M := M } @ Iris.Stuckness.NotStuck ; ⊤ {{ w, Ψ w.w w.ρ }}
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.wps_sound_cps :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {Θ : CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpec GF} (p : Option sym)
  (Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpec GF)
  {Ψ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF}
  (κ : List (Option sym × context)) (ℓ : exec_location) (e : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr)
  (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack) (Φ : CerberusHeapLang.CoreRVal → Iris.IProp GF),
  CerberusHeapLang.procSpecs M Θ ⊢
    CerberusHeapLang.blockSpecs M p Ls Θ Ψ -∗
      CerberusHeapLang.wps M p Ls Θ Ψ e ρ -∗
        (∀ ℓ' w ρ',
            ⌜CerberusHeapLang.SameTail ρ ρ'⌝ -∗
              Ψ w ρ' -∗
                WP
                  { e := CerberusHeapLang.ofVal w, ρ := ρ',
                    ctl := { κ := κ, proc := p, execLoc := ℓ' }, M := M } @
                  Iris.Stuckness.NotStuck ; ⊤ {{ Φ }} ) -∗
          WP { e := e, ρ := ρ, ctl := { κ := κ, proc := p, execLoc := ℓ }, M := M } @
            Iris.Stuckness.NotStuck ; ⊤ {{ Φ }}
----

theorem CerberusHeapLang.wps_store :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p : Option sym} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpec GF}
  {Θ : CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpec GF}
  {Ψ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF}
  (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ann : core_run_annotation) (ty : ctype) (pv : CerbMem.PointerValue)
  (cv : value) (mo : memory_order) (mv : CerbMem.MemValue) (bs : List CerbMem.AbsByte)
  (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack),
  memValueFromValue M.tagDefs (Ctype [] (unatomic_ ty)) cv = some mv →
    CerberusHeapLang.StorableAt M.tagDefs ty mv →
      (pv ↦c[M.tagDefs]{Iris.DFrac.own 1} ty ; bs ∗
          ∀ fp,
            pv ↦c[M.tagDefs]{Iris.DFrac.own 1} ty ; (CerbMem.memValueToBytes M.tagDefs [] mv).snd -∗
              Ψ (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.annot [DA_pos [] fp] Vunit) ρ) ⊢
        CerberusHeapLang.wps M p Ls Θ Ψ (CerberusHeapLang.storeExpr loc ann ty pv cv mo) ρ
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.wps_store_at :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p : Option sym} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpec GF}

  (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ann : core_run_annotation) (id a : Int) (aty : ctype) (off : Nat)
  (vty : ctype) (cv : value) (mo : memory_order) (dqm : Iris.DFrac) (bs : List CerbMem.AbsByte)
  (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack) {mv : CerbMem.MemValue},
  memValueFromValue M.tagDefs (Ctype [] (unatomic_ vty)) cv = some mv →
    CerberusHeapLang.StorableView M.tagDefs vty mv →
      (CerberusHeapLang.pointsToView M.tagDefs id a aty off dqm (Iris.DFrac.own 1) vty bs ∗
          ∀ fp,
            CerberusHeapLang.pointsToView M.tagDefs id a aty off dqm (Iris.DFrac.own 1) vty
                (CerbMem.memValueToBytes M.tagDefs [] mv).snd -∗
              Ψ (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.annot [DA_pos [] fp] Vunit) ρ) ⊢
        CerberusHeapLang.wps M p Ls Θ Ψ
          (CerberusHeapLang.storeExpr loc ann vty (CerberusHeapLang.cellPtr id (a + ↑off)) cv mo) ρ
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.wps_store_cell_at :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p : Option sym} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpec GF}
  {Θ : CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpec GF}
  {Ψ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF}
  (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ann : core_run_annotation) (id a : Int) (aty : ctype) (off : Nat)
  (vty : ctype) (cv : value) (mo : memory_order) (bs : List CerbMem.AbsByte)
  (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack) {mv : CerbMem.MemValue},
  memValueFromValue M.tagDefs (Ctype [] (unatomic_ vty)) cv = some mv →
    off + CerbMem.sizeofCtype M.tagDefs vty ≤ CerbMem.sizeofCtype M.tagDefs aty →
      CerberusHeapLang.StorableView M.tagDefs vty mv →
        CerberusHeapLang.decIndep M.tagDefs a aty
            (CerberusHeapLang.spliceBytes off (CerbMem.memValueToBytes M.tagDefs [] mv).snd bs) →
          (CerberusHeapLang.cellOwn M.tagDefs id (Iris.DFrac.own 1)
                { addr := a, ty := aty, bytes := bs } ∗
              ∀ fp,
                CerberusHeapLang.cellOwn M.tagDefs id (Iris.DFrac.own 1)
                    { addr := a, ty := aty,
                      bytes :=
                        CerberusHeapLang.spliceBytes off
                          (CerbMem.memValueToBytes M.tagDefs [] mv).snd bs } -∗
                  Ψ (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.annot [DA_pos [] fp] Vunit) ρ) ⊢
            CerberusHeapLang.wps M p Ls Θ Ψ
              (CerberusHeapLang.storeExpr loc ann vty (CerberusHeapLang.cellPtr id (a + ↑off)) cv
                mo)
              ρ
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.wps_store_eval :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p : Option sym} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpec GF}
  {Θ : CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpec GF}
  {Ψ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF}
  (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ann : core_run_annotation) (ty : ctype)
  (pe2 pe3 : generic_pexpr Unit sym) (mo : memory_order) (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack)
  {pv : CerbMem.PointerValue} {cv : value},
  valueFromPexprs [pe2, pe3] = none →
    CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr M.tagDefs M.extern ρ pe2 = some (Vobject (OVpointer pv)) →
      CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr M.tagDefs M.extern ρ pe3 = some cv →
        CerberusHeapLang.wps M p Ls Θ Ψ (CerberusHeapLang.storeExpr loc ann ty pv cv mo) ρ ⊢
          CerberusHeapLang.wps M p Ls Θ Ψ (CerberusHeapLang.storeOpRedex loc ann ty pe2 pe3 mo) ρ
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.wps_store_node_field :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p : Option sym} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpec GF}
  {Θ : CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpec GF}
  {Ψ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF}
  (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ann : core_run_annotation) (id a : Int) (off : Nat) (cv : value)
  (mo : memory_order) (bs : List CerbMem.AbsByte) (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack)
  {mv : CerbMem.MemValue},
  memValueFromValue M.tagDefs (Ctype [] (unatomic_ CerberusHeapLang.nodePtrTy)) cv = some mv →
    off + 8 ≤ CerbMem.sizeofCtype M.tagDefs CerberusHeapLang.nodeTy →
      (CerbMem.memValueToBytes M.tagDefs [] mv).snd.length = 8 →
        CerbMem.ctypeMemCompatible CerberusHeapLang.nodePtrTy (CerbMem.typeofMval mv) = true →
          (∀ (fpm : CerbMem.Funptrmap), (CerbMem.memValueToBytes M.tagDefs fpm mv).fst = fpm) →
            (∀ (fpm : CerbMem.Funptrmap),
                (CerbMem.memValueToBytes M.tagDefs fpm mv).snd =
                  (CerbMem.memValueToBytes M.tagDefs [] mv).snd) →
              (CerberusHeapLang.cellOwn M.tagDefs id (Iris.DFrac.own 1)
                    { addr := a, ty := CerberusHeapLang.nodeTy, bytes := bs } ∗
                  ∀ fp,
                    CerberusHeapLang.cellOwn M.tagDefs id (Iris.DFrac.own 1)
                        { addr := a, ty := CerberusHeapLang.nodeTy,
                          bytes :=
                            CerberusHeapLang.spliceBytes off
                              (CerbMem.memValueToBytes M.tagDefs [] mv).snd bs } -∗
                      Ψ (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.annot [DA_pos [] fp] Vunit) ρ) ⊢
                CerberusHeapLang.wps M p Ls Θ Ψ
                  (CerberusHeapLang.storeExpr loc ann CerberusHeapLang.nodePtrTy
                    (CerberusHeapLang.cellPtr id (a + ↑off)) cv mo)
                  ρ
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.wps_store_plain :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p : Option sym} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpec GF}
  {Θ : CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpec GF}
  {Ψ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF},
  (∀ (ds : List dyn_annotation) (v : value) (ρ' : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack),
      Ψ (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.annot ds v) ρ' = Ψ (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.pure v) ρ') →
    ∀ (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ann : core_run_annotation) (ty : ctype) (pv : CerbMem.PointerValue)
      (cv : value) (mo : memory_order) (mv : CerbMem.MemValue) (bs : List CerbMem.AbsByte)
      (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack),
      memValueFromValue M.tagDefs (Ctype [] (unatomic_ ty)) cv = some mv →
        CerberusHeapLang.StorableAt M.tagDefs ty mv →
          pv ↦c[M.tagDefs]{Iris.DFrac.own 1} ty ; bs ∗
              (pv ↦c[M.tagDefs]{Iris.DFrac.own 1} ty ;
                  (CerbMem.memValueToBytes M.tagDefs [] mv).snd -∗
                Ψ (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.pure Vunit) ρ) ⊢
            CerberusHeapLang.wps M p Ls Θ Ψ (CerberusHeapLang.storeExpr loc ann ty pv cv mo) ρ
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.wps_store_regionOwn_at :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p : Option sym} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpec GF}
  {Θ : CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpec GF}
  {Ψ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF}
  (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ann : core_run_annotation) (id a : Int) (n off : Nat) (vty : ctype)
  (cv : value) (mo : memory_order) (bs : List CerbMem.AbsByte) (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack)
  {mv : CerbMem.MemValue},
  memValueFromValue M.tagDefs (Ctype [] (unatomic_ vty)) cv = some mv →
    off + CerbMem.sizeofCtype M.tagDefs vty ≤ n →
      CerberusHeapLang.StorableView M.tagDefs vty mv →
        (CerberusHeapLang.regionOwn id a n (Iris.DFrac.own 1) bs ∗
            ∀ fp,
              CerberusHeapLang.regionOwn id a n (Iris.DFrac.own 1)
                  (CerberusHeapLang.spliceBytes off (CerbMem.memValueToBytes M.tagDefs [] mv).snd
                    bs) -∗
                Ψ (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.annot [DA_pos [] fp] Vunit) ρ) ⊢
          CerberusHeapLang.wps M p Ls Θ Ψ
            (CerberusHeapLang.storeExpr loc ann vty (CerberusHeapLang.cellPtr id (a + ↑off)) cv mo)
            ρ

  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p : Option sym} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpec GF}

  CerberusHeapLang.wps M p Ls Θ Ψ e ρ ⊣⊢

  CerberusHeapLang.wps M p Ls Θ Ψ (CerberusHeapLang.ofVal w) ρ ⊢ |={⊤}=> Ψ w ρ

theorem CerberusHeapLang.wps_wand :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p : Option sym} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpec GF}
  {Θ : CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpec GF}
  {Ψ₁ Ψ₂ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF}
  (e : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr) (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack),
  CerberusHeapLang.wps M p Ls Θ Ψ₁ e ρ ⊢
    (∀ w ρ', Ψ₁ w ρ' -∗ Ψ₂ w ρ') -∗ CerberusHeapLang.wps M p Ls Θ Ψ₂ e ρ

theorem CerberusHeapLang.wps_wseq :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p : Option sym} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpec GF}
  {Θ : CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpec GF}
  {Ψ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF} (a pa : List annot)
  (bty : core_base_type) (e1 e2 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr) (ev0 : Fmap sym value)
  (evs : List (Fmap sym value)),
  CerberusHeapLang.wps M p Ls Θ
      (fun w ρ' => CerberusHeapLang.wps M p Ls Θ (fun u ρ'' => Ψ (w.mergeInto u) ρ'') e2 ρ') e1
      (ev0 :: evs) ⊢
    CerberusHeapLang.wps M p Ls Θ Ψ
      (generic_expr.Expr a (Ewseq (Pattern pa (CaseBase (none, bty))) e1 e2)) (ev0 :: evs)
----
def CerberusHeapLang.wpt :
{hlc : Iris.HasLC} →
  {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} →
    [CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF] →
      CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx →
        Option sym →
          CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpecT GF →
            CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpecT GF →
              Nat →
                (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF) →
                  CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.wpt.eq_def :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx) (p : Option sym) (Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpecT GF)
  (Θ : CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpecT GF) (x : Nat),
  CerberusHeapLang.wpt M p Ls Θ x =
    have k := x;
    CerberusHeapLang.wpt.pre M p Ls Θ k fun k' x => CerberusHeapLang.wpt M p Ls Θ k'
----
def CerberusHeapLang.wpt.pre :
{hlc : Iris.HasLC} →
  {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} →
    [CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF] →
      CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx →
        Option sym →
          CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpecT GF →
            CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpecT GF →
              (k : Nat) →
                ((k' : Nat) →
                    k' < k →
                      (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF) →
                        CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF) →
                  (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF) →
                    CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.wpt_alloc :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p : Option sym} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpecT GF}
  {Θ : CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpecT GF}
  {Ψ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF}
  (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ann : core_run_annotation) (aprov sprov : CerbMem.Provenance)
  (alignN sizeN : Int) (pref : prefix0) (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack) {k : Nat},
  2 ≤ k →
    0 < CerberusHeapLang.regionCost alignN sizeN →
      (CerberusHeapLang.allocBudget (CerberusHeapLang.regionCost alignN sizeN) ∗
          ∀ id a,
            CerberusHeapLang.regionOwn id a sizeN.toNat (Iris.DFrac.own 1)
                  (List.replicate sizeN.toNat CerberusHeapLang.undefByte) ∗
                ⌜0 < a ∧ a + ↑sizeN.toNat ≤ 2 ^ 64⌝ -∗
              Ψ
                (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.pure
                  (Vobject (OVpointer (CerberusHeapLang.cellPtr id a))))
                ρ) ⊢
        CerberusHeapLang.wpt M p Ls Θ k Ψ
          (CerberusHeapLang.allocExpr loc ann (CerbMem.IntegerValue.IV aprov alignN)
            (CerbMem.IntegerValue.IV sprov sizeN) pref)
          ρ
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.wpt_alloc_eval :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p : Option sym} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpecT GF}
  {Θ : CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpecT GF}
  {Ψ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF}
  (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ann : core_run_annotation) (pe1 pe2 : generic_pexpr Unit sym)
  (pref : prefix0) (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack) {align size : CerbMem.IntegerValue} {k : Nat},
  valueFromPexprs [pe1, pe2] = none →
    CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr M.tagDefs M.extern ρ pe1 = some (Vobject (OVinteger align)) →
      CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr M.tagDefs M.extern ρ pe2 = some (Vobject (OVinteger size)) →
        CerberusHeapLang.wpt M p Ls Θ k Ψ (CerberusHeapLang.allocExpr loc ann align size pref) ρ ⊢
          CerberusHeapLang.wpt M p Ls Θ (k + 1) Ψ
            (CerberusHeapLang.allocOpRedex loc ann pe1 pe2 pref) ρ
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.wpt_alloc_lit_sym :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p : Option sym} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpecT GF}
  {Θ : CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpecT GF}
  {Ψ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF}
  (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ann : core_run_annotation) (align : CerbMem.IntegerValue) (n : sym)
  (pref : prefix0) (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack) {size : CerbMem.IntegerValue} {k : Nat},
  CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr M.tagDefs M.extern ρ (Pexpr [] () (PEsym n)) =
      some (Vobject (OVinteger size)) →
    CerberusHeapLang.wpt M p Ls Θ k Ψ (CerberusHeapLang.allocExpr loc ann align size pref) ρ ⊢
      CerberusHeapLang.wpt M p Ls Θ (k + 1) Ψ
        (CerberusHeapLang.allocOpRedex loc ann (Pexpr [] () (PEval (Vobject (OVinteger align))))
          (Pexpr [] () (PEsym n)) pref)
        ρ
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.wpt_annot :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p : Option sym} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpecT GF}
  {Θ : CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpecT GF} (ds : List dyn_annotation) (e : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr)
  (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack) {k : Nat}
  {Ψ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF},
  CerberusHeapLang.wpt M p Ls Θ k (fun w ρ' => Ψ (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.merge ds w) ρ') e ρ ⊢
    CerberusHeapLang.wpt M p Ls Θ (k + 1) Ψ (generic_expr.Expr [] (Eannot ds e)) ρ
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.wpt_annot_reindex :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p : Option sym} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpecT GF}
  {Θ : CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpecT GF} (a : List annot) (dsA dsB : List dyn_annotation)
  (c : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr) (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack) {k : Nat}
  {Ψ₁ Ψ₂ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF},
  (∀ (w : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal) (ρ' : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack),
      Ψ₁ (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.merge dsA w) ρ' =
        Ψ₂ (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.merge dsB w) ρ') →
    CerberusHeapLang.wpt M p Ls Θ k Ψ₁ (generic_expr.Expr a (Eannot dsA c)) ρ ⊢
      CerberusHeapLang.wpt M p Ls Θ k Ψ₂ (generic_expr.Expr a (Eannot dsB c)) ρ
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.wpt_call :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p : Option sym} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpecT GF}
  {Θ : CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpecT GF}
  {Ψ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF}
  {e : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {ctx : context} {f : sym} {pes : List (generic_pexpr Unit sym)}
  {params : List (sym × core_base_type)} {body : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {vs : List value}
  (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack) {m k' k : Nat},
  CerberusHeapLang.callRedex? e = some (ctx, f, pes) →
    CerberusHeapLang.lookupProc M.file M.extern f = some (params, body) →
      params.length = vs.length →
        CerberusHeapLang.evalPexprs M.tagDefs M.extern ρ pes = some vs →
          1 + m + k' ≤ k →
            ((Θ f m vs).fst ∗
                ∀ ret,
                  (Θ f m vs).snd ret -∗
                    CerberusHeapLang.wpt M p Ls Θ k' Ψ
                      (apply_ctx ctx (generic_expr.Expr [] (Epure (Pexpr [] () (PEval ret))))) ρ) ⊢
              CerberusHeapLang.wpt M p Ls Θ k Ψ e ρ
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.wpt_call_eq :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p : Option sym} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpecT GF}
  {Θ : CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpecT GF}
  {Ψ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF} {k : Nat}
  {e : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack},
  CerberusHeapLang.toVal e = none →
    CerberusHeapLang.jumpRedex? e = none →
      ∀ {ctx : context} {f : sym} {pes : List (generic_pexpr Unit sym)},
        CerberusHeapLang.callRedex? e = some (ctx, f, pes) →
          CerberusHeapLang.wpt M p Ls Θ k Ψ e ρ =
            iprop(|={⊤}=>
                ∃ params body vs m k' x,
                  ⌜CerberusHeapLang.lookupProc M.file M.extern f = some (params, body)⌝ ∗
                    ⌜params.length = vs.length⌝ ∗
                      ⌜CerberusHeapLang.evalPexprs M.tagDefs M.extern ρ pes = some vs⌝ ∗
                        (Θ f m vs).fst ∗
                          ∀ ret,
                            (Θ f m vs).snd ret -∗
                              CerberusHeapLang.wpt M p Ls Θ k' Ψ
                                (apply_ctx ctx
                                  (generic_expr.Expr [] (Epure (Pexpr [] () (PEval ret)))))
                                ρ)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.wpt_call_root :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p : Option sym} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpecT GF}
  {Θ : CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpecT GF}
  {Ψ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF} (a : List annot)
  (ra : core_run_annotation) (f : sym) (pes : List (generic_pexpr Unit sym))
  {params : List (sym × core_base_type)} {body : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {vs : List value}
  (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack) {m k' k : Nat},
  CerberusHeapLang.lookupProc M.file M.extern f = some (params, body) →
    params.length = vs.length →
      CerberusHeapLang.evalPexprs M.tagDefs M.extern ρ pes = some vs →
        1 + m + k' ≤ k →
          ((Θ f m vs).fst ∗
              ∀ ret,
                (Θ f m vs).snd ret -∗
                  CerberusHeapLang.wpt M p Ls Θ k' Ψ
                    (generic_expr.Expr [] (Epure (Pexpr [] () (PEval ret)))) ρ) ⊢
            CerberusHeapLang.wpt M p Ls Θ k Ψ (generic_expr.Expr a (Eproc ra (Sym f) pes)) ρ
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.wpt_case_value :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p : Option sym} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpecT GF}
  {Θ : CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpecT GF}
  {Ψ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF} (a : List annot)
  (pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym) (pats : List (pattern × CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr)) {cval : value}
  {e' : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack) {k : Nat},
  valueFromPexpr pe = some cval →
    select_case subst_sym_expr cval pats = some e' →
      CerberusHeapLang.wpt M p Ls Θ k Ψ e' ρ ⊢
        CerberusHeapLang.wpt M p Ls Θ (k + 1) Ψ (generic_expr.Expr a (Ecase pe pats)) ρ
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.wpt_create :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p : Option sym} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpecT GF}
  {Θ : CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpecT GF}
  {Ψ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF}
  (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ann : core_run_annotation) (aprov : CerbMem.Provenance) (alignN : Int)
  (ty : ctype) (pref : prefix0) (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack) {k : Nat},
  2 ≤ k →
    0 < CerbMem.sizeofCtype M.tagDefs ty →
      CerberusHeapLang.atomicTy ty = false →
        (∀ (a : Int),
            CerberusHeapLang.decIndep M.tagDefs a ty
              (List.replicate (CerbMem.sizeofCtype M.tagDefs ty) CerberusHeapLang.undefByte)) →
          (CerberusHeapLang.allocBudget (CerberusHeapLang.allocCost M.tagDefs ty alignN) ∗
              ∀ p,
                p ↦c[M.tagDefs]{Iris.DFrac.own 1} ty ;
                      List.replicate (CerbMem.sizeofCtype M.tagDefs ty) CerberusHeapLang.undefByte ∗
                    ⌜0 < CerberusHeapLang.addrOf p ∧ CerberusHeapLang.addrOf p < 2 ^ 64⌝ -∗
                  Ψ (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.pure (Vobject (OVpointer p))) ρ) ⊢
            CerberusHeapLang.wpt M p Ls Θ k Ψ
              (CerberusHeapLang.createExpr loc ann (CerbMem.IntegerValue.IV aprov alignN) ty pref) ρ
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.wpt_create_of_plan :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p : Option sym} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpecT GF}
  {Θ : CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpecT GF}
  {Ψ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF}
  (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ann : core_run_annotation) (aprov : CerbMem.Provenance)
  (req : CerberusHeapLang.AllocReq) (rest : List CerberusHeapLang.AllocReq) (pref : prefix0)
  (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack) {k : Nat},
  2 ≤ k →
    0 < CerbMem.sizeofCtype M.tagDefs req.ty →
      CerberusHeapLang.atomicTy req.ty = false →
        (∀ (a : Int),
            CerberusHeapLang.decIndep M.tagDefs a req.ty
              (List.replicate (CerbMem.sizeofCtype M.tagDefs req.ty) CerberusHeapLang.undefByte)) →
          (CerberusHeapLang.allocBudget (CerberusHeapLang.planCost M.tagDefs (req :: rest)) ∗
              ∀ p,
                p ↦c[M.tagDefs]{Iris.DFrac.own 1} req.ty ;
                      List.replicate (CerbMem.sizeofCtype M.tagDefs req.ty)
                        CerberusHeapLang.undefByte ∗
                    CerberusHeapLang.allocBudget (CerberusHeapLang.planCost M.tagDefs rest) ∗
                      ⌜0 < CerberusHeapLang.addrOf p ∧ CerberusHeapLang.addrOf p < 2 ^ 64⌝ -∗
                  Ψ (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.pure (Vobject (OVpointer p))) ρ) ⊢
            CerberusHeapLang.wpt M p Ls Θ k Ψ
              (CerberusHeapLang.createExpr loc ann (CerbMem.IntegerValue.IV aprov req.align) req.ty
                pref)
              ρ
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.wpt_det_step :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p : Option sym} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpecT GF}
  {Θ : CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpecT GF}
  {Ψ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF}
  {e : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack} {e' : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr}
  {ρ' : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack} {k : Nat},
  CerberusHeapLang.toVal e = none →
    CerberusHeapLang.jumpRedex? e = none →
      CerberusHeapLang.callRedex? e = none →
        (∀ (κ : List (Option sym × context)) (ℓ : exec_location) (σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem),
            CerberusHeapLang.Step M (e, ρ, { κ := κ, proc := p, execLoc := ℓ }, σ)
              (e', ρ', { κ := κ, proc := p, execLoc := ℓ }, σ)) →
          (∀ (κ : List (Option sym × context)) (ℓ : exec_location) (σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem)
              (out : CerberusHeapLang.Config),
              CerberusHeapLang.Step M (e, ρ, { κ := κ, proc := p, execLoc := ℓ }, σ) out →
                out = (e', ρ', { κ := κ, proc := p, execLoc := ℓ }, σ)) →
            CerberusHeapLang.wpt M p Ls Θ k Ψ e' ρ' ⊢ CerberusHeapLang.wpt M p Ls Θ (k + 1) Ψ e ρ
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.wpt_driver_aux :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M₀ : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {ctl : CerberusHeapLang.Ctl},
  M₀.tagDefs = fmapEmpty →
    M₀.extern = fmapEmpty →
      ∀ {Q : CerberusHeapLang.LabelMap},
        M₀.labelsAt ctl.proc = Q →
          ∀ {p : sym},
            ctl.proc = some p →
              ∀ {th₀ : thread_state},
                th₀.stack0 = ctl.toStack →
                  th₀.current_proc_opt = ctl.proc →
                    ctl.κ = [] →
                      (∀ (l : sym) (params : List (sym × core_base_type))
                          (cont : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr),
                          CerberusHeapLang.lookupLabel (M₀.labelsAt ctl.proc) l =
                              some (params, cont) →
                            CerberusHeapLang.Frag cont) →
                        (∀ (l : sym) (params : List (sym × core_base_type))
                            (cont : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr),
                            CerberusHeapLang.lookupLabel (M₀.labelsAt ctl.proc) l =
                                some (params, cont) →
                              CerberusHeapLang.pot cont ≤ lemDefaultFuel) →
                          ∀ (Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpecT GF)
                            (ψ : value → CerberusHeapLang.Mem → Prop) (k : Nat)
                            (e : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr) (ev0 : Fmap sym value)
                            (evs : List (Fmap sym value)) (σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem) (ns nt : Nat),
                            CerberusHeapLang.Frag e →
                              CerberusHeapLang.pot e ≤ lemDefaultFuel →
                                Iris.stateInterp σ ns [] nt ∗
                                    CerberusHeapLang.blockSpecsT M₀ ctl.proc Ls
                                        CerberusHeapLang.emptyProcSpecT
                                        (CerberusHeapLang.readoutPost ψ) ∗
                                      CerberusHeapLang.wpt M₀ ctl.proc Ls
                                        CerberusHeapLang.emptyProcSpecT k
                                        (CerberusHeapLang.readoutPost ψ) e (ev0 :: evs) ⊢
                                  |={⊤|}=>
                                    ⌜CerberusHeapLang.DriverDoneAt p Q th₀ e (ev0 :: evs) σ ψ k⌝
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.wpt_driver_cps :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M₀ : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx},
  M₀.tagDefs = fmapEmpty →
    M₀.extern = fmapEmpty →
      M₀.FragProcs →
        ∀ {th₀ : thread_state},
          th₀.current_loc = M₀.currentLoc →
            ∀ (Θ : CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpecT GF) (ψ : value → CerberusHeapLang.Mem → Prop)
              (k : Nat) (p : sym) (Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpecT GF)
              (Ψ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF)
              (κ : List (Option sym × context)) (ℓ : exec_location) (e : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr)
              (ev0 : Fmap sym value) (evs : List (Fmap sym value)) (σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem)
              (ns nt kc : Nat),
              (∃ params body,
                  CerberusHeapLang.lookupProc M₀.file M₀.extern p = some (params, body)) →
                CerberusHeapLang.Frag e →
                  CerberusHeapLang.pot e ≤ lemDefaultFuel →
                    Iris.stateInterp σ ns [] nt ∗
                        CerberusHeapLang.procSpecsT M₀ Θ ∗
                          CerberusHeapLang.blockSpecsT M₀ (some p) Ls Θ Ψ ∗
                            CerberusHeapLang.wpt M₀ (some p) Ls Θ k Ψ e (ev0 :: evs) ⊢
                      (∀ w ρ' ℓ' σ' ns' k',
                          ⌜CerberusHeapLang.SameTail (ev0 :: evs) ρ'⌝ -∗
                            ⌜CerberusHeapLang.deliveryCost w ≤ k'⌝ -∗
                              Iris.stateInterp σ' ns' [] nt -∗
                                Ψ w ρ' -∗
                                  |={⊤|}=>
                                    ⌜CerberusHeapLang.DriverDoneCtl M₀ th₀
                                        (CerberusHeapLang.ofVal w) ρ'
                                        { κ := κ, proc := some p, execLoc := ℓ' } σ' ψ
                                        (k' + kc)⌝) -∗
                        |={⊤|}=>
                          ⌜CerberusHeapLang.DriverDoneCtl M₀ th₀ e (ev0 :: evs)
                              { κ := κ, proc := some p, execLoc := ℓ } σ ψ (k + kc)⌝
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.wpt_driver_done :
∀ {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGpreS GF] {M₀ : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx}
  {ctl : CerberusHeapLang.Ctl},
  M₀.tagDefs = fmapEmpty →
    M₀.extern = fmapEmpty →
      ∀ {Q : CerberusHeapLang.LabelMap},
        M₀.labelsAt ctl.proc = Q →
          ∀ {p : sym},
            ctl.proc = some p →
              ∀ {th₀ : thread_state},
                th₀.stack0 = ctl.toStack →
                  th₀.current_proc_opt = ctl.proc →
                    ctl.κ = [] →
                      (∀ (l : sym) (params : List (sym × core_base_type))
                          (cont : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr),
                          CerberusHeapLang.lookupLabel (M₀.labelsAt ctl.proc) l =
                              some (params, cont) →
                            CerberusHeapLang.Frag cont) →
                        (∀ (l : sym) (params : List (sym × core_base_type))
                            (cont : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr),
                            CerberusHeapLang.lookupLabel (M₀.labelsAt ctl.proc) l =
                                some (params, cont) →
                              CerberusHeapLang.pot cont ≤ lemDefaultFuel) →
                          ∀
                            (Ls :
                              [CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS Iris.HasLC.hasLC GF] →
                                CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpecT GF)
                            (e₀ : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr) (ev00 : Fmap sym value)
                            (evs0 : List (Fmap sym value)) (σ₀ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem)
                            (m₀ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerberusHeapLang.SpikeCell),
                            CerberusHeapLang.Frag e₀ →
                              CerberusHeapLang.pot e₀ ≤ lemDefaultFuel →
                                CerberusHeapLang.Coh M₀.tagDefs σ₀ m₀ →
                                  ∀ (ψ : value → CerberusHeapLang.Mem → Prop) (k : Nat),
                                    (∀ [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS Iris.HasLC.hasLC GF],
                                        ([∗map] i ↦ c ∈ m₀,
                                            CerberusHeapLang.cellOwn M₀.tagDefs i (Iris.DFrac.own 1)
                                              c) ⊢
                                          CerberusHeapLang.blockSpecsT M₀ ctl.proc Ls
                                              CerberusHeapLang.emptyProcSpecT
                                              (CerberusHeapLang.readoutPost ψ) ∗
                                            CerberusHeapLang.wpt M₀ ctl.proc Ls
                                              CerberusHeapLang.emptyProcSpecT k
                                              (CerberusHeapLang.readoutPost ψ) e₀ (ev00 :: evs0)) →
                                      CerberusHeapLang.DriverDoneAt p Q th₀ e₀ (ev00 :: evs0) σ₀ ψ k
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.wpt_driver_done_alloc :
∀ {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGpreS GF] {M₀ : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx}
  {ctl : CerberusHeapLang.Ctl},
  M₀.tagDefs = fmapEmpty →
    M₀.extern = fmapEmpty →
      ∀ {Q : CerberusHeapLang.LabelMap},
        M₀.labelsAt ctl.proc = Q →
          ∀ {p : sym},
            ctl.proc = some p →
              ∀ {th₀ : thread_state},
                th₀.stack0 = ctl.toStack →
                  th₀.current_proc_opt = ctl.proc →
                    ctl.κ = [] →
                      (∀ (l : sym) (params : List (sym × core_base_type))
                          (cont : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr),
                          CerberusHeapLang.lookupLabel (M₀.labelsAt ctl.proc) l =
                              some (params, cont) →
                            CerberusHeapLang.Frag cont) →
                        (∀ (l : sym) (params : List (sym × core_base_type))
                            (cont : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr),
                            CerberusHeapLang.lookupLabel (M₀.labelsAt ctl.proc) l =
                                some (params, cont) →
                              CerberusHeapLang.pot cont ≤ lemDefaultFuel) →
                          ∀
                            (Ls :
                              [CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS Iris.HasLC.hasLC GF] →
                                CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpecT GF)
                            (e₀ : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr) (ev00 : Fmap sym value)
                            (evs0 : List (Fmap sym value)) (σ₀ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem)
                            (m₀ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerberusHeapLang.SpikeCell) (B : Nat),
                            CerberusHeapLang.Frag e₀ →
                              CerberusHeapLang.pot e₀ ≤ lemDefaultFuel →
                                CerberusHeapLang.LaunchCoh M₀.tagDefs σ₀ m₀ B →
                                  ∀ (ψ : value → CerberusHeapLang.Mem → Prop) (k : Nat),
                                    (∀ [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS Iris.HasLC.hasLC GF],
                                        ([∗map] i ↦ c ∈ m₀,
                                              CerberusHeapLang.cellOwn M₀.tagDefs i
                                                (Iris.DFrac.own 1) c) ∗
                                            CerberusHeapLang.allocBudget B ⊢
                                          CerberusHeapLang.blockSpecsT M₀ ctl.proc Ls
                                              CerberusHeapLang.emptyProcSpecT
                                              (CerberusHeapLang.readoutPost ψ) ∗
                                            CerberusHeapLang.wpt M₀ ctl.proc Ls
                                              CerberusHeapLang.emptyProcSpecT k
                                              (CerberusHeapLang.readoutPost ψ) e₀ (ev00 :: evs0)) →
                                      CerberusHeapLang.DriverDoneAt p Q th₀ e₀ (ev00 :: evs0) σ₀ ψ k
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.wpt_driver_done_procs :
∀ {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGpreS GF] {M₀ : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx},
  M₀.tagDefs = fmapEmpty →
    M₀.extern = fmapEmpty →
      M₀.FragProcs →
        ∀ {th₀ : thread_state},
          th₀.current_loc = M₀.currentLoc →
            ∀ {p : sym} {params : List (sym × core_base_type)} {body : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr},
              CerberusHeapLang.lookupProc M₀.file M₀.extern p = some (params, body) →
                ∀ (ℓ : exec_location)
                  (Θ :
                    [CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS Iris.HasLC.hasLC GF] → CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpecT GF)
                  (Ls :
                    [CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS Iris.HasLC.hasLC GF] → CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpecT GF)
                  (e₀ : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr) (ev00 : Fmap sym value)
                  (evs0 : List (Fmap sym value)) (σ₀ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem)
                  (m₀ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerberusHeapLang.SpikeCell) (B : Nat),
                  CerberusHeapLang.Frag e₀ →
                    CerberusHeapLang.pot e₀ ≤ lemDefaultFuel →
                      CerberusHeapLang.LaunchCoh M₀.tagDefs σ₀ m₀ B →
                        ∀ (ψ : value → CerberusHeapLang.Mem → Prop) (k : Nat),
                          (∀ [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS Iris.HasLC.hasLC GF],
                              ([∗map] i ↦ c ∈ m₀,
                                    CerberusHeapLang.cellOwn M₀.tagDefs i (Iris.DFrac.own 1) c) ∗
                                  CerberusHeapLang.allocBudget B ⊢
                                CerberusHeapLang.procSpecsT M₀ Θ ∗
                                  CerberusHeapLang.blockSpecsT M₀ (some p) Ls Θ
                                      (CerberusHeapLang.readoutPost ψ) ∗
                                    CerberusHeapLang.wpt M₀ (some p) Ls Θ k
                                      (CerberusHeapLang.readoutPost ψ) e₀ (ev00 :: evs0)) →
                            CerberusHeapLang.DriverDoneCtl M₀ th₀ e₀ (ev00 :: evs0)
                              { κ := [], proc := some p, execLoc := ℓ } σ₀ ψ k
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.wpt_empty_call_false :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p : Option sym} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpecT GF}
  {Ψ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF} {k : Nat}
  {e : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack},
  CerberusHeapLang.toVal e = none →
    CerberusHeapLang.jumpRedex? e = none →
      ∀ {q : context × sym × List (generic_pexpr Unit sym)},
        CerberusHeapLang.callRedex? e = some q →
          CerberusHeapLang.wpt M p Ls CerberusHeapLang.emptyProcSpecT k Ψ e ρ ⊢ |={⊤}=> False
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.wpt_frame :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p : Option sym} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpecT GF}
  {Θ : CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpecT GF}
  {Ψ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF} (R : Iris.IProp GF)
  (k : Nat) (e : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr) (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack),
  CerberusHeapLang.wpt M p Ls Θ k Ψ e ρ ∗ R ⊢
    CerberusHeapLang.wpt M p Ls Θ k (fun w ρ' => iprop(Ψ w ρ' ∗ R)) e ρ
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.wpt_frame_labels :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p : Option sym} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpecT GF}
  {Θ : CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpecT GF}
  {Ψ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF} (R : Iris.IProp GF)
  (k : Nat) (e : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr) (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack),
  CerberusHeapLang.wpt M p Ls Θ k Ψ e ρ ⊢
    R -∗
      CerberusHeapLang.wpt M p (CerberusHeapLang.frameLsT R Ls) Θ k (fun w ρ' => iprop(Ψ w ρ' ∗ R))
        e ρ

theorem CerberusHeapLang.wpt_free :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p : Option sym} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpecT GF}

  {Ψ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF}

  (bs : List CerbMem.AbsByte) (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack) {k : Nat},
  2 ≤ k →
    is_dynamic kind = true →
      CerberusHeapLang.regionOwn id a n (Iris.DFrac.own 1) bs ∗
          (CerberusHeapLang.deadRegion id a n -∗ Ψ (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.pure Vunit) ρ) ⊢
        CerberusHeapLang.wpt M p Ls Θ k Ψ
          (CerberusHeapLang.killExpr loc ann kind (CerberusHeapLang.cellPtr id a)) ρ

theorem CerberusHeapLang.wpt_fupd :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]

theorem CerberusHeapLang.wpt_if :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p : Option sym} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpecT GF}
  {Θ : CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpecT GF}
  {Ψ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF} (a : List annot)
  (g : generic_pexpr Unit sym) (e2 e3 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr) (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack)
  (b : Bool) {k : Nat},
  ⌜CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr M.tagDefs M.extern ρ g = some (CerberusHeapLang.boolValue b)⌝ ∗
      CerberusHeapLang.wpt M p Ls Θ k Ψ (bif b then e2 else e3) ρ ⊢
    CerberusHeapLang.wpt M p Ls Θ (k + 1) Ψ (generic_expr.Expr a (Eif g e2 e3)) ρ
----

    CerberusHeapLang.wpt M p Ls Θ k Ψ e3 ρ ⊢
      CerberusHeapLang.wpt M p Ls Θ (k + 1) Ψ (generic_expr.Expr a (Eif g e2 e3)) ρ

theorem CerberusHeapLang.wpt_jump_eq :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p : Option sym} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpecT GF}
  {Θ : CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpecT GF}
  {Ψ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF} (k : Nat)
  {e : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {l : sym} {pes : List (generic_pexpr Unit sym)}
  {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack},
  CerberusHeapLang.toVal e = none →
    CerberusHeapLang.jumpRedex? e = some (l, pes) →
      CerberusHeapLang.wpt M p Ls Θ k Ψ e ρ =
        iprop(|={⊤}=>
            ∃ params cont vs ev0 evs m,
              ⌜ρ = ev0 :: evs⌝ ∗
                ⌜CerberusHeapLang.lookupLabel (M.labelsAt p) l = some (params, cont)⌝ ∗
                  ⌜CerberusHeapLang.evalPexprs M.tagDefs M.extern ρ pes = some vs⌝ ∗
                    ⌜1 + m ≤ k⌝ ∗ Ls l m vs ρ)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.wpt_jump_frame_sseq :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p : Option sym} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpecT GF}
  {Θ : CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpecT GF}
  {Ψ₁ Ψ₂ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF} (a : List annot)
  (pat : pattern) {e1 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} (e2 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr)
  (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack) {l : sym} {pes : List (generic_pexpr Unit sym)} {k k' : Nat},
  k ≤ k' →
    CerberusHeapLang.toVal e1 = none →
      CerberusHeapLang.jumpRedex? e1 = some (l, pes) →
        CerberusHeapLang.wpt M p Ls Θ k Ψ₁ e1 ρ ⊢
          CerberusHeapLang.wpt M p Ls Θ k' Ψ₂ (generic_expr.Expr a (Esseq pat e1 e2)) ρ
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.wpt_jump_frame_wseq :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p : Option sym} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpecT GF}
  {Θ : CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpecT GF}

  (pat : pattern) {e1 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} (e2 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr)
  (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack) {l : sym} {pes : List (generic_pexpr Unit sym)} {k k' : Nat},
  k ≤ k' →
    CerberusHeapLang.toVal e1 = none →
      CerberusHeapLang.jumpRedex? e1 = some (l, pes) →
        CerberusHeapLang.wpt M p Ls Θ k Ψ₁ e1 ρ ⊢
          CerberusHeapLang.wpt M p Ls Θ k' Ψ₂ (generic_expr.Expr a (Ewseq pat e1 e2)) ρ
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.wpt_kill :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p : Option sym} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpecT GF}
  {Θ : CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpecT GF}
  {Ψ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF}
  (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ann : core_run_annotation) (kind : kill_kind)
  (pv : CerbMem.PointerValue) (ty : ctype) (bs : List CerbMem.AbsByte)
  (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack) {k : Nat},
  2 ≤ k →
    is_dynamic kind = false →
      pv ↦c[M.tagDefs]{Iris.DFrac.own 1} ty ; bs ∗
          ((∃ id a,
              ⌜pv = CerberusHeapLang.cellPtr id a⌝ ∗ CerberusHeapLang.deadObj M.tagDefs id a ty) -∗
            Ψ (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.pure Vunit) ρ) ⊢
        CerberusHeapLang.wpt M p Ls Θ k Ψ (CerberusHeapLang.killExpr loc ann kind pv) ρ
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.wpt_kill_emp :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p : Option sym} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpecT GF}
  {Θ : CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpecT GF}
  {Ψ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF}
  (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ann : core_run_annotation) (kind : kill_kind)
  (pv : CerbMem.PointerValue) (ty : ctype) (bs : List CerbMem.AbsByte)
  (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack) {k : Nat},
  2 ≤ k →
    is_dynamic kind = false →
      pv ↦c[M.tagDefs]{Iris.DFrac.own 1} ty ; bs ∗ Ψ (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.pure Vunit) ρ ⊢
        CerberusHeapLang.wpt M p Ls Θ k Ψ (CerberusHeapLang.killExpr loc ann kind pv) ρ
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.wpt_kill_eval :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p : Option sym} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpecT GF}
  {Θ : CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpecT GF}
  {Ψ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF}
  (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ann : core_run_annotation) (kind : kill_kind)
  (pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym) (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack) {pv : CerbMem.PointerValue}
  {k : Nat},
  valueFromPexpr pe = none →
    CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr M.tagDefs M.extern ρ pe = some (Vobject (OVpointer pv)) →
      CerberusHeapLang.wpt M p Ls Θ k Ψ (CerberusHeapLang.killExpr loc ann kind pv) ρ ⊢
        CerberusHeapLang.wpt M p Ls Θ (k + 1) Ψ (CerberusHeapLang.killOpRedex loc ann kind pe) ρ
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.wpt_load :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p : Option sym} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpecT GF}
  {Θ : CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpecT GF}
  {Ψ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF}
  (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ann : core_run_annotation) (ty : ctype) (pv : CerbMem.PointerValue)
  (mo : memory_order) (dq : Iris.DFrac) (bs : List CerbMem.AbsByte) (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack)
  {k : Nat},
  3 ≤ k →
    CerberusHeapLang.cellLoadTrap M.tagDefs
          { addr := CerberusHeapLang.addrOf pv, ty := ty, bytes := bs } =
        false →
      (pv ↦c[M.tagDefs]{dq} ty ; bs ∗
          ∀ fp,
            pv ↦c[M.tagDefs]{dq} ty ; bs -∗
              Ψ
                (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.annot [DA_pos [] fp]
                  (CerberusHeapLang.loadedVal M.tagDefs pv ty bs))
                ρ) ⊢
        CerberusHeapLang.wpt M p Ls Θ k Ψ (CerberusHeapLang.loadExpr loc ann ty pv mo) ρ
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.wpt_load_at :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p : Option sym} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpecT GF}
  {Θ : CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpecT GF}
  {Ψ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF}
  (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ann : core_run_annotation) (id a : Int) (aty : ctype) (off : Nat)
  (vty : ctype) (mo : memory_order) (dqm dqb : Iris.DFrac) (bs : List CerbMem.AbsByte)
  (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack) {mv : CerbMem.MemValue} {k : Nat},
  3 ≤ k →
    (∀ (lum : List (Int × identifier)) (fpm : CerbMem.Funptrmap),
        CerbMem.reconstructValue M.tagDefs lum fpm (a + ↑off) vty bs = mv) →
      CerberusHeapLang.loadTrapV vty mv = false →
        (CerberusHeapLang.pointsToView M.tagDefs id a aty off dqm dqb vty bs ∗
            ∀ fp,
              CerberusHeapLang.pointsToView M.tagDefs id a aty off dqm dqb vty bs -∗
                Ψ (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.annot [DA_pos [] fp] (valueFromMemValue mv).snd) ρ) ⊢
          CerberusHeapLang.wpt M p Ls Θ k Ψ
            (CerberusHeapLang.loadExpr loc ann vty (CerberusHeapLang.cellPtr id (a + ↑off)) mo) ρ
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.wpt_load_cell_at :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p : Option sym} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpecT GF}
  {Θ : CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpecT GF}
  {Ψ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF}
  (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ann : core_run_annotation) (id a : Int) (aty : ctype) (off : Nat)
  (vty : ctype) (mo : memory_order) (dq : Iris.DFrac) (bs : List CerbMem.AbsByte)
  (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack) {mv : CerbMem.MemValue} {k : Nat},
  3 ≤ k →
    off + CerbMem.sizeofCtype M.tagDefs vty ≤ CerbMem.sizeofCtype M.tagDefs aty →
      (∀ (lum : List (Int × identifier)) (fpm : CerbMem.Funptrmap),
          CerbMem.reconstructValue M.tagDefs lum fpm (a + ↑off) vty
              (List.take (CerbMem.sizeofCtype M.tagDefs vty) (List.drop off bs)) =
            mv) →
        CerberusHeapLang.loadTrapV vty mv = false →
          (CerberusHeapLang.cellOwn M.tagDefs id dq { addr := a, ty := aty, bytes := bs } ∗
              ∀ fp,
                CerberusHeapLang.cellOwn M.tagDefs id dq { addr := a, ty := aty, bytes := bs } -∗
                  Ψ (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.annot [DA_pos [] fp] (valueFromMemValue mv).snd) ρ) ⊢
            CerberusHeapLang.wpt M p Ls Θ k Ψ
              (CerberusHeapLang.loadExpr loc ann vty (CerberusHeapLang.cellPtr id (a + ↑off)) mo) ρ
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.wpt_load_eval :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p : Option sym} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpecT GF}
  {Θ : CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpecT GF}
  {Ψ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF}
  (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ann : core_run_annotation) (ty : ctype) (pe2 : generic_pexpr Unit sym)
  (mo : memory_order) (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack) {pv : CerbMem.PointerValue} {k : Nat},
  valueFromPexpr pe2 = none →
    CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr M.tagDefs M.extern ρ pe2 = some (Vobject (OVpointer pv)) →
      CerberusHeapLang.wpt M p Ls Θ k Ψ (CerberusHeapLang.loadExpr loc ann ty pv mo) ρ ⊢
        CerberusHeapLang.wpt M p Ls Θ (k + 1) Ψ (CerberusHeapLang.loadOpRedex loc ann ty pe2 mo) ρ
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.wpt_load_node_field :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p : Option sym} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpecT GF}
  {Θ : CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpecT GF}
  {Ψ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF}
  (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ann : core_run_annotation) (id a : Int) (off : Nat) (mo : memory_order)
  (dq : Iris.DFrac) (bs : List CerbMem.AbsByte) (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack)
  {mv : CerbMem.MemValue} {k : Nat},
  3 ≤ k →
    off + 8 ≤ CerbMem.sizeofCtype M.tagDefs CerberusHeapLang.nodeTy →
      (∀ (lum : List (Int × identifier)) (fpm : CerbMem.Funptrmap),
          CerbMem.reconstructValue M.tagDefs lum fpm (a + ↑off) CerberusHeapLang.nodePtrTy
              (List.take 8 (List.drop off bs)) =
            mv) →
        (CerberusHeapLang.cellOwn M.tagDefs id dq
              { addr := a, ty := CerberusHeapLang.nodeTy, bytes := bs } ∗
            ∀ fp,
              CerberusHeapLang.cellOwn M.tagDefs id dq
                  { addr := a, ty := CerberusHeapLang.nodeTy, bytes := bs } -∗
                Ψ (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.annot [DA_pos [] fp] (valueFromMemValue mv).snd) ρ) ⊢
          CerberusHeapLang.wpt M p Ls Θ k Ψ
            (CerberusHeapLang.loadExpr loc ann CerberusHeapLang.nodePtrTy
              (CerberusHeapLang.cellPtr id (a + ↑off)) mo)
            ρ
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.wpt_load_plain :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p : Option sym} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpecT GF}
  {Θ : CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpecT GF}
  {Ψ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF},
  CerberusHeapLang.AnnotInsensitive Ψ →
    ∀ (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ann : core_run_annotation) (ty : ctype) (pv : CerbMem.PointerValue)
      (mo : memory_order) (dq : Iris.DFrac) (bs : List CerbMem.AbsByte)
      (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack) {k : Nat},
      3 ≤ k →
        CerberusHeapLang.cellLoadTrap M.tagDefs
              { addr := CerberusHeapLang.addrOf pv, ty := ty, bytes := bs } =
            false →
          pv ↦c[M.tagDefs]{dq} ty ; bs ∗
              (pv ↦c[M.tagDefs]{dq} ty ; bs -∗
                Ψ (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.pure (CerberusHeapLang.loadedVal M.tagDefs pv ty bs))
                  ρ) ⊢
            CerberusHeapLang.wpt M p Ls Θ k Ψ (CerberusHeapLang.loadExpr loc ann ty pv mo) ρ
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.wpt_load_regionOwn_at :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p : Option sym} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpecT GF}
  {Θ : CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpecT GF}
  {Ψ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF}
  (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ann : core_run_annotation) (id a : Int) (n off : Nat) (vty : ctype)
  (mo : memory_order) (dq : Iris.DFrac) (bs : List CerbMem.AbsByte) (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack)
  {mv : CerbMem.MemValue} {k : Nat},
  3 ≤ k →
    off + CerbMem.sizeofCtype M.tagDefs vty ≤ n →
      (∀ (lum : List (Int × identifier)) (fpm : CerbMem.Funptrmap),
          CerbMem.reconstructValue M.tagDefs lum fpm (a + ↑off) vty
              (List.take (CerbMem.sizeofCtype M.tagDefs vty) (List.drop off bs)) =
            mv) →
        CerberusHeapLang.loadTrapV vty mv = false →
          (CerberusHeapLang.regionOwn id a n dq bs ∗
              ∀ fp,
                CerberusHeapLang.regionOwn id a n dq bs -∗
                  Ψ (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.annot [DA_pos [] fp] (valueFromMemValue mv).snd) ρ) ⊢
            CerberusHeapLang.wpt M p Ls Θ k Ψ
              (CerberusHeapLang.loadExpr loc ann vty (CerberusHeapLang.cellPtr id (a + ↑off)) mo) ρ
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.wpt_load_region_at :

  (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack) {mv : CerbMem.MemValue} {k : Nat},
  3 ≤ k →
    (∀ (lum : List (Int × identifier)) (fpm : CerbMem.Funptrmap),
        CerbMem.reconstructValue M.tagDefs lum fpm (a + ↑off) vty bs = mv) →
      CerberusHeapLang.loadTrapV vty mv = false →

          CerberusHeapLang.wpt M p Ls Θ k Ψ
            (CerberusHeapLang.loadExpr loc ann vty (CerberusHeapLang.cellPtr id (a + ↑off)) mo) ρ

theorem CerberusHeapLang.wpt_memop_eval :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p : Option sym} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpecT GF}
  {Θ : CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpecT GF}
  {Ψ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF} (mop : memop)
  (pe1 pe2 : generic_pexpr Unit sym) {v1 v2 : value} (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack) {k : Nat},
  valueFromPexprs [pe1, pe2] = none →
    CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr M.tagDefs M.extern ρ pe1 = some v1 →
      CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr M.tagDefs M.extern ρ pe2 = some v2 →
        CerberusHeapLang.wpt M p Ls Θ k Ψ
            (CerberusHeapLang.memopRedex mop [Pexpr [] () (PEval v1), Pexpr [] () (PEval v2)]) ρ ⊢
          CerberusHeapLang.wpt M p Ls Θ (k + 1) Ψ (CerberusHeapLang.memopRedex mop [pe1, pe2]) ρ
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.wpt_memop_ptreq :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p : Option sym} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpecT GF}
  {Θ : CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpecT GF}
  {Ψ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF}
  (pv1 pv2 : CerbMem.PointerValue) {b : Bool} (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack) {k : Nat},
  2 ≤ k →
    (∀ (σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem),
        CerberusHeapLang.applyMemM (CerbMem.eqPtrval default pv1 pv2) σ = some (b, σ)) →
      Ψ (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.pure (CerberusHeapLang.boolValue b)) ρ ⊢
        CerberusHeapLang.wpt M p Ls Θ k Ψ
          (CerberusHeapLang.memopPtrEqVals (Vobject (OVpointer pv1)) (Vobject (OVpointer pv2))) ρ
----

theorem CerberusHeapLang.wpt_of_atomic :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p : Option sym} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpecT GF}
  {Θ : CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpecT GF}
  {Ψ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF}
  {e : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack} {c : Nat} {P : Iris.IProp GF}
  {Q : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → Iris.IProp GF} {k : Nat},
  (∀ (κ : List (Option sym × context)) (ℓ : exec_location),
      CerberusHeapLang.AtomicStep M { κ := κ, proc := p, execLoc := ℓ } e ρ c P Q) →
    CerberusHeapLang.toVal e = none →
      CerberusHeapLang.jumpRedex? e = none →
        CerberusHeapLang.callRedex? e = none →
          c + 1 ≤ k → (P ∗ ∀ w, Q w -∗ Ψ w ρ) ⊢ CerberusHeapLang.wpt M p Ls Θ k Ψ e ρ
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.wpt_pure :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p : Option sym} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpecT GF}
  {Θ : CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpecT GF}
  {Ψ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF}
  (pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym) (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack) {v : value} {k : Nat},
  2 ≤ k →
    valueFromPexpr pe = none →
      CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr M.tagDefs M.extern ρ pe = some v →
        Ψ (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.pure v) ρ ⊢
          CerberusHeapLang.wpt M p Ls Θ k Ψ (generic_expr.Expr [] (Epure pe)) ρ
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.wpt_run :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p : Option sym} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpecT GF}
  {Θ : CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpecT GF}
  {Ψ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF} (a : List annot)
  (ra : core_run_annotation) (l : sym) (pes : List (generic_pexpr Unit sym))
  {params : List (sym × core_base_type)} {cont : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {vs : List value}
  (ev0 : Fmap sym value) (evs : List (Fmap sym value)) (m : Nat) {k : Nat},
  CerberusHeapLang.lookupLabel (M.labelsAt p) l = some (params, cont) →
    CerberusHeapLang.evalPexprs M.tagDefs M.extern (ev0 :: evs) pes = some vs →
      1 + m ≤ k →
        Ls l m vs (ev0 :: evs) ⊢
          CerberusHeapLang.wpt M p Ls Θ k Ψ (generic_expr.Expr a (Erun ra l pes)) (ev0 :: evs)
----

∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p : Option sym} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpecT GF}

    List
      (sym × (core_base_type × Option (ctype × pass_by_value_or_pointer)) × generic_pexpr Unit sym))

        (CerberusHeapLang.saveParamPexprs ps) =
      some cvals →
    CerberusHeapLang.wpt M p Ls Θ k Ψ body (CerberusHeapLang.bindSaveParams ps cvals (ev0 :: evs)) ⊢
      CerberusHeapLang.wpt M p Ls Θ (k + CerberusHeapLang.saveEntryCost ps) Ψ
        (generic_expr.Expr a (Esave sb ps body)) (ev0 :: evs)

theorem CerberusHeapLang.wpt_seq :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p : Option sym} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpecT GF}
  {Θ : CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpecT GF}
  {Ψ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF} (a pa : List annot)
  (bty : core_base_type) (e1 e2 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr) (ev0 : Fmap sym value)
  (evs : List (Fmap sym value)) (k1 k2 : Nat),
  CerberusHeapLang.wpt M p Ls Θ k1
      (fun w ρ' => CerberusHeapLang.wpt M p Ls Θ k2 (fun u ρ'' => Ψ (w.mergeInto u) ρ'') e2 ρ') e1
      (ev0 :: evs) ⊢
    CerberusHeapLang.wpt M p Ls Θ (k1 + k2) Ψ
      (generic_expr.Expr a (Esseq (Pattern pa (CaseBase (none, bty))) e1 e2)) (ev0 :: evs)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.wpt_seq_spec :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p : Option sym} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpecT GF}
  {Θ : CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpecT GF}
  {Ψ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF} (a pa pb : List annot)
  (x : sym) (bty : core_base_type) (e1 e2 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr) (ev0 : Fmap sym value)
  (evs : List (Fmap sym value)) (k1 k2 : Nat),
  CerberusHeapLang.wpt M p Ls Θ k1
      (fun w ρ' =>
        iprop(∃ ov,
            ⌜w.val = Vloaded (LVspecified ov)⌝ ∗
              CerberusHeapLang.wpt M p Ls Θ k2 (fun u ρ'' => Ψ (w.mergeInto u) ρ'') e2
                (update_env (CerberusHeapLang.specPat pa pb x bty) (Vloaded (LVspecified ov)) ρ')))
      e1 (ev0 :: evs) ⊢
    CerberusHeapLang.wpt M p Ls Θ (k1 + k2) Ψ
      (generic_expr.Expr a (Esseq (CerberusHeapLang.specPat pa pb x bty) e1 e2)) (ev0 :: evs)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.wpt_seq_sym :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p : Option sym} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpecT GF}
  {Θ : CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpecT GF}
  {Ψ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF} (a pa : List annot)
  (x : sym) (bty : core_base_type) (e1 e2 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr) (ev0 : Fmap sym value)
  (evs : List (Fmap sym value)) (k1 k2 : Nat),
  CerberusHeapLang.wpt M p Ls Θ k1
      (fun w ρ' =>
        iprop(∃ v,
            ⌜w = CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.pure v⌝ ∗
              CerberusHeapLang.wpt M p Ls Θ k2 Ψ e2
                (update_env (CerberusHeapLang.symPat pa x bty) v ρ')))
      e1 (ev0 :: evs) ⊢
    CerberusHeapLang.wpt M p Ls Θ (k1 + k2) Ψ
      (generic_expr.Expr a (Esseq (CerberusHeapLang.symPat pa x bty) e1 e2)) (ev0 :: evs)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.wpt_sound :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpecT GF}
  {Θ : CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpecT GF}
  {Ψ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF}
  {ctl : CerberusHeapLang.Ctl},
  ctl.κ = [] →
    ∀ (k : Nat) (e : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr) (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack),
      CerberusHeapLang.procSpecsT M Θ ∗ CerberusHeapLang.blockSpecsT M ctl.proc Ls Θ Ψ ⊢
        CerberusHeapLang.wpt M ctl.proc Ls Θ k Ψ e ρ -∗
          WP { e := e, ρ := ρ, ctl := ctl, M := M } @ Iris.Stuckness.NotStuck ; ⊤ [{ w, Ψ w.w w.ρ }]
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.wpt_sound_cps :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {Θ : CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpecT GF} (p : Option sym)
  (Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpecT GF)
  (Ψ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF) (k : Nat)
  (κ : List (Option sym × context)) (ℓ : exec_location) (e : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr)
  (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack) (Φ : CerberusHeapLang.CoreRVal → Iris.IProp GF),
  CerberusHeapLang.procSpecsT M Θ ⊢
    CerberusHeapLang.blockSpecsT M p Ls Θ Ψ -∗
      CerberusHeapLang.wpt M p Ls Θ k Ψ e ρ -∗
        (∀ ℓ' w ρ',
            ⌜CerberusHeapLang.SameTail ρ ρ'⌝ -∗
              Ψ w ρ' -∗
                WP
                  { e := CerberusHeapLang.ofVal w, ρ := ρ',
                    ctl := { κ := κ, proc := p, execLoc := ℓ' }, M := M } @
                  Iris.Stuckness.NotStuck ; ⊤ [{ Φ }] ) -∗
          WP { e := e, ρ := ρ, ctl := { κ := κ, proc := p, execLoc := ℓ }, M := M } @
            Iris.Stuckness.NotStuck ; ⊤ [{ Φ }]
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.wpt_sound_empty :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpecT GF}
  {Ψ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF}
  {ctl : CerberusHeapLang.Ctl},
  ctl.κ = [] →
    ∀ (k : Nat) (e : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr) (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack),
      CerberusHeapLang.blockSpecsT M ctl.proc Ls CerberusHeapLang.emptyProcSpecT Ψ ⊢
        CerberusHeapLang.wpt M ctl.proc Ls CerberusHeapLang.emptyProcSpecT k Ψ e ρ -∗
          WP { e := e, ρ := ρ, ctl := ctl, M := M } @ Iris.Stuckness.NotStuck ; ⊤ [{ w, Ψ w.w w.ρ }]
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.wpt_step_eq :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p : Option sym} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpecT GF}
  {Θ : CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpecT GF}
  {Ψ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF} (k : Nat)
  {e : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack},
  CerberusHeapLang.toVal e = none →
    CerberusHeapLang.jumpRedex? e = none →
      CerberusHeapLang.callRedex? e = none →
        CerberusHeapLang.wpt M p Ls Θ (k + 1) Ψ e ρ =
          iprop(∀ κ ℓ σ₁ ns obs nt,
              Iris.stateInterp σ₁ ns obs nt ={⊤,∅}=∗
                ⌜Iris.ProgramLogic.PrimStep.Reducible
                      ({ e := e, ρ := ρ, ctl := { κ := κ, proc := p, execLoc := ℓ }, M := M },
                        σ₁)⌝ ∗
                  ∀ r σ₂ eₜ,
                    ⌜Iris.ProgramLogic.PrimStep.primStep
                          ({ e := e, ρ := ρ, ctl := { κ := κ, proc := p, execLoc := ℓ }, M := M },
                            σ₁)
                          [] (r, σ₂, eₜ)⌝ ={∅,⊤}=∗
                      Iris.stateInterp σ₂ (ns + 1) obs nt ∗
                        CerberusHeapLang.wpt M p Ls Θ k Ψ r.e r.ρ)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.wpt_store :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p : Option sym} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpecT GF}
  {Θ : CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpecT GF}
  {Ψ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF}
  (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ann : core_run_annotation) (ty : ctype) (pv : CerbMem.PointerValue)
  (cv : value) (mo : memory_order) (mv : CerbMem.MemValue) (bs : List CerbMem.AbsByte)
  (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack) {k : Nat},
  3 ≤ k →
    memValueFromValue M.tagDefs (Ctype [] (unatomic_ ty)) cv = some mv →
      CerberusHeapLang.StorableAt M.tagDefs ty mv →
        (pv ↦c[M.tagDefs]{Iris.DFrac.own 1} ty ; bs ∗
            ∀ fp,
              pv ↦c[M.tagDefs]{Iris.DFrac.own 1} ty ;
                  (CerbMem.memValueToBytes M.tagDefs [] mv).snd -∗
                Ψ (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.annot [DA_pos [] fp] Vunit) ρ) ⊢
          CerberusHeapLang.wpt M p Ls Θ k Ψ (CerberusHeapLang.storeExpr loc ann ty pv cv mo) ρ
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.wpt_store_at :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p : Option sym} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpecT GF}
  {Θ : CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpecT GF}
  {Ψ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF}
  (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ann : core_run_annotation) (id a : Int) (aty : ctype) (off : Nat)
  (vty : ctype) (cv : value) (mo : memory_order) (dqm : Iris.DFrac) (bs : List CerbMem.AbsByte)
  (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack) {mv : CerbMem.MemValue} {k : Nat},
  3 ≤ k →
    memValueFromValue M.tagDefs (Ctype [] (unatomic_ vty)) cv = some mv →
      CerberusHeapLang.StorableView M.tagDefs vty mv →
        (CerberusHeapLang.pointsToView M.tagDefs id a aty off dqm (Iris.DFrac.own 1) vty bs ∗
            ∀ fp,
              CerberusHeapLang.pointsToView M.tagDefs id a aty off dqm (Iris.DFrac.own 1) vty
                  (CerbMem.memValueToBytes M.tagDefs [] mv).snd -∗
                Ψ (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.annot [DA_pos [] fp] Vunit) ρ) ⊢
          CerberusHeapLang.wpt M p Ls Θ k Ψ
            (CerberusHeapLang.storeExpr loc ann vty (CerberusHeapLang.cellPtr id (a + ↑off)) cv mo)
            ρ

theorem CerberusHeapLang.wpt_store_cell_at :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p : Option sym} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpecT GF}
  {Θ : CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpecT GF}
  {Ψ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF}
  (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ann : core_run_annotation) (id a : Int) (aty : ctype) (off : Nat)
  (vty : ctype) (cv : value) (mo : memory_order) (bs : List CerbMem.AbsByte)
  (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack) {mv : CerbMem.MemValue} {k : Nat},
  3 ≤ k →
    memValueFromValue M.tagDefs (Ctype [] (unatomic_ vty)) cv = some mv →
      off + CerbMem.sizeofCtype M.tagDefs vty ≤ CerbMem.sizeofCtype M.tagDefs aty →
        CerberusHeapLang.StorableView M.tagDefs vty mv →
          CerberusHeapLang.decIndep M.tagDefs a aty
              (CerberusHeapLang.spliceBytes off (CerbMem.memValueToBytes M.tagDefs [] mv).snd bs) →
            (CerberusHeapLang.cellOwn M.tagDefs id (Iris.DFrac.own 1)
                  { addr := a, ty := aty, bytes := bs } ∗
                ∀ fp,
                  CerberusHeapLang.cellOwn M.tagDefs id (Iris.DFrac.own 1)
                      { addr := a, ty := aty,
                        bytes :=
                          CerberusHeapLang.spliceBytes off
                            (CerbMem.memValueToBytes M.tagDefs [] mv).snd bs } -∗
                    Ψ (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.annot [DA_pos [] fp] Vunit) ρ) ⊢
              CerberusHeapLang.wpt M p Ls Θ k Ψ
                (CerberusHeapLang.storeExpr loc ann vty (CerberusHeapLang.cellPtr id (a + ↑off)) cv
                  mo)
                ρ

theorem CerberusHeapLang.wpt_store_eval :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p : Option sym} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpecT GF}

  {Ψ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF}

  (pe2 pe3 : generic_pexpr Unit sym) (mo : memory_order) (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack)
  {pv : CerbMem.PointerValue} {cv : value} {k : Nat},
  valueFromPexprs [pe2, pe3] = none →
    CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr M.tagDefs M.extern ρ pe2 = some (Vobject (OVpointer pv)) →
      CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr M.tagDefs M.extern ρ pe3 = some cv →
        CerberusHeapLang.wpt M p Ls Θ k Ψ (CerberusHeapLang.storeExpr loc ann ty pv cv mo) ρ ⊢
          CerberusHeapLang.wpt M p Ls Θ (k + 1) Ψ
            (CerberusHeapLang.storeOpRedex loc ann ty pe2 pe3 mo) ρ

∀ {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS Iris.HasLC.hasLC GF]

theorem CerberusHeapLang.wpt_store_node_field :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p : Option sym} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpecT GF}
  {Θ : CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpecT GF}
  {Ψ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF}
  (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ann : core_run_annotation) (id a : Int) (off : Nat) (cv : value)
  (mo : memory_order) (bs : List CerbMem.AbsByte) (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack)
  {mv : CerbMem.MemValue} {k : Nat},
  3 ≤ k →
    memValueFromValue M.tagDefs (Ctype [] (unatomic_ CerberusHeapLang.nodePtrTy)) cv = some mv →
      off + 8 ≤ CerbMem.sizeofCtype M.tagDefs CerberusHeapLang.nodeTy →
        (CerbMem.memValueToBytes M.tagDefs [] mv).snd.length = 8 →
          CerbMem.ctypeMemCompatible CerberusHeapLang.nodePtrTy (CerbMem.typeofMval mv) = true →
            (∀ (fpm : CerbMem.Funptrmap), (CerbMem.memValueToBytes M.tagDefs fpm mv).fst = fpm) →
              (∀ (fpm : CerbMem.Funptrmap),
                  (CerbMem.memValueToBytes M.tagDefs fpm mv).snd =
                    (CerbMem.memValueToBytes M.tagDefs [] mv).snd) →
                (CerberusHeapLang.cellOwn M.tagDefs id (Iris.DFrac.own 1)
                      { addr := a, ty := CerberusHeapLang.nodeTy, bytes := bs } ∗
                    ∀ fp,
                      CerberusHeapLang.cellOwn M.tagDefs id (Iris.DFrac.own 1)
                          { addr := a, ty := CerberusHeapLang.nodeTy,
                            bytes :=
                              CerberusHeapLang.spliceBytes off
                                (CerbMem.memValueToBytes M.tagDefs [] mv).snd bs } -∗
                        Ψ (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.annot [DA_pos [] fp] Vunit) ρ) ⊢
                  CerberusHeapLang.wpt M p Ls Θ k Ψ
                    (CerberusHeapLang.storeExpr loc ann CerberusHeapLang.nodePtrTy
                      (CerberusHeapLang.cellPtr id (a + ↑off)) cv mo)
                    ρ

theorem CerberusHeapLang.wpt_unfold :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p : Option sym} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpecT GF}

  (Ψ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF)
  (e : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr) (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack),
  CerberusHeapLang.wpt M p Ls Θ k Ψ e ρ =
    CerberusHeapLang.wpt.pre M p Ls Θ k (fun k' x => CerberusHeapLang.wpt M p Ls Θ k') Ψ e ρ

theorem CerberusHeapLang.wpt_val_eq :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p : Option sym} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpecT GF}
  {Θ : CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpecT GF}
  {Ψ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF} (k : Nat)
  {e : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {w : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal} {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack},
  CerberusHeapLang.toVal e = some w →
    CerberusHeapLang.wpt M p Ls Θ k Ψ e ρ =
      iprop(⌜CerberusHeapLang.deliveryCost w ≤ k⌝ ∗ |={⊤}=> Ψ w ρ)

theorem CerberusHeapLang.wpt_wseq :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p : Option sym} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpecT GF}
  {Θ : CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpecT GF}
  {Ψ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF} (a pa : List annot)
  (bty : core_base_type) (e1 e2 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr) (ev0 : Fmap sym value)
  (evs : List (Fmap sym value)) (k1 k2 : Nat),
  CerberusHeapLang.wpt M p Ls Θ k1
      (fun w ρ' => CerberusHeapLang.wpt M p Ls Θ k2 (fun u ρ'' => Ψ (w.mergeInto u) ρ'') e2 ρ') e1
      (ev0 :: evs) ⊢
    CerberusHeapLang.wpt M p Ls Θ (k1 + k2) Ψ
      (generic_expr.Expr a (Ewseq (Pattern pa (CaseBase (none, bty))) e1 e2)) (ev0 :: evs)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.wpt_zero_step_eq :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p : Option sym} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpecT GF}
  {Θ : CerberusHeapLang.ProcSpecT GF}
  {Ψ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF}
  {e : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack},
  CerberusHeapLang.toVal e = none →
    CerberusHeapLang.jumpRedex? e = none →
      CerberusHeapLang.callRedex? e = none → CerberusHeapLang.wpt M p Ls Θ 0 Ψ e ρ = iprop(False)
----
